Russia here. A WAR, A MOS and F SEV hold this fall. None moves toward Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw or Berlin. F BOT stays in the Gulf of Bothnia, out of the Baltic. Please keep A BER, A MUN, A HOL and A KIE west as agreed, and keep F BAL out of Russian waters.

Russia here. This fall A WAR and F SEV hold, so no move into Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople from us. I'll keep the Black Sea line, but I expect A RUM to withdraw from my centre in time. F BLA must stay off Sevastopol and out of Armenia. Tell me if your fleet moves into the Black Sea this spring.

Turkey here. Agreed: F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. For Serbia this fall, my A SER holds and I press Austria from there; I am not sending units to Budapest or Trieste, so no bounce risk from my side. Please keep F NAP, A VEN and F TYS away from Greece. We remain at peace.

Turkey here. I am holding A RUM this fall and will not move it. Your A WAR and F SEV must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople, and I keep F BLA off Sevastopol and out of Armenia. If you attack RUM, I will defend it. Confirm your Black Sea orders hold so we avoid a clash.

notes.note: Fall 1905: all hold to keep promises. England kept word on BEL (F BEL stays), Italy kept word on WES/Tunis/Marseille, Germany kept out of Burgundy. No unowned centers reachable. Next: if England or Italy breaks, MAO to WES then convoy SPA to NAF/TUN. Watch F BEL and German moves into Holland/Belgium.

Fall 1905: holding all units. A NOR stays to take NOR this Fall (ENGLAND claims it too; watch). Turkey's A RUM still sits on RUM; no clash with Turkey's Black Sea line. Keep Austria and Germany deals (no Galicia, Prussia, Silesia moves). Next: consider attacking RUM with support if Turkey keeps refusing to withdraw.

Fall 1905: hold Trieste with F TRI, supported by BUD and VIE (holding). Promised Turkey and Italy no Serbia/Bulgaria/Greece or Venice/Tyrolia entry. Italy (VEN, NAP) attacked TRI in Spring and asked for withdrawal; watch whether it pulls back. Keep defensive; Turkey's SER holds and Russia is quiet.

Fall 1905: holding BER, HOL, KIE, MUN per pacts with England, Russia, Austria, France. F BAL to SWE to keep Sweden occupied. Pacts kept so far by England and Russia. Growth needs taking from neighbors later; watch Russia's WAR/MOS toward Prussia and England's BEL toward HOL.

Fall 1905: all hold. VEN to TRI has no ROM support option and would bounce vs F TRI. Austria asked us to withdraw; I did not confirm. Turkey kept AEG out of Ionian and stays out of Apulia/Naples. Keep NAP/ROM/TYS out of Greece and Ionian. Revisit TRI only with support, e.g. Turkey taking BUD/SER.

Fall 1905: all holds. NOR is Russian-held (A NOR holds); we cannot dislodge it with one fleet and convoy, so expect to lose it. Keep BEL out of Holland, avoid Denmark/Sweden, keep MAO out of Channel promise to France. Russia and Germany claim peace; France says Bur/Pic stay clear. Watch Germany F BAL and Russia on Nor. Look at Spain/Portugal later with France if it opens.

Fall 1905: holding all centers. BLA supports RUM holding against Russia's WAR/SEV. Keeping promises: AEG out of ION, no moves into BUL/GRE/APU. Russia threatens RUM; Austria and Italy have kept peace. Next: reassess Austrian SER/BUD front and Russian SEV.

messages.body: Austria here. Italy, your VEN and NAP attacks on Trieste are wasting both our armies while Turkey and Russia grow. Withdraw A VEN and F NAP away from TRI and ALB this Spring, and I will hold F TRI, A BUD and A VIE defensively and keep out of Venice and Tyrolia. Confirm your Spring orders now.

Austria here. Your A SER is isolated and Italy is pressing me at Trieste. Withdraw A SER toward Rumania and I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece. Otherwise I must keep pressing Serbia. Tell me your Spring orders.

Austria here. Spring 1906: A VIE and A BUD stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania as agreed. I am holding Trieste against Italy and attacking Turkish Serbia only. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia and Hungary and tell me your Spring moves first.

England here. Spring 1906: Russia has taken Nor and our board is tense. Will A NOR and your northern units stay out of the North Sea and off Edinburgh's approaches? I will not move toward Stp or Swe. Tell me plainly whether A NOR moves this spring.

England here. Spring 1906: I am holding Belgium, Edinburgh, London, Liverpool and the North Sea. Will A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium, and F SWE stay out of the North Sea? I will keep F BEL in place and keep my fleets out of Denmark and Sweden.

England here. Spring 1906: F BEL holds and stays out of Holland. Please confirm A BUR stays out of Belgium and Picardy and F MAO stays out of the Channel and Brest this spring. I am open to discussing Spain or Portugal later if the board opens.

France here. Spring 1906: I'm holding A BUR out of Belgium and Picardy and F MAO out of the Channel and Brest. Your F BEL is still in Belgium; please keep it there and keep English units out of Burgundy and Picardy. Tell me if you plan any change this spring.

Germany here. Spring 1906: I hold BER, MUN, HOL, KIE and F SWE and will not move toward Warsaw or Prussia. Please confirm A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay off Prussia and Silesia. Turkey is the bigger threat to both of us in the south, so tell me if you plan anything against Rumania or Galicia.

Italy here. Spring 1906: A VEN and F NAP hold this spring, and I will not move on Trieste while A VIE stays out of Venice and Tyrolia and F TRI stays put. Confirm that and we keep the Adriatic quiet. Tell me your Spring orders.

Italy here. I am holding A ROM, F NAP, F TYS and A VEN this spring, with nothing into Greece, Ionian or Apulia, as agreed. What are your Spring 1906 moves in Serbia and toward Budapest? Tell me so we avoid any bounce.

Russia here. A RUM sits on my centre and I am contesting it this spring with A WAR and F SEV, with support. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia now and I will keep out of Bulgaria, Greece and Constantinople, and F SEV stays out of the Black Sea south. Otherwise we fight over Rumania. Tell me your Spring orders first.

Russia here. Spring 1906: A WAR and A MOS hold, and neither moves toward Prussia or Silesia. I ask the same of you: keep A BER, A MUN, A HOL and A KIE west, and keep F BAL out of Russian waters. Confirm your Spring 1906 moves so the northern border stays quiet.

Russia here. I will keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia and Hungary as agreed. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania this spring. Tell me your Spring 1906 orders before they resolve, so we avoid any clash in the Balkans.

Turkey here. Spring 1906: A RUM is staying, and I will defend it if attacked. Your A WAR and F SEV must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. In return I keep F BLA off Sevastopol and out of Armenia. Can you commit to that line for 1906?
Turkey here. Spring 1906: A SER holds and I am not moving into Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia and Greece. Will you confirm that holds this spring?

Turkey here. Spring 1906: F AEG stays out of the Ionian and Adriatic, and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A ROM, F TYS and A VEN out of Greece. Confirm we remain at peace this spring.

Austria here. Spring 1906: I confirm A VIE and F TRI hold, and A VIE stays out of Venice and Tyrolia. But your A VEN and F NAP must actually leave Trieste's approaches. Holding is not enough. Show me the withdrawal in your Fall orders and I will keep A BUD and F TRI purely defensive.

Austria here. Spring 1906: A VIE and A BUD will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. I am attacking only Turkish-held Serbia. Please keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia and Hungary as agreed. My full orders will be shared with you before they resolve, and I expect the same from you.

Austria here. I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece as long as you do not reinforce SER or push toward Trieste. However, A SER is still a target. Withdraw it toward Rumania and I will not pursue. Otherwise I will press Serbia this spring.

England here. Spring 1906: F BEL holds and stays in Belgium, not Holland. A BUR stays out of Belgium and Picardy, and F MAO stays out of the Channel and Brest. English units will not enter Burgundy or Picardy this spring. I remain open to discussing Spain or Portugal later if the board opens. Let's keep the west quiet.

France here. Confirmed for Spring 1906: A BUR stays out of Belgium and Picardy, and F MAO stays out of the Channel and Brest. Please keep your fleets out of Brest, the Channel and Picardy, and no English unit enters Burgundy. Your F BEL is still in Belgium; I'd like it to move to Holland at some point, since we both benefit if German pressure there is shared. Let's keep the west quiet.

Germany here. Spring 1906: A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium, and F SWE stays out of the North Sea as you asked. I'll hold Holland, Kiel, Denmark and Sweden. Please keep F BEL and your fleets out of Denmark and Sweden too, and let us both keep our centers in the north.

Germany here. Spring 1906: A BER, A MUN, A HOL and A KIE hold and stay west, away from Warsaw, Prussia and Silesia. Please keep A WAR and A MOS off Prussia and Silesia, and keep your fleets out of the Baltic. Turkey is the bigger threat to us both in the south; I'm open to discussing Rumania.

Italy here. Confirmed for Spring 1906: A VEN and F NAP hold, and I will not move on Trieste while A VIE stays out of Venice and Tyrolia and F TRI stays put. If you break that, I will respond. Keep the Adriatic quiet and tell me if your Serbia plans change.

Italy here. Spring 1906: A ROM, F NAP, F TYS and A VEN hold, with nothing into Greece, the Ionian or Apulia. Please tell me your exact Serbia and Budapest orders so we avoid any bounce. Keep F AEG out of the Ionian and your armies out of Apulia and Naples, and we remain at peace.

Russia here. A NOR holds this spring and will not enter the North Sea, Norwegian Sea or Barents. I will not move toward Stp or Swe from the north. Keep F NWG and F NTH away from Norway and our northern units, and we stay at peace.

Russia here. This spring A WAR and A MOS hold and stay out of Galicia and Hungary. Our Rumania fight is with Turkey only. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania, and we remain friends.

Russia here. A RUM sits on my centre, and I am contesting it this spring with F SEV and A WAR in support. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia now and I will keep out of Bulgaria, Greece and Constantinople. Otherwise we fight over Rumania.

Russia here. A WAR and A MOS hold this spring and do not move toward Prussia or Silesia. I ask that A BER, A MUN, A HOL and A KIE stay west, and F BAL stays out of Russian waters. Turkey is our shared problem in the south.

Turkey here. Spring 1906: A SER holds. I am not moving into Bulgaria or Greece, and I will keep my units off Trieste and Vienna's approaches. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia and Greece this spring. Confirm and we stay at peace.

Turkey here. Spring 1906: A RUM stays and I will defend it if attacked. Your A WAR and F SEV must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. In return my F BLA stays off Sevastopol and out of Armenia. Confirm this line for 1906 and we avoid a costly clash.

Turkey here. Spring 1906: my A SER holds and I am pressing Austria from there, not Budapest or Trieste, so no bounce risk. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and Adriatic, and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. We remain at peace.

notes.note: Spring 1906: holding all units to keep promises to Austria (no Trieste move while VIE/TRI stay put), Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia) and France. Austria wants withdrawal; I did not agree. No unowned centers reachable. Watch Austria at TRI/VEN and Turkey's Serbia push.

Spring 1906: holding BEL, EDI, LON, LVP. Kept promises to France (BEL stays, no Bur/Pic/Channel entry) and Germany (no Hol/Den/Swe moves). Russia says A NOR holds and stays north. Nor is Russian; consider convoy to retake later if Russia breaks peace. Watch France on Bel/Pic and Germany on Hol.

Spring 1906: all hold. Honoring Russia (no GAL/WAR/RUM), Turkey (no SER/GRE entry), Italy (no VEN/TYR while TRI holds). Italy's VEN/NAP have not withdrawn; watch for Adriatic attack. Serbia attack alone would bounce, so deferred. Reassess Fall.

Spring 1906: holding BER, HOL, KIE, MUN per pacts with England, Russia, Austria, France. F SWE to BAL sets up convoy of A BER/A KIE. England and Russia have kept word so far. Watch Turkey in the south; consider Rumania talks with Russia. Next: look for growth via Prussia only if Russia breaks pact.

Spring 1906: holding BUR, MAR, POR, SPA to keep promises to England, Germany and Italy. F MAO moves to WES to prepare a convoy of SPA to NAF next turn, which is unowned. Italy and England have kept word so far. Check whether Italy objects to WES.
Spring 1906: holding RUM with BLA support against Russia; SER holds per Austria deal. AEG out of ION per Italy deal. Russia and Austria broke trust over RUM/SER. Italy kept peace. Reassess in Fall.

Spring 1906: all hold. Board shows RUM is Turkish, not Russian; no supports can reach RUM, so no attack this turn. Turkey, Austria, Germany keep asking for no moves into their areas. Keep MOS supporting SEV hold against BLA/ANK. Re-check RUM with support next spring. England says NOR stays out of the North Sea; NOR-SWE attack would bounce.

messages.body: Austria, Fall 1906. Your A VEN and F NAP have still not left Trieste's approaches, and that breaks our understanding. Pull them back this Fall, away from TRI and ALB, and I will keep F TRI, A BUD and A VIE defensive and stay out of Venice and Tyrolia. Otherwise I will defend Trieste and look at Venice. Confirm your Fall orders.

Austria, Fall 1906. Your A SER is isolated, and I will press it unless it withdraws. Move A SER to Rumania this Fall and I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece. Hold it, and I will attack Serbia with A BUD and support from A VIE. Tell me your orders now.

England here. Fall 1906: F BEL stays in Belgium and I will not enter Burgundy or Picardy. Please keep A BUR and F WES away from Belgium, Channel and Brest. I'm willing to discuss Spain or Portugal later if the board opens. What are your fall orders?

England here. Fall 1906: F BEL holds and stays out of Holland; my fleets stay out of Denmark, Kiel and Sweden. Please confirm A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway, and F BAL stays out of the North Sea. Let us both keep our centers in the north.

England here. Fall 1906: I want to keep the north quiet. I will hold Edinburgh, London, Liverpool and Belgium, with F NWG and F NTH staying out of Norway. Will A NOR and F SEV stay off Sweden and Stp? Tell me if you plan any move against Turkey or Austria that would affect me.

France here. Fall 1906: I plan F MAO to WES and possibly a convoy of SPA toward North Africa (NAF/TUN area). I am not targeting Tunis or Piedmont. Do you object, and do you plan any move toward Marseille or Spain? Let's keep our understanding.

Germany here. Fall 1906: I hold BER, MUN, HOL, KIE and fleets in the north. Turkey is the real threat to us both. I propose you keep A WAR and A MOS off Prussia and Silesia, and I keep my armies west. Would you consider joint pressure on Rumania, with you taking Galicia-side targets while I stay out of the Balkans? Please confirm.

Italy here. Fall 1906: Austria is weakening. I propose you take Budapest or Trieste area pressure with your armies while my A VEN and F NAP hold. Which Serbian or Budapest moves are you making this Fall, so we avoid bounces? I keep F AEG-free Ionian promise and no Greece moves.

Russia here. Fall 1906: A RUM still sits on my centre and I am not withdrawing my plan to retake it. Turkey holds 7 centres, the lead. Let's discuss a split: you withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia and I stay out of Bulgaria, Greece and Constantinople. Otherwise I will contest RUM with F SEV and A WAR next spring.

Turkey here. Fall 1906: A RUM and F BLA hold, so I expect your A WAR and F SEV to stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. Will you move A WAR elsewhere this fall? Mutual non-aggression keeps both our centres safe. Please confirm your orders.

Turkey here. My A SER holds this fall and I am not moving into Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia and Greece as agreed. Tell me your fall orders so we avoid any clash.
Turkey here. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples this fall. Please keep F NAP, A VEN and F TYS out of Greece. Confirm your fall orders so we remain at peace.

Austria here. Fall 1906: I will not move A BUD, A VIE or F TRI into Serbia, Bulgaria or Greece while you keep the peace. Your A SER is still a target for me, though. If it withdraws toward Rumania this fall, we keep a clean border. If it holds, I may press it next year. Your choice, and I will watch your moves on Trieste and Vienna's approaches closely.

France here. Fall 1906: A BUR stays out of Belgium and Picardy, and my fleets stay out of the Channel and Brest. Your F BEL can hold in Belgium. Please keep English units out of Burgundy and Picardy as well. I'm still open to a Spain or Portugal arrangement later, but for now let's keep the west quiet and both grow.

Germany here. Fall 1906: A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway, and F BAL stays out of the North Sea. I will hold Holland, Kiel, Denmark and Sweden as agreed. Keep F BEL out of Holland and your fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and Sweden, and we both keep our centers in the north.

Italy here. Fall 1906: I am not withdrawing A VEN or F NAP from the Trieste approaches while your F TRI and A VIE sit beside us and Austria's own threats continue. Keep F TRI in Trieste and A VIE out of Venice and Tyrolia, and I will hold. Any move against Venice or Tyrolia ends our understanding.

Italy here. Fall 1906: F MAO to WES is fine by me. I have no plans against Marseille or Spain, and I will keep my units out of Western Mediterranean waters. A convoy into Tunis would be a different matter, so I ask that any North African landing avoid Tunis and Piedmont. I will tell you before any move near your lines.

Italy here. Fall 1906: F NAP, A VEN and F TYS will not move toward Greece, the Ionian or Apulia, and I keep that promise. My concern is Austria, which is weakening. Please push Serbia and Budapest with your armies. Tell me your exact Serbia and Budapest orders so we avoid any bounce. We remain at peace.

Russia here. A NOR and F SEV will not move toward Sweden or Stp this fall. F NWG and F NTH should stay out of Norway and the Barents. I have no plans against Edinburgh or your northern coast. Keep the north quiet and we remain at peace.

Russia here. A WAR and A MOS hold this fall and will not move toward Prussia or Silesia. I accept your western proposal: keep A BER, A MUN, A HOL, A KIE west and F BAL out of Russian waters. I am open to discussing Rumania, but Turkey holds RUM with A RUM and must withdraw first.

Russia here. A RUM sits on my centre and I will contest it next spring unless it withdraws to Bulgaria or Serbia. If you withdraw, I will keep A WAR and F SEV out of Bulgaria, Greece and Constantinople, and F BLA stays off Sevastopol. Otherwise A WAR and F SEV will move against Rumania.

Turkey here. A SER holds this fall and I am not moving into Bulgaria or Greece. I ask that A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia and Greece as agreed. Any move into Serbia from you will be defended. Keep your units off Rumania and Bulgaria and we can talk about a Galicia-free border in 1907.

Turkey here. Fall 1906: F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. I will not move toward Budapest or Trieste this fall. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece as agreed. We remain at peace and I wish you well against Austria.

Turkey here. A RUM and F BLA hold this fall. Your A WAR and F SEV must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople, and I keep F BLA off Sevastopol and out of Armenia. Please move A WAR elsewhere, toward Galicia or Ukraine, so we avoid a clash. Confirm and we keep the Black Sea line.

notes.note: Fall 1906: holding Trieste with F TRI, supported by A BUD and A VIE. Italy (VEN, NAP) has not withdrawn from Trieste approaches and broke our understanding. Turkey's A SER holds; no deal on Serbia. Russia keeps faith (no GAL/WAR/RUM entry). Next: reassess Venice and Serbia in 1907; keep defensive unless Italy retreats.

Fall 1906: held all units to keep peace with Germany (no Hol/Den/Kie entry) and France (no Bur/Pic/Channel entry). Russia says no move on Edi/north coast. Next: consider F BEL to NTH to convoy A EDI toward Nor if Russia breaks peace. Watch Germany on Bel/Hol and France on Bel/Pic.
Fall 1906: WES to MAO to prep convoy of SPA to NAF next turn. Italy OK'd WES; England asked BUR/WES stay out of Bel/Channel. Avoid Tunis/Piedmont. Keep promises; no unowned centers reachable yet.

Fall 1906: holding all. Pacts: England (keep out of BEL/NOR, F BAL out of NTH) and Russia (no Prussia/Silesia/Warsaw; Russia accepted west pact). Russia says it will discuss Rumania only if Turkey's A RUM withdraws. No unowned centers left, so growth needs taking from a neighbor. Watch Turkey in south and Russia's WAR/MOS. Next: revisit Russia or England if they break pacts.

Fall 1906: all hold. No unowned centres reachable without breaking deals. Turkey's A RUM still holds; a lone SEV-RUM attack would bounce and expose SEV to F BLA. Keep Germany (no Prussia/Silesia), Austria (no Galicia/Hungary) and England (no NOR/North Sea) deals. Retake RUM next spring with support if Turkey refuses to withdraw. Watch Turkey's F BLA near SEV.

Fall 1906: holding all units. No unowned centers reachable; VEN to TRI bounces vs F TRI without support. ROM supports VEN holding against Austrian threat. Promises kept: no Greece/Ionian/Apulia moves (Turkey), no MAR/SPA/TUN/Piedmont moves (France). Austria demands VEN/NAP withdrawal, refused. Watch Austria at VEN and Turkey's Serbia push.

Fall 1906: hold all. BLA supports RUM holding against Russia. Keeping peace with Italy (AEG out of ION, no Greece/Apulia moves) and Austria (SER holds, no Bulgaria/Greece). Russia and Austria have broken trust; Russia threatens RUM. Reassess SER/BUD in 1907.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1907: your A VEN and F NAP still sit on Trieste's approaches. Withdraw them this spring from TRI and ALB, and I will keep F TRI, A BUD and A VIE defensive and out of Venice and Tyrolia. Otherwise F TRI holds and I will defend Trieste fully. Tell me your spring orders.

England here. Spring 1907: A NOR is still Russian and I am not moving north. Please confirm A NOR and F SEV stay out of the North Sea and Norwegian Sea this spring, and that you will not attack Edinburgh. I would like to retake Norway later through diplomacy if you agree to stay out of Sweden and St Petersburg.

France here. Spring 1907: F MAO moves to WES as agreed, and I plan A SPA to convoy toward North Africa, avoiding Tunis and Piedmont. Please confirm your fleets stay out of WES and Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and tell me of any move near my lines.

Germany here. Spring 1907: I hold Berlin, Munich, Kiel, Holland and Denmark. Turkey is our shared problem. Rather than a Rumania deal, I'd like to know if you plan to take Galicia-side Austrian targets or stay on Warsaw. Let's keep Prussia and Silesia off limits to both of us this year.

Italy here. Spring 1907: I hold A ROM, F NAP, F TYS and A VEN, with nothing into Greece, the Ionian or Apulia, as promised. Austria is the target for both of us. Please tell me your exact Serbia and Budapest orders this Spring so we avoid any bounce, and keep F AEG out of the Ionian.

Russia here. Spring 1907: A RUM still sits on my centre. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia and I will keep A WAR and F SEV out of Bulgaria, Greece and Constantinople, and F SEV stays off your Black Sea coast. If A RUM holds, I will attack it with A WAR and F SEV. Tell me your orders now.

Russia here. Spring 1907: A WAR and A MOS hold and stay out of Galicia and Hungary, as agreed. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. I will not contest Serbia or Trieste. Confirm your Spring 1907 orders before they resolve.

Turkey here. Spring 1907: I hold A RUM and F BLA, and I expect A WAR and F SEV to stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. Move A WAR toward Galicia or Ukraine and I will keep F BLA off Sevastopol. Confirm your spring orders so we avoid a costly clash over Rumania.

Turkey here. Spring 1907: A SER holds. I will not move into Bulgaria or Greece, and I ask that A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia and Greece. Confirm your spring orders so we both keep our centres.

Turkey here. Spring 1907: F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece. What are your spring orders, so we avoid any clash and stay at peace?

Austria here. Spring 1907: A VIE and A BUD stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania as agreed, and I will not contest Serbia-to-Russia lines. I am holding Trieste against Italy. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia and Hungary, and tell me before any move that touches Serbia or Rumania.

Austria here. Spring 1907: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece while you keep the peace. A SER remains a target for me, so withdraw it toward Rumania if you want the border kept clean. Keep your fleets off Trieste and Vienna's approaches.

Italy here. Spring 1907: I will not withdraw A VEN or F NAP while your fleet sits on Trieste and your armies threaten Venice. If F TRI stays put and A VIE stays out of Venice and Tyrolia, I will hold my position and not attack Trieste this spring. Break that and I respond.

Italy here. Agreed: I keep my fleets and armies out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and out of Western Mediterranean waters. Your F MAO to WES is acceptable. Please keep your North African convoy away from Tunis and Piedmont, as we discussed. I will tell you before any move near your lines.

Italy here. Spring 1907: F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM hold, with nothing into Greece, the Ionian or Apulia, as promised. I am focused on Austria. My Serbia and Budapest orders are not yet fixed, but I will tell you before any move that could bounce yours. Keep F AEG out of the Ionian.

Russia here. A NOR and F SEV hold this spring; neither enters the North Sea, Norwegian Sea or Barents, and neither moves toward Edinburgh. Keep F NWG and F NTH away from Norway and St Petersburg and we stay at peace. Norway is not up for discussion while A NOR sits there.

Russia here. Prussia and Silesia stay off limits from my side this spring; A WAR and A MOS will not move toward them. I ask you to keep A BER, A MUN, A HOL, A KIE and F BAL out of Russian waters. On Galicia, I hold my southern units for now and will tell you before any move that touches Austria.

Russia here. A RUM is on my centre and I will contest it this spring with A WAR and F SEV unless it withdraws to Bulgaria or Serbia. If you withdraw, I keep out of Bulgaria, Greece and Constantinople and F SEV stays off your Black Sea coast. Your F BLA must stay off Sevastopol. Choose now.

Turkey here. Spring 1907: F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. I am holding my Serbian and Rumanian positions and will not move toward Budapest or Trieste this spring. Please keep F NAP, A ROM, F TYS and A VEN out of Greece and the Ionian as agreed. We remain at peace.

Turkey here. A RUM holds this spring, and I will defend it if attacked. Your A WAR and F SEV must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. If A WAR moves toward Galicia or Ukraine, F BLA stays off Sevastopol and out of Armenia. Confirm that line and we avoid a costly clash.

notes.note: Spring 1907: all hold to defend Trieste and keep promises to Russia, Turkey, Italy. Italy's VEN/NAP still on Trieste approaches; watch for attack. Consider pressing Serbia only if Turkey weakens. Turkey and Russia have kept faith so far.

Spring 1907: F BEL to NTH to set up convoy of A EDI toward NOR (Russian-held) next turn. Holding other centers. Peace with Germany and France kept (no Hol/Den/Bel/Pic/Channel entry). Russia says A NOR holds; watch for breaking of peace. Consider Norway retake or Spain/Portugal later.

Spring 1907: MAO to WES as agreed with Italy (Italy OK'd). Next turn MAO convoys SPA to NAF (avoid Tunis/Piedmont). Holding BUR/MAR/POR/SPA to keep England/Germany promises. Keep fleets out of Channel/Brest. Italy kept word so far.

Spring 1907: all hold, ROM supports VEN holding against Austria's TRI/VEN threat. Promises kept to Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples moves) and France (no MAR/SPA/POR/WES). Austria wants VEN/NAP withdrawal; refused. Watch A VIE toward VEN/TYR and Turkey's Serbia push; revisit TRI only with Turkish support in BUD/SER.

Spring 1907: holding BER, HOL, KIE, MUN and moving F BAL to SWE (own center) to keep pacts with Russia (no Prussia/Silesia), England and Austria. Russia has kept word. Turkey is main threat in south. Consider growth against a neighbor if pacts break.

Spring 1907: WAR moves to unowned GAL for a free center; MOS supports SEV hold vs F BLA. Holding NOR, STP, SEV. Austria asked us to stay out of Galicia, so expect friction. Turkey keeps refusing to leave RUM; no clean attack on RUM possible this turn. Watch F BLA and A RUM.

1907 Spring: hold all centers. BLA supports RUM holding against Russia; SER supports RUM. Keep AEG out of ION (Italy deal), no moves into BUL/GRE (Austria, Russia deals). Russia, Austria, Italy have kept or claimed peace; watch RUM and SER. Reassess Fall 1907 for expansion.

messages.body: Austria here. Fall 1907: I need a real answer, not repeated holds. Your A VEN and F NAP still sit on Trieste's approaches. If they pull back this Fall, I keep F TRI in place and A VIE out of Venice and Tyrolia. If not, I will treat Venice as a target next year. Tell me your Fall orders.

Austria here. Your A SER still blocks my only route to growth in the Balkans. Withdraw it toward Rumania this Fall and I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece. If it holds, I will press Serbia next year with support. Your choice; tell me your Fall orders.

England here. Fall 1907: I intend to move A EDI by convoy from NTH toward Norway, since Norway is the only center I can realistically win back. I am not moving toward Sweden or St Petersburg. Will A NOR stand and fight, or would you accept a peaceful retreat to Sweden or Finland?

England here. Fall 1907: F BEL has moved to NTH, so Belgium is empty and open to anyone. Please keep A HOL and any other German unit out of Belgium this fall. I will keep my fleets out of Denmark, Kiel and Sweden as agreed, and will not enter Holland.

England here. Fall 1907: Belgium is now empty. I will not enter Belgium, Burgundy or Picardy, and my fleets stay out of the Channel and Brest. Please confirm your fleets stay out of the Channel too. I remain open to a Spain or Portugal arrangement later.

France here. Fall 1907: A BUR and F WES stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel. Please keep F BEL in Belgium and English units out of Burgundy. If you are willing, let's agree that Spain and Portugal are mine when the time comes, and that Belgium stays with you.

Germany here. Fall 1907: my fleets stay out of Russian waters and my armies stay west. Turkey holds Rumania and Serbia is contested. Will your A GAL and southern units help push Turkey from Rumania this year? I'd rather see Russia gain there than Turkey. Please confirm your Warsaw and Moscow armies stay off Prussia and Silesia.

Italy here. Fall 1907: I hold ROM, VEN, NAP and TYS, nothing into Greece, the Ionian or Apulia. Austria is weakening. Are you moving on Serbia or Budapest this fall? Tell me your exact orders so we avoid any bounce and keep F AEG out of the Ionian.

Russia here. A RUM is on my centre. Fall 1907: withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia and I keep A WAR, F SEV out of Bulgaria, Greece and Constantinople. If A RUM holds, I attack it with A WAR and F SEV, and F BLA off Sevastopol is your risk. Tell me your choice now.

Russia here. Fall 1907: A WAR has moved toward Galicia, which is unowned, and I know that breaks our word. I will hold GAL and keep A MOS out of Hungary. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania, and tell me your fall orders before they resolve.

Russia here. Fall 1907: A NOR and F SEV hold, and neither enters the North Sea, Norwegian Sea or Edinburgh approaches. Norway stays Russian. Keep F NWG and F NTH away from Norway and St Petersburg and we remain at peace.

Turkey here. Fall 1907: A RUM and F BLA hold. I need your word that A WAR, F SEV and A GAL stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. In return F BLA stays off Sevastopol. Pulling Russia and Turkey away from each other lets Austria and Germany feed on us both. Confirm your orders.

Turkey here. Fall 1907: A SER holds, and I am not moving into Bulgaria or Greece. Your A BUD, A VIE and F TRI must stay out of Serbia and Greece. If you attack Serbia I will defend it, so let us both keep our centres and look elsewhere for growth.

Turkey here. Fall 1907: F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece. Tell me your Austrian plans before any move that could affect Trieste or Serbia.

Austria here. Fall 1907: I keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania as agreed. Your move of A WAR into Galicia breaks that understanding, so I expect it to stop at GAL and not go further toward Vienna or Hungary. My fall orders: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold, supporting each other against Italy at Trieste. I will tell you before any move near Serbia.

Austria here. Fall 1907: my A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold and stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece, as you asked. A SER is still the Balkan issue between us. If it withdraws toward Rumania this fall, we keep a clean border. If it holds, I may press Serbia next year. Keep your fleets off Trieste and Vienna's approaches.

England here. Fall 1907: F BEL has moved to NTH, so Belgium is empty. I will not enter Belgium, Burgundy, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. My F LVP and F NTH stay in the Irish Sea and North Sea. I cannot promise Spain or Portugal now, but I will talk when the west opens. Please keep A BUR and F WES out of Belgium and the Channel too.

England here. Fall 1907: I intend to move A EDI by convoy through NTH toward Norway. I am not moving toward Sweden or St Petersburg, and I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic. Norway is the only center I want back. If A NOR retreats to Sweden or Finland, I will not pursue into the Baltic. Please keep F SEV and your fleets away from Edinburgh and the North Sea.

France here. Fall 1907: my fleets stay out of the Channel and Brest, and A BUR stays out of Belgium and Picardy as agreed. Noted that F BEL is empty now and you won't enter Belgium, Burgundy or Picardy. I'm not aiming at London. Spain and Portugal are mine to take, and I'll keep to that line while you hold the north.

Germany here. Fall 1907: I have no intention of moving into Belgium, Norway or the North Sea, and my units stay out of Denmark, Kiel and Sweden as well. A HOL will hold, not enter Belgium. Keep your fleets out of Holland and Denmark, and we both keep our northern centers. Tell me if F NTH plans to return to Belgium.

Italy here. I will not withdraw A VEN or F NAP while your armies sit near Venice and your fleet holds Trieste. Our peace is already broken, so I will keep my units where they are this fall. Pull A VIE out of Tyrolia and I will consider a truce; otherwise expect Venice to be defended hard.

Italy here. My promise stands: F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM stay out of Greece, the Ionian and Apulia this fall. Please keep F AEG out of the Ionian and your armies out of Apulia and Naples. I am pressing Austria, and I will tell you before any move that could affect your Serbia or Budapest bounces.

Russia here. Fall 1907: A GAL holds, F SEV holds, and I will not move any unit into Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople this fall. F SEV stays on its own coast, so F BLA has no reason to fear Sevastopol. Rumania remains contested for spring if A RUM stays, but this fall we keep the Black Sea quiet.

Russia here. Fall 1907: A GAL and F SEV hold, and A MOS stays in Moscow. Neither moves toward Prussia or Silesia, and no Russian army is heading to Warsaw this year. I may consider Rumania next spring, but I won't commit to it now. Please keep your armies west and your fleets out of the Baltic approaches to St Petersburg.

Russia here. A NOR holds this fall and will not retreat, because Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its own coast and is not moving toward Edinburgh. Please keep F NWG and F NTH out of Norway and away from St Petersburg, and we can keep the north quiet. Norway is not for sale, but I'm open to peace.

Turkey here. A SER holds this Fall and stays put. I am not moving into Bulgaria or Greece, and I expect A BUD, A VIE and F TRI to stay out of Serbia and Greece. Any move into Serbia will be met with a defense. Let us both keep our centres and look elsewhere for growth.

Turkey here. A RUM holds and I will defend it if attacked. I need your word that A WAR, F SEV and A GAL stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. In return F BLA stays off Sevastopol and out of Armenia. Confirm and we both avoid a costly fight while Austria and Germany grow.

Turkey here. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece as agreed. I am not moving on Budapest or Trieste this Fall, and I will tell you before any Adriatic move.

notes.note: Fall 1907: holding NAP, VEN, TYS and ROM. ROM supports VEN holding against Austria's TRI/VEN threat. Turkey has kept its promises (AEG out of Ionian, no Apulia/Naples). Austria has broken the peace and threatens VEN. Revisit a Trieste push only with Turkish support in Serbia or Budapest.

Fall 1907: all hold to keep 6 centers. Pacts: England (no Hol/Bel/Nor push, fleets out of DEN/KIE/SWE), Russia (no Prussia/Silesia/Warsaw). Turkey is the main threat in the south. Next: consider F SWE to BAL to set up convoys, and revisit Russia's Rumania offer if it moves.

Fall 1907: all hold to keep promises to England (BUR out of Bel/Pic, fleets out of Channel), Italy (no Tunis/Piedmont) and Germany. No unowned centers exist. Watch England F BEL now at NTH. Next option: F WES to MAO/GOL then convoy SPA to NAF or TUS if Italy breaks word.

Fall 1907: holding all units. Norway attack via convoy would bounce against A NOR without support and break Russian peace. Keep peace with Germany, France, Russia. Watch for chances to retake Norway or take Spain/Portugal if they open. Re-evaluate Norway if Russia's NOR moves.

Fall 1907: BUD attacks unowned GAL (Russian A GAL there) supported by VIE, to take it since Russia broke its word. TRI holds Trieste vs Italy. Watch Russia and Italy; keep Turkey's SER out of reach; don't enter Serbia.

Fall 1907: GAL holds, MOS to WAR to secure our center, NOR holds with STP supporting, SEV holds. Keep Turkey off Rumania for now; no clean RUM attack. Austria and Germany deals: no Prussia/Silesia moves; England: NOR stays Russian. Watch England convoy threat on NOR.

Fall 1907: holding all. BLA supports RUM vs Russia. Promises: Austria (SER holds, no BUL/GRE), Italy (AEG out of ION, no GRE/APU moves), Russia (no RUM moves by me beyond holds). Russia offered Black Sea quiet if A RUM holds. Reassess 1908 for growth via Russia's RUM/GAL or Austria's SER/BUD once trust is clear.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1908: your A VEN and F NAP still sit near Trieste. Pull them back from TRI and ALB this spring and I keep F TRI in place and my armies out of Venice and Tyrolia. Otherwise Trieste stays defended and Venice remains a target. Please confirm your spring orders.

England here. Spring 1908: I still want Norway back. A NOR is Russian-held, and I will not move into the Baltic or toward St Petersburg. Will A NOR stay or retreat to Sweden or Finland this spring? If you hold, I will keep my fleets out of your area and I will not attack Russian units.

England here. Spring 1908: my F NTH and A EDI stay north, and my fleets stay out of the Channel, Brest and Belgium. Are your units still holding Spain and Portugal without moving toward Belgium or Picardy? If the west opens later, I'm willing to discuss Portugal in writing.

England here. Spring 1908: F NTH will not enter Belgium, Holland, Denmark or Kiel, and I will not enter the Baltic. Please confirm A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway this spring, and that F SWE stays out of the North Sea.

France here, Spring 1908. A BUR and F WES stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel as agreed. Please confirm F NTH and F LVP stay out of Belgium and Brest. Since no centers are open in the west, let's keep quiet and reconsider Spain or Portugal only if one opens up.

Germany here. Your armies hold Rumania and Serbia and I have no quarrel with you. I stay out of the Balkans. Will you keep your fleets out of the Baltic and North Sea, and tell me your Spring 1908 plans for Serbia and Rumania?

Germany here. Spring 1908: I keep A BER, A MUN, A HOL, A KIE and F BAL out of Russian waters, and I expect A WAR and A MOS to stay off Prussia and Silesia. Are A GAL and F SEV moving against Rumania or Austria this spring?

Germany here. Spring 1908: A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway as agreed, and F SWE stays out of the North Sea. Please confirm F NTH and F LVP stay out of Holland, Denmark and Sweden this spring.

Italy here. Spring 1908: I hold my fleets and armies out of Greece, the Ionian and Apulia. I am weighing a move on Trieste against Austria. Are you taking Serbia or Budapest this spring? Tell me exact orders so we avoid bounces. Please keep F AEG out of the Ionian as before.

Russia here. Spring 1908: I will not move into Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople while your A RUM stays. Let's be honest: RUM is contested. If you hold it, I may strike next turn. Would you withdraw A RUM to Serbia or Bulgaria? Tell me your Spring orders and I'll keep F SEV on its coast.

Russia here. Spring 1908: A GAL holds and I will keep A WAR, A MOS out of Hungary and Trieste. I have no plans against Serbia this spring. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Share your Spring orders before they resolve.

Russia here. Spring 1908: A NOR holds and will not retreat. F SEV stays on its coast, away from Edinburgh. Keep F NTH and F NWG out of Norway and St Petersburg and we stay at peace. Tell me your Spring orders so we can confirm the north stays quiet.

Turkey here. Spring 1908: I hold A RUM and F BLA supports it. Please keep A WAR, F SEV and A UKR out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople, and F SEV off the Black Sea coast I hold. Confirm your spring orders so we both keep our centres while Austria and Germany grow.

Austria here. Spring 1908: A VIE and A BUD will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. I hold Trieste and Bohemia-side lines, no attack on Serbia-to-Russia lines this spring. Your A GAL is in an awkward spot after the fall move; I expect it to withdraw toward Warsaw or Sevastopol. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Hungary and Trieste as you promised, and we stay clear.

England here, Spring 1908. F NTH and F LVP stay out of Belgium, Brest and the Channel as you asked. My A BUR concerns are settled, so keep A BUR and F WES out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel too. I will reconsider Portugal in writing if Spain or Portugal opens up.

England here, Spring 1908. F NTH will not enter Belgium, Holland, Denmark or Kiel, and I will not enter the Baltic. I expect A HOL, KIE and MUN to stay out of Belgium and Norway, and F SWE out of the North Sea. Let us both hold our northern centers this spring.

England here, Spring 1908. I still want Norway back, but I will not move into the Baltic or toward St Petersburg this spring. Keep A NOR and F SEV away from Edinburgh and the North Sea, and I will keep my fleets off your units. Tell me if A NOR plans to retreat to Sweden or Finland.

France here, Spring 1908. Confirmed: A BUR and F WES stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel, and my fleets stay out of Brest. Please confirm F NTH and F LVP stay out of Belgium and the Channel, and that no English unit enters Burgundy or Picardy. I am not moving on London. If the west opens and we both want Portugal, I'm willing to write a clear arrangement then.

Germany here. Confirmed for Spring 1908: A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway, and F SWE stays out of the North Sea. I expect F NTH and F LVP to stay out of Holland, Denmark, Sweden and Kiel as you said. Let us both keep our northern centers.

Italy here. I will not withdraw A VEN or F NAP while your fleet holds Trieste and your armies press toward Venice. Our understanding broke when Austria's forces stayed at our border. Pull A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI out of the Adriatic approaches, and I will talk truce. Otherwise Venice and Trieste remain contested.

Russia here. A NOR holds this spring and will not retreat; Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its coast, away from Edinburgh. I will not move into the Baltic toward St Petersburg from the north. Keep F NTH and F NWG out of Norway and the Barents and we stay at peace.

Russia here. A WAR, A MOS and A GAL are not moving toward Prussia or Silesia this spring. A GAL and F SEV are not moving against Austria this spring either; I am still weighing Rumania. Keep your armies west and F BAL out of Russian waters, and we stay on track.

Russia here. A RUM is on my centre. Withdraw it to Bulgaria or Serbia this spring and I keep A WAR, F SEV and A UKR out of Bulgaria, Greece and Constantinople. If A RUM holds, I will attack it. Your F BLA must stay off Sevastopol. Choose now.

Turkey here. My fleets stay out of the Baltic and North Sea; F AEG remains in the Aegean. This spring A SER holds in Serbia and A RUM holds in Rumania, with F BLA supporting. I have no plans to attack Germany and ask that you keep your armies out of Bohemia and Silesia toward my Balkan centres.

Turkey here. Spring 1908: F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples, as before. I am holding my Serbian and Rumanian positions this spring and not moving on Trieste or Budapest. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece. Good luck against Austria.

notes.note: Spring 1908: holding all to keep promises to England (no BEL/PIC/BUR breach) and Italy (no WES/Tunis moves). England has kept word so far. No unowned centers reachable. If England breaks or Spain/Portugal opens, consider F WES to MAO then convoy SPA to NAF/TUN.

Spring 1908: holding all. ROM supports VEN against Austria. Promises kept: no Greece/Ionian/Apulia moves (Turkey), no MAR/SPA/TUN/WES (France). Austria wants VEN/NAP out, refused. Turkey kept AEG out of Ionian. Revisit TRI only with Turkish support in SER/BUD.

Spring 1908: GAL retreats to BUD to secure our center, since it is exposed in Galicia. TRI holds Trieste against Italy; VIE holds. Russia's A WAR/A MOS promised to stay out of Hungary and Trieste; Turkey and Italy have not kept their word on Trieste. Keep BUD/VIE/TRI defensive; reassess Serbia only if Turkey weakens.

Spring 1908: holding BER, HOL, KIE, MUN; F SWE to BAL to set up convoys. Pacts: England (no BEL/NOR, F SWE out of NTH) and Russia (no PRU/SIL). Turkey says no Baltic/NTH fleets. No unowned centers, so growth needs a neighbor. Watch Russia's WAR/MOS and England's NTH.

Spring 1908: F NTH to NWG to set up convoy of A EDI to NOR next turn, if Russia's NOR is still there and peace is breaking. Kept peace with Germany and France (no Bel/Hol/Den/Kie, no Channel/Brest/Pic/Bur entry). Russia says A NOR holds. Watch for Russian NOR retreat.

Spring 1908: all hold. Turkey still holds RUM and has not withdrawn, so a UKR-RUM attack would bounce at 2 vs 2 with F BLA support. Keeping the Austria, Germany and England deals. Re-check RUM next turn with more support, and watch Turkey's F BLA near SEV.

Spring 1908: holding all centers. F BLA supports RUM holding vs Russia. Promises kept: AEG out of ION (Italy), no BUL/GRE moves (Austria/Russia). Russia has not yet attacked RUM. Reassess Fall 1908 for growth via BUD or GAL once Austria/Russia intentions are clear.

messages.body: Austria here. I propose a truce: F TRI stays in Trieste, A VIE stays out of Tyrolia and Venice, and I will not attack Venice in 1908. Your A VEN and F NAP should move off the Trieste approaches. Confirm your Fall orders so we both keep our centres.

Austria here. Galicia is now empty after A GAL retreated to Bud. I want Galicia kept neutral and A WAR and A MOS out of Hungary. I will keep A VIE and A BUD out of Warsaw and Rumania. Tell me your Fall orders before they resolve.

Austria here. Russia is our shared threat in the north. Withdraw A SER toward Rumania or keep it there, but do not let Russia use Rumania. I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia and Greece. Let us coordinate against Russian moves.

England here, Fall 1908. We have not spoken yet. My fleets stay out of the Mediterranean and I have no plans against Italy. What are your plans for Tunisia, Naples and the Tyrrhenian? Let us both avoid wasted moves and keep our fleets apart.

England here, Fall 1908. Your A NOR is still the only thing between us. I will not enter the Baltic or St Petersburg, and I am not attacking your units. Will A NOR hold or move this fall? Please keep F SEV away from the North Sea and Edinburgh, and we both stay at peace.

France here, Fall 1908. I keep A BUR and F WES out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel as agreed. Please confirm F NTH and F LVP stay out of Belgium and Brest this fall. Since Spain and Portugal are still held, I'd like to know if you plan any move toward Picardy or Brest.

Germany here, Fall 1908. Turkey is the common threat in the south. Are A GAL, A WAR, A MOS and F SEV moving against Rumania or Austria this fall? I will keep my armies west and F BAL out of Russian waters. Please confirm Prussia and Silesia stay untouched by you.

Germany here, Fall 1908. Our Bohemia and Tyrolia agreement stands; A MUN stays home. What are A BUD, A VIE and F TRI doing this fall? If Italy threatens Trieste, I am willing to discuss support against Italy, but I need your word that Vienna stays off Bohemia.

Germany here, Fall 1908. Confirming my northern pact: A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway, and F SWE stays out of the North Sea. Please keep F NWG, F LVP and F NTH out of Denmark, Holland, Sweden and Kiel this fall.

Italy here. Fall 1908: I am considering a move on Trieste. If I strike Austria, will you take Serbia or Budapest this fall? Please confirm exact orders so we avoid bounces. I keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian as promised.

Italy here. Fall 1908: our peace is broken and your armies near Venice are a threat. Pull A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI out of the Adriatic approaches and I will talk truce. Otherwise I will keep Venice defended and may strike Trieste.

Italy here. Fall 1908: I keep my units out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Western Mediterranean waters and Tunis, as agreed. Please confirm your North African plans avoid Tunis and Piedmont, and tell me of any move toward my lines.

Russia here. Fall 1908: I will not move A UKR, A WAR or F SEV into Rumania this fall, and A GAL stays out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia and we keep the Black Sea quiet. If A RUM holds, I may strike in Spring 1909. Tell me your fall orders.

Russia here. Fall 1908: A WAR, A MOS and A UKR stay off Prussia and Silesia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please keep F BAL and your armies out of Warsaw and Livonia. Share your fall orders so we can confirm this peace holds.

Russia here. Fall 1908: A GAL holds and I will not move toward Hungary or Vienna. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania as agreed. Tell me your fall orders before they resolve.

Turkey here. Fall 1908: A RUM holds and F BLA supports it. Russia, if you move A WAR, F SEV or A UKR into Rumania or Bulgaria I will fight, and Austria and Germany will gain. Keep to the north and we both keep our centres. Confirm your Fall orders.

Austria here. Fall 1908: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this turn. A VIE stays out of Bohemia and Tyrolia, and I will not move toward Munich. I will keep my word on the border. If Italy attacks Trieste, I will defend it, but I ask you to keep A MUN and your other units away from Bohemia and Tyrolia.

Austria here. I accept a truce on these terms: F TRI stays in Trieste, A VIE stays out of Tyrolia and Venice, and I will not attack Venice in 1908. Your A VEN and F NAP must move off the Trieste approaches, away from TRI and ALB. Show that in your Fall orders and I will keep my fleet defensive.

Austria here. Fall 1908: A VIE and A BUD will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania, as agreed. I expect A WAR and A MOS to stay out of Galicia-to-Hungary and to keep A GAL off Vienna. My fall orders are defensive holds in Bohemia-side lines and Trieste. I will share them before resolution.

England here. Fall 1908: F NTH and F LVP stay out of Belgium, Brest and the Channel this fall, as agreed. I will not enter Burgundy or Picardy. Please keep A BUR and F WES out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel too. If Spain or Portugal opens up, we can write a clear arrangement then.

England here, Fall 1908. Confirmed: F NTH, F NWG and F LVP stay out of Holland, Denmark, Sweden and Kiel, and my fleets stay out of the Baltic. Please keep A HOL, KIE and MUN out of Belgium and Norway, and F SWE out of the North Sea. Let us both hold our northern centers.

France here. Fall 1908: I confirm no plans against Tunis, Naples, Piedmont, Marseille, Spain, Portugal or Western Mediterranean waters. My F MAO stays out of WES. My North African ideas are on hold and would avoid Tunis and Piedmont anyway. I will tell you before any move near your lines. Please keep your units out of Marseille and Spain too.

Germany here. Fall 1908: I am holding BER, MUN, KIE, HOL and F BAL, and none of my units will enter Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw or Livonia. I am not moving A GAL, A WAR, A MOS or F SEV against you. Please keep your fleets out of the Baltic and your armies off Prussia and Silesia, and we both stay safe while Turkey is dealt with.

Italy here. I will not sign a truce that leaves my Venice and Naples approaches exposed while your fleet holds Trieste. Pull A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI out of the Adriatic approaches first, then we can talk. Until then, VEN and NAP stay defended.

Russia here. Fall 1908: A GAL is now empty and I will keep it neutral. A WAR and A MOS stay out of Hungary and Trieste. I am not moving toward Vienna or Bohemia. My fleets stay north. Keep A VIE and A BUD out of Warsaw, Galicia and Rumania as agreed, and we stay clear.

Russia here. A NOR holds this fall and Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its coast and is not moving toward Edinburgh or the North Sea. Keep F NTH and F NWG out of Norway, the Barents and St Petersburg, and we remain at peace.

Russia here. A WAR, A MOS and A UKR stay off Prussia and Silesia this fall, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I have no plans against Austria with A GAL this fall. I am still weighing Rumania against Turkey and will tell you before any move. Keep F BAL out of Russian waters.

Russia here. A RUM is on my centre and I will not move into Rumania this fall, nor Bulgaria or Constantinople from A GAL. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia and we keep the Black Sea quiet. If it holds, I may strike in Spring 1909 with A WAR, A UKR and F SEV. F BLA must stay off Sevastopol.

Turkey here. Fall 1908: A SER holds and stays put. I am not moving into Bulgaria or Greece. I expect A BUD, A VIE and F TRI to stay out of Serbia and Greece as agreed. On Russia, I agree we should watch their northern moves, but Rumania is my centre and I will defend it. Keep your word and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here. Fall 1908: A RUM holds, supported by F BLA. If A WAR, F SEV or A UKR enters Rumania or Bulgaria, I will fight and you will lose those units. Keep to the north and Galicia-free of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and the Black Sea stays quiet. Confirm your fall orders in writing.

Turkey here. Fall 1908: F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. I am holding Serbia and Rumania this fall and will not move on Budapest or Trieste. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece. If you strike Trieste, I will not interfere, but I cannot promise a Serbia or Budapest move.

notes.note: Fall 1908: all hold to keep 6 centers. Pacts: England (no BEL/NOR, fleets out of DEN/KIE/SWE), Russia (no PRU/SIL/WAR/LVN, no Russian fleet in Baltic), Austria (no BOH/TYR). Russia and England have kept word. Turkey is the south threat. No unowned centers, so growth needs breaking a pact; consider Russia via PRU/SIL if they stall on Rumania.

Fall 1908: all hold to keep promises to England (no BUR/WES into Bel/Pic/Channel) and Italy (no Tunis/Piedmont/WES-Med moves). England and Italy kept word. No unowned centers. Option later: WES to MAO/GOL then convoy SPA or MAR to NAF/TUS if Italy breaks.

Fall 1908: all hold, keeping Austria (no GAL/Hungary), Germany (no Prussia/Silesia) and England (NOR stays Russian) deals. Turkey's A RUM still sits on RUM; Russia may strike Spring 1909 with A WAR, A UKR, F SEV plus support if Turkey refuses to withdraw. Watch F BLA near SEV.

Fall 1908: all hold. Kept promises to Russia (no GAL/WAR/RUM), Turkey (no SER/GRE), Germany (no BOH/TYR). Italy truce not confirmed; Italy's VEN/NAP still near TRI. Reassess Serbia if Turkey weakens; watch Italy.

Fall 1908: holding EDI, LON, LVP. F NWG to NTH to set up a possible convoy of A EDI to NOR later. Peace with Germany, France, Russia kept so far; Russia says A NOR holds. Do not attack Norway unless Russia breaks peace. Look for Spain/Portugal if they open. Keep fleets out of Belgium, Brest, Channel, Kiel, Holland, Denmark.

Fall 1908: holding NAP, TYS, VEN; ROM supports VEN holding vs Austria. Turkey has kept Greece/Ionian promises; France has kept out of MAR/SPA/TUN. Austria has not withdrawn VIE from TYR or F TRI from Adriatic approaches, so no truce. No unowned centers; a VEN-TRI attack would bounce without Italian support. Revisit a Trieste strike only with Turkish help at SER/BUD.

Fall 1908: holding all 7 centers. BLA supports RUM holding vs Russia. Kept promises: AEG out of ION (Italy), no BUL/GRE moves (Austria/Russia). Russia has not attacked RUM yet. Reassess Spring 1909 for growth via BUD/TRI/SEV once intentions are clear.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1909. Our truce stands only if your A VEN and F NAP leave the Trieste approaches now. I will keep F TRI in Trieste and A VIE out of Venice and Tyrolia. Confirm your Spring orders and I will hold defensive.

Austria here, Spring 1909. Keep A SER and your Balkan units away from Trieste and Vienna. I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece while Russia is the real threat to Rumania. Tell me your Spring orders.

Austria here, Spring 1909. A VIE and A BUD stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania as agreed. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A GAL out of Hungary and Trieste. Share your Spring orders so we both avoid surprises.

England here, Spring 1909. I want to retake Norway eventually, but I am not attacking now. Will A NOR hold again this spring? If you keep F SEV off the North Sea and out of Edinburgh, I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic and off your units.

England here. My fleets stay in the North Sea and Channel and will not enter the Mediterranean or the Black Sea. I have no plans against your Balkan holdings. Are your fleets staying in the Aegean and Black Sea, away from Western Europe? Let us both keep to our own fronts.

France here, Spring 1909. Confirming A BUR and F WES stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel this spring. Please keep F NTH, F LVP and A LON out of Belgium, Brest and Picardy too. If Spain or Portugal opens, I'm open to a written arrangement.

Germany here, Spring 1909. Are A WAR, A MOS, A UKR or F SEV moving against Rumania or Austria this spring? I will keep BER, MUN, KIE, HOL and F BAL home and out of Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw and Livonia. Please confirm your army stays off Prussia and Silesia.

Germany here, Spring 1909. Your fleets stay out of the Baltic and North Sea, and I stay out of the Balkans. What are A SER, A RUM and A GRE doing this spring? I would like your word F AEG and F BLA stay away from Germany's coasts.

Germany here, Spring 1909. Our Bohemia and Tyrolia agreement stands; A MUN stays home. Are A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding or attacking Serbia or Trieste this spring? Please confirm Vienna stays off Bohemia.

Italy here, Spring 1909. Considering a strike on Trieste. Are you moving on Serbia or Budapest this spring? If you take Budapest, I can threaten Trieste to pull Austrian forces away. Please confirm exact orders so we avoid any bounce or conflict.

Russia here. Spring 1909: A RUM sits on my centre and I intend to retake it with A WAR, A UKR and F SEV. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia now and I keep those units out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. Tell me your Spring orders before they resolve.

Turkey here. Spring 1909: I am moving A RUM to Bulgaria is not planned; I hold RUM with F BLA support. Russia, your A UKR and A WAR are at my border. Tell me exactly what you order this spring. If you move on Rumania I will fight. If you hold north, I see no reason for us to fight, and we can both grow elsewhere.

Austria here, Spring 1909. A BUD, A VIE and F TRI are holding this spring, not attacking Serbia or Trieste. A VIE stays out of Bohemia and Tyrolia, as agreed. Please keep A MUN home and off Tyrolia too. If Italy moves on Trieste I will defend it, and I am open to discussing support against Italy later.

England here, Spring 1909. Confirmed: F NTH and F LVP stay out of Belgium, Brest and the Channel, and no English unit enters Burgundy or Picardy. A LON stays home this spring. Please keep A BUR and F WES out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel as well. If Spain or Portugal opens up, we can put a written arrangement in place then.

Italy here. Spring 1909: I am holding A VEN, F NAP and ROM in place. I have no plans to attack Trieste this spring. Keep F TRI in Trieste and A VIE out of Venice and Tyrolia, and we can talk about a lasting truce in Fall once your Tyrolia threat is gone.

Russia here. A NOR holds this spring and Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its coast, away from Edinburgh and the North Sea. Keep F NTH and F NWG out of Norway, the Barents and St Petersburg and we stay at peace.

Russia here, Spring 1909. A WAR, A MOS and A GAL will not enter Hungary or Trieste this spring. I am not moving toward Vienna or Bohemia. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania as agreed. I will share my full orders before they resolve.

Russia here, Spring 1909. A MOS and A UKR will not enter Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw or Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I am weighing action in the south against Turkey's Rumania, not against you. Keep F BAL and your armies home and we stay safe.

Russia here. A RUM sits on a Russian centre and I intend to retake it this spring with A WAR, A UKR and F SEV. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia now and I keep my units out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. If it holds, I will attack. Your F BLA must stay off Sevastopol.

Turkey here, Spring 1909. A SER holds, and I will not move into Bulgaria or Greece. I expect A BUD, A VIE and F TRI to stay out of Serbia and Greece as agreed. If Russia moves on Rumania, I will defend it, and I am open to coordinating against Russia.

Turkey here. A RUM holds this spring with F BLA supporting, and it will not withdraw. Any move by A WAR, A UKR or F SEV into Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople will be fought. Hold north and we both keep our centres and can grow elsewhere.
Turkey here. Agreed: my fleets stay in the Aegean and Black Sea and will not enter Western Europe or the Atlantic. Keep your fleets in the North Sea and Channel and we have no quarrel.

Turkey here, Spring 1909. I am not moving on Serbia or Budapest this spring; A SER and A RUM hold. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece. Good luck against Austria.

Turkey here. Spring 1909: A SER and A RUM hold and A GRE stays put. F AEG and F BLA stay in the Aegean and Black Sea, away from your coasts. I have no plans against Germany and ask that your armies stay out of Bohemia and Silesia toward my Balkan centres.

notes.note: Spring 1909: all hold to keep promises to Russia, Turkey, Italy, Germany. Watch Italy VEN/NAP near TRI and Russia GAL/WAR. Reassess Serbia only if Turkey weakens. Fall: stay defensive unless broken.

Spring 1909: holding NAP, TYS, VEN; ROM supports VEN holding vs Austria. Promises kept to Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples moves) and France (no MAR/SPA/TUN/WES). Austria demands VEN/NAP withdrawal; refused. No unowned centers reachable. Revisit TRI only with Turkish support in SER/BUD.

Spring 1909: no unowned centers. WES to MAO to prep convoy of SPA to NAF (avoid Tunis/Piedmont) next turn. England and Italy have kept word; keep BUR/WES out of Bel/Pic/Channel. Check Italy's reply on NAF.

Spring 1909: holding all to keep pacts with England, Russia, Austria, Turkey. No unowned centers. Russia and England have kept word so far. Watch Russia's WAR/MOS and Turkey in south. Consider growth against Russia via Prussia/Silesia only if pacts break.

Spring 1909: Turkey's A RUM still holds with F BLA support, so the RUM attack would bounce. Took unowned GAL with WAR, supported by UKR, instead. Breaks the Austria no-Galicia promise, so expect friction. Holding NOR, SEV, STP. England and Germany have kept their deals so far. Retry RUM only with more support.

Spring 1909: holding all 7 centers. BLA supports RUM holding vs Russia. Promises: Italy (AEG stays out of ION, no Apulia/Naples moves), Austria (SER holds, no BUL/GRE moves), Russia (no RUM moves beyond holds), Germany (fleets stay out of Baltic/North Sea), England (fleets stay in Aegean/Black Sea). Russia has threatened RUM; watch A WAR/UKR/SEV. Reassess Fall 1909 for growth via BUD/SEV once inte

Spring 1909: NTH to NWG to set up convoy of A EDI to NOR later if Russia's NOR stays and peace breaks. Peace kept with France, Germany, Russia, Turkey. No unowned centers in reach. Watch Russia NOR and France Bel/Pic. Keep fleets out of Med, Baltic, Channel, Bel.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1909. Your A VEN and F NAP are still near Trieste. I will keep F TRI in Trieste and A VIE out of Venice. Move VEN and NAP away from the Adriatic coast this fall and I will hold defensively. Otherwise I must defend Trieste and Tyrolia.

England here, Fall 1909. Norway is still Russian-held with A NOR. I am not attacking this fall. Will A NOR hold again, or is Russia planning to move it? Keep F SEV off the North Sea and Edinburgh and I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic.

England here, Fall 1909. Confirming F NTH, F NWG and F LVP stay out of Belgium, Brest and the Channel this fall. Please keep A BUR, F WES and F MAO away from Belgium, Picardy and the Channel too. If Spain or Portugal opens, let us write the arrangement then.

France here, Fall 1909. I plan F MAO to WES this turn and then a possible SPA convoy to North Africa. I will not enter Tunis, Naples, Piedmont or Rome. Please confirm your fleets stay out of Western Mediterranean waters, Marseille and Spain, and tell me before any move toward my lines.

France here, Fall 1909. My A BUR and F MAO stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel, as agreed. Please confirm F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of Belgium, Brest and Picardy this fall. If Spain or Portugal opens, I'm willing to put a clear written arrangement in place.

Germany here. Fall 1909: I am holding all units and will not move toward Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw or Livonia. Please confirm A MOS, A WAR and A UKR stay off those too, and that no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. If you move on Rumania, tell me first.

Italy here, Fall 1909. Our truce has not been kept while F TRI and A VIE sit on my border. Withdraw A VIE from Tyrolia and F TRI from the Adriatic approaches, and I will move A VEN and F NAP off Trieste lines and talk peace. Tell me your Fall orders first.

Italy here, Fall 1909. Are you moving on Serbia or Budapest this fall? If Austria's Trieste and Budapest front weakens, I may strike Trieste. Confirm exact orders so we avoid bounces. I will keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian.

Italy here, Fall 1909. I am keeping my units out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Western Mediterranean waters and Tunis, as agreed. Please confirm your North African plans still avoid Tunis and Piedmont, and tell me before any move toward my lines.

Russia here. I took unowned Galicia with A WAR, supported by A UKR, in Spring 1909. I know it breaks our understanding and I regret the friction. I will not move into Hungary, Trieste or Bohemia. Keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia and Warsaw, and we can both focus elsewhere.

Russia here. A RUM is a Russian centre and I intend to retake it this Fall with A UKR, A GAL and F SEV. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia now and I will keep my units out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. Otherwise we fight. Tell me your orders.

Russia here. I am keeping A UKR, A WAR and F SEV out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I am turning south against Turkey's Rumania, not against you. Keep F BAL and your armies home and we stay at peace.

Turkey here, Fall 1909. Russia, A RUM holds and F BLA supports it. Your A UKR, A WAR and F SEV are next to my border. If any of them enters Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople, I will fight. Confirm your fall orders now. Hold north and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here, Fall 1909. A SER holds and I will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia as agreed. Russia is the threat to Rumania, and I will defend it. Confirm your fall orders.

Turkey here, Fall 1909. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. I am holding Serbia and Rumania. Keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece. Good luck if you strike Trieste.

Austria here. Fall 1909: I keep F TRI in Trieste and A VIE out of Venice and Tyrolia this turn. Your A VEN and F NAP are still on the Adriatic approaches. Move them off the Trieste lines this Fall and I will reciprocate with a defensive posture and a written truce for 1910. If they stay, I will defend Trieste firmly.

Austria here. Fall 1909: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece as long as you keep A SER out of Bulgaria and Greece. Russia has taken Galicia and is the real danger to Rumania. I am open to coordinating against Russian moves in 1910. Please keep your forces off Trieste and Vienna's approaches.

Austria here. Fall 1909: I accept your regret, but Galicia taken by force strains our understanding. Keep A WAR and A GAL out of Hungary, Bohemia and Trieste, and I will keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia and Warsaw. If you pull A GAL back toward Warsaw or Sevastopol, we can restore trust.

England here. Fall 1909: F NTH, F NWG and F LVP stay out of Belgium, Brest and the Channel, and no English unit enters Burgundy or Picardy. A LON holds. Please keep A BUR, F MAO and F WES out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel too. Spain and Portugal remain yours to contest; if they open, we will put a written arrangement in place.

France here, Fall 1909. Agreed: my A BUR and F MAO stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel, and Brest is not entered. I expect your F NTH, F LVP and A LON to stay out of Belgium, Brest and Picardy this fall as well. Any Spain or Portugal arrangement can be written once a centre there opens.

Germany here. Thanks for confirming. I am holding all units this fall and will keep BER, MUN, KIE, HOL and F BAL off Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw and Livonia. Good that you are turning south against Turkey's Rumania. I'll stay out of the Balkans. Please keep your fleets out of the Baltic and tell me before any move touching Austria or Sweden.

Italy here. Fall 1909: I will not withdraw VEN or NAP while your A VIE and F TRI press our border. Pull A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI off the Adriatic approaches, and I will move off the Trieste lines and talk a lasting truce. Show it in your orders and I will reciprocate.

Italy here. Agreed: F MAO to WES is fine. My fleets and armies stay out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Western Mediterranean waters and Tunis this fall. Keep your North African convoy off Tunis and Piedmont, and tell me before any move near my lines.

Italy here. Confirmed: F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM stay out of Greece, the Ionian and Apulia this fall. I am focused on Austria. Please keep F AEG out of the Ionian and your armies out of Apulia and Naples. I will tell you before any move affecting your Serbia or Budapest plans.

Russia here. My attack is aimed at Turkey's Rumania, not at you. A UKR, A GAL and F SEV will move south. A WAR, A UKR and F SEV will not enter Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw or Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Keep F BAL and your armies home and we stay at peace.

Russia here. A NOR holds this fall and Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its coast and will not move toward Edinburgh or the North Sea. Keep F NTH, F NWG and your fleets out of Norway, the Barents and St Petersburg, and we remain at peace.

Russia here. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia now and I keep my units out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. If A RUM holds, A UKR, A GAL and F SEV will attack Rumania this fall, and we will fight. Your choice. Keep F BLA off Sevastopol.

Turkey here. Fall 1909: F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. I am holding A SER and A RUM this fall, not moving on Budapest or Trieste. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece. Good luck if you strike Trieste.

Turkey here. Fall 1909: A RUM holds, supported by F BLA, and it will not withdraw. If A UKR, A GAL, A WAR or F SEV enters Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople, I will fight. Hold north, keep F SEV off the Black Sea coast I control, and we both keep our centres and can grow elsewhere.

notes.note: Fall 1909: F MAO to WES as agreed with Italy and England. Holding BUR, MAR, POR, SPA. Next turn: F WES to MAO or stay, then convoy SPA to NAF (avoid Tunis/Piedmont). England and Italy have kept word; keep BUR/WES out of Bel/Pic/Channel.

Fall 1909: holding all units. Pacts: Russia (no Prussia/Silesia/Warsaw/Livonia, no Russian fleet in Baltic; Russia now attacking Turkey's Rumania, not me), England (no Bel/Nor, fleets out of Den/Kie/Swe), Austria (no Bohemia/Tyrolia), Turkey (no Balkans, fleets out of Baltic/NTH). All have kept word so far. No unowned centers. Watch Russia's WAR/UKR; consider growth only if a pact breaks.

Fall 1909: F NWG to NTH sets up a possible convoy of A EDI to NOR later. Holding EDI, LON, LVP. Peace kept with Russia, France, Germany, Turkey. Russia says A NOR holds. Only attack Norway if Russia breaks peace. Keep fleets out of Belgium, Brest, Channel, Baltic and Med. Watch for Spain/Portugal openings.

Fall 1909: holding NAP, TYS, VEN; ROM supports VEN holding vs Austria. Promises kept to Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples moves) and France (no MAR/SPA/TUN/WES). Austria still demands VEN/NAP withdrawal; refused until VIE leaves TYR and TRI leaves Adriatic. No unowned centers reachable. Revisit TRI only with Turkish support in SER/BUD.

Fall 1909: holding BUD, TRI, VIE to keep promises to Turkey and Germany and defend Trieste. Italy asks for VEN/NAP to leave the Trieste approaches; watch for an Adriatic attack. Russia's GAL/WAR went into Galicia; no entry into Galicia or Warsaw. Reassess a Galicia attack on BUD/VIE if Russia keeps breaking its word.

Fall 1909: holding all 7 centers. BLA supports RUM holding vs Russia. Promises kept: AEG out of ION (Italy), no BUL/GRE moves (Austria/Russia). Russia still threatens RUM; Russia has not attacked yet. Reassess Spring 1910 for growth via BUD/SEV if Russia or Austria weakens.

Fall 1909: GAL holds Galicia (unowned, takes it at fall end) and supports UKR to RUM; UKR attacks RUM with SEV support (3 vs 2). Expect Turkey to fight. Keep Germany and England deals (no Baltic fleets, NOR stays). Austria broken on Galicia; watch VIE/BUD. Next: hold WAR/MOS, retake RUM if it succeeds.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1910: Russia holds Galicia with A WAR and A GAL, and Austria cannot accept that. Pull A GAL back to Warsaw or Sevastopol and I will keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia and Warsaw. Otherwise I must defend Budapest. Tell me your Spring orders before they resolve.

England here, Spring 1910. Russia has built a second army at WAR while Norway remains your only northern center under A NOR. Will A NOR hold again, and will F SEV stay off the North Sea? I am not attacking Norway this spring, and I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic if you keep yours away from Edinburgh.

France here, Spring 1910. My A BUR, F WES and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel. Please keep F NTH, F LVP and A LON out of Belgium, Brest and Picardy this spring too. Spain and Portugal are my focus, so let's keep that arrangement in writing.

Germany here, Spring 1910. Austria is the weakest power with 3 centers. I propose we plan a split: you keep pressing Turkey in Rumania and Serbia, and when the time is right I will take Bohemia and Tyrolia toward Vienna. Keep A WAR and A GAL off Prussia and Silesia, and I will keep my units home. Do you agree?

Italy here, Spring 1910. My A VEN and F NAP are holding, and I am not attacking Trieste this spring. Keep F TRI in Trieste and A VIE out of Tyrolia and Venice, and I will keep my units off your lines. Confirm in writing and we can build toward a lasting truce.

Italy here, Spring 1910. Are you moving on Serbia or Budapest this spring? I will keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece, the Ionian and Apulia as agreed. Please keep F AEG out of the Ionian and your armies away from Apulia and Naples.

Italy here, Spring 1910. I keep my units out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Western Mediterranean waters and Tunis. Please confirm your F MAO to WES and any SPA convoy stay away from Tunis and Piedmont, and tell me before any move toward my lines.

Russia here, Spring 1910. A RUM is a Russian centre and I will retake it. Withdraw A RUM to Serbia or Bulgaria now and my units stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. If it holds, we fight. Your F BLA must stay off Sevastopol. Tell me your choice now.

Turkey here, Spring 1910. Your A WAR, A UKR and F SEV are at my border. Your Galicia and Ukraine units can grow in the north. I will hold A RUM with F BLA support. If you enter Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople I will fight. Tell me your Spring orders now.
