Austria here, Spring 1910. Confirmed in writing: F TRI stays in Trieste, A VIE stays out of Tyrolia and Venice this spring. In return, your A VEN and F NAP must move off the Trieste and Albania approaches this Fall, not merely hold. Show that withdrawal in Fall orders and we can sign a lasting truce for 1911. I will not move toward Venice while this holds.

England here, Spring 1910. Confirmed: F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this spring, and no English unit enters Burgundy. Please keep A BUR, F WES and A MAR out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel too. Spain and Portugal are yours to pursue; if they open, we can write the arrangement then.

France here, Spring 1910. Confirmed: my units stay out of Marseille-adjacent Italian lines, Tunis, Piedmont, Naples and Western Mediterranean waters where your fleets operate. F MAO is currently in WES as agreed; any North African convoy will avoid Tunis and Piedmont. I will tell you before any move near your lines. Please keep your units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal as well.

Russia here. A GAL stays in Galicia this spring; Galicia is ours now and I will not be pushed out by threats. I will not move A WAR or A GAL into Hungary or Trieste. Keep A VIE and A BUD out of Warsaw and Rumania and we can avoid a wider war. Lasting peace depends on respecting current lines.

Russia here. A NOR holds this spring and Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its coast and will not move toward Edinburgh or the North Sea. Keep F NTH and your fleets out of Norway, the Barents and St Petersburg, and we remain at peace.

Russia here. A RUM is a Russian centre and I intend to retake it this spring with A WAR, A UKR and F SEV. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia and my units stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. If it holds, we fight. Keep F BLA off Sevastopol.

Russia here. A WAR and A GAL will stay off Prussia and Silesia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I am focused on Turkey in the south. Keep BER, MUN, KIE, HOL and F BAL home. A split against Austria is premature; I will tell you before any move touching Vienna or Bohemia.

Turkey here. Spring 1910: I am not moving on Serbia or Budapest this spring, and A SER holds. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece as agreed. We remain at peace.

Turkey here. A RUM holds this spring with F BLA supporting, and it will not withdraw. Your A WAR, A UKR and F SEV should grow in the north toward Sweden and Galicia rather than fight over Rumania. If any of them enters Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople, I will fight. Hold north and we both keep our centres.

notes.note: Spring 1910: all holding to keep pacts with Russia (no Prussia/Silesia/Warsaw/Livonia, no Russian fleet in Baltic), England (no Bel/Nor, fleets out of Den/Kie/Swe), Austria (no Bohemia/Tyrolia), Turkey (no Balkans). Russia declined a split vs Austria for now; will tell Russia before moving on Vienna/Bohemia. No unowned centers. Growth needs a pact to break; watch Russia WAR/GAL.

Spring 1910: NTH to NWG to set up convoy of A EDI to NOR next turn if Russia's NOR still there. EDI, LON, LVP hold. Peace kept with France, Russia, Germany, Turkey. France and Russia say they keep their arrangements. Watch for Russia or France breaking peace; Spain/Portugal arrangement with France pending.

Spring 1910: all hold. VIE supports BUD to defend Budapest against Russian A GAL. TRI holds Trieste vs Italy. Russia broke its GAL/WAR promises. Italy has not yet withdrawn VEN/NAP from Trieste approaches; Fall needs that. Keep defensive, watch Russia on BUD.

Spring 1910: all hold. No unowned centers reachable. Honoring truces with Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples) and France (no MAR/SPA/POR/WES/TUN). Austria demands VEN/NAP withdrawal in Fall; refused unless VIE leaves TYR and TRI leaves Adriatic. Revisit Trieste only with Turkish help in SER/BUD.

Spring 1910: all hold. Our RUM unit holds Rumania; Turkey has no unit there. Keeping Germany (no Prussia/Silesia), England (NOR stays), Austria (no Hungary/Trieste) deals. Watch Austria A VIE/A BUD on GAL/WAR. Retake RUM only if it becomes empty or with support. Consider SEV-BLA convoy plan later.

Spring 1910: no unowned centers reachable without breaking England/Italy promises. Holding BUR/MAR/POR/SPA; F WES to MAO to prep SPA convoy to NAF (avoid Tunis/Piedmont). England and Italy have kept word. Next: check if Spain/Portugal opens; consider convoy then.

Spring 1910: SER attacks RUM (Russian centre), BLA supports SER to RUM. Keep AEG out of ION (Italy). Italy and Austria kept peace so far. Russia repeatedly threatened RUM. Next: if RUM taken, consolidate Balkans; keep Italy and Germany promises.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1910. A GAL is in Galicia and threatens Budapest. Withdraw A GAL to Warsaw or Sevastopol this Fall and I will keep A BUD and A VIE out of Galicia and Warsaw. If it stays, I will defend Budapest firmly. Tell me your Fall orders now.

England here, Fall 1910. Russia's A NOR is still your only northern center and I am not attacking this fall. Please confirm A NOR holds again and F SEV stays off the North Sea. In return my fleets stay out of the Baltic and away from Norway and St Petersburg.

England here, Fall 1910. Please confirm A BUR, F WES and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Picardy and the Channel this fall. My F NTH, F NWG, F LVP and A LON will not enter Belgium, Brest or Picardy. Spain and Portugal are yours to pursue; let us write that arrangement once they open.

England here, Fall 1910. Confirming A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway this fall, and F SWE stays out of the North Sea. My F NTH will not enter Holland, Denmark, Kiel or Sweden. Let us both hold our northern centers.

France, Fall 1910: A BUR holds, F MAO holds in Mid-Atlantic, and no French unit enters Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. I ask that your F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of Belgium, Picardy and Brest as well. Let's keep that arrangement in writing.

France, Fall 1910: A SPA and A POR hold, and no French unit moves toward Tunis, Piedmont, Naples or Western Mediterranean waters. Please confirm your units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this fall too.

Germany here, Fall 1910. Russia took RUM from Turkey's retreat, so the south is open. Confirm A WAR, A GAL and A UKR stay off Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I am holding BER, MUN, KIE, HOL and BAL this fall. Tell me before any move on Vienna or Bohemia.

Germany here, Fall 1910. My A MUN stays home and out of Bohemia and Tyrolia as agreed. Please confirm A VIE and F TRI stay out of Bohemia and Tyrolia this fall too. Italy is your real threat on Trieste, and I'd rather we both keep our centers.

Italy here, Fall 1910. My A VEN and F NAP stay where they are this turn, but I will not move them off the Adriatic while F TRI and A VIE threaten us. Keep F TRI in Trieste and A VIE out of Tyrolia and Venice, and I will keep my units defensive. Let us sign a written truce for 1911.

Italy here, Fall 1910. Are you moving A SER or A RUM against Budapest or Trieste this fall? I still keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece, the Ionian and Apulia. Please keep F AEG out of the Ionian and your armies away from Apulia and Naples. Confirm your exact orders.

Italy here, Fall 1910. I am keeping my units out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Western Mediterranean waters and Tunis. Please confirm F MAO and any North African convoy avoid Tunis and Piedmont this fall, and tell me before any move toward my lines.

Russia here, Fall 1910. A RUM now shows as Turkish after our retreat. I will not attack Bulgaria or Constantinople while you hold the south. Tell me if A RUM stays, and whether F BLA stays off Sevastopol. If you pull out of Rumania, I will keep my armies north of the Black Sea.

Russia here, Fall 1910. I hold Galicia with A GAL and will not move A WAR or A GAL into Hungary or Trieste. Keep A VIE and A BUD out of Warsaw and Galicia, and we can avoid a costly war. Tell me your Fall orders before they resolve.

Russia here, Fall 1910. A WAR, A GAL and A NOR are staying put, and no Russian fleet will enter the Baltic. Please keep F BAL and your armies off Prussia, Silesia and Livonia. Tell me if your plans change.

Turkey here. Your A RUM retreated to UKR, and A RUM is now mine. I will hold it with F BLA support this Fall. Your A UKR, A WAR and F SEV should stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. Keep F SEV off the Black Sea coast I control, and Turkey will stay out of Galicia, Ukraine and Sevastopol. Confirm your Fall orders.

Turkey here, Fall 1910. A SER holds and I will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia as agreed. Russia has taken the Rumanian front in the north and is the shared threat. Tell me your Fall orders so we avoid bounces.

Austria here. Agreed: A VIE and F TRI stay out of Bohemia and Tyrolia this fall. Keep your A MUN home as well. I am defending Budapest and Trieste, not moving toward Munich. If Italy attacks Trieste, I would welcome your later cooperation against Italy.

Austria here. Your A VEN and F NAP still sit on the Trieste and Albania approaches. I cannot sign a lasting truce while they stay. Move them off this Fall, as we agreed, and I will keep F TRI in Trieste and A VIE out of Venice and Tyrolia. Otherwise Trieste will be defended firmly.

Austria here. A GAL in Galicia threatens Budapest, and I will not accept that. Withdraw A GAL to Warsaw or Sevastopol this Fall and I will keep A BUD and A VIE out of Galicia and Warsaw. If it stays, Budapest will be defended. The choice is yours.

Austria here. I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece while your A SER stays out of Bulgaria and Greece. Russia is the real danger to Rumania, and I am open to coordinating against Russian moves. Please keep your forces off Trieste and Vienna's approaches.

England here, Fall 1910. Confirmed: F NTH, F NWG, F LVP and A LON will not enter Belgium, Brest, Picardy or the Channel this fall. I will not enter Burgundy either. Please keep A BUR, F MAO, F WES and A MAR out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel. Spain and Portugal can be written up once they open, but not before.

France, Fall 1910: Confirmed. A BUR holds, F MAO holds in Mid-Atlantic, and no French unit enters Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. I ask that your F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of Belgium, Picardy and Brest as well. Spain and Portugal remain my focus; let's keep this arrangement in writing.

France, Fall 1910: Confirmed. A SPA and A POR hold this fall. No French unit moves toward Tunis, Piedmont, Naples or Western Mediterranean waters. Please confirm your units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this fall too, and tell me before any move toward my lines.

Germany here, Fall 1910. Confirmed: A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway this fall, and F SWE stays out of the North Sea. Keep F NTH, F NWG and F LVP out of Holland, Denmark, Sweden and Kiel. Let us both hold our northern centers.

Germany here, Fall 1910. Noted: A WAR, A GAL and A NOR stay put. I will keep BER, MUN, KIE, HOL and F BAL home and out of Prussia, Silesia, Warsaw and Livonia. Please keep your fleets out of the Baltic. If your plans touch Vienna or Bohemia, tell me first.

Italy here. Fall 1910: I confirm my fleets and armies stay out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Western Mediterranean waters and Tunis this fall. F MAO in WES is fine. Keep any North African convoy off Tunis and Piedmont, and I will tell you before any move near your lines. Let us both keep growing.

Russia here. A GAL stays in Galicia this Fall; I will not move A WAR or A GAL into Hungary or Trieste. I keep my word on Hungary and Trieste. Please keep A VIE and A BUD out of Warsaw and Galicia, and we can both build elsewhere rather than fight.

Russia here. Confirmed: A WAR, A GAL and A NOR stay put this Fall, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please keep F BAL and your armies off Prussia, Silesia and Livonia. I will tell you before any move touching Vienna or Bohemia, and I expect the same courtesy.

Russia here. A NOR holds this Fall and Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its coast and will not move toward Edinburgh or the North Sea. Please keep F NTH, F NWG and all fleets out of Norway, the Barents and St Petersburg, and we remain at peace.

Russia here. Your RUM claim is noted, but I will retake it when it suits me. For now I will not attack Bulgaria or Constantinople while you hold the south. Keep F BLA off Sevastopol and out of the Black Sea north coast. If you push into Ukraine or Galicia, we will fight.

Turkey here. Fall 1910: my A GRE and A RUM hold, and I have no unit in Serbia. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece as agreed. I will tell you before any move near the Adriatic.

Turkey here. Fall 1910: A RUM holds with F BLA support and will not move. Your A UKR, A WAR and F SEV should stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople, and I will keep my units out of Galicia, Ukraine and Sevastopol. Keep F SEV off the Black Sea coast I control. Confirm your Fall orders.

notes.note: Fall 1910: all hold to defend BUD, TRI, VIE. Russia A GAL still in Galicia threatens BUD; Italy VEN/NAP not withdrawn. Promised Germany no BOH/TYR, Turkey no SER. Watch Russia GAL and Italy VEN.

Fall 1910: holding NAP, VEN; ROM supports VEN holding vs Austria; TYS holds. Promises kept to Turkey and France (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples/MAR/SPA/POR/TUN/WES moves). Austria still demands VEN/NAP withdrawal and has F TRI, A VIE nearby; refused. Revisit TRI only with Turkish support in SER/BUD.

Fall 1910: holding EDI, LON, LVP; NWG to NTH to set up convoy of EDI to NOR later. Peace kept with Russia, France, Germany, Turkey so far. Russia says A NOR holds; attack Norway only if Russia breaks peace. Keep fleets out of Belgium, Brest, Channel, Holland, Denmark, Kiel, Baltic. Watch for Spain/Portugal openings with France.

Fall 1910: holding all units to keep pacts with England (no Bel/Nor), Russia (no Prussia/Silesia/Warsaw/Livonia, no Russian fleet in Baltic), Austria (no Bohemia/Tyrolia), Turkey (no Balkans). Russia took RUM. Growth needs a pact to break; watch Russia WAR/GAL and England NWG/NTH. Revisit when no unowned centers remain and a pact fails.

Fall 1910: all hold to keep promises to England (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel, A BUR holds) and Italy (no Tunis/Piedmont/Naples/WES-Med). Both have kept word so far. No unowned centers reachable without breaking promises. Next: check if any unowned center opens; consider MAO to WES then SPA convoy to NAF/TUN only if Italy breaks word.

Fall 1910: holding RUM (now ours) with F BLA support, all other units hold. Promises: Italy (AEG out of ION, no APU/NAP moves), Austria (no BUL/GRE/SER moves by me), Russia (no entry into RUM/BUL/CON beyond holds). Watch Russian A UKR/A WAR/F SEV for an attack on RUM. Next: look for growth via SEV/BUD once Russia or Austria weakens.

Fall 1910: UKR attacks RUM (3 vs 2) with SEV and GAL supporting UKR to RUM. WAR holds vs Austria. NOR and STP hold. Turkey, Austria, Germany, England have all asked for no Galicia or Baltic moves; I broke the Austria promise by keeping GAL. Watch Austria at WAR and VIE.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1911. A GAL remains in Galicia and threatens Budapest. I need it withdrawn to Warsaw or Sevastopol this Spring, or Austria will treat Galicia as a hostile front. Confirm your Spring orders now.

Austria here, Spring 1911. Your A VEN and F NAP are still on the Trieste and Albania approaches. Move them off this Spring and F TRI stays in Trieste, A VIE stays out of Venice and Tyrolia. Without that, Trieste is defended firmly. Confirm in writing.

Austria here, Spring 1911. A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece while A SER stays out of Bulgaria and Greece. Russia is the danger to Rumania. Tell me your Spring orders so we avoid bounces.

England here, Spring 1911. Norway is still yours with A NOR. I want to keep the peace and not attack Norway. Will A NOR hold again, and will F SEV stay off the North Sea? If so I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic and away from St Petersburg.

England, Spring 1911: I confirm F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel. Please confirm A BUR, F MAO and A MAR stay out of those too. Spain and Portugal are yours to pursue; we can write the arrangement when they open.

France here, Spring 1911. I hold A BUR, F MAO, A MAR, A POR and A SPA as agreed, with no French unit entering Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Please confirm F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of Belgium and Picardy this spring too. Tell me your plans for Belgium and Holland so we avoid a collision.

Germany here, Spring 1911. Russia has taken Rumania and the south is open. Please confirm A WAR, A GAL and A NOR stay off Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I keep BER, MUN, KIE, HOL and F BAL home. Tell me before any move on Vienna or Bohemia.

Germany here, Spring 1911. I am holding A MUN, BER and KIE, and I keep my word on Bohemia and Tyrolia. Please confirm A VIE and F TRI stay out of Bohemia and Tyrolia this spring. I will not move toward Vienna while you hold your word.

Germany here, Spring 1911. Confirming A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway, and F SWE stays out of the North Sea. Please keep F NTH, F NWG and F LVP out of Holland, Denmark, Sweden and Kiel. Let us both hold our northern centers.

Italy here, Spring 1911. Board is shifting. Are you still holding A SER and A GRE, or planning moves on Budapest or Trieste? If you strike Austria, I may join from Venice against Trieste with you on Serbia and Budapest. Confirm your Spring orders, and I keep F AEG-free Ionian promises.

Russia here, Spring 1911. Our armies should not fight each other while Austria is weak. I will keep A RUM and F SEV on Russian coasts and stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. Keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of Rumania, Sevastopol and Ukraine, and we can both look west and take Austrian centres.

Russia here. A GAL holds Galicia this Spring and A WAR stays in Warsaw. I will not move into Hungary or Trieste. Keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia and Warsaw, and we can both focus on Germany and Italy instead of fighting each other.

Turkey here, Spring 1911. A RUM holds with F BLA support and will not move. Your A WAR, A UKR and F SEV should stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. I will stay out of Galicia, Ukraine and Sevastopol. Confirm your Spring orders so neither of us wastes a unit.

Austria here. Confirmed: A VIE and F TRI stay out of Bohemia and Tyrolia this spring. I expect your A MUN to stay home as well. Italy is the common threat to Trieste; if you want to coordinate against Italy later, let's talk in Fall once Italian intentions are clearer.

Austria here. Your A GAL in Galicia is the problem; it still threatens Budapest and our trust. I will keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia and Warsaw, but I need A GAL withdrawn toward Warsaw or Sevastopol soon. Until then, Budapest stays defended. Tell me your Fall orders honestly.

England here, Spring 1911. Confirmed: F NTH, F LVP and A LON will not enter Belgium, Brest, Picardy or the Channel this spring. Please keep A BUR, F MAO and A MAR out of those as well. My Belgium plans: none this spring. Spain and Portugal are yours to pursue; we can write the arrangement when they open.

France here, Spring 1911. Confirmed: A BUR, F MAO, A MAR, A POR and A SPA hold this spring, and no French unit enters Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Please confirm F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of Belgium and Picardy too. Tell me your plans for Belgium and Holland so we avoid any collision in the north.

Italy here. Our Adriatic peace is over; your F TRI and A VIE have kept pressure on my border and I will not withdraw A VEN or F NAP while Trieste is held against me. Trieste is a fair target for me now. Only a real move, A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI off the Adriatic, changes my position. Otherwise expect a hard fight for Trieste.

Russia here, Spring 1911. A NOR holds this spring and Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its coast, away from Edinburgh and the North Sea. Keep F NTH and all fleets out of Norway, the Barents and St Petersburg, and we remain at peace.

Russia here, Spring 1911. A GAL holds Galicia and A WAR stays in Warsaw. I will not move into Hungary or Trieste. Keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia and Warsaw, and we can both focus on Germany and Italy rather than fight each other.

Russia here, Spring 1911. Confirmed: A WAR, A GAL and A NOR stay put this spring, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please keep F BAL and your armies off Prussia, Silesia and Livonia. I will tell you before any move touching Vienna or Bohemia.

Russia here, Spring 1911. A RUM and F SEV stay on Russian coasts and I will stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. Keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of Rumania, Sevastopol and Ukraine, and we can both look west for Austrian centres.

Turkey here, Spring 1911. A SER holds and stays out of Bulgaria and Greece. I will keep A GRE and A BUL home. Your A BUD, A VIE and F TRI should stay out of Serbia and Greece as agreed. Russia is the threat to Rumania, and I will defend it. Hold steady and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here, Spring 1911. I hold A SER and A GRE this spring, no moves on Budapest or Trieste. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece. Good luck against Austria, but I will not join a strike on Trieste.

Turkey here, Spring 1911. A RUM holds with F BLA support and will not move. I will stay out of Galicia, Ukraine and Sevastopol. Your A WAR, A UKR and F SEV should stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. Keep F SEV on the Russian coast and we can both grow westward against Austria.

notes.note: Spring 1911: holding all units to keep pacts with Russia, England, Austria. Russia, England and Austria confirmed their pacts this spring. No unowned centers. Growth needs a pact to break; watch Russia WAR/GAL and England NTH/NWG. Revisit in Fall if a pact fails.

Spring 1911: BUR, MAR, POR, SPA hold; F MAO to WES to prep SPA convoy to NAF/TUN next turn, avoiding Tunis and Piedmont per Italy. England (NTH, LVP, LON out of Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel) and Italy have kept word so far. Ask England about Belgium/Holland collision. No unowned centers reachable.

Spring 1911: holding BUD, TRI, VIE. VIE supports BUD to defend against Russian GAL. Russia has not withdrawn GAL despite repeated requests; Italy threatens TRI via VEN. Germany kept BOH/TYR promise so far. Turkey holding SER. Reassess an attack on GAL if Russia keeps breaking its word.

Spring 1911: all hold, keeping peace with Germany, England, Austria, Turkey. Austria objects to GAL; watch BUD/VIE. Turkey claims RUM but our unit holds it. Consider GAL/RUM push on BUD later if Austria weakens; no Baltic fleets.

Spring 1911: peace with Russia, France, Germany holds. Keeping NOR/Bel/Channel promises. F NTH to NWG sets up EDI convoy to NOR later if Russia breaks peace. Watch France Spain/Portugal arrangement and any Russian moves on Norway.

Spring 1911: all hold defensively; ROM supports VEN holding vs Austria. No unowned centers reachable; attacking TRI alone bounces with no support option. Kept promises to Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples) and France (no MAR/SPA/TUN/WES). Austria refuses truce, demands VEN/NAP withdrawal; refused. Revisit TRI only with Turkish support in SER/BUD, or if Austria's VIE leaves TYR.

Spring 1911: A GRE moves to SER (ours, so BUL stays home). Holding RUM claim with BLA support, no moves on Bulgaria/Constantinople. Promises kept: AEG out of ION, no Apulia/Naples moves. Russia and Austria both say they stay out of Bulgaria/Constantinople. Watch Russian A RUM and F SEV. Look for growth west once Austria is weak.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1911. Your A VEN and F NAP still threaten Trieste, and Italy has declared hostility. A VIE will not enter Tyrolia this fall, but F TRI and A BUD will defend Trieste firmly. If you withdraw VEN and NAP from the Adriatic, I will consider a truce. Otherwise we fight.

Austria here. A GAL is still in Galicia threatening Budapest despite our repeated requests. Withdraw it to Warsaw or Sevastopol now, or Austria will treat Galicia as hostile. Confirm your Fall orders in writing and I will keep A BUD and A VIE out of Galicia and Warsaw.

Austria here, Fall 1911. I keep A VIE and F TRI out of Bohemia and Tyrolia as agreed. Please keep A MUN home. Italy is hostile toward Trieste; if you move against Italy later, I am open to coordinating. Confirm your Fall orders.

England, Fall 1911. I am moving F NWG to NTH this fall and keeping A EDI and A LON home. I still see no reason to fight over Norway while peace holds. Please confirm A NOR holds again and F SEV stays off the North Sea and Edinburgh. I will keep fleets out of the Baltic and St Petersburg.

England, Fall 1911. My F NWG moves to NTH this fall, with no move toward Holland, Denmark, Kiel or Sweden. Please confirm A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway, and F SWE stays out of the North Sea. Let us both keep our northern centers.

France, Fall 1911: I hold A BUR, F MAO and my southern units, with no French move toward Munich, Ruhr, Kiel or Holland. With no unowned centers left, we both need growth. If England's Belgium weakens, I'd like to hear your view on a coordinated split of the north before anyone commits units there.

France, Fall 1911: I confirm no French unit enters Tunis, Piedmont, Naples or Western Mediterranean waters this fall. F MAO stays in MAO or WES. Please tell me your intentions for Tunis and Naples, and whether you plan any move toward Marseille or Spain before we settle the western sea.

Germany here, Fall 1911. Thank you for keeping your word. Austria is our weakest neighbour with only 3 centers. I propose we plan a joint move on Vienna and Bohemia in Spring 1912, with your armies coming through Galicia and my A MUN taking Bohemia. Tell me your Spring plans first.

Germany here, Fall 1911. Our northern pact has held well. Please confirm F NTH, F NWG and F LVP stay out of Holland, Denmark, Sweden and Kiel again this fall. I will keep A HOL, KIE and MUN out of Belgium and Norway. Tell me if your plans change.

Germany here, Fall 1911. I have kept A MUN out of Bohemia and Tyrolia as agreed. Russia's pressure on Rumania is a shared concern. I remain open to discussing a later arrangement against Italy around Trieste, but I want your A VIE and F TRI to stay out of Bohemia and Tyrolia this fall.

Italy here, Fall 1911. Austria is weakened and Trieste is open. Will you move A SER or A BUD against Budapest this fall? If Turkey strikes north, I will move A VEN and F TYS toward Trieste while keeping Greece and the Ionian untouched. Confirm your exact orders.

Russia here, Fall 1911. A RUM holds and F SEV stays on the Russian coast. I will not move against BUL or CON this fall. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of RUM, SEV and UKR. Tell me your Fall orders so we can both push west against Austria's Serbia and Trieste front without wasting units.

Russia here, Fall 1911. A WAR, A GAL, A NOR and A STP hold this fall, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I still ask F BAL and your armies to stay off Prussia, Silesia and Livonia. I will tell you before any move on Vienna or Bohemia. Please confirm your Fall orders.

Turkey here, Fall 1911. Your A RUM and F SEV are on the board and I have no move into Rumania or Sevastopol this fall. Please confirm A RUM and F SEV stay put, and that A WAR and A GAL stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. If you turn west against Austria, I will keep A SER and A BUL home.

Turkey here, Fall 1911. A SER holds and I will not enter Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia and Greece as agreed. Tell me your Fall orders so we avoid any bounce near Serbia or Rumania.

Austria here. Fall 1911: A VIE and F TRI stay out of Bohemia and Tyrolia, and I expect your A MUN to stay home as well. Russia is pressing Rumania and Galicia, which concerns us both. I'm open to coordinating against Italy around Trieste later, but let's first see Italian moves in Spring 1912 before committing.

Austria here. Fall 1911: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece as agreed, provided A SER stays out of Bulgaria and Greece. Russia is the shared threat to Rumania. Let's keep our fronts quiet and watch Italian moves in the Adriatic, which threaten Trieste.

England here, Fall 1911. Confirmed: F NTH, F NWG and F LVP will not enter Holland, Denmark, Sweden or Kiel this fall, and my fleets stay out of the Baltic. I expect A HOL, KIE and MUN to stay out of Belgium and Norway, and no German fleet to enter the North Sea. If both hold, we both keep our northern centers.

Germany here, Fall 1911. A MUN stays home this fall and stays out of Bohemia and Tyrolia, as agreed. I have no orders against Trieste. Italy is the threat to you, so I'm open to talking about coordinating against Italy in Spring 1912. Keep A VIE and F TRI out of Bohemia and Tyrolia.

Germany here. Thank you for keeping your word. A MUN, BER, KIE, HOL and F BAL hold this fall. I'm open to the joint Vienna and Bohemia plan for Spring 1912, but I'll need your Spring orders first, so I know your armies are headed through Galicia before I commit A MUN.

Italy here. Our Adriatic truce is over and I will not withdraw A VEN or F NAP while your fleet and army press Trieste and Tyrolia. Pull F TRI off the Adriatic approaches and A BUD away from Serbia, and I will reconsider. Otherwise expect Venice to be defended hard and Trieste to be contested.

Italy here. I confirm my units stay out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Western Mediterranean waters, Tunis, Naples and Piedmont this fall, as agreed. I have no plans against your western positions. Please keep F MAO out of Naples-bound waters and tell me before any move toward Tunis or the Ionian Sea.

Russia here. A GAL stays in Galicia this Fall; Galicia is ours and I will not withdraw it. I still will not move A WAR or A GAL into Hungary or Trieste. If A VIE and A BUD stay out of Galicia and Warsaw, we can both turn our attention elsewhere. Your move.

Russia here. A NOR holds this Fall and Norway stays Russian. F SEV stays on its coast, away from Edinburgh and the North Sea. Please keep F NTH, F NWG and all fleets out of Norway, the Barents and St Petersburg. I will keep my word on the Baltic and Norway.

Russia here. Confirmed: A WAR, A GAL, A NOR and A STP hold this Fall, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I will tell you before any move touching Vienna or Bohemia. A joint push in Spring 1912 can be discussed then, but I want your BAL and armies kept off Prussia, Silesia and Livonia first.

Russia here. A RUM holds and F SEV stays on the Russian coast this Fall. I have no move against BUL or CON now. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of RUM, SEV and UKR. I will consider turning west against Austria in due course, and I will tell you before any move that affects your units.

Turkey here. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. I am not moving A SER toward Budapest or Trieste this fall, so you are free to strike Trieste as you see fit. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece.

Turkey here. I have no move into Rumania or Sevastopol this fall. A BUL, A CON and F BLA will stay home and stay out of RUM, SEV and UKR. Please keep A WAR, A GAL and F SEV off Bulgaria and Constantinople, and let us both press Austria to the west.

notes.note: Fall 1911: NWG to NTH sets up convoy of A EDI/LON to NOR later. Holding EDI, LON, LVP. Peace with Russia, France, Germany holds; Russia says NOR holds. Attack Norway only if Russia breaks peace. Keep fleets out of Belgium, Brest, Channel, Baltic, Holland, Denmark, Kiel, Sweden.

Fall 1911: holding all to keep pacts. Russia, England, Austria kept word so far. Russia proposes Spring 1912 joint Vienna/Bohemia push; wants Russian Spring orders first. Only break pacts for solid gain. Watch Russia and England.

Fall 1911: all hold. Kept promises to England (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel, no BUR entry) and Italy (no Tunis/Piedmont/Naples/WES-Med). Both kept word. Germany asked about splitting north; no commitment. No unowned centers. Next: consider convoy of SPA to NAF/TUN via WES to MAO if Italy breaks word.

Fall 1911: Russia's A GAL ignored repeated withdrawal demands, so BUD attacks GAL with VIE support to clear the threat to BUD. TRI holds vs Italy. Germany kept BOH/TYR promise; Turkey kept SER/GRE. Italy hostile on Trieste. Reassess after result.

Fall 1911: holding all four Italian centers. ROM supports VEN holding against Austria. Keeping promises to France (no Tunis, Marseille, Spain, Western Med) and Turkey (no Greece, Ionian, Apulia, Naples). Trieste attack alone bounces with no support, so no attack. Austria refused truce. Revisit Trieste only with Turkish help in Serbia/Budapest.

Fall 1911: GAL attacks BUD (RUM supports) to grow into Austria; NOR takes unguarded German SWE. Broke Austria/Germany no-move promises; Turkey kept its word. Keep SEV and STP defensive; watch Austrian reprisals on WAR and GAL.

Fall 1911: all 6 centers held, no unowned centers nearby. Holding all units to keep promises: Russia (no RUM/SEV/UKR/BUL/CON entry), Italy (AEG out of ION, no NAP/APU), Austria (SER out of BUL/GRE). Watch Russian RUM/SEV and Italian fleets. Seek growth only if a neighbor weakens.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1912. A GAL has attacked Budapest's approaches for two years. Withdraw A GAL to Warsaw or Sevastopol now and I will keep A BUD and A VIE out of Galicia and Warsaw. If it stays, A BUD and A VIE will strike Galicia. Confirm your Spring orders.

Austria here. Your VEN and NAP still threaten Trieste. Move one unit off the Adriatic approaches this Spring and I will keep F TRI out of the Adriatic and hold Trieste only defensively. Let us put a written truce in place for 1912, and I will reply with my orders.

Austria here, Spring 1912. Russia and Italy both threaten me. I keep A VIE and F TRI out of Bohemia and Tyrolia. Please keep A MUN home. If Russia's Galicia pressure grows, I am open to a joint plan in 1912 against Russian units near Silesia and Bohemia.

England here, Spring 1912. I see Norway is empty and still yours, with A SWE and the new army in MOS. What are your plans for the north? I am holding EDI, LON and LVP and have no move into Norway this spring. Please confirm you will keep F SEV and your fleets away from the North Sea and Edinburgh.

England here, Spring 1912. Your A HOL, KIE and MUN are close to Belgium, which is mine. Please confirm none of them enter Belgium this spring, and that F BAL stays out of the North Sea. In return my F NTH stays out of Holland, Denmark and Kiel. Tell me your plans for the Baltic.

France, Spring 1912: I hold A BUR, F MAO, A MAR, A POR, A SPA as agreed, no French entry into Belgium, Picardy, Brest or Channel. Please confirm F NTH, F LVP, A LON stay out of those again. If you ever want Belgium, let's talk before anyone moves.

Germany here, Spring 1912. As you asked, I want your Spring orders first. Confirm A WAR, A GAL and A STP stay off Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. If your army is clearly headed for Vienna via Galicia, I will move A MUN into Bohemia to coordinate. Tell me your exact moves.

Germany here, Spring 1912. I will keep A MUN home unless Russia's Galicia push on Vienna is confirmed. Please confirm A VIE and F TRI still stay out of Bohemia and Tyrolia, and tell me your Spring orders. I remain open to coordinating against Italy around Trieste this Fall once Italian moves are clear.

Italy here, Spring 1912. Turkey, if you strike Budapest or Serbia-to-Budapest this spring, I will move A VEN against Trieste and F TYS toward the Adriatic in support. Greece and the Ionian stay untouched by me. Confirm whether A SER or A BUD moves north this spring.

Italy here, Spring 1912. Austria, I am weighing a move on Trieste while your army is stretched against Turkey. Withdraw A VIE from Tyrolia and keep F TRI out of the Adriatic approaches and I will hold. Otherwise, expect pressure on Trieste this fall.

Italy here, Spring 1912. I still keep my units out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Tunis and Western Mediterranean waters. Please confirm A MAR and F WES stay away from Piedmont and Tunis this spring, and tell me before any move toward Italian lines.

Russia here, Spring 1912. I have A SWE and F BAL is yours, so let's not fight over the Baltic. I will keep A SWE and A WAR out of Prussia and Livonia this spring. Please keep F BAL and your armies off SWE and STP. Tell me your Spring orders, and we can discuss Bohemia afterward.

Russia here, Spring 1912. I am keeping A RUM and F SEV on Russian coasts and have no move into BUL or CON. Please keep A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of RUM, SEV and UKR. Tell me your Spring orders so we can both press Austria in the west without wasting units.

Turkey here, Spring 1912. Your A RUM, F SEV and A GAL are on your side of the line. I will keep A BUL, A CON, A SER and F BLA out of Rumania and Sevastopol. Will you keep A WAR, A MOS and F SEV out of Bulgaria and Constantinople? Tell me your Spring orders so we avoid bounces.

Turkey here, Spring 1912. Our Serbia line has held well. I will keep A SER out of Budapest and Trieste while A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece. Russia is still the main danger in the north. Please confirm your Spring orders so we avoid any bounce.

Austria here, Spring 1912. A VIE and F TRI are staying out of Bohemia and Tyrolia this spring and I expect A MUN to stay home. Russia's Galicia push is the real danger; if it reaches Vienna I will coordinate with you against Russian units near Silesia. Let's talk Fall against Italy once their moves are clear.

Austria here. I will keep F TRI out of the Adriatic approaches and hold Trieste only defensively, provided your A VEN and F NAP move off the Trieste and Albania lines this spring. Show it in your orders and we can sign a written truce for 1912. Otherwise Trieste is defended firmly.

Austria here, Spring 1912. Confirmed: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece while A SER stays out of Bulgaria and Greece and away from Budapest and Trieste. Russia is the main danger in the north. My orders are defensive this spring; let's keep the Balkans quiet.

England here, Spring 1912. F NTH, F LVP and A LON will stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this spring as agreed. I will not enter Burgundy either. Please keep A BUR, F MAO, A MAR out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel too. Spain and Portugal can be written up once they open, but not before.

France here, Spring 1912. Confirmed: A MAR and F WES stay away from Piedmont and Tunis this spring, and my units stay out of Marseille-adjacent Italian lines and Western Mediterranean waters where your fleets operate. Please keep your units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal too. I will tell you before any move near your lines.

Germany here. A VIE and F TRI staying out of Bohemia and Tyrolia is noted. A MUN stays home for now. I have no orders against Trieste. If Russia's Galicia push threatens you seriously, we can talk about coordinating against Russian units near Silesia in Fall, but show me your Spring moves first.

Germany here. A HOL, KIE and MUN will not enter Belgium or Norway this spring, and F BAL stays out of the North Sea. Please keep F NTH out of Holland, Denmark, Kiel and Sweden as well. We both hold our northern centers for now.

Germany here. Before I move on Bohemia or Vienna I need clear Spring orders from you. Confirm A WAR, A GAL and A STP stay off Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. My F BAL stays home. Tell me exact moves and we can talk.

Italy here. I will not sign a written truce that leaves my Venice and Naples exposed while F TRI sits on Trieste and A VIE presses Tyrolia. Show me a real move first: A VIE back out of Tyrolia and F TRI off the Adriatic approaches. Then I will move VEN and NAP off the Trieste lines and we can talk about 1912 terms.

Russia here. A GAL stays in Galicia this Spring; I have no plan to move it into Hungary or Trieste. Keep A VIE and A BUD out of Galicia and Warsaw and we can both focus on Germany and Italy. Any move against Galicia will be answered.

Russia here. F SEV stays on its coast and will not move toward Edinburgh or the North Sea. A NOR is not moving this spring. Keep F NTH and all fleets out of Norway, the Barents and St Petersburg, and we stay at peace.

Russia here. This Spring A WAR, A GAL and A STP will not move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I will not commit to Vienna or Bohemia yet. Keep F BAL and your armies off SWE and STP and we are fine.

Russia here. A RUM and F SEV hold this Spring and I have no move into BUL or CON. A WAR and A MOS are not heading south. Keep A BUL, A CON, A SER and F BLA out of RUM, SEV and UKR and we keep the peace.

Turkey here, Spring 1912. I am not moving A SER or A BUD against Budapest or Trieste this spring, so the north-west is yours to contest with Austria. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece as agreed.

Turkey here, Spring 1912. A RUM holds with F BLA support, A BUL and A CON stay home, and I will not enter Galicia, Ukraine or Sevastopol. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and F SEV out of Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. Hold north and we both keep our centres while you press Austria.

notes.note: Spring 1912: holding BUR, MAR, POR, SPA per England/Italy promises. F WES to MAO to prep SPA convoy to NAF next turn, avoiding Tunis/Piedmont. England and Italy have kept word so far. Watch for growth chances; no unowned centers.

Spring 1912: holding all four Italian centers. ROM supports VEN holding vs Austria. Keeping promises to Turkey (no Greece, Ionian, Apulia, Naples) and France (no Marseille, Spain, Tunis, Western Med). Austria demands VEN/NAP withdrawal; refused until VIE leaves TYR and TRI leaves Adriatic. Revisit Trieste only with Turkish help.

Spring 1912: peace holds with Russia, France, Germany. Norway is empty Russian, but I keep the peace for now. F NTH to NWG sets up a convoy of EDI to NOR if Russia breaks peace. Keep fleets out of Belgium, Channel, Holland, Denmark, Kiel, Baltic. Watch for Spain/Portugal openings with France.

Spring 1912: F BAL to DEN (our SC, unowned-free growth-safe). Armies hold. Russia, England, Austria kept word so far. Watch Russia GAL/WAR, England NTH near DEN. Revisit Fall for Bohemia/Vienna only if pacts break.

Spring 1912: GAL attacks BUD, RUM supports GAL to BUD. Broke Austria's Galicia promise to gain Austrian centre. Keep Germany no-Prussia/Baltic deal, England NOR deal, Turkey no-RUM/SEV deal. Watch Austria reprisal on WAR/GAL and Turkey on RUM.

Spring 1912: all units hold to keep promises to Russia, Austria, Italy (no BUL/SER/RUM moves, AEG out of ION). No unowned centers nearby. Watch Russian WAR/MOS/SEV and Austrian BUD/TRI. Reassess for growth if a neighbor weakens.

Spring 1912: all hold to defend BUD, TRI, VIE. Russia says GAL stays; Turkey keeps SER/GRE quiet. Italy threatens TRI via VEN. Promised Germany no BOH/TYR. Reassess a GAL attack if Russia threatens BUD or VIE.

messages.body: Austria here. Your A BUD sits on our Budapest, which we have held for years. Withdraw it to Galicia or Serbia now, and I will keep A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania this Fall. If it stays, A VIE will attack it and I will look for a new partner against you.

Austria here. Russia now holds Budapest and threatens Vienna. I am ready to coordinate against Russian units near Bohemia and Silesia. Your A MUN and A BER could move toward Silesia in Spring 1913 while A VIE pressures Galicia. Can you confirm you will not attack Vienna or Trieste?

Austria here. Trieste is my last Adriatic center and Russia is now threatening Budapest. I propose a written truce: F TRI stays on Trieste, defends only, and does not enter the Adriatic approaches. In return, A VEN and F NAP stay off Trieste and Albania for 1913. Reply with your orders so we can sign.

England here. Norway is empty and I am taking it this Fall with F NWG. I know this breaks our peace, and I'm sorry for it. Keep your armies out of Norway, and I will keep my fleets out of Sweden, St Petersburg and the Baltic. I'd rather we both focus on other fronts than fight further.

England here. My F NWG is moving to Norway this Fall, and my northern fleets stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel as agreed. Please keep A BUR, F MAO and A MAR out of Belgium and the Channel, and let's leave Spain and Portugal to the arrangement we discussed.

France, Fall 1912. I hold A BUR, F MAO, A MAR, A POR, A SPA. Spain and Portugal are my units now, so I'll stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel. Please keep F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON out of Belgium and Brest. Let's talk before either of us moves into the north.

Germany here, Fall 1912. Your units now include A BUD, A RUM, A SWE, A WAR, A STP, A MOS, F SEV. Your Galicia push threatens Austria, and I hold A MUN. What are your Fall orders? I want no Russian move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia, and no fleet into the Baltic, as agreed. Tell me if you plan to take Warsaw or Bohemia this Fall.

Germany here, Fall 1912. Your BUD is under Russian pressure and I see A BUD now listed as Russian. I still keep A MUN out of Bohemia and Tyrolia for now. Tell me your Fall orders for VIE and TRI. If Russia takes Galicia and moves on Vienna, I am willing to discuss striking Russian units near Silesia together.

Germany here, Fall 1912. Please confirm F NWG, F NTH and F LVP stay out of Holland, Denmark, Kiel and Sweden this fall. My A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway. I am moving F BAL to DEN, so please keep F NTH out of Denmark. Tell me your Fall orders for EDI, LON and LVP.

Italy here, Fall 1912. Austria's BUD is now a Russian target and Austria is weakening. I propose we keep our pact: no Greece, Ionian, Apulia or Naples from me, and you keep A SER and your armies away from Venice and Apulia. Will you move against Budapest or Trieste this fall? Tell me your exact orders.

Russia here. A BUD takes Budapest this Fall and will stay. I will not move against Vienna or Trieste this Fall. Hold A VIE and F TRI and we can stop fighting. Any move on Vienna or Trieste will be answered.

Russia here. A RUM and F SEV hold this Fall, and I have no move into BUL or CON. Keep A BUL, A CON, A SER and F BLA out of RUM, SEV and UKR, and we stay at peace while I deal with Austria. Tell me your Fall orders.

Russia here. A SWE holds this Fall. I will not move against Prussia, Silesia, Livonia or Berlin. Keep F BAL and your armies off SWE and STP, and stay out of WAR and SEV. Please confirm your Fall orders.

Turkey here, Fall 1912. Your A BUD now sits next to my A SER, and A RUM is still yours. I have kept my word and my units hold. Please confirm A RUM, A BUD and F SEV stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Constantinople, and that you will not move on Ankara, Smyrna or Greece. If you keep the north quiet, I will keep A SER, A BUL and A CON home.

Turkey here, Fall 1912. Russia's A BUD and A RUM threaten both of us, and Russian units are close to Vienna and Trieste. Are you planning to contest BUD this fall? If you move against Budapest, I will keep A SER and A BUL home and not interfere, and we can later coordinate against Russian RUM. Tell me your exact orders.

Austria here. Your A BUD is in Budapest, which is ours. Withdraw it to Galicia or Serbia now or A VIE and F TRI will strike it this Fall. I will not move on Galicia or Warsaw unless you attack Vienna or Trieste first. Your choice.

Austria here. Russia holds Budapest and threatens Vienna. I am attacking BUD this Fall with A VIE supported by F TRI. Please keep A MUN out of Bohemia and Tyrolia, and move A BER or A MUN toward Silesia in Spring to pressure Russian units there.

Austria here. Yes, I am contesting BUD this Fall with A VIE and F TRI. Please keep A SER and A BUL out of Budapest and Trieste, and I will keep my units out of Serbia and Bulgaria. Once Russian RUM is weakened, we can talk about dividing the Rumanian front.

England here, Fall 1912. Confirmed: F NWG moves to Norway, and my F NTH, F LVP, A EDI and A LON stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this fall. Please keep A BUR, F MAO and A MAR out of Belgium and the Channel too. Spain and Portugal remain yours; we can write the arrangement once they open.

England here, Fall 1912. I confirm F NWG, F LVP and my other northern fleets stay out of Holland, Denmark, Kiel and Sweden this fall. Please keep A HOL, KIE and MUN out of Belgium and Norway, as you have promised. I am not moving toward Denmark. Tell me if F BAL changes course; I will hold EDI and LON and watch the north.

France here, Fall 1912. Confirmed: A BUR, F MAO, A MAR stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel this fall. Your F NWG moving to Norway is fine by me. Please keep F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON out of Belgium and Brest, as you agreed. Spain and Portugal are my units now, and I'm not moving north. Let's keep the west quiet.

Germany here. I will not attack Vienna or Trieste. Russia's seizure of Budapest breaks our trust, so let's coordinate against Russian units near Silesia and Bohemia in Spring 1913. This Fall my A MUN holds. Let's agree that A VIE stays on Galicia pressure and not on Munich, and that we share intelligence on Russian moves.

Germany here. You now hold Budapest, Sweden and a fleet on Sevastopol, and you told me A SWE holds only this Fall. Taking Austrian ground while pressing my border is not what we agreed. Withdraw from Galicia and Silesia threats, keep A WAR out of Prussia and Silesia, and keep F BAL out of your reach. Tell me your Spring moves plainly.

Italy here. I will not sign a truce that leaves Venice and Naples open while your fleet sits on Trieste and your army presses Tyrolia. Our Adriatic peace is already broken. Show me a real move first: A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI off the Adriatic approaches. Then we can talk about 1913 terms.

Russia here. A SWE holds this Fall, and A WAR, A STP and F SEV stay put. I will not move against Prussia, Silesia, Livonia or Berlin, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. F BAL and your armies must stay off SWE and STP. Bohemia can wait until we see Austria's moves.

Russia here. A BUD stays in Budapest and I will not move against Vienna or Trieste this Fall. I cannot withdraw from Budapest. Hold A VIE and F TRI, keep your armies out of Galicia and Warsaw, and we can both turn our attention to Italy and Germany.

Russia here. Norway is Russian, and A NOR is not empty while F NWG is adjacent. I will defend it. If F NWG moves into Norway this Fall, I will treat it as war on the north. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic and St Petersburg, and we can still avoid fighting elsewhere.

Russia here. A RUM and F SEV hold this Fall. A BUD is only holding Budapest against Austria, not moving against Serbia. I have no move into Bulgaria or Constantinople. Keep A SER, A BUL, A CON and F BLA out of Rumania, Sevastopol and Ukraine, and we stay at peace.

Turkey here, Fall 1912. I will not move against Budapest or Trieste this fall, and A SER stays home. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples, and I keep to our pact. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian. Good luck against Austria.

Turkey here, Fall 1912. A RUM holds with F BLA support, A BUL and A CON stay home, and I will not enter Galicia, Ukraine or Sevastopol. Please keep A BUD, A SWE, A WAR, A MOS, A STP and F SEV out of Serbia, Bulgaria, Constantinople, Rumania and Ankara. Keep the north quiet and we both keep our centres.

notes.note: Fall 1912: all hold, keeping four Italian centers. Promises kept to Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples) and France (no Marseille/Spain/Tunis moves). Austria wants VEN/NAP withdrawal first; refused until VIE leaves TYR and TRI leaves Adriatic. Revisit Trieste only with Turkish help in SER/BUD.

Fall 1912: all holding to protect 5 German SCs. Russia took BUD and is hostile via SWE/WAR; Austria at war with Russia. Pacts: England (no Bel/Nor, fleets out of Den/Kie/Swe) kept so far. Keep A MUN out of Bohemia/Tyrolia unless needed. Revisit Spring 1913 for Silesia/Prussia defense or Russian SWE if Russia stays aggressive.

Fall 1912: F NWG moves to NOR to take the empty Russian center, breaking peace with Russia, who has threatened war. EDI, LON, LVP hold home. France and Germany were told their zones stay untouched. Watch for Russian retaliation on NOR and for German moves toward Denmark or Sweden.

Fall 1912: Held BUR/MAR/POR/SPA, MAO to WES to prep SPA convoy to NAF next turn, avoiding Tunis/Piedmont per Italy. England (NWG to NOR, north out of Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel) and Italy have kept word. No unowned centers; watch for openings, keep promises.

Fall 1912: VIE attacks BUD alone (no TRI support option for BUD); TRI holds Trieste vs Italy. Russia promised no move on VIE/TRI. Germany and Turkey pledged no BUD/TRI moves. Italy hostile on Adriatic. Reassess after result.

Fall 1912: BUD holds, RUM supports BUD (defend vs Austria). STP to NOR with SWE support to hold Norway vs England NWG. Keep MOS, SEV, WAR home. Austria and Germany want no Galicia/Prussia moves; I broke promises earlier. Watch Austria attacks on BUD and England on NOR; Turkey peaceful so far. Consider SEV-BLA convoy plan next turn.

Fall 1912: attacking RUM with BUL (BLA and SER support). Russia and Austria are in conflict over BUD. Keep AEG, ANK, CON home; Italy pact holds (no Greece/Ionian moves). If RUM falls, consolidate; watch Russian retaliation on SER and BUL.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1913. Budapest is still yours and I am not forgetting it. Russia holds Budapest and Rumania pressure while my Vienna stands. Withdraw A BUD toward Galicia or Serbia and I will keep A VIE and F TRI off Galicia and Warsaw. Otherwise I will keep contesting Budapest. Your answer?

Austria here. Spring 1913: I want A MUN and A BER moving toward Silesia against Russian units there, and I will keep A VIE off Munich and Bohemia. Please confirm you will not attack Vienna or Trieste, and tell me which Russian unit you target first.

Austria here. Trieste is defended and F TRI stays put. I ask that F NAP and A VEN leave the Trieste and Albania lines this spring. Show that in your orders and I will keep F TRI out of the Adriatic approaches. Otherwise Trieste holds firmly.

England here, Spring 1913. Russia's A NOR and our F NWG are now in open standoff. Russia has threatened war on the north. I propose we coordinate against Russia: I press Norway with F NWG and fleets from EDI/LON, and you take Sweden and St Petersburg pressure from Denmark and Kiel. Will you keep A HOL, KIE and MUN out of Belgium while we do this?

England here, Spring 1913. Confirming our arrangement: my F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this spring. Please keep A BUR, F WES and A MAR out of Belgium and the Channel too. Let's keep the west quiet while I deal with Russia in the north.

France, Spring 1913. I'm still holding A BUR, F MAO, A MAR, A POR, A SPA and keeping my units out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel. Your Belgium plans matter to me. Are F NTH, F LVP, A LON and A EDI staying north for now? Tell me your fall intentions before either of us moves into the north.

France here, Spring 1913. I'm keeping A BUR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and I want no German units into Burgundy or Picardy. What are A MUN, A BER and A HOL doing this year? If Belgium opens, I'd like to hear your view on splitting the north before anyone commits units.

Germany here. Russia's A SWE, A STP and A BUD moves have broken our pact. Russia holds Sweden and Budapest now. Tell me plainly your Spring 1913 orders for SWE, WAR and SEV, and whether A WAR stays out of Prussia and Silesia. Without that, I will defend Berlin and Silesia.

Italy here, Spring 1913. Austria is collapsing and Russia is pushing on Budapest. Do you plan any move on Serbia-to-Budapest or Trieste this spring? I will hold my Greece and Ionian pact, and if you strike north I will move A VEN toward Trieste. Confirm your exact orders.

Russia here, Spring 1913. Your Fall 1912 complaint is fair; I broke my word on Budapest. A SWE and A WAR will not move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Will you keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg? Tell me your Spring orders.

Russia here. A BUD holds Budapest and A RUM, F SEV hold this Spring. I will not move into Serbia, Bulgaria or Constantinople. Will your A SER, A BUL and A CON stay out of Rumania, Ukraine and Sevastopol? Confirm your Spring orders so we both keep our centres.

Turkey here, Spring 1913. Your A UKR, A WAR and A MOS are massed near Rumania and I see A BUD, A RUM threat. I will hold A RUM and A SER. Please confirm no move into RUM, BUL, CON or SEV this spring so we both can keep our centres and focus on Austria.

England here, Spring 1913. My F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this spring, as agreed. I have no plans for Belgium now. Please keep A BUR, F WES and A MAR out of Belgium and the Channel too. Spain and Portugal stay yours to pursue; we can put a written arrangement in place once they are open.

France here, Spring 1913. Confirmed: A BUR, F MAO, A MAR, A POR, A SPA hold this spring; no French unit enters Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Please keep F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel as well. Let's keep the west quiet while you deal with Russia. I'm open to a written Spain/Portugal arrangement when the board opens.

Germany here. Your A SWE and A BUD moves broke trust, but I will consider a fresh pact if it is verified. Confirm in writing: A SWE and A WAR leave Prussia, Silesia and Livonia alone, F SEV stays out of the Black Sea toward Rumania, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I will keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg while you do so.

Italy here. Spring 1913: I will not withdraw A VEN or F NAP while your F TRI sits on Trieste and A VIE can reach Tyrolia. Our truce died long ago. Give me a real move first, A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI off the Adriatic approaches, and I will reconsider. Until then Venice and Naples stay defended.

Russia here. A BUD stays in Budapest this Spring; I cannot withdraw from it. I will not move A BUD, A RUM or A UKR into Vienna or Trieste. Keep A VIE and F TRI at home and out of Galicia and Warsaw, and we can both look west and south instead of fighting.

Russia here, Spring 1913. A SWE and A WAR will not move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic this Spring. I cannot promise A BUD will leave Budapest. Please keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg, and we can keep the north quiet.

Russia here. A RUM and F SEV hold this Spring, and I will not move into Bulgaria or Constantinople. Confirm A SER, A BUL, A CON and F BLA stay out of Rumania, Ukraine and Sevastopol, and we both keep our centres while I deal with Austria.

Turkey here, Spring 1913. I am holding A SER and A RUM this spring and am not moving on Budapest or Trieste. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece as agreed. Good luck if you strike Trieste.

Turkey here, Spring 1913. A RUM and A SER hold this spring, and I have no move into Bulgaria, Constantinople or Sevastopol. Your A UKR, A WAR and A MOS are massed near Rumania, so please keep them out of RUM, BUL and CON. Confirm your Spring orders and we both keep our centres while we press Austria.

notes.note: Spring 1913: holding NAP, VEN, ROM supports VEN vs Austria; TYS holds. Kept pacts with Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples) and France. Austria refuses to withdraw F TRI and A VIE; no truce. Revisit Trieste only with Turkish help in SER/BUD.

Spring 1913: holding all five German SCs. Russia (SWE, WAR, BUD) has broken prior pacts; Russia promises no move into Prussia/Silesia/Livonia and no Baltic fleet, but Russia held Budapest and Sweden. England wants a north coalition vs Russia; France wants no German units in Burgundy/Picardy. Watch Russia WAR/SWE and whether Russia enters Prussia or Silesia. Consider a verified pact with Russia bef

Spring 1913: Russia keeps A BUD and refuses to withdraw; I attack BUD with VIE, TRI holds Trieste vs Italy. Russia, Germany, Turkey have made promises; Italy hostile on Adriatic. Reassess after result; keep VIE/TRI home if Italy moves on TRI.

Spring 1913: F WES to TUN to grab an unowned-by-me Italian center (breaks Italy promise on Tunis; Italy had kept word). Held BUR/MAR/POR/SPA, keeping out of Belgium/Picardy/Brest/Channel per England. Watch Italian retaliation from TYS/NAP; England kept word so far.

Spring 1913: A EDI convoyed via F NWG to NOR to attack Russian A NOR. LON and LVP hold home. Peace with France holds in west; Germany talks on Belgium pending. Russia threatened war; watch for Russian support into Norway.

Spring 1913: BUD attacks RUM, supported by SEV and UKR (3 vs 1) to take Rumania. Broke Turkey's RUM promise. Holding MOS, NOR, SWE, WAR to keep the north quiet and deal with Germany and England. Watch Austria retaking BUD and Turkey's counterattack.

Spring 1913: all hold to keep pacts with Russia (no RUM/BUL/CON/SEV entry), Italy (AEG out of ION, no Greece/Apulia/Naples), Austria. Watch Russian A UKR/A WAR/A MOS near RUM. Look for growth on BUD/TRI or SEV if Russia commits north; Russia has not kept full promises but no attack yet.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1913. A BUD is still in Budapest. I am attacking it this Fall with A VIE and F TRI support. Withdraw to Galicia or Serbia now and I will hold my units off Galicia and Warsaw. Otherwise expect a fight for Budapest. Your answer?

Austria here. Fall 1913: I am moving A VIE against Budapest and keeping F TRI on Trieste. Please keep A MUN out of Bohemia and Tyrolia and confirm you will not move on Vienna. Share what you see of Russian moves toward Silesia.

Austria here. F TRI holds Trieste and stays out of the Adriatic approaches this Fall. I ask that A VEN and F NAP do not move toward Trieste or Albania. Confirm your Fall orders so we both avoid a costly clash.

England here. Norway is now contested; A NOR and our fleets are in standoff. I propose a ceasefire in the north: I withdraw from Norway if your A NOR and F SEV stay off Edinburgh, the North Sea and Sweden to my west. Tell me your Fall orders for NOR and SWE.

England here, Fall 1913. I will keep F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel as agreed. Please keep A BUR, F MAO and A MAR out of Belgium and the Channel. A written Spain/Portugal arrangement can follow once the board opens.

England here, Fall 1913. Please keep A HOL, KIE and MUN out of Belgium and Norway, and F DEN out of the North Sea. I will keep my fleets out of Denmark, Holland and Kiel. Let us both hold our northern centers while I deal with Russia.

France here. I moved F WES into Tunis, which breaks our Tunis understanding, and I regret the surprise. I will not move toward Naples, Rome or Venice, and I'd like F TYS and F NAP to stay out of Tunis. Let's keep the central Mediterranean stable and discuss a fair split of the North African options.

France here. My Belgium and Channel promises still hold: no French unit enters Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Please keep F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON out of those too. Once Spain and Portugal open, let's write the Spain/Portugal arrangement down together.

Germany here, Fall 1913. Russia's A SWE and A BUD are taking my neighbours' ground. I will keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg only if A SWE leaves Sweden or stays out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and F SEV stays out of Rumania. Confirm your Fall orders for SWE, WAR, SEV and BUD in writing.

Germany here. I will keep A HOL, KIE and MUN out of Belgium and Norway this Fall. I am not joining a northern attack on Russia yet; Russia has broken pacts, but I want to see verified Russian moves first. Keep F NWG and F NTH out of Holland, Denmark and Kiel, and we both hold.

Germany here. A MUN stays home this Fall and A BER holds. I will not attack Vienna or Trieste. Russia holds Budapest, so I suggest you press BUD with A VIE and F TRI while I watch Silesia. Tell me your Fall orders so we avoid bumping units.

Italy here, Fall 1913. Turkey, RUM is now yours after BUL retreat. Russia's A UKR and A RUM-area pressure threatens you too. I keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS, A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian. Will you keep A SER home and F AEG out of the Ionian this fall? Tell me your exact orders.

Italy here, Fall 1913. Your BUD is under Russian attack and I see no reason to fight you now. I will hold VEN, NAP and ROM this fall. If A VIE leaves Tyrolia and F TRI stays off the Adriatic approaches, I will not move against Trieste. Confirm your orders.

Italy here, Fall 1913. I keep my fleets out of Tunis, Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Western Mediterranean waters this fall. Your F TUN is in Tunis, so I expect you to hold it. Please confirm that A MAR, A SPA and A POR stay away from Piedmont and Naples.

Russia here, Fall 1913. I hold RUM with A RUM and F SEV stays in the Black Sea. Your A BUL is next to RUM, so please confirm A BUL, A CON and A SER stay out of RUM, UKR and SEV this Fall. I will keep my armies out of BUL and CON. Confirm your orders so we both keep our centres.

Russia here, Fall 1913. A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. In return, please keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. I will tell you my Fall orders plainly before they are final.

Russia here. A BUD stays in Budapest this Fall, and I will not move A WAR or A GAL-side units into Vienna or Trieste. Keep A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania, and we can both turn to Italy and Germany.

Turkey here, Fall 1913. I am moving A BUL against Rumania this Fall, supported by F BLA. Your A RUM is the target. I will not enter Sevastopol or Ukraine. Keep A UKR, A WAR and A MOS out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and we can talk about the north once Rumania is settled.

Turkey here, Fall 1913. Russia's A BUD is under pressure from your A VIE and F TRI. I will keep A SER out of Budapest and Trieste. I am striking Russian Rumania this Fall with A BUL and F BLA. Please hold your Balkan units out of Serbia and Bulgaria as agreed.

Austria: Thanks. A VIE attacks Budapest this Fall with F TRI holding Trieste. I will keep A VIE out of Munich and Bohemia. Please keep A MUN home and do not move on Vienna or Trieste. Silesia coordination can wait until Russia's units there are clearer.

Austria: F TRI holds Trieste and stays out of the Adriatic approaches this Fall. Please keep A VEN and F NAP off Trieste and Albania. Our units are not moving toward each other this turn, so let's both hold and avoid a costly clash.

Austria: A BUD is still in Budapest and I am attacking it this Fall with A VIE, supported by F TRI. Withdraw now to Galicia or Serbia and I will keep my units off Galicia and Warsaw. If it stays, we fight. Your choice.

Austria: Understood on your Rumania strike with A BUL and F BLA. I am attacking Russian BUD with A VIE and F TRI, not entering Serbia or Bulgaria. Please keep A SER out of Budapest and Trieste as agreed, and we both keep our Balkan lines quiet.

England here. Fall 1913: my F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON will stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel as agreed. Please keep A BUR, F MAO and A MAR out of Belgium and the Channel too. Once Spain and Portugal open, let's write our Spain/Portugal arrangement down and keep the west quiet.

France here, Fall 1913. Confirmed: no French unit enters Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel this fall. A BUR and F MAO hold. Please keep F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON out of those too. Once Spain and Portugal are settled, let's write the arrangement down, and let's talk before either of us moves into the north.

France here. Yes, F TUN took Tunis and I regret breaking our understanding. I will not move toward Naples, Rome or Venice this fall. I'd like F TYS and F NAP kept out of Tunis, and I'm open to a fair split of the North African options. Let's keep the central Mediterranean stable and talk before any move there.

Germany here. A MUN and A BER hold this Fall, and I will not move against Vienna or Trieste. Press Budapest with A VIE and F TRI as you planned. I will watch Silesia and Bohemia, and if Russian units move toward Silesia I will consider striking them with you in Spring 1914.

Germany here. A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway this Fall as promised, and I am not moving into the North Sea. Keep F NWG and F NTH out of Holland, Denmark and Kiel and we both hold. I remain unconvinced about a northern attack on Russia until I see verified Russian moves.

Germany here. Your Fall pledges on Prussia, Silesia, Livonia and the Baltic are noted, but Budapest and Sweden were taken against our pact. Verify it: A SWE and A WAR must stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and F SEV must stay out of Rumania. Then A BER, F DEN and A KIE stay off Sweden and St Petersburg.

Italy here. Our Adriatic positions are defensive: VEN, NAP and ROM hold this fall. I will not move against Trieste while A VIE stays out of Tyrolia and F TRI stays off the Adriatic approaches. Show that in your orders and we can keep the peace. Any move into Venice or Tyrolia changes everything.

Italy here. Your F WES into Tunis is a serious breach, and I will not accept it quietly. Tunis was ours to keep out of. I am holding NAP, VEN and ROM and I will defend them. Move F TUN out and return to the understanding, or we are at odds in the central Mediterranean.

Russia here. A BUD stays in Budapest this Fall and I cannot withdraw it. I will not move A WAR or A GAL-side units into Vienna or Trieste this Fall. If A VIE and F TRI attack Budapest, we are at war, so consider the alternative: hold, and we both turn toward Italy and Germany.

Russia here. Norway is contested and A NOR stays this Fall. Your F NWG is the threat. I will keep F SEV off Edinburgh and the North Sea and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Withdraw F NWG from Norway and we can keep the north quiet. Attack Norway and I will answer.

Russia here. A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic this Fall. Please keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. A BUD stays in Budapest, which is a separate matter with Austria. Confirm and we keep the north quiet.

Russia here. Your A BUL moving on RUM is a broken promise to me, and I will defend Rumania with A RUM, F SEV and the Black Sea. Keep A UKR-side units and A WAR out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and I will keep my armies out of BUL and CON. Withdraw A BUL from RUM and we can talk.

Turkey here, Fall 1913. I keep F AEG out of the Ionian and my armies out of Apulia and Naples, as agreed. A SER stays home this fall. I am dealing with Russia in Rumania, so I cannot spare units for the Adriatic. Keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece and I will not trouble your Trieste plans.

Turkey here, Fall 1913. Your RUM claim is not accepted. A RUM is Turkish-held ground I am contesting, and A BUL moves against it this Fall with F BLA support. Keep A UKR, A WAR and A MOS out of Bulgaria, Constantinople and Rumania, and I will not enter Sevastopol or Ukraine. Please confirm your orders.

notes.note: Fall 1913: holding all to keep TUN (taken this Fall if F TUN stays). Kept promises to England (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel, BUR holds) and kept out of Naples/Rome/Venice. Italy angry over Tunis; try to rebuild understanding. Next: consider SPA convoy to NAF once Italy settles, and talk Spain/Portugal arrangement with England.

Fall 1913: holding all five German SCs as promised to England (no Bel/Nor) and Austria (MUN home). Russia took SWE/BUD against pact; watch SWE/WAR moves into Prussia/Silesia. Revisit Spring 1914 for Silesia strike with Austria if Russia moves west.

Fall 1913: A BUD holds to take BUD, which becomes mine if it stays. F TRI holds Trieste against Italy. Russia has repeatedly broken its word, so I expect attack on BUD. Turkey promised to keep SER out of BUD/TRI. Italy is hostile on Adriatic. Next: consider supporting BUD defense and watch Russian RUM/GAL/WAR moves.

Fall 1913: all hold to keep NAP, ROM, VEN and TUN-claim. Promises: kept Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples) and France (no Tunis/Marseille/Spain moves). France's F TUN breached Tunis; I may challenge it later. Austria asked VEN/NAP to stay off TRI; I'll not move on TRI unless A VIE enters Tyrolia or F TRI enters Adriatic. Revisit with Turkish help.

Fall 1913: NWG to NTH sets up convoy of EDI/LON toward NOR later. Keeping peace with France and Germany (no Belgium, Channel, Holland, Denmark, Kiel). Russia threatens over NOR; Russia has not attacked yet. Watch Russian moves on NOR/SWE and German moves in the north.

Fall 1913: holding RUM with SEV and UKR support against Turkish BUL/BLA attack. All others hold for defence. Turkey, Germany, England, Austria have all broken or contested pledges; reassess next turn. Consider SEV-BLA convoy to take ANK/CON area later.

Fall 1913: A BUL moves to RUM, F BLA supports. Attacking Russian RUM. Other units hold to guard centers. Russia has broken pact over RUM. Keep AEG out of ION per Italy pact; SER stays home per Austria pact. Watch Russian SEV/UKR/WAR for retaliation on BUL/CON.

messages.body: Austria here. Spring 1914: A BUD remains a direct threat to my Vienna and Trieste. Withdraw A BUD to Galicia or Serbia now and I will keep A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia and Warsaw. If it stays, I attack it with A VIE supported by F TRI. Your answer before orders lock?

England here, Spring 1914. Our northern standoff is costing us both. I propose a ceasefire: my F NTH and fleets stay out of Norway, Barents and St Petersburg, and your A NOR, F SEV and fleets stay off Edinburgh, the North Sea and Sweden. Please confirm your Spring orders for NOR and SWE.

England here, Spring 1914. I am holding EDI, LON and LVP and my fleets stay out of Holland, Denmark, Kiel and Belgium. Please confirm A HOL, KIE, MUN and F DEN stay out of Belgium and the North Sea. Tell me your Spring plans against Russia, since I may need to coordinate on Sweden.

England here, Spring 1914. My fleets stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel as agreed. Please keep A BUR, A PAR and F MAO out of those areas too. Let us draft the Spain/Portugal arrangement in writing now that the board is open.

France here, Spring 1914. Still holding to our Belgium and Channel understanding. I'd like to write down the Spain/Portugal arrangement now: I take Spain and Portugal, you keep Belgium, Picardy and Brest out of French reach. Let me know if you want your fleets to stay in the North Sea this spring.

Germany here, Spring 1914. Russia has taken Sweden and Budapest, so trust is low. Before I consider any pact, tell me plainly: will A SWE or A WAR move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia this spring, and will F SEV stay out of Rumania? Verifiable answers only.

Germany here, Spring 1914. I hold MUN, BER and KIE this spring and will not attack Vienna or Trieste. If Russian units move into Silesia, I want A VIE pressuring Galicia or Budapest, and I will strike Silesia with you. What are your Spring orders?

Germany here, Spring 1914. I still hold Belgium's neighbours peacefully and will keep A HOL, KIE and MUN out of Belgium and Norway. I will not join a northern attack on Russia until I see Russia's Spring moves. Keep F NTH out of Denmark and Holland, please.

Italy here, Spring 1914. F TUN is a breach of our understanding. I want F TUN out of Tunis, or at least a clear split: you keep Iberia and Marseille, I keep Tunis and the Italian coast. Tell me your orders for Tunis and the Tyrrhenian this spring.

Italy here. Russia is pressing you in Rumania and Bulgaria. I will keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian as agreed. Will you hold A SER and F AEG this spring? If you strike north against Russia, I may join against Trieste.

Italy here. Your F TRI and A VIE still block my Adriatic. Withdraw A VIE from Tyrolia and F TRI from the Adriatic approaches, and I will hold VEN and NAP. If you refuse, I will press Trieste this year. Tell me your Spring 1914 orders.

Russia here. Your A BUL attacked RUM last Fall and I am holding it. Withdraw A BUL to Serbia or Bulgaria-safe ground and F BLA stays out of SEV. Then I will keep A UKR and A WAR out of BUL and CON. Otherwise Rumania stays a war zone. Your answer?

Russia here. A BUD stays this Spring. Austria, withdraw A VIE and F TRI from Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania-facing squares, and I will not move into VIE or TRI. Attack BUD and we fight. Let us both look at Italy and Germany instead.

Turkey here, Spring 1914. Rumania is the open question. A BUL and F BLA are attacking A RUM this spring. If you pull A RUM back to Galicia or Ukraine and keep A UKR, A WAR and A MOS out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, I will keep F BLA out of Sevastopol and Ukraine. Tell me your exact orders so we avoid a bounce.

Austria here. A BUD is ours and I will hold Vienna and Trieste defensively, with A VIE and F TRI staying home. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Withdraw from Budapest and we can both look at Italy and Germany. Keep your armies out of Vienna and Trieste and I will do the same.

Austria here. Thanks for holding MUN, BER and KIE. A VIE stays in Vienna and does not enter Bohemia or Tyrolia. If Russian units move into Silesia, I am ready to coordinate against them in Spring 1914. Tell me which Russian unit you target first, and confirm A BER will not move toward Vienna.

Austria here. A VIE is in Vienna, not Tyrolia, and F TRI holds Trieste defensively. I will not move into the Adriatic approaches. Please keep A VEN and F NAP off Trieste and Albania, and I will hold. Your best gains are against Turkey in the Balkans, not against me. Confirm your Spring orders.

England here, Spring 1914. My fleets stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel. Please keep A BUR, A PAR and F MAO out of those areas too. Spain and Portugal are yours; I agree to a written arrangement: you take Spain and Portugal, I keep my northern and Channel holdings untouched. Let's keep the west quiet while I deal with Russia.

England here, Spring 1914. My F NTH, F LVP, A EDI and A LON will stay out of Holland, Denmark, Kiel and Belgium. Please confirm A HOL, KIE, MUN and F DEN stay out of Belgium and the North Sea. I am considering a northern operation against Russia via Norway and Sweden, and I will tell you before any move that touches your zone.
