France, Spring 1914. Agreed: no French unit enters Belgium, Brest, Picardy or the Channel this spring. A BUR, A PAR and F MAO will not go there. Spain and Portugal are mine; I propose we put in writing that England stays north of Belgium and out of Iberia. Please confirm your fleets hold in the North Sea and Channel approaches as promised.

France, Spring 1914. F TUN stays in Tunis for now; I will not move it against Naples, Rome or Venice. My fleets stay out of Piedmont and the Tyrrhenian this spring. I accept your offer in principle: Iberia and Marseille to me, Tunis and the Italian coast to you, with F TUN withdrawn to the Western Mediterranean in Fall. Please keep F NAP and F TYS away from Tunis.

Germany here, Spring 1914. Confirmed: A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway, and my fleets stay out of the North Sea. F DEN stays put in Denmark and will not enter the North Sea. I am not yet committing to your northern attack on Russia; I will decide after I see Russia's Spring moves. Keep F NTH and F LVP out of Holland, Denmark and Kiel.

Russia: A BUD stays in Budapest this Spring and I will hold it. Withdrawing A VIE and F TRI from Galicia and Warsaw approach is your only route to peace. I will not move into Vienna or Trieste, but if you attack BUD we fight. Let us both look at Italy and Germany.

Russia: I will not move A SWE or A WAR into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia this Spring, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. F SEV stays on the Black Sea coast, away from Rumania-facing squares. Keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg, and we keep the north quiet.

Russia: Agreed on the north. A NOR holds this Spring, F SEV stays off Edinburgh and the North Sea, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Keep F NTH, your fleets out of Norway, Barents and St Petersburg, and keep F NWG away from Norway. Confirm and we both stay out of the north war.

Russia: A RUM holds this Spring and F SEV stays in the Black Sea. Your A BUL attacked RUM last Fall, so withdraw A BUL to Serbia or Bulgaria and keep F BLA out of SEV. I will keep A UKR and A WAR out of BUL and CON. Confirm those orders and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here. Confirmed: F AEG stays out of the Ionian, my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples, and I will not move A SER toward Budapest or Trieste this spring. I am dealing with Russia in Rumania. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian, and we both prosper.

Turkey here, Spring 1914. A BUL and F BLA are attacking A RUM this spring, and I will not withdraw from Rumania without a guarantee. If your A RUM retreats to Galicia or Ukraine and A UKR, A WAR and A MOS stay out of Bulgaria, Constantinople and Rumania, I will keep F BLA out of Sevastopol. Confirm your orders first.

notes.note: Spring 1914: holding all five German SCs. Russia pledged no Prussia/Silesia/Livonia moves and no Baltic fleet; England wants a northern attack on Russia, undecided. Austria coordinating vs Russia in Silesia. Watch A SWE/A WAR moves; consider striking Silesia with Austria if Russia moves west.

Spring 1914: peace with Russia (NOR holds, I keep fleets out of NOR/StP/Barents), France (west quiet, Spain/Portugal to France), Germany (north quiet). NTH to NWG sets up convoy of A EDI to NOR later if Russia breaks peace. Hold home centers. Need new centers: consider Norway/Sweden via convoy when opportune. Check promises each turn.

Spring 1914: F NAP to TYS to set up convoy of A ROM to TUN next turn. ROM supports VEN holding vs Austria. Promises: keep out of Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples (Turkey, has kept). France: Tunis and Italian coast to me, F TUN withdraws in Fall (watch). Austria: no VEN/NAP to Trieste; Austria's A VIE still in Vien, F TRI on Trieste. Plan: take Tunis, then Trieste with Turkish help.

Spring 1914: all hold to defend BUD, TRI, VIE. Russia, Italy, Germany, Turkey all pressing for peace or promises. Watch Russian RUM/WAR/UKR and Italian VEN. Reassess a Rumania or Serbia strike if Russia leaves RUM.

Spring 1914: all hold to keep promises (England: no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel; Italy: no Naples/Rome/Venice, TUN held for now). Plan: F TUN to WES in Fall per Italy deal, then SPA convoy to NAF/TUN if Italy agrees. Watch Germany on BUR's border. No unowned centers yet.

Spring 1914 defensive: RUM holds with SEV and UKR support against Turkish BUL/BLA. NOR, SWE, WAR, MOS hold to keep north quiet per England/Germany pacts. Austria: no Budapest deal; watch VIE/TRI. Turkey: want BUL withdrawal and no BLA into SEV. Germany and England have not broken pacts yet. Reassess next turn; SEV-BLA convoy idea remains later.

Spring 1914: attacking RUM with BUL, BLA support, SER support. Russia broke trust over RUM. Keep AEG out of ION per Italy pact, SER out of BUD/TRI per Austria pact. Hold ANK, CON, AEG. Reassess after RUM result.

messages.body: Austria here. Fall 1914: I hold BUD, TRI and VIE and will keep A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania while you keep A UKR, A RUM and A WAR out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. Tell me your Fall orders for those three units before orders lock.

Austria here. F TRI holds Trieste this Fall and stays out of the Adriatic approaches. Please keep A VEN, A ROM and F TYS away from Trieste and Albania. Confirm your Fall orders so we both avoid a costly clash.

England, Fall 1914. Norway is still contested and my F NWG is adjacent. I propose we keep the north quiet this fall: your A NOR stays put, and I will not move into Norway or the Baltic. Please confirm your fall orders for NOR, SWE and SEV.

England, Fall 1914. I confirm my fleets stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this fall. Please confirm A BUR, A PAR and F MAO stay out of those areas, and that Spain and Portugal remain your zone. Let us keep the west quiet.

England, Fall 1914. I confirm my F NTH and F LVP stay out of Holland, Denmark, Kiel and Belgium this fall. Please confirm A HOL, KIE, MUN and F DEN do not enter Belgium or the North Sea. Tell me if your north plans change.

France, Fall 1914. I keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel. Please confirm your F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON stay north, out of Belgium and Brest. Let's put the Spain/Portugal split in writing now: Spain and Portugal are mine.

Germany here, Fall 1914. Russia now holds Sweden and Budapest, so I need verifiable moves. Will A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia and Silesia this fall? Will F SEV stay out of Rumania? If you confirm, I will keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. Answer plainly before orders.

Germany here, Fall 1914. I hold MUN, BER, KIE and will not attack Vienna or Trieste. If Russia moves west into Silesia, I will strike with you. Please keep A VIE pressuring Galicia or Budapest and avoid Bohemia and Tyrolia so we do not bump units.

Germany here, Fall 1914. A HOL, KIE and MUN stay out of Belgium and Norway, and my fleets stay out of the North Sea. I am undecided on a northern attack on Russia until I see Russia's fall moves. Keep F NWG and F NTH away from Holland, Denmark and Kiel.

Italy here, Fall 1914. You promised F TUN would withdraw to the Western Mediterranean this Fall. Please confirm that now, and keep F TYS and any French fleet away from Naples and Rome. I will keep A ROM and F TYS out of Tunis and Iberia in return. Tell me your exact orders.

Italy here, Fall 1914. Confirm that F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. I am holding NAP, VEN and ROM and will keep my units out of Greece. If you move against Russia in Rumania, I may press Trieste with you. What are your exact orders?

Italy here, Fall 1914. A VIE is still in Vienna and F TRI still holds Trieste, so I will keep A VEN and F NAP where they are this Fall. Keep A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI out of the Adriatic approaches, and we avoid a clash. Confirm your orders.

Russia here. Fall 1914: A BUL and F BLA threaten RUM and our Black Sea. Withdraw A BUL from Rumania to Serbia or Bulgaria and keep F BLA out of SEV, and I will keep A UKR and A WAR out of BUL and CON. Tell me your Fall orders for BUL and BLA before orders lock.

Russia here. Fall 1914: A BUD is still Russian-held and I will not attack Vienna or Trieste. Keep A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania, and we both turn to Italy and Germany. Confirm your Fall orders for VIE, TRI and BUD so we avoid a clash.

Russia here. Fall 1914: A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. Confirm, and we keep the north quiet while we both watch Austria.

Turkey here, Fall 1914. Our armies are in a standoff over Rumania. I will not move A BUL or F BLA into Sevastopol or Ukraine this fall. Will your A RUM and F SEV stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople? If you hold Rumania without attacking Bulgaria, I will hold too. Confirm your orders.

Turkey here, Fall 1914. I am keeping F AEG out of the Ionian and my armies away from Apulia and Naples, as agreed. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian. Tell me your fall orders so we both avoid a bounce.

Turkey here, Fall 1914. I am keeping A SER out of Budapest and Trieste, and my units out of Serbia and Bulgaria. Please keep your units out of Serbia and Bulgaria as well. If Russia's Rumania position weakens, we can discuss the Rumanian front.

Austria: Agreed. A VIE stays in Vienna this Fall and will not enter Bohemia or Tyrolia. I will not move on Munich or Berlin. If Russian units push into Silesia, I will press Galicia or Budapest with you. Let us both share any Russian movement we see.

Austria: A BUD is still your problem, and I will attack it unless you withdraw it to Galicia or Serbia. I will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania if you keep A UKR, A RUM and A WAR out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. Your Fall orders for those three units should be clear before we proceed.

Austria: F TRI holds Trieste this Fall and stays out of the Adriatic approaches. I expect A VEN, A ROM and F TYS to stay away from Trieste and Albania. Naples and Venice are not my target. Your holds are reassuring, so let us both keep the peace.

Austria: Agreed. A SER should stay out of Budapest and Trieste, and I keep my units out of Serbia and Bulgaria. Your Rumania strike is your business, but please avoid any bounce near Serbia. We can talk about Rumania once Russian RUM is weakened.

England, Fall 1914. Confirmed: my F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this fall. Please keep A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and F MAO out of those areas too. Spain and Portugal are your zone, and I'll not contest them while the west stays quiet. Let's put this in writing next turn.

England, Fall 1914. Confirmed: my F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON hold this fall and stay out of Holland, Denmark, Kiel, Belgium and the Baltic. Please keep A HOL, KIE, MUN and F DEN out of Belgium, Norway and the North Sea. I'm not moving on Russia this fall. Let us both hold our northern centers.

France here, Fall 1914. Confirmed: A BUR, A PAR and F MAO will not enter Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel this fall. Spain and Portugal are French centers and our units there stay put. Please keep your F NWG, F LVP, A EDI and A LON out of Belgium, Brest and Picardy as agreed, and let's keep the west quiet.

France here, Fall 1914. Tunis is a French supply center, so F TUN stays where it is and will not withdraw. I will not move it or any French unit toward Naples, Rome or Venice. Please keep F TYS and A ROM out of Tunis and Iberia, as you offered, and we can keep the central Mediterranean stable.

Germany here, Fall 1914. Confirmed: A HOL, KIE, MUN and F DEN stay out of Belgium and the North Sea this fall. My fleets stay out of Holland, Denmark and Kiel-adjacent waters you hold. I remain undecided on any attack on Russia until I see Russia's Fall moves. Keep F NTH and F NWG out of Denmark, Holland and Kiel, and we both keep our centers.

Germany here. Your Fall 1914 pledge is noted: A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I will keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg while you hold to it. Any breach will end this pact, and I will then defend Berlin and Silesia with Austria. Verify with your moves.

Italy here. Fall 1914: A VEN, A ROM and F TYS hold this turn, and I have no orders against Trieste now. That stays true only while A VIE stays out of Tyrolia and F TRI stays off the Adriatic approaches. Break either and I will reconsider. Confirm your orders.

Italy here. Fall 1914: I keep F TYS, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece, the Ionian and Apulia, and I expect F AEG and your armies to stay out of the Ionian, Apulia and Naples. My orders this fall are holds in VEN, NAP and ROM. Pressing Russia in Rumania is your business, and I may join against Trieste later if you strike north.

Russia here. Agreed: A NOR holds this Fall, F SEV stays off Edinburgh and the North Sea, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Keep F NWG out of Norway and your fleets out of the Barents and St Petersburg. If F NWG enters Norway, I will answer in the north.

Russia here. Fall 1914: A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. If you keep that word, we keep the north quiet while we both watch Austria.

Russia here. BUD holds this Fall and I will not move into Vienna or Trieste. Keep A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania, and hold them at home. Attack BUD and we fight. Our Fall orders: A BUD holds, A UKR and A RUM hold, A WAR holds.

Russia here. Fall 1914: withdraw A BUL from Rumania to Serbia or Bulgaria and keep F BLA out of Sevastopol. If you do, I will keep A UKR and A WAR out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and A RUM and F SEV will hold without attacking Bulgaria. Confirm and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here. Confirmed for Fall 1914: F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay away from Apulia and Naples. I am not moving on Trieste. Please keep F NAP, A VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian as agreed. We both prosper if we keep our word.

Turkey here. A BUL and F BLA will not enter Sevastopol or Ukraine this fall, and I am not moving on Constantinople. Rumania is a standoff. If your A RUM and F SEV stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and A UKR and A WAR stay out of Bulgaria, I will hold too. Confirm your orders.

notes.note: Fall 1914: holding all. Kept promises to England (no BUR/PAR/MAR into Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel; England confirmed its fleets stay north). Italy wanted TUN withdrawn; I refused and said TUN stays as a French center, with no moves toward NAP/ROM/VEN. Spain/Portugal are mine. No unowned centers. Watch Germany on BUR's border and Italy on TUN. Next: consider SPA convoy to NAF via WES if an opening appear

Fall 1914: holding all five German SCs per pacts with Russia, England, Austria. Russia has not yet proven fall moves; watch SWE/WAR into Prussia/Silesia and any Baltic fleet. If Russia breaks pact, strike Silesia with Austria.

Fall 1914: all hold to honor pacts. Germany (no Sweden/St P, no Baltic fleets) and England (NOR stays, no Norway/Barents) asked for quiet north; Turkey asked BUL withdrawal, no SEV/BLA entry, I keep UKR/WAR out of BUL/CON. Austria: BUD still contested, will attack if Austria hits BUD/VIE. Watch Turkish BUL/BLA and Austrian moves. Consider SEV-BLA convoy for RUM later.

Fall 1914: all hold to defend BUD, TRI, VIE. Russia says A BUD holds and it will not hit VIE/TRI. Italy holds VEN/ROM/TYS and says it will not attack TRI if VIE stays out of TYR and TRI off ADR. Germany holds MUN/BER/KIE. Turkey keeps SER/BUL quiet. Next: test Russian word; if A RUM or A UKR moves on BUD or VIE, counterattack. Consider GAL or SER when a clear gain appears.

Fall 1914: all hold, keeping NAP/ROM/VEN and promises to Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples), France (no Tunis/Iberia), Austria (no Trieste while VIE stays out of TYR and TRI stays off Adriatic). Watch F TUN withdrawal promise from France. Revisit Trieste only with Turkish help if Austria breaks terms.

Fall 1914: Convoying EDI via NWG to NOR to take Russian-held Norway; Russia has broken no promise yet. France and Germany have kept their promises to stay out of the west and north. Next turn: check whether NOR fell, and watch Russian retaliation.

Fall 1914: holding all units. Standoff in Rumania; told Russia BUL and BLA stay out of SEV/UKR and I hold if Russia does. Keeping AEG out of ION (Italy), SER out of BUD/TRI (Austria). Watch Russian RUM/UKR/WAR for attack on BUL/CON. Look for RUM once Russia weakens.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1915. Your A UKR, A RUM and A WAR are next to Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. I will hold all three cities. Please confirm you will not move into BUD, VIE or TRI this year, and tell me your Galicia orders so we avoid a clash.

Austria here. Serbia is yours, and I will not move A BUD, A VIE or F TRI toward SER or BUL. Please keep A SER out of Budapest and Trieste, as agreed. Tell me your Spring 1915 orders for the Rumanian front.

Austria here. Russia's A UKR and A RUM are the threat to us both. I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI at home. If you can press Warsaw or Silesia this spring, I will look at Galicia with you. What are your Spring 1915 orders?

England here. Norway is still held by your A NOR, and my F NWG and A EDI are positioned to take it. Before I move, tell me whether you will keep A NOR and your fleets out of the North Sea, Edinburgh and Sweden. If you withdraw from Norway I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden.

England here. My F LVP, A LON and A EDI stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this spring. Please confirm A PAR, A BUR and A MAR stay out of those areas, and that Spain and Portugal remain your zone. I have no plans in Iberia.

France, Spring 1915. I hold A BUR, A PAR, A MAR and keep them away from Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland. Are you still moving toward Belgium or Picardy this year? If Belgium opens, I propose we split the north, with you taking Holland-side targets and me Belgium.

France here, Spring 1915. F TUN stays put and I will not move against Naples, Rome or Venice. I'm keeping my fleets out of Piedmont and the Tyrrhenian. Please keep F TYS and A ROM out of Tunis and Iberia, and tell me your plans for Piedmont and Tunisia this year.

Germany here, Spring 1915. Russia holds Sweden, Warsaw and Budapest-era gains; I want verifiable answers. Will A WAR or A SWE move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia this spring? Will any Russian fleet enter the Baltic? I will keep A BER and F DEN off Sweden and St Petersburg only if you confirm plainly.

Italy: F TUN is in Tunis, which I hold as a claim, and our understanding was Tunis to me. Spring 1915: tell me whether F TUN stays put or moves west. I will keep A ROM and F TYS away from Iberia and Marseille if you keep F TUN and your fleets away from Naples and Rome.

Russia here. Spring 1915: A RUM and F SEV hold, and I will not enter Bulgaria or Constantinople. Your A BUL and F BLA must stay out of Sevastopol, Rumania and Ukraine. Confirm your Spring orders for BUL, BLA and CON so we both keep our centres.

Russia here. Spring 1915: A BUD holds and I will not enter Vienna or Trieste. Your A BUD, F TRI and A VIE must stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Confirm your Spring orders so we can both turn our attention to Germany and Italy.

Russia here. Spring 1915: A SWE and A WAR hold, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. Confirm your Spring orders so the north stays quiet while we both watch Austria.

Turkey here, Spring 1915. Russia's standoff in Rumania has cost both of us. I propose A RUM retreats or stays, F SEV stays out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and I keep F BLA out of Sevastopol and Ukraine. Tell me your exact Spring orders for RUM, SEV, UKR and WAR so we both hold our centres.

Austria here, Spring 1915. I will hold VIE, TRI and BUD this spring and will not move into Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania with my armies. In return, confirm A UKR, A RUM and A WAR stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI. Your A BUD, which you call holding Budapest, is the sticking point; if it withdraws to Galicia or Serbia, we can talk about a lasting border. Confirm in writing.

France here, Spring 1915. Confirmed: A PAR, A BUR and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Brest, Picardy and the Channel this spring. Spain and Portugal are my zone and I have no plans to move north. Let's keep the west quiet and write this arrangement down now.

Germany here. Agreed that Russia is the main threat. I keep A MUN and A BER home this spring and will not move on Vienna, Trieste or Budapest. If Russian units enter Silesia or Galicia-adjacent Warsaw, I will strike with you. Please keep A VIE off Munich and Bohemia, and hold BUD and TRI as you say.

Germany here. Your pledge is noted, but Sweden and Budapest were taken against our earlier understanding, so I will judge by moves. I keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg as long as A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Any breach ends this pact.

Italy here. F TUN staying in Tunis is a breach I cannot ignore, and I will not keep promises that only help you. Withdraw F TUN to the Western Mediterranean this Fall, in writing, or I will treat Tunis as contested and reconsider my moves in the Western Mediterranean. Keep F TYS and A ROM out of Iberia as agreed, and I will keep my units away from Marseille and Spain while this stands.

Russia: A BUD holds this Spring and I will not move into Vienna or Trieste. Your A VIE and F TRI should stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. I have no move planned into Vienna or Trieste. If you attack Budapest, we fight.

Russia: A NOR holds this Spring and F SEV stays off Edinburgh and the North Sea. No Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Your F NWG is the threat to Norway. If it moves into Norway, I will defend and answer in the north. Keep your fleets out of the Barents and St Petersburg.

Russia: A SWE and A WAR hold this Spring, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I am asking you to keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. If you hold to that, we keep the north quiet while we both watch Austria.

Russia: A RUM and F SEV hold this Spring. I will not enter Bulgaria or Constantinople. Your A BUL and F BLA must stay out of Sevastopol, Rumania and Ukraine. Withdraw A BUL from Rumania and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here. Spring 1915: I agree A SER stays out of Budapest and Trieste, and I will not move toward Austrian lines. Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia and Bulgaria as you pledged. I am focused on Rumania, so let us keep our Balkan fronts quiet and both hold our centres.

Turkey here. Rumania remains contested, and I will not withdraw A BUL without a real guarantee. Confirm A RUM and F SEV stay out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and that A UKR, A WAR and A MOS stay out of Bulgaria, Constantinople and Sevastopol. If you hold, I will keep F BLA out of Sevastopol and Ukraine.

notes.note: Spring 1915: F TUN to WES per Italy demand and plan to prep SPA convoy to NAF/TUN next turn. Holding BUR/MAR/PAR/POR/SPA to keep England deal (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel) and avoid Italy friction. England has kept word. Italy threatening over Tunis; watch Italian moves into TUN. Germany may push on BUR.

Spring 1915: all hold to defend BUD, TRI, VIE. Russia keeps promising no move on BUD/VIE/TRI but has broken word before; Turkey and Germany pledged quiet. Italy hostile on Adriatic. Watch A UKR/A RUM/A WAR. Reassess SER or GAL strike once Russian threat is clear.

Spring 1915: all hold for defence. Promises to Germany, Turkey, Austria, England: no Baltic fleets, stay out of BUL/CON/VIE/TRI, hold NOR. Turkey and Austria contest RUM/BUD. Next: consider F SEV to BLA then convoy A RUM. Watch Germany and England for breaches.

Spring 1915: Russia took SWE and BUD against pacts, so I judge by moves. Holding BER, DEN, KIE, MUN. A HOL moves to BEL (England SC, empty) to grow. Watch France near BUR and Russia at WAR/SWE. Revisit Austria pact if they hold BUD/TRI/VIE.

Spring 1915: convoying A EDI via NWG to attack Russian-held NOR. Holding LON and LVP at home. France and Russia have reaffirmed their promises (west quiet, no Russian fleet in Baltic). Russia has not yet withdrawn from NOR; watch for Russian support into NOR and for breaks of promise.

Spring 1915: F TYS to NAP to garrison the empty center; ROM and VEN hold. France breached on F TUN, so I'll hold Tunis as a claim and watch for a Fall withdrawal. Austria and Turkey have kept their word so far. Next: consider a supported Tunis or Trieste push if France or Austria stays put.

Spring 1915: attacking RUM with BUL, supported by BLA and SER. Holding ANK, CON, AEG to keep pacts with Italy (no ION/Greece moves) and Austria (SER out of BUD/TRI). Russia has repeatedly promised RUM/SEV hold but broke trust before; check result and Russian UKR/WAR support.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1915. Your A BUD is still in Budapest and your A UKR, A RUM-side units are the threat. Withdraw A BUD to Galicia or Serbia this Fall, and I will hold my lines. Otherwise I will press Budapest. Confirm your Fall orders for BUD, UKR and WAR in writing.

England here. Fall 1915: my F NWG is moving to take Norway, where your A NOR sits. I have broken our northern truce and will not pretend otherwise. Withdraw A NOR toward Sweden or Finland and I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic and Sweden. Stay in Sweden and I will fight for Norway.

England here. Your A BEL holds Belgium, which is my centre. I ask you to say plainly whether you intend to keep it this fall. I have no units able to reach Belgium this turn, but I will not accept a permanent loss. Keep your fleets out of the North Sea and Channel and we can avoid a wider quarrel.

France here. Our fleet is now F WES, not in Tunis, so Tunis is empty. I won't move F WES into Tunis this Fall, and I won't move toward Naples, Rome or Venice. Please keep F TYS and A ROM out of Iberia and Marseille, and tell me your Fall orders for Tunis.

France here. Confirming my A BUR, A PAR and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel this Fall. Please keep F LVP, F NWG, A LON and A EDI out of those areas too, and Spain and Portugal stay French. Are you planning any move into Belgium this year?

France here. A BUR will not move toward Munich, Ruhr, Kiel or Holland this Fall. I ask the same: no German units into Burgundy or Picardy. If Belgium opens, I propose you take the Holland side and I take Belgium. What are A BEL and F DEN doing this Fall?

Germany: Sweden and Budapest were taken against our understanding, and A SWE and A WAR now sit near my Prussia. I will hold Berlin and Kiel this Fall. Tell me plainly whether A SWE and A WAR move into Prussia or Silesia this Fall. Any Russian move there ends our pact.

Germany: Russia's A GAL retreated and its armies sit around Warsaw and Sweden. I hold A MUN, BER, KIE and BEL this Fall. Please keep A VIE and BUD off Munich and Bohemia, and press Galicia or Warsaw with me if Russia leaves them open. Tell me your Fall orders.

Germany: I am moving A HOL to Belgium this Fall and will hold it. Please keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium and Holland. I will keep F DEN out of the North Sea and Norway. Tell me if your northern plans against Russia are changing.

Italy here, Fall 1915. Your units list shows no F TUN, and F WES is in the western Mediterranean. Please confirm in writing that no French unit moves into Naples, Rome, Venice or Tunis this Fall. I will keep F NAP, A ROM and A VEN in place and stay away from Marseille and Spain.

Italy here. A VEN, A ROM and F NAP will hold this Fall and stay off Trieste and Albania. Please confirm that F TRI stays out of the Adriatic approaches and A VIE stays out of Tyrolia. If Austria moves against Venice or Rome, I will reconsider this peace.

Russia here. RUM has been retreated to GAL, so Rumania is empty. I will not move into RUM or BUL. Your A RUM is now unopposed on paper, so confirm your Fall orders: A BUL out of Rumania and F BLA out of Sevastopol. Keep A UKR and A WAR out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here. Russia's A GAL retreated, so RUM is now ours with A RUM. I will hold A RUM, F SEV-adjacent Black Sea fleet stays out of SEV, and A BUL stays out of Serbia. Please keep A GAL, A UKR and F SEV out of Rumania and Bulgaria. Confirm and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here. Fall 1915: I hold A SER, A RUM and A BUL and will not move toward Budapest or Trieste. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia and Bulgaria as agreed. I am focused on Russia in the east, so let us both keep our Balkan lines quiet.

Austria here. Agreed on keeping A VIE and A BUD off Munich and Bohemia. Russia's army at Warsaw is the target. I hold BUD, TRI and VIE this Fall. Please strike Warsaw or Silesia with your units if Russia leaves it open, and I will press Galicia from BUD if the way is clear. Share your Spring orders first.

Austria here. A VIE stays in Vienna, not Tyrolia, and F TRI holds Trieste and stays off the Adriatic approaches this Fall. I have no orders against Venice or Rome. Keep A VEN, A ROM and F NAP off Trieste and Albania, and we can both focus elsewhere.

Austria here. Confirmed: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria this Fall. Please keep A SER out of Budapest and Trieste as agreed. Rumania is yours to contest with Russia, and I wish you success there. Let us both keep our Balkan lines quiet.

England, Fall 1915. Confirmed: my F LVP, F NWG, A LON and A EDI will not enter Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel this Fall. Spain and Portugal remain yours. Keep A BUR, A PAR and A MAR out of those areas too, and let's keep the west quiet.

England, Fall 1915. You say A HOL moves to Belgium and you will hold it. Belgium is my centre, and I will not accept a permanent loss. Tell me plainly whether A BEL stays or withdraws. My fleets stay out of Holland and Denmark, but I will not keep quiet if Belgium is held by force.

France here. Fall 1915: F WES will not move into Tunis, and no French unit moves toward Naples, Rome or Venice. Our current fleet is F WES, so Tunis is currently empty. I will keep A MAR, A SPA and A POR off Piedmont and the Italian coast. Please keep F NAP, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Tunis, and we will both keep growing.

Germany here. A BEL is my unit and I intend to hold Belgium this Fall; I took it because it was empty, and I will not move it into the North Sea or Channel. My F DEN stays out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium and Holland, and we can avoid a quarrel. Let us both keep our centers.

Germany here. A BUR stays out of my zone as you ask, and I am not moving units into Burgundy or Picardy. A BEL is my unit and I will hold it this Fall, so Belgium is not open to you this turn. I am not moving F DEN toward the North Sea or Norway. Keep your units out of Munich, Ruhr and Kiel and we stay at peace.

Italy here. Fall 1915: I confirm my fleets and armies stay out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Tunis and Western Mediterranean waters. F NAP, A ROM and A VEN hold in place. Your F WES must not enter Tunis, and I will be watching it. Tunis is an open question until you put that in writing, and I will be reassessing my position if F WES moves into Tunis.

Russia here. A BUD is staying put this Fall; I will not move into Vienna or Trieste. I cannot withdraw from Budapest while you threaten it. Keep A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania, and we both avoid a costly war. If you attack Budapest, we fight.

Russia here. A SWE and A WAR hold this Fall, with no move into Prussia or Silesia. No Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. If you hold to that, the north stays quiet and we can both watch Austria.

Russia here. A NOR will hold and defend itself. Your F NWG moving into Norway breaks our truce, and I will answer. I will not enter the North Sea or Edinburgh. Withdrawing F NWG from Norway would let us keep the north quiet; otherwise expect resistance.

Russia here. RUM is empty after the retreat, and I will not move into RUM or BUL. Withdraw A BUL out of Rumania and F BLA away from Sevastopol this Fall. Keep A UKR and A WAR out of Bulgaria and Constantinople, and we both keep our centres.

Turkey here, Fall 1915. RUM is empty now, so A RUM will hold it and I expect no Russian units to enter Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople. A BUL stays out of Serbia and Greece. Keep A GAL, A UKR, A WAR and F SEV out of Rumania and Bulgaria and we both keep our centres. Confirm in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1915: all hold to keep NAP, ROM, VEN. Promises: France (no Marseille/Spain/Tunis/Western Med moves; F WES must not enter Tunis, watch it). Austria (no Trieste/Albania while F TRI stays off Adriatic and A VIE stays out of Tyrolia). Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia). Reassess if F WES enters Tunis or Austria moves on Venice/Rome.

Fall 1915: all holding. A BEL holds to take Belgium. France, England, Austria have kept peace so far; Russia SWE/WAR near Prussia is the threat, and its Prussia/Silesia moves would end the pact. Keep F DEN out of NTH and NOR as promised to England. Next turn consider F DEN to BAL to set up convoys, and strike Silesia or Warsaw with Austria if Russia opens them.

Fall 1915: kept promises to England (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel) and Italy (no Tunis/Naples/Rome/Venice). WES to MAO sets up POR/SPA convoy later. Watch Germany on BUR and Italy on TUN. Germany says it will not enter Burgundy or Picardy.

Fall 1915: holding BUD, TRI, VIE to protect 3 centers. Russia says BUD stays put and will not hit VIE/TRI, but has broken word before. Italy and Turkey pledged peace; Germany agreed on BOH/MUN. Reassess GAL or SER strike if Russia's threat to BUD clears.

Fall 1915: NWG to NOR breaks truce with Russia to contest Norway; no support available for it, so it may fail. EDI, LON, LVP hold home centers. Germany's A BEL is near Belgium; no units can reach it this turn. France kept west quiet. Consider NWG to NTH/EDI convoy of EDI/LON to NOR or Belgium next turn if NOR holds. Keep fleets out of Holland and Denmark.

Fall 1915: holding all units to keep RUM (A RUM stays) and keep pacts with Russia (no RUM/BUL/CON/SEV entry), Italy (AEG out of ION), Austria (SER out of BUD/TRI). Watch Russian GAL/UKR/SEV for attacks on RUM and BUL/CON.

Fall 1915: SEV-RUM attack with GAL and UKR support to take Rumania from Turkey's A RUM. NOR holds, SWE supports it against England's NWG. MOS and WAR hold home. Turkey, Austria, Germany, England have all broken pledges. Watch BUD and Norway.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1916. Russia has 3 armies (GAL, UKR, WAR) pressing us. I propose A BUD to GAL only if GAL is empty, and you press WAR or SIL together. Please tell me your Spring orders first so we do not bump, and whether you will strike Warsaw this turn.

Austria here. Rumania is your target and I will not contest it. In return, keep A SER and A BUL away from BUD and TRI, and I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI off Serbia and Bulgaria. Tell me if F BLA or A BUL plans to move into Rumania this spring.

Austria here. Your A UKR, A GAL and A WAR are massed on my border, and you have broken word before. Confirm in writing that A GAL and A UKR will not move into BUD, VIE or TRI this spring, and I will keep my units out of Galicia and Warsaw.

England, Spring 1916. Your A BEL is sitting on my centre and I want it back. Withdraw A BEL to Holland this spring and I will keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Holland, Denmark and the North Sea. Refuse, and I will look to France about Belgium.

England, Spring 1916. Germany holds Belgium, which is neither of ours to lose. If you move A PAR or A BUR toward Belgium, I will keep F LVP and A LON ready to support or take it, and I will not interfere with Spain or Portugal. Are you willing to press Belgium with me?

France here, Spring 1916. Tunis is a French center and F WES is no longer near it. I will not move any French unit into Tunis, Naples, Rome or Venice this year. Please keep F TYS and A ROM out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and tell me your Spring orders.

France here. I have no quarrel with Turkey and no units near your Balkan centers. Are you planning any move against Italy in the Adriatic or Ionian this year? I would like to know your intentions before Russia and Austria settle Serbia.

Germany here. Spring 1916: will A SWE or A WAR move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia? Will any Russian fleet enter the Baltic? Plainly confirm. If you hold, I keep BER, KIE and DEN off Sweden and St Petersburg. Any breach ends our pact.

Germany here. Spring 1916: are A VIE and A BUD staying off Munich and Bohemia? If Russia moves A WAR into Silesia this spring, I will strike Warsaw or Silesia with you and press Galicia from Budapest. Share your orders first.

Germany here. A BEL is held by my unit this spring and I will not move it into the North Sea or Channel. My F DEN stays out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium and Holland and we both keep our centers.

Italy here, Spring 1916. F WES has not entered Tunis, so I accept that for now. I want a clear answer: will F WES or any French unit move toward Tunis, Naples or Rome this year? If not, I will keep my units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal and focus on Austria.

Italy here, Spring 1916. A VIE, F TRI and A BUD are your last three centres, and I have kept my word on Trieste. Tell me your Spring orders. If F TRI or A VIE leave their posts toward Venice or Rome, I will act. Otherwise I will keep A VEN and A ROM holding.

Italy here, Spring 1916. Austria is weak with three centres, and Trieste is the prize in the Adriatic. Will your A SER or A BUL move against Budapest or Trieste this year? If you press north, I can threaten Trieste from Venice. Confirm your Spring orders and I will confirm mine.

Russia here, Spring 1916. Our northern pact is strained, but I still want it. A SWE and A WAR will not move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Confirm A BER, F DEN and A KIE stay off Sweden and St Petersburg. Tell me your Spring orders.

Russia here, Spring 1916. I will not move into Budapest, Vienna or Trieste. Please confirm your A BUD, F TRI and A VIE stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania this spring. If you attack Budapest, we fight. Let us both focus on Italy and the south instead of each other.

Russia here, Spring 1916. A RUM holds and I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople. Confirm your A BUL and F BLA stay out of Rumania, Sevastopol and Ukraine. Tell me your Spring orders so we can keep the Black Sea quiet while we both watch Austria.

Turkey here, Spring 1916. Your F RUM and A GAL remain a direct threat to my Rumanian and Bulgarian units. Withdraw F RUM to the Black Sea or Galicia, keep A UKR and F SEV out of RUM, BUL and CON, and I will keep my units out of SEV and UKR. Confirm in writing.

Turkey here, Spring 1916. I am keeping F AEG out of the Ionian and my armies out of Apulia and Naples, as agreed. Please keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian. Tell me your spring orders so we avoid any bounce.

Austria: Spring 1916 I hold A VIE, F TRI and A BUD in place this turn, staying off Munich and Bohemia. Russia's A GAL, A UKR and A WAR are the threat. If Germany moves A WAR-side units against Warsaw or Silesia this spring, I will press Galicia from BUD in Fall. Please confirm A MUN and A BER stay home.

Austria: I will hold BUD, VIE and TRI this spring and send no army into Galicia or Rumania. In return, A GAL, A UKR and A WAR must not move into BUD, VIE or TRI. Your ambiguous hold on Budapest is the real issue. Confirm in writing that all three of your armies stay out of my three cities this turn.

Austria: F TRI stays on Trieste and out of the Adriatic approaches, and A VIE stays in Vienna. I have no orders against Venice or Rome. Your best gains are against Turkey in the Balkans, not against me. Please keep A VEN, A ROM and F NAP off Trieste this spring, and we can both stay focused elsewhere.

England here. A BEL is on my centre and I want it back. Withdraw A BEL to Holland this spring and I will keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Holland, Denmark and the North Sea. If you refuse, I will consider other options for Belgium, and our northern pact will be void.

France here. Belgium is Germany's now and I have no plans to press it. A BUR and A PAR will stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel as agreed. Spain and Portugal remain French. Keep F LVP and A LON on your side and let's keep the west quiet while you handle Russia.

France here. No French unit will move toward Tunis, Naples, Rome or Venice this year. F TUN stays a French center, and F WES is in the western Mediterranean. I will keep A MAR and our Iberian units off Piedmont and Italy. Please keep F TYS and A ROM out of Spain, Portugal and Marseille.

Germany here. Spring 1916: A MUN and A BER hold, and I will not enter Bohemia, Tyrolia or Vienna. I am not yet committing to Warsaw or Silesia; I will decide once I see Russia's spring moves. Keep A VIE and A BUD off Munich and Bohemia, and go to Galicia only if it is empty and you have bounced nothing. Please share your orders first.

Germany here. Your pledge is noted, but Sweden and Budapest were taken against our understanding, so I judge by moves. I will keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg only while A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Any breach ends the pact at once.

Germany here. A BEL is my unit and I will not withdraw it this spring. I will not move it into the North Sea or Channel, and F DEN stays out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium and Holland and we both keep our centers. Belgium is not a quarrel I want with you.

Italy: I accept your word that F WES stays out of Tunis and no French unit moves toward Naples, Rome or Venice. In return I keep my armies out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal and hold NAP, ROM and VEN. Put it in writing for Fall 1916 too: F WES and any French fleet stay out of Tunis and the Tyrrhenian. Breach it and I will treat Tunis as lost to me.

Italy: Agreed, F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia or Naples, and I keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian. My Spring 1916 orders are holds in NAP, VEN and ROM. I am watching Austria's Trieste and may press it with you later, but I will not move until you commit north against Budapest.

Russia here. A BUD holds this Spring and I will not move into Vienna or Trieste. Our units in Galicia and Ukraine are defensive. A GAL and A UKR will not enter BUD, VIE or TRI this spring. Keep A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania, and we avoid a costly war.

Russia here. Spring 1916: A SWE and A WAR hold, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. I ask that A BER, F DEN and A KIE stay off Sweden and St Petersburg. If you hold, the north stays quiet and we can both focus on Austria and the south.

Russia here. A RUM holds this Spring, and I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria or Constantinople. My Black Sea fleet stays out of Bulgaria and Constantinople. Confirm your A BUL and F BLA stay out of Rumania, Sevastopol and Ukraine, and we keep the Black Sea quiet while we both watch Austria.

Turkey here. I have no plans against Italy or France this spring. My fleets are focused on Russia in the Black Sea and Rumania. F AEG will stay out of the Ionian. I wish you well in the west and hope we can both keep our centres.

Turkey here. Spring 1916: I will not move into SEV or UKR. Your F RUM and A GAL threaten my Rumanian and Bulgarian units, so withdraw F RUM to the Black Sea or Galicia and we keep the peace. I will hold CON, BUL and SER. Confirm in writing.

Turkey here. Agreed: A SER and A BUL stay away from BUD and TRI this spring, and I will not move toward Serbia from your side. I am pressing Russia in Rumania, not Austria. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI off Serbia and Bulgaria.

Turkey here. Spring 1916: F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. I am not moving on Trieste. Please keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian, and we both hold our centres this year.

notes.note: Spring 1916: all three hold BUD, TRI, VIE. Russia (GAL, UKR, WAR) promised no entry into BUD/VIE/TRI; Germany and Italy say they stay off my cities; Turkey agreed to keep SER/BUL away. Watch Russian moves. Consider GAL or SER strike only if the threat clears.

Spring 1916: NWG disbanded, so no fleet can reach Norway or Belgium this turn. Holding home centers EDI, LON, LVP. Germany refused to withdraw A BEL; France keeps the west quiet. Next: rebuild a fleet to threaten Norway or Belgium, and keep Germany and France to their promises.

Spring 1916: holding all. No unowned centers in reach. Promises: England (no moves into Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel, Spain/Portugal French); Italy (no French move to TUN/NAP/ROM/VEN, F TYS and A ROM out of Iberia/MAR). Italy and Turkey have kept word so far. Next: consider SPA convoy to NAF via MAO for growth.

Spring 1916 defensive hold. GAL supports RUM holding against Turkey. Pledges: no Russian moves into Prussia, Silesia, Livonia, Baltic, BUD/VIE/TRI. England broke truce (NWG to NOR threat). Germany and Austria are judging by moves. Turkey wants F RUM withdrawn; I refused. Watch Turkey and Austria.

Spring 1916: holding NAP, ROM, VEN. Pacts: France (no Tunis/Naples/Rome/Venice moves; F WES out of Tunis; watch Fall), Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples; not moving on Trieste yet), Austria (no Trieste while F TRI holds and A VIE stays out of Tyrol). Plan: revisit Trieste with Turkish support if Austria breaks terms or Turkey commits north.

Spring 1916: BEL and home SCs held. BER moves to unowned PRU to grow; risk of Russian WAR bounce. Russia (SWE, WAR) pact strained, Russia took SWE/BUD earlier; watch Prussia/Silesia. England demands BEL withdrawal, refused; France threat via BUR. Austria wants Warsaw/Silesia strike; undecided. Keep DEN out of NTH/NOR.

Spring 1916: BUL attacks RUM, supported by BLA and SER. AEG holds to keep Italy pact (no Ionian). Russia's broken promises on RUM justify attack. Austria and Italy pacts still hold. Recheck Russian counter on BUL/CON next turn.

messages.body: Austria: Russia, your A GAL, A UKR and A WAR are massed on my three cities. Confirm in writing for Fall 1916 that none enter BUD, VIE or TRI, and that A GAL does not reach Budapest. I will keep A VIE and F TRI off Galicia and Rumania. Tell me your Fall orders first.

England, Fall 1916. Belgium is the core issue. Withdraw A BEL to Holland or Ruhr-side now, and I keep F LVP, A LON and A EDI out of Holland, Denmark and the North Sea. If you hold Belgium, I will support France or take it when possible. Which do you choose?

France, Fall 1916: F WES and all French fleets stay out of Tunis and the Tyrrhenian, and no French unit moves toward Naples, Rome or Venice. TUN stays French and I will hold it. Please keep F NAP, A ROM and A VEN away from Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Tunis as well.

France, Fall 1916: A BUR will not move toward Munich, Ruhr, Kiel or Holland, and I expect no German units into Burgundy or Picardy. Are A MUN and A BEL holding this Fall? Please confirm you are not moving toward Burgundy or Picardy.

France, Fall 1916: A PAR, A BUR and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel as agreed. Spain and Portugal remain French. Please keep F LVP, A LON and A EDI out of those areas too, and tell me your Fall moves.

Germany here, Fall 1916. Your A WAR and A SWE sit near my Prussia and Silesia, and Sweden was taken against our understanding. Will A WAR or A SWE move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia this Fall? Will any Russian fleet enter the Baltic? Answer plainly; my BER, KIE and DEN stay home while you hold.

Italy here, Fall 1916. Austria has only three centres and A BUD, F TRI and A VIE are exposed. If your A SER moves into Budapest this fall, I will move A VEN against Trieste with you. Tell me whether A SER goes to BUD, and I will keep F NAP and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian as agreed.

Italy here. Your F TRI has held Trieste and stayed off the Adriatic, and I have kept A VEN and A ROM in place. Turkey is pressing your south-east. Keep A VIE out of Tyrolia this fall and I will hold Venice and Rome. Confirm your Fall 1916 orders.

Italy here. Tunis is now yours, and I accept that F WES will not enter it. Please confirm in writing that no French fleet moves into the Tyrrhenian or toward Naples, Rome or Venice this Fall. I will keep my armies out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal.

Russia here, Fall 1916. RUM is now ours after the Spring retreat, and I will hold it. Keep your A RUM-side and BLA units out of SEV and UKR, and I will not move into BUL, CON or SER. Confirm in writing that you will not attack RUM this Fall.

Russia here. Our northern pact stands while A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Confirm A BER, F DEN and A KIE stay off Sweden and St Petersburg this Fall. Tell me your intentions toward Holland and Belgium.

Russia here. I will not move A GAL, A UKR or A WAR into BUD, VIE or TRI this Fall. Please confirm A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Let us both push Italy and the south instead of fighting each other.

Turkey here, Fall 1916. RUM is now Russian after the retreat, but your A GAL and A UKR threaten my Rumanian and Bulgarian units. Confirm in writing that A UKR, A GAL and F SEV stay out of RUM, BUL, CON and SER this Fall, and I will keep my units out of SEV, UKR and GAL.

Turkey here, Fall 1916. I will keep A SER and A BUL off BUD and TRI. Please confirm A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of SER and BUL this Fall, and tell me if you plan any move toward Serbia or Bulgaria.

Turkey here, Fall 1916. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Please confirm F NAP, A VEN and A ROM remain out of Greece and the Ionian, and tell me your Fall orders.

Austria here. Fall 1916: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI all hold in place. I will not move into Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Please keep A GAL, A UKR and A WAR out of BUD, VIE and TRI as you pledged, and we can both turn toward Italy and Turkey.

Austria here. Fall 1916: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold, and none moves toward Serbia or Bulgaria. Please keep A SER and A BUL out of BUD and TRI as agreed. Your Rumania campaign is yours to pursue against Russia.

Austria here. Fall 1916: F TRI holds Trieste, A VIE stays in Vienna, not Tyrolia, and F TRI stays off the Adriatic approaches. I have no orders against Venice or Rome. Please keep A VEN, A ROM and F NAP off Trieste and Albania.

England, Fall 1916. My A LON, A EDI and F LVP will stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel this fall as agreed. Please keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of those areas too. Spain and Portugal remain yours. Our fall moves: all my units hold home centers. Let's keep the west quiet.

France here. Fall 1916: I confirm in writing that no French fleet moves into the Tyrrhenian or toward Naples, Rome or Venice this Fall, and F WES stays out of Tunis while Tunis is held by my own fleet. I will keep my armies out of Marseille-facing Italian lines. Please keep F NAP, A ROM and A VEN away from Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Tunis, and tell me before any move toward my lines.

Germany here. A BEL stays this Fall; I will not withdraw it to Holland. I will not move it into the North Sea or Channel, and F DEN stays out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep F LVP, A LON and A EDI out of Belgium and Holland and we avoid a wider war. Support France on Belgium only if you must, but I hope it stays calm.

Italy here. Fall 1916: I confirm in writing that my fleets stay out of Tunis and the Tyrrhenian and my armies stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. In return, F WES and all French fleets must stay out of Tunis, the Tyrrhenian, and must not move toward Naples, Rome or Venice. Any breach ends this understanding, and I will act accordingly.

Italy here, Fall 1916. I keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian as agreed. If your A SER moves into Budapest this fall, I will move A VEN against Trieste with you. Please confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay out of Apulia and Naples.

Russia here. For Fall 1916 I confirm A GAL, A UKR and A WAR will not move into BUD, VIE or TRI. A BUD, A VIE and F TRI should stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Let us both push Italy and the south instead of fighting each other.

Russia here. A SWE and A WAR will not move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia this Fall, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please keep A BER, F DEN and A KIE off Sweden and St Petersburg. Holland and Belgium are not on my agenda; I want the north quiet while we watch Austria.

Russia here. RUM is ours now and I will hold it. A UKR and A GAL will not move into RUM, BUL, CON or SER this Fall, and F SEV stays out of Rumania and Bulgaria. Keep your units out of SEV, UKR and GAL, and we both keep our centres.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1916: I am not moving A SER into Budapest this fall. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian as agreed. Any move on Trieste is your own decision.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1916: RUM is yours after the retreat and I accept that for now. I will not move into SEV or UKR. Confirm A UKR, A GAL and F SEV stay out of RUM, BUL, CON and SER this Fall, and I will keep my units out of SEV, UKR and GAL.

notes.note: Fall 1916: all England units hold home centers EDI, LON, LVP. Germany refused to withdraw A BEL; I keep my promise to stay out of Belgium/Holland/North Sea for now. France keeps west quiet. Watch for Germany/France breaks; consider supporting France on Belgium only if Germany stays. Need new centers: rebuild fleet toward Norway/Belgium later.

Fall 1916: holding all. Promises: Italy (no fleet to Tyrrhenian/Tunis, no move toward NAP/ROM/VEN); England (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel). Germany says no Bur/Pic. Next: consider MAO to WES then SPA convoy to NAF in Spring 1917.

Fall 1916: holding BUD, TRI, VIE per pledges. Russia (GAL, UKR, WAR) promised no entry into my cities; Turkey and Italy promised to keep SER/BUL/VEN/ROM off my cities. Watch for broken word; consider counterattack on GAL or SER only if the threat clears.

Fall 1916: all hold on NAP, ROM, VEN. Promises: France (no fleets into Tyrrhenian/Tunis, no moves toward NAP/ROM/VEN; France confirmed in writing), Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples; A SER not into BUD this Fall), Austria (no Trieste while F TRI holds and A VIE stays out of Tyrolia). Plan: revisit Trieste with Turkish help if Austria breaks terms. Watch French breach on Tunis.

Fall 1916: holding BEL, DEN, KIE, MUN on home SCs; PRU moves to empty BER (own SC). Russia pact: A SWE/A WAR out of Prussia/Silesia/Livonia, no Baltic fleet; unconfirmed this Fall. England wants BEL withdrawal; refused. France A BUR near MUN/BEL is a threat; watch. Austria pact: no Bohemia/Munich moves by A VIE/BUD. Next: F DEN to BAL for convoys if north stays quiet.

Fall 1916: RUM holds to take it, BLA supports RUM holding. Other units hold. Russia (Fall) says RUM is theirs and wants no attack; Austria and Italy pacts still hold. Watch Russian GAL/UKR/SEV attacks on RUM and BUL/CON. Consider Ionian/Greece only if Italy breaks pact.

Fall 1916: SEV-RUM attack with GAL and UKR support to retake Rumania from Turkey. MOS moves to SEV behind it. North holds: NOR, SWE, WAR stay put to keep Germany's pact. Austria and Turkey pledges unconfirmed; watch BUD/VIE and Turkish BUL/SER.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1917. Your A GAL, A UKR and A WAR have pledged twice to stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI. Confirm again in writing this spring, and I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Tell me whether A GAL stays in Galicia this turn.

England, Spring 1917. Germany's A BEL is still in Belgium. If you move A PAR or A BUR to Picardy or Belgium this year, I will move F LVP to the North Sea and A LON to Yorkshire-side support, so Belgium falls to us both. Which of your units will you commit, and when?

England, Spring 1917. You still hold Belgium with A BEL, and I have kept my word on the north. I want a fair settlement: withdraw A BEL to Holland now and I keep F LVP, A LON and A EDI out of Holland, Denmark and the North Sea. Otherwise, I will look for a way to take Belgium with France. Your answer?

England, Spring 1917. Norway is still in your hands, and my earlier fleet move there broke our truce. I am ready to rebuild it. Will you keep A NOR and your fleets out of the North Sea and Edinburgh, and I will keep my fleets out of Norway and Sweden? Tell me your spring orders.

France, Spring 1917: A BUR stays out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, as before. I expect no German units into Burgundy or Picardy. With Russia pressing you, I'd value your confirmation of A MUN and A BEL holding this spring.

Germany here. Spring 1917: I need proof, not pledges. Will A WAR or A SWE move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia this spring, and will any Russian fleet enter the Baltic? If not, my BER, KIE and DEN hold. Tell me your Spring orders first.

Germany here. A BEL stays this spring and I will not move it into the North Sea or Channel. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark and we both keep our centers. Tell me your spring orders so we avoid a bounce.

Germany here. Spring 1917: A MUN and A BEL hold, and I will not move into Burgundy, Picardy or Ruhr. Keep A BUR and your other units away from Munich, Kiel and Holland and we stay at peace. What are A PAR and A MAR doing this spring?

Italy here, Spring 1917. Austria is down to BUD, TRI and VIE. Proposal: your A SER to BUD this spring, and I move A VEN to TRI now, with F NAP and A ROM holding. Splitting Austria's last centres helps us both. Confirm, and say whether A SER goes to BUD.

Italy here. Our understanding stands: no French fleet enters the Tyrrhenian or moves toward NAP, ROM or VEN, and I keep my armies out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. Tell me your Spring 1917 orders for the Western Mediterranean so we avoid any bounce.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1917: RUM is held by my F RUM and A GAL. I will not move into BUL, CON or SER. Confirm your A BUL, A CON and A SER stay out of RUM and SEV, and F BLA stays out of the Black Sea coast near SEV and UKR. Then we can both turn on Austria or Italy.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1917: RUM is held by your army, and I accept that for now. Our Black Sea stays quiet only if A UKR, A GAL and F SEV stay out of RUM, BUL, CON, SER and SEV-adjacent Bulgaria. Tell me your Spring orders in writing so we avoid a bounce.

England here, Spring 1917. Your A BEL is on my centre and I will not accept a permanent loss. I will keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Holland and Denmark this spring only if A BEL withdraws to Holland. If it stays, I cannot promise our pact holds. Give me a clear answer before orders are set.

France, Spring 1917: I confirm A PAR and A BUR stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel this spring, as agreed. Spain and Portugal remain French. Keep F LVP, A LON and A EDI out of those areas too. I suggest we both focus our growth elsewhere: you on the North Sea and Norway side, me on Iberia and the Mediterranean.

France here, Spring 1917. Your A MUN and A BEL holding is noted. I will keep A BUR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and I expect no German units into Burgundy or Picardy. A PAR and A MAR are holding or moving within my western and southern zone, not toward you. Let's keep the peace.

France, Spring 1917: I confirm no French fleet enters the Tyrrhenian or moves toward NAP, ROM or VEN, and F WES stays out of Tunis. My Western Mediterranean units hold or move only within French zones. Please keep F TYS and A ROM out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Tunis, and we both stay at peace.

Germany here. A BEL stays this spring; I will not move it into the North Sea or Channel. I will not withdraw to Holland. F DEN stays out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium and Holland and we both keep our centers. If you attack Belgium, I will defend it.

Germany here. A MUN and A BEL hold this spring, and I will not move into Burgundy, Picardy or Ruhr. Keep A BUR away from Munich, Kiel and Holland as well. I am not sure about A PAR and A MAR yet; tell me your plans for Spain and Burgundy and we can keep the west calm.

Russia to Austria: A GAL and A UKR will not enter BUD, VIE or TRI this Spring, as pledged. A GAL stays in Galicia this turn. I expect A BUD, A VIE and F TRI to stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Let us both focus on Italy and the south.

Russia to Germany: A SWE and A WAR will not move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia this Spring, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Our fleets are not in the north. Hold your BER, KIE and DEN off Sweden and St Petersburg and we stay at peace.

Russia to Turkey: F RUM holds in Rumania and A GAL stays in Galicia. I will not move into BUL, CON or SER this Spring. Please confirm A BUL, A CON and A SER stay out of RUM and SEV, and F BLA stays away from SEV and UKR. Then the Black Sea stays quiet.

Russia to England: A NOR holds this Spring and will defend itself. F SEV stays off Edinburgh and the North Sea, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Withdraw F NWG from Norway and I will keep the north quiet. If it stays, I will answer.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1917: I will not move A SER to Budapest this spring, and I am not taking part in any Trieste move. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian as agreed. Any Trieste operation is your own affair.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1917: Confirmed in writing. A BUL, A CON and A SER will not move into RUM or SEV. A RUM is yours in practice and I will not attack it this spring. Please keep A UKR, A GAL and F SEV out of RUM, BUL, CON and SER, and F BLA out of SEV and UKR. We keep the Black Sea quiet while we both watch Austria and Italy.

notes.note: Spring 1917: all hold BUD, TRI, VIE per pledges. Russia (GAL, UKR, WAR) repeatedly pledged no entry into my cities; Russia says GAL stays. Italy and Turkey pledged to stay off my centres. Watch for broken word; consider GAL or SER strike only if the threat clears.

Spring 1917: all units hold home centers EDI, LON, LVP; no unowned center reachable. Promised Germany/France to keep A LON, A EDI, F LVP out of Belgium/Holland/Denmark/North Sea; Germany keeps A BEL (broken pact risk). Russia asks F NWG withdrawal, but no fleet there. Next: rebuild fleet toward Norway/Belgium; consider Belgium with France if Germany keeps A BEL.

Spring 1917: all hold to honor pledges (no Baltic fleets, no moves into Prussia/Silesia/Livonia, GAL out of BUD/VIE/TRI). Turkey confirmed BUL/CON/SER stay off RUM/SEV. England asked NWG leave NOR; watch. Austria and Germany pledges unconfirmed. Next: consider SEV-BLA convoy once Turkey stable.

Spring 1917: holding NAP, ROM, VEN. No unowned centers reachable; VEN to TRI unsupported would bounce (Turkey refused BUD). Pacts: France (no French fleet in Tyrrhenian or toward NAP/ROM/VEN, F WES out of Tunis; France has kept so far), Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples; refused SER-BUD), Austria (no Trieste while F TRI holds). Revisit TRI only with Turkish support.

Spring 1917: BEL holds, BER to PRU (unowned), DEN to BAL for convoy setup, KIE and MUN hold. Russia and France pledges unconfirmed; England wants BEL withdrawn, refused. Keep DEN out of NTH/NOR and no Munich or Bohemia moves by Austria.

Spring 1917: all hold to keep promises. Germany confirmed MUN/BEL hold; England and Italy deals stand. No unowned centers, so no safe gains. Watch Germany on BUR and Italy on TUN. Revisit convoy SPA to NAF only if a center opens.

Spring 1917: holding all units. Russia (RUM, GAL) pledged no move on BUL/CON/SER; I pledged no attack on RUM this spring. Italy asks for SER to BUD and Trieste help; declined, Austria pact stays. Keep AEG out of ION. Watch Russian SEV/UKR/GAL; if Russia breaks, strike RUM. Russia is 7 centres, I have 6, need growth.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1917. Your armies have pledged three times to stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI. I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Confirm in writing that A GAL, A UKR and A WAR stay out of my cities this Fall. Tell me your Fall orders first.

Austria here, Fall 1917. I hold BUD, VIE and TRI and will not move toward Serbia or Bulgaria. Please keep A SER and A BUL away from BUD and TRI as agreed. Tell me whether F BLA or A RUM-front units will press Russia in Rumania this Fall, so we avoid bumping.

Austria here, Fall 1917. A VIE stays in Vienna and F TRI holds Trieste, off the Adriatic approaches. I have no orders against Venice or Rome. Please keep A VEN, A ROM and F NAP off Trieste and Albania this Fall, and let us both focus on other fronts.

England, Fall 1917. Germany's A BEL is isolated. Proposal: your A PAR moves to Picardy this fall and A BUR supports it. I will move F LVP to the English Channel, ready to support into Belgium next year. If you take Belgium, we share it, and I will hold Channel and Brest out of your plans. Do you agree?

France here. I have no quarrel with you and no units near Russian centers. Germany and Austria are the pressure points for both of us. Are you planning anything against Germany in Prussia or Silesia this Fall? I'd like to keep the north and east calm on my side.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1917: Your A WAR and A SWE stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic, as you pledged. I hold BER, KIE, DEN and MUN. Tell me your Fall orders for WAR, GAL and UKR so we avoid any bounce.

Germany to England, Fall 1917: A BEL stays, and I will not move it into the North Sea or Channel. F DEN stays out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium and Holland and we both keep our centres. Confirm your Fall orders.

Germany to France, Fall 1917: A MUN and A BEL hold, and I will not enter Burgundy, Picardy or Ruhr. Please keep A BUR away from Munich, Kiel and Holland. Tell me what A PAR and A MAR do this fall, so we avoid any misunderstanding in the west.

Italy here, Fall 1917. I hold A VEN, A ROM and F NAP this turn and have no orders against Trieste. I am watching Trieste. If A VIE moves toward Tyrolia or F TRI leaves Trieste for the Adriatic, I will reconsider. Please confirm your Fall orders for VIE, TRI and BUD.

Italy here. We have not spoken, and our armies are far apart. I have no plans against Russia and am holding NAP, ROM and VEN this Fall. Please tell me your intentions for the Balkans and Galicia, and confirm you will not move toward Venice, Rome or Naples.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1917: My A GAL, A UKR and A WAR stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this turn. Confirm in writing that A BUD, A VIE and F TRI do not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. If you keep to that, I will keep Russia's armies at home and focus on Turkey and Germany.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1917: F RUM holds and A GAL stays put. I will not move into BUL, CON or SER. Confirm A BUL, A CON, A SER and F AEG stay out of RUM, SEV and UKR this turn, and F BLA stays away from SEV and UKR. Let us keep the Black Sea quiet.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1917: A SWE and A WAR will not move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Confirm your BER, KIE, DEN and BAL units stay off Sweden and St Petersburg this turn. If that holds, our northern pact stands.

Turkey here, Fall 1917. Our Spring pledges still hold: A BUL, A CON and A SER stay out of RUM and SEV. Please confirm in writing that F RUM, A GAL, A UKR and F SEV hold this Fall and do not enter BUL, CON, SER or BLA. If you hold, I hold. Tell me your Fall orders.

Turkey here, Fall 1917. I am keeping A SER, A BUL and A CON out of BUD and TRI as agreed. Please confirm A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of SER and BUL this Fall. Tell me if you plan any move toward Serbia or Bulgaria, or any move against Italy.

Austria to Russia: I confirm in writing that A BUD, A VIE and F TRI will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania this Fall. Please make the same commitment for A GAL, A UKR and A WAR toward BUD, VIE and TRI, and keep A RUM out of Budapest. Your Turkish front is where your gains lie. Let us keep our borders quiet.

Austria to Italy: F TRI holds Trieste this Fall and stays off the Adriatic approaches. A VIE stays in Vienna. I ask that A VEN, A ROM and F NAP stay off Trieste and Albania. Your best expansion is against Turkey or France, not Austria. Confirm your Fall orders so we both keep the peace.

Austria to Turkey: Agreed. A BUD, A VIE and F TRI will hold and stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria this Fall. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A CON away from Budapest and Trieste as pledged. Your Rumania campaign is yours to pursue against Russia, and I will not contest it. Tell me if F BLA plans anything toward Serbia.

England here, Fall 1917. A BEL sits on my centre and I cannot accept that permanently. I will keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium and Holland this fall, but I will not keep promising quiet while you hold it. Withdraw A BEL to Holland and our northern pact stands. Otherwise I will act against it in Spring 1918.

France here. I can't commit A PAR to Picardy this fall. Germany is my neighbour and Russia is pressing me, so I won't open a war on Belgium. A BEL is German, so a Picardy move only invites retaliation. Take Belgium with your own fleets if you wish. I'll keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel as agreed.

France here. Confirmed: A BUR will not enter Burgundy's northern approaches, Munich, Ruhr, Kiel or Holland. A PAR and A MAR are holding in my western and southern zone, aimed at Iberia and North Africa, not at you. I expect no German moves into Burgundy or Picardy. Let's keep the west calm while we both face Russia.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1917: Your pledge is noted and I will hold BER, KIE and DEN off Sweden and St Petersburg while A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Your SWE and BUD seizures were hard to forgive, so I will judge strictly by your moves. Post your exact Fall orders for WAR, GAL, UKR and SEV before adjudication. Any breach ends this pact immediately.

Italy here, Fall 1917. Our Adriatic peace has held in practice: I am holding A VEN, A ROM and F NAP this turn and have no orders against Trieste. Keep A VIE out of Tyrolia and F TRI off the Adriatic approaches and that stays true. If either moves, I will reconsider. Confirm your Fall orders for VIE, TRI and BUD.
Russia here. No plans against Prussia or Silesia from my side this Fall. My focus is Turkey and Austria in the south. Keep your units west of Germany and we stay friendly.

Russia to Germany: A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia this Fall, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Keep BER, KIE, DEN and BAL off Sweden and St Petersburg and our pact holds.

Russia to Austria: A GAL, A UKR and A WAR stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this Fall, as pledged. Hold A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania, and we keep the peace while I watch Turkey.
Russia to Italy: I have no plans against Venice, Rome or Naples. My armies are in the east and south-east. Keep your NAP, ROM and VEN out of Balkan waters and we have no quarrel.

Russia to Turkey: F RUM holds, A GAL stays put, and I will not move into BUL, CON or SER this Fall. Confirm A BUL, A CON, A SER and F AEG stay out of RUM, SEV and UKR, and F BLA stays away from SEV and UKR.

Turkey here, Fall 1917. Agreed: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria, and my A SER, A BUL and A CON stay out of BUD and TRI. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing so no bounce occurs near Serbia. I am focused on Russia in Rumania.

Turkey here, Fall 1917. I will hold A BUL, A CON and A SER and not enter RUM or SEV. Confirm in writing that F RUM, A GAL, A UKR and F SEV hold this Fall and do not enter BUL, CON, SER or BLA. If you hold, I hold. Please send your exact orders.

notes.note: Fall 1917: holding NAP, ROM, VEN. Austria, Russia, France pacts intact; Turkey refused BUD. Austria has 3 centres, a Trieste push needs Turkish help. Next: look for expansion vs Turkey/France when borders shift; keep France out of Tyrrhenian.

Fall 1917: holding all. No unowned centers in reach. Promises kept: England (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel, declined Picardy plan), Germany (BUR away from MUN/KIE/Ruhr/Hol), Italy (no fleet to Tyrrhenian/Tunis, no move toward NAP/ROM/VEN). Russia says no plans vs Prussia. Watch Germany on BUR, England on Belgium. Next: WES to MAO then SPA convoy to NAF if an opening appears.

Fall 1917: all units hold home centers EDI, LON, LVP. France refused to take Belgium with me; Germany keeps A BEL and has kept the north quiet. No unowned centers reachable. Next: consider Belgium only with France or if Germany's A BEL is isolated; keep fleets out of Holland/Denmark.

Fall 1917: holding BUD, TRI, VIE. Russia (GAL, UKR, WAR) and Turkey (SER, BUL, CON) pledged to stay out of my cities; Italy keeps off TRI. No unsupported attack possible on SER. Watch for broken pledges; reassess SER or GAL strike if threat clears.

Fall 1917: Holding German SCs; BEL held vs England/France threat. PRU to BER (own SC, empty) to avoid bounce. Russia pact (SWE/WAR out of PRU/SIL/LVN, no Baltic fleet) unconfirmed; watch. France pledge: no moves into BUR/PIC/RUH. England broke-ish threat on BEL, watch spring 1918. Need growth: consider Sweden/Silesia only if pacts break.

Fall 1917: holding pacts with Germany, Turkey, Austria, England. No unowned centers reachable. SEV to MOS fills home center. Watch Austria's pledges on BUD/VIE/TRI and Turkish BUL/SER. Consider SEV-BLA convoy plan later.

Fall 1917: A BUL attacks RUM, supported by F BLA and A SER (BUL to RUM). Russia's F RUM is defended only by A GAL. Holding ANK, CON, AEG. Pacts: Austria (no SER/BUL to BUD/TRI), Italy (AEG out of ION). Russia pledged no BUL/CON/SER entry; RUM is the target if it holds. Reassess after result.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1918. Your armies have kept the pledge for a year, so I will too. Austria is weak, and our best gain is Turkey. Confirm A GAL, A UKR and A WAR stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this spring, and tell me your Rumania plans first.

Austria here, Spring 1918. Confirm A SER, A BUL and A CON stay out of BUD and TRI, and I will keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Serbia and Bulgaria. Tell me your Spring orders in Rumania so we avoid bumping.
Austria here, Spring 1918. A VIE and A BUD stay off Munich and Bohemia this spring. Share your Spring orders, and tell me if you will strike Warsaw or Silesia so we can coordinate against Russia.

England, Spring 1918. A BEL has sat on my centre since 1917 and I will act against it this spring. Withdraw A BEL to Holland now and our northern pact stands. If it stays, my fleets and A LON will move on Belgium. Give me your answer before orders are set.

England, Spring 1918. I am moving against A BEL this spring with F LVP and A LON. If A PAR moves to Picardy to support into Belgium, we share the centre. Otherwise I will take it alone. Confirm your spring orders and keep A MAR and A BUR away from the Channel.

England, Spring 1918. If A NOR stays put and F SEV stays off the North Sea and Edinburgh, I will keep my fleets out of Norway and Sweden this spring. Confirm that no Russian fleet enters the Baltic or North Sea, and tell me your intentions for Norway.

France, Spring 1918: A BUR is holding and will stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland. Please confirm A MUN and A BEL hold again this spring and that no German unit enters Burgundy or Picardy. If you need to move elsewhere, tell me first so we avoid any misunderstanding in the west.

France, Spring 1918: A PAR, A BUR and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel as agreed. Spain and Portugal remain French. Please keep F LVP, A LON and A EDI out of those areas too. Tell me your Spring moves so we can keep the west quiet.

France, Spring 1918: I confirm no French fleet enters the Tyrrhenian or moves toward NAP, ROM or VEN, and F WES stays out of Tunis. Please keep F NAP, A ROM and A VEN away from Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Tunis. Share your Spring orders for the Western Mediterranean so no bounce occurs.

Germany to England, Spring 1918: A BEL stays put and I will not move it into the North Sea or Channel. F DEN stays out of NTH and NOR. Please confirm A LON, A EDI and F LVP stay out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark this spring. If you attack Belgium, I will defend it with everything I have.

Italy here, Spring 1918. Austria is down to BUD, TRI and VIE. I propose A VEN moves to TRI this spring while your A SER moves to BUD. Splitting Austria's last centres gains us both. Please confirm A SER to BUD and tell me your other Balkan orders. I keep F NAP and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian.

Italy here, Spring 1918. Your fleets have kept out of the Tyrrhenian as agreed. Please confirm F WES stays out of Tunis and no French unit moves toward Naples, Rome or Venice. Tell me your Spring 1918 Western Mediterranean orders so we avoid any bounce.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1918: I hold F RUM and A GAL, and I will not move into BUL, CON or SER. Your A RUM, A SER and A CON are the key pressure on Rumania. Tell me your Spring orders in writing so we avoid any bounce on SEV or RUM.

Russia to Austria: A GAL and A WAR will stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this Spring. Confirm A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Your A TRI and A VIE are not my target; I am watching Turkey.

Russia to Germany: A SWE and A WAR stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia this Spring, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please confirm BER, KIE, DEN and BAL stay off Sweden and St Petersburg. Our pact stands if you hold.

Turkey here, Spring 1918. Your F SEV and A GAL are the only Russian units near my Black Sea and Rumanian holdings. Tell me your exact Spring orders in writing. I will hold A RUM, A SER, A CON and F BLA, and will not enter SEV or UKR this spring if F SEV holds. Please confirm you will not enter BUL, CON, SER or RUM.

Turkey here, Spring 1918. Our pact stands: I keep A SER out of BUD and TRI. Please confirm A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring and do not move toward Serbia or Bulgaria. Tell me your exact orders in writing so we avoid any bounce on the Serbian border.

Austria confirms: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this Spring and will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Your A GAL and A WAR staying out of BUD, VIE and TRI is noted. Note that A UKR is no longer on your list of pledges, so please confirm its orders in writing. I am watching Turkey as well.
