Austria confirms: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this Spring and do not move toward Serbia or Bulgaria. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A CON out of BUD and TRI. My orders are holds, so there is no bounce risk on the Serbian border. Good luck against Russia in Rumania.

England to Germany, Spring 1918: A BEL is still on my centre and I will not accept that. I am moving F LVP and A LON against Belgium this spring. Withdraw A BEL to Holland now and I will keep my fleets out of Holland, Denmark and the North Sea. Otherwise you should expect a fight for Belgium.

England to France, Spring 1918: I am moving F LVP and A LON against A BEL this spring. If your A PAR moves to Picardy to support into Belgium, we share the centre afterwards. If not, I will take it alone. Please keep A BUR and A MAR out of the Channel and Brest, as agreed, and Spain and Portugal stay yours.

France here. I will not move A PAR, A BUR or A MAR into Belgium or Picardy this spring, and I will not move into the Channel or Brest. I am not joining an attack on A BEL. Keep F LVP, A LON and A EDI out of Brest, Picardy and Spain-Portugal, and we both stay out of each other's way.

France here. Confirmed: F WES stays out of Tunis this spring, no French fleet enters the Tyrrhenian, and no French unit moves toward Naples, Rome or Venice. Keep F NAP, A ROM and A VEN away from Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Tunis, and we will both keep our centers.

Germany here. A MUN and A BER hold this spring. I will not enter Bohemia, Tyrolia or Vienna. I am not committing to Warsaw or Silesia yet; I will decide after seeing Russia's spring moves. Keep A VIE and A BUD off Munich and Bohemia, and share your orders so we avoid any bounce.

Germany here. My BER, KIE, DEN and BAL hold as you asked, and I will not enter Sweden or St Petersburg. Your A SWE and A WAR must stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet may enter the Baltic. Any breach ends our pact at once.

Germany here. A MUN and A BEL hold this spring. I will not move into Burgundy, Picardy or Ruhr, and I expect A BUR to stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland. Please tell me your plans for A PAR and A MAR so the west stays calm.

Germany here. A BEL stays where it is and will not move into the North Sea or Channel. I will not withdraw to Holland. F DEN stays out of NTH and NOR. If you move A LON, A EDI or F LVP into Belgium, I will defend it with everything I have. Keep your northern units out of Holland and Denmark.

Italy, Spring 1918: F WES stays out of Tunis as you confirm, and I hold NAP, ROM and VEN. My fleets keep out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal and the Western Mediterranean. Please keep F WES and any French fleet out of Tunis and the Tyrrhenian, and do not move toward Naples, Rome or Venice. Breach that and I will act. My Spring orders are holds in the south while I watch the Adriatic.

Russia to Austria: A GAL and A WAR stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this Spring, as pledged. A UKR is gone, so that pledge no longer applies. Please confirm A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Keep to that and we both stay quiet while I deal with Turkey.

Russia to England: A NOR holds this Spring and F SEV stays off Edinburgh and the North Sea. No Russian fleet enters the Baltic or North Sea. Withdraw F NWG from Norway and the north stays quiet. If it moves into Norway, I will answer. Your choice.

Russia to Turkey: F RUM holds, A GAL holds, and I will not move into BUL, CON or SER this Spring. Confirm A BUL, A CON, A SER and F AEG stay out of RUM and SEV, and F BLA stays away from SEV and UKR. Given your new army in SMY, I want these commitments in writing.

Turkey here, Spring 1918. My A SER, A CON and A RUM stay out of BUD and TRI, and I will not move toward Serbia or Bulgaria from my side. I am pressing Russia in Rumania, not you. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding this spring, as you have pledged.

Turkey here. Your F RUM is not on the board, since my A RUM holds Rumania. Your F SEV and A GAL are the only Russian units near my Black Sea holdings. If F SEV and A GAL stay out of RUM, BUL, CON, SER and BLA this spring, I will hold A RUM, A SER, A CON and F BLA and not enter SEV or UKR.

Turkey here. I will not move A SER to Budapest, and I will not join a Trieste move this spring. Austria is still an ally of my pact and I intend to keep it. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Please keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Ionian.

notes.note: Spring 1918: all hold BUD, TRI, VIE as pledged. Russia (GAL, WAR) and Turkey (SER, CON, RUM) promised to stay out of my cities; Germany off Munich/Bohemia. Watch for broken word. Reassess a strike on GAL or SER only if the threat clears.

Spring 1918: holding NAP, ROM, VEN. Turkey again refused SER-BUD and any Trieste move, so a VEN-TRI attack would bounce. France confirmed no Tyrrhenian/Tunis/Naples moves. Austria pact holds. Revisit TRI only with Turkish support; watch France on Tunis and Turkey on Greece/Ionian.

Spring 1918: no unowned centers. Holding all armies per promises to England (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel), Germany (BUR out of MUN/RUH/KIE/HOL), Italy (no Tunis/Tyrrhenian/NAP/ROM/VEN). F WES to MAO sets up SPA/POR convoy to NAF later. Watch England on Belgium and Germany on BUR.

Spring 1918: no reachable unowned centre or Belgium move available this turn, so all units hold home centres EDI, LON, LVP. Germany's A BEL still sits on my centre and Germany refused to withdraw; France declines to join. Next: move fleet toward ENG/NTH to threaten BEL in a later spring, and keep Russia to its north promise (NOR, SEV, NWG).

Spring 1918: all units hold to keep 6 SCs; no unowned SCs exist. Russia pact (SWE/WAR out of PRU/SIL/LVN, no Baltic fleet) and France pact (BUR out of MUN/RUH/KIE/HOL) still active. England threatens BEL; refused withdrawal, will defend. Austria: no Bohemia/Munich by VIE/BUD. Revisit growth vs Russia if pacts break.

Spring 1918: BLA moves to SEV, supported by RUM (BLA to SEV) to take Russian SEV. Pacts: Austria (no SER/BUL to BUD/TRI), Italy (AEG out of ION), Russia promised no BUL/CON/SER entry. Hold others. Watch Russian MOS/GAL support on SEV and any Austrian/Italian move.

Spring 1918: SEV attacks RUM, GAL supports SEV to RUM; others hold. Pledges to Germany (no Baltic/Prussia/Livonia) and Austria (GAL/WAR out of BUD/VIE/TRI) kept. Turkey pledges broken by my RUM attack; England NWG threat on NOR. Watch Turkish retaliation on SEV/UKR.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1918. Our armies are on Serbia's border and Russia's GAL and WAR still threaten BUD and VIE. Confirm in writing that A GAL and A WAR stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this Fall, and tell me what A UKR is doing now.

Austria here, Fall 1918. I hold BUD, VIE and TRI and will not move toward Serbia or Bulgaria. Confirm your A SER and A CON stay out of BUD and TRI, and tell me your Rumania plans so we avoid bounces in the Balkans.

Austria here, Fall 1918. I am holding A BUD and A VIE this Fall and will stay out of Munich, Bohemia and Tyrolia. Please confirm A MUN and A BER do not enter Bohemia or Vienna's approaches, and tell me if you plan any move on Warsaw.

England to France, Fall 1918: F LVP cannot reach Belgium this fall, so I am holding EDI, LON and LVP. For Spring 1919, I will move F LVP to the Channel and A LON toward Belgium only if A PAR or A BUR supports into Picardy or Belgium. Tell me your Fall moves so we both keep the west quiet.

France, Fall 1918. I am keeping A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel as agreed. Please confirm F LVP, A LON and A EDI stay out of Brest, Picardy and Spain-Portugal. Tell me your Fall orders so we avoid any bounce in the west.

France, Fall 1918. A BUR will not enter Munich, Ruhr, Kiel, Holland or Burgundy's northern approaches. I expect no German unit into Burgundy or Picardy. Please tell me your Fall moves for A BEL and A MUN so the west stays calm while we both face Russia.

Germany to England, Fall 1918: A BEL is staying and will defend itself. If A LON, A EDI or F LVP moves into Belgium, Holland or Denmark this fall, I will fight back hard. Stay out of the North Sea entry points and we can both keep our centres. Confirm your orders now.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1918: Your A WAR and A SWE must stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia, and no Russian fleet may enter the Baltic. I am holding BER, KIE, DEN and BAL. Tell me your exact Fall orders for WAR, GAL, MOS and SWE so we avoid any bounce.

Germany to France, Fall 1918: A MUN and A BEL hold. I expect A BUR to stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland. Please confirm A BUR's Fall order and tell me what A PAR and A MAR do, so the west stays calm while we face Russia and England.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1918: I still propose A SER to BUD and A VEN to TRI, which would take Austria's last centres. Turkey has refused twice. If you will not join, tell me your plans for Greece and Bulgaria so we avoid friction. Keep F AEG out of the Ionian as agreed.

Italy to France, Fall 1918: Our understanding holds. Please confirm no French fleet enters the Tyrrhenian and F WES stays out of Tunis this Fall. I keep NAP, ROM and VEN in place. Tell me your Fall orders for the Western Mediterranean.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1918: I keep A VEN, A ROM and F NAP off Trieste while F TRI holds and A VIE stays out of Tyrolia. Please confirm TRI, VIE and BUD hold this Fall. Any move toward Venice or Tyrolia breaks our terms.

Russia to Turkey: F SEV and A RUM are contested. Your A RUM retreated to BUL, so RUM is empty now. I will not move into BUL, CON, SER or BLA this Fall. Will you hold A SMY, A ANK and F AEG away from SEV and RUM? Confirm in writing and I keep F SEV off the Balkans.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1918: RUM and SEV are the contested centres now. Your A GAL and F SEV are the only units near my holdings. I hold A RUM, A SER, A CON and F BLA, and I will not enter SEV or UKR if F SEV stays put. Confirm in writing your orders in SEV, RUM, BUL and CON, and whether you will move into RUM.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1918: I confirm A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this Fall. A VIE stays out of Tyrolia and F TRI stays on Trieste. Please keep A VEN, A ROM and F NAP off Trieste and Albania. If you hold as you say, we both keep our centers and can talk about 1919 terms.

England here, Fall 1918. My A EDI, A LON and F LVP all hold this fall. None of them will enter Belgium, Holland, Denmark, the North Sea or Norway. A BEL is your unit, and I am not pressing it now. Keep your F DEN out of NTH and NOR, and we both keep our centres.

Italy, France here. I have no fleet in the Tyrrhenian or Western Mediterranean now. F MAO is in the Atlantic, and no French unit moves toward NAP, ROM, VEN or TUN this Fall. A MAR and A SPA stay in my own zone. Our understanding stands; please keep your fleets out of Marseille and Tunis too.

England, France here. A PAR, A BUR and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and the Channel this Fall. F MAO is in the Atlantic and does not move toward Brest or the Channel. Spain and Portugal remain French. Keep F LVP, A LON and A EDI out of Brest, Picardy and Spain-Portugal, and we will keep the west quiet.

Germany, France here. A BUR will not enter Munich, Ruhr, Kiel, Holland, Burgundy's northern approaches or Picardy this Fall. A PAR and A MAR stay in my western and southern zone. I expect A MUN and A BEL to hold as you said. Let's keep the west calm while we both face Russia.

Germany: Fall 1918, A MUN and A BER hold this turn. I will not enter Bohemia, Tyrolia, Vienna or Trieste. Keep your A VIE and A BUD out of Munich and Bohemia as agreed. I make no move on Warsaw or Silesia yet; I will judge Russia's orders first.

Russia to Austria: A GAL and A WAR will stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this Fall. A UKR is no longer in Galicia; its orders are being decided separately and I will not move it into your cities. Your A BUD, A VIE and F TRI should not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Keep to that and we stay at peace.

Russia to Germany: A SWE and A WAR will not move into Prussia, Silesia or Livonia this Fall, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. My Fall orders in the north are holds. Keep BER, KIE, DEN and BAL off Sweden and St Petersburg and our pact stands.

Russia to Turkey: RUM is empty after your retreat, and I will not move into BUL, CON, SER or BLA this Fall. F SEV will not enter RUM or your Balkan centres. Please confirm A SMY, A ANK and F AEG stay out of SEV and RUM, and that A RUM stays in Bulgaria.

Turkey here, Fall 1918. My A SER and A CON stay out of BUD and TRI, and I will not move toward Serbia or Bulgaria from my side. Rumania is contested with Russia; I will not send units into Austrian land. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding as pledged.

Turkey here. I will not move A SER to Budapest or join a Trieste move; my pact with Austria stands. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Greece and Bulgaria are mine to hold this Fall. Keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM away from Greece and the Ionian.

Turkey to Russia: A RUM is holding Rumania now, and I will not enter SEV or UKR if F SEV stays put. Please confirm in writing that F SEV and A GAL do not move into RUM, BUL, CON, SER or BLA. Any move into Rumania by you will be met.

notes.note: Fall 1918: all three units hold EDI, LON, LVP as promised to Germany and France. Germany keeps A BEL; France keeps west quiet. Next: F LVP to Channel and A LON toward Belgium in Spring 1919 only if France supports into Picardy/Belgium. Watch Germany's F DEN and Russia's north promise.

Fall 1918: holding BUD, TRI, VIE to keep 3 centers. Russia (GAL, WAR) and Turkey pledged no entry into my cities; Italy pledged to keep off TRI. Watch for broken pledges; consider a strike on SER or GAL only if the threat clears.

Fall 1918: all units hold to keep 6 SCs (BEL, BER, KIE, MUN, DEN, HOL-area). Pacts: Russia (no SWE/WAR into PRU/SIL/LVN, no Baltic fleet) and France (BUR out of MUN/RUH/KIE/HOL) and Austria (no Bohemia/Munich) all said holding. England threatens BEL; will defend. Revisit growth only if a pact breaks.

Fall 1918: holding all to keep French centers PAR MAR POR SPA BRE. Promises kept: England (no Bel/Pic/Brest/Channel), Germany (BUR out of MUN/RUH/KIE/HOL/Bur approaches), Italy (no Tunis/Tyrrhenian/NAP/ROM/VEN). No unowned centers in reach. Watch Germany on BUR, England on Belgium. Next: MAO to WES then SPA convoy to NAF/TUN if Italy stays aligned.

Fall 1918: holding NAP, ROM, VEN. No unowned centers reachable. Pacts: France (no Tyrrhenian/Tunis, no moves to NAP/ROM/VEN; confirmed), Turkey (no Greece/Ionian/Apulia/Naples; refused SER-BUD and Trieste), Austria (confirmed TRI/VIE/BUD hold). VEN-TRI unsupported would bounce, so wait for Turkish support or a French breach. Watch Tunis and Greece.

Fall 1918: F RUM holds to take RUM; A GAL supports it against Turkish F SEV/A SER/A BUL. Holding MOS, NOR, SWE, WAR for home defense and pacts. No Baltic fleets. Watch Turkey on SEV/RUM and Austria on BUD/VIE/TRI.

Fall 1918: BUL to RUM supported by SEV and SER to take empty RUM; SEV stays to hold SEV. Other units hold. Pacts: Austria (no SER/BUL to BUD/TRI), Italy (AEG out of ION), Russia (no BUL/CON/SER entry). Watch Russian GAL vs RUM.

messages.body: Austria here, Spring 1919. Your A GAL is the main threat to BUD and VIE. Confirm in writing that A GAL, A WAR and A MOS stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this Spring. In return, A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold and stay out of Galicia, Warsaw and Rumania. Tell me your Spring orders for GAL and WAR first.

Austria here, Spring 1919. Your A SER is still the center I would most like to take, but I will not attack this year. Please confirm A SER, A CON and A RUM stay out of BUD and TRI. If your Serbian army leaves SER this year, I may reconsider in Fall. Tell me your Spring orders for SER and RUM first.

England to France, Spring 1919: F LVP moves to the Channel this spring and A LON holds. If you want Belgium, tell me now whether A PAR or A BUR will support into Belgium; otherwise I will not move into Belgium this spring. Keep your units out of the Channel and Brest.

France, Spring 1919. I hold A PAR, A BUR, A MAR and F MAO as agreed, with no moves toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Please confirm F LVP and A LON stay out of Brest, Picardy and Spain-Portugal. We keep the west quiet and both build for 1919.

France, Spring 1919. I confirm F MAO and my armies stay out of the Tyrrhenian, Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice. Please keep F NAP, A ROM and A VEN away from Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Tunis. Tell me your Spring 1919 southern orders so no bounce occurs.

France, Spring 1919. A BUR holds and will not enter Munich, Ruhr, Kiel, Holland, Burgundy's northern approaches or Picardy. Please confirm A MUN and A BEL hold this spring and no German unit enters Burgundy or Picardy. Let us keep the west calm while we both face Russia.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1919: Your A SWE and A WAR have held the pact, and so have my BER, KIE, DEN and BAL. Tell me your exact Spring orders for SWE, WAR, MOS, NOR and GAL. If Sweden is vacated, I will consider it, but only if you confirm you stay out of Prussia and Silesia.

Germany to France, Spring 1919: A MUN and A BEL hold, and I will not enter Burgundy, Picardy or Ruhr. Please confirm A BUR stays out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and tell me what A PAR, A MAR and F MAO do so we avoid a bounce in the west.

Germany to England, Spring 1919: A BEL holds and will stay put. F BAL and F DEN stay out of the North Sea and Norway. Please confirm A LON, A EDI and F LVP hold or move only away from Belgium, Holland and Denmark. Tell me your intentions for the North Sea.

Italy, Spring 1919: my fleet at NAP is moving into the Tyrrhenian this turn and may reach Tunis next. Your western fleets are far from Tunis, so I'm not threatening you directly. Tell me if you plan any French unit toward Tunis or Piedmont, so we avoid a bounce.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1919: I still hold VEN, ROM and NAP. I'm looking south and west rather than at Greece or Trieste. Please confirm F AEG and your armies stay out of the Ionian and Apulia, and tell me your Balkan plans.

Russia to Turkey: I propose a Spring 1919 mutual standoff. My A GAL and A MOS hold, and I will not move into Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople. Confirm in writing that your A RUM, A SER, A CON and A SMY stay out of Sevastopol, Ukraine and Galicia. Your answer decides whether we keep the Black Sea quiet.

Russia to Austria: A GAL holds this Spring and will not move into Bud, Vie or Tri. Confirm that A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Galicia and Warsaw. Tell me what you intend against Turkey in Serbia and Rumania, since I would prefer we both stay out of each other's way.

Russia to Germany: A WAR and A SWE hold this Spring and will not enter Prussia, Silesia or Livonia. No Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Please confirm BER, KIE, DEN and BAL stay off Sweden and St Petersburg. If you keep to this, I will keep my armies in the east.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1919: Rumania and Sevastopol are the contested points. Please confirm in writing that F SEV and A GAL do not enter RUM, BUL, CON or SER this spring. In return my A RUM stays out of SEV and UKR, and I will not move toward Galicia or Ukraine. Tell me your exact orders so we avoid any bounce.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1919: I am still not joining any Trieste or Serbia operation, and my fleets stay out of the Ionian. Please keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM out of Greece and the Adriatic toward Albania. Tell me your Spring orders so neither of us is surprised by a bounce.

Austria: Confirmed in writing for Spring 1919: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold and will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. You say A GAL holds and will not enter BUD, VIE or TRI. Please also confirm A WAR and A MOS stay out of my three cities. Serbia and Rumania are not on my plan against you; I am watching Turkey. If your GAL moves on Budapest, we fight.

England to France, Spring 1919: I am not moving A LON into Belgium without support, so I will hold it. F LVP will go to the Channel only as a staging move, not toward Brest. Spain and Portugal are yours. If you want Belgium, tell me now whether A PAR or A BUR will support into Picardy; otherwise we keep the west quiet.

England to Germany, Spring 1919: A LON and A EDI hold this spring and will not enter Belgium, Holland, Denmark, the North Sea or Norway. F LVP only moves toward the Channel, away from your units. I have no Spring move planned against you. Your A PAR, A MAR and F MAO are your business, but if any move toward Belgium or Holland, our pact ends at once.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1919: My BER, KIE, DEN and BAL hold, and I will not enter Sweden or St Petersburg while your A WAR and A SWE stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Livonia and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Our pact stands if you hold. Any breach ends it.

Tell me if any French unit heads toward Tunis or Piedmont, and I will reassess.

Please keep F AEG out of the Ionian and your armies out of Apulia and Naples. My orders are holds in the Adriatic, with NAP moving into the Tyrrhenian.

I can't promise A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Galicia and Warsaw without knowing their Spring orders, so post them first. Our borders stay quiet if you hold.

I ask that BER, KIE, DEN and BAL stay off Sweden and St Petersburg. Sweden stays Russian for now, so do not expect a vacancy. Keep the pact and we both stay at peace.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1919: My A SER, A CON and A RUM will not move toward BUD or TRI this spring. I hold the Balkans and Rumania against Russia. Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding as pledged, and we will both stay out of each other's centres.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1919: My F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. I am not joining any Trieste or Serbia move. Keep F NAP, A VEN and A ROM away from Greece and Albania, and we both hold our centres.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1919: I will not move A RUM into SEV or UKR, and I will not move toward Galicia. But I cannot accept a standoff while Russia holds units beside Rumania. Keep F SEV and A GAL out of RUM, BUL, CON and SER, and we keep the Black Sea quiet.

notes.note: Spring 1919: holding BUD, TRI, VIE per pledges. Russia GAL holds and promised no entry into my cities; Turkey SER/CON/RUM promised no move on BUD/TRI. Watch for broken word; reassess SER or GAL strike in Fall if threat clears.

Spring 1919: F NAP to TYS to set up convoy of A ROM to TUN next turn. VEN holds, no Trieste move without Turkish support. Spring 1919: no unowned centres reachable. Holding EDI, LON, LVP. Belgium needs French support, which France refuses. Germany's A BEL is still on my centre history. Keep fleets out of North Sea and Norway. Revisit Belgium only with French support.

Spring 1919: holding all units to keep 6 SCs (BEL, BER, DEN, HOL, KIE, MUN). No unowned SCs; revisit growth only if a pact breaks.

Watch Russian GAL and Austrian moves; consider Fall strike on BUD/TRI only if Austria breaks.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Fall 1919: My orders are A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding, so none of them enters Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Please post your Fall orders for GAL, WAR, MOS and UKR before we finalize. If GAL stays home and nothing moves on BUD, VIE or TRI, I will keep the peace.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1919: My A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this Fall. Please confirm A SER, A CON and A RUM stay out of BUD and TRI, and tell me your Fall orders for SER and RUM. If SER is vacated, I would like to discuss Serbia terms for next year.

England, Fall 1919. I have 3 centres and need to grow. Belgium is yours for now. Tell me your plans for Holland and Denmark. If you move your units east or south, I will keep F LVP and A LON on home soil and stay out of the North Sea. Confirm, or tell me what you intend.

England to France, Fall 1919: I hold EDI, LON and LVP with A EDI, A LON and F LVP. Neither of us has gained ground in the west. If you want to contest Belgium in 1920, tell me your spring plan now, and whether A PAR or A BUR will support into Picardy or Belgium. I will not move without a clear agreement.

France to Italy, Fall 1919: Your fleet has left Naples for the Tyrrhenian, so NAP and the Adriatic approaches are open. I still hold F WES, A MAR and A SPA, and will not enter the Tyrrhenian or Tunis. Are you keeping A ROM and A VEN defensive this fall? I'd like to know before Austria moves south.

France to Germany, Fall 1919: A BUR will hold and stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel, Holland and Picardy. Please confirm A MUN and A BEL hold, and that no German unit enters Burgundy. If Russia or Austria pressure you, tell me, and we can keep the west quiet while you deal with them.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1919: My BER, KIE, DEN, BAL and BEL hold, and I stay out of Sweden and St Petersburg. Your A WAR is my main concern. If A WAR leaves Warsaw for Galicia or Ukraine, I will consider Silesia. Confirm your Fall orders for WAR and SWE now.

Germany to England, Fall 1919: A BEL holds and will defend itself. My F BAL and F DEN stay out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark and we both keep our centres. Confirm your Fall orders.

Italy to France, Fall 1919: My fleet is now in the Tyrrhenian at TYS and I am considering convoying A ROM toward Tunis. Tunis is your centre, so I need to know your intentions. Will F WES or A MAR move against Tunis or Naples? If not, I'd like your word that Tunis stays unthreatened by you while we both hold our current positions.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1919: A UKR will hold and will not enter SEV, RUM, BUL, CON or SER this Fall. Please confirm F SEV does not enter UKR or MOS, and A RUM stays out of UKR. Tell me your Fall orders for F SEV, A RUM and A SMY so we avoid any bounce. A quiet Black Sea suits us both.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1919: A UKR holds and will not enter Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Trieste. I ask that A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Warsaw and Ukraine. Turkey is the power that gains most from a Russia-Austria war, so let's keep our borders quiet and share intelligence on Turkish moves.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1919: Rumania is my contested point. Your A GAL and F SEV stay out of RUM, BUL, CON and SER this Fall, and I will keep A RUM out of SEV and UKR. Confirm your exact Fall orders in writing so neither of us faces a bounce.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1919: Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding as pledged and I will keep A SER, A CON and A RUM out of BUD and TRI. Tell me your Fall orders now so we avoid any surprise on the Serbian border.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1919: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this Fall and will not enter Galicia, Warsaw or Ukraine. I accept your pledge that A UKR holds and does not enter Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Trieste. Please also confirm A GAL, A WAR and A MOS stay out of my three cities. Post your full Fall orders, and we keep the peace while you deal with Turkey.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1919: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this Fall and will not move toward Serbia, Bulgaria or Rumania. Confirm A SER, A CON and A RUM stay out of BUD and TRI. Serbia remains a question for next year; if A SER leaves Serbia vacant, we can discuss terms. My Fall orders are holds.

England, Fall 1919. Belgium is a Germany-England dispute I will not settle by force while France refuses to help. My A EDI, A LON and F LVP hold this fall and will not enter Belgium, Holland, Denmark or the North Sea. Keep F BAL and F DEN out of the North Sea and Norway, and keep A BEL on its own side of the Channel. We can both hold our centres.

France to England: Fall 1919. I hold A PAR, A BUR, A MAR, F WES and A SPA this fall. No French unit moves toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. I am not contesting Belgium in 1920 without a clear, written plan from you first, and I will not support anything into Belgium unless we agree terms. Keep A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal and we stay at peace.

I suggest your A ROM and A VEN stay defensive toward the Adriatic while we both hold.

Tell me where A PAR, A MAR and F MAO are going next, since Iberia and North Africa are your zone and I have no quarrel there.

Germany to England: A BEL holds and will defend itself, as before. I will not move F BAL or F DEN into the North Sea or Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark and we both keep our centres. Your home islands are yours; I have no plans against them.

Italy to France, Fall 1919: Thank you for confirming F WES, A MAR and A SPA stay out of the Tyrrhenian and Tunis. I am keeping A ROM and A VEN defensive this fall. F TYS is my only move in the south and it is not an attack on you. Keep your word on Tunis and we will both grow. Any French move toward Naples, Rome or Venice ends this peace.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1919: Confirmed. My A SER, A CON and A RUM will not move toward BUD or TRI this Fall, and I expect A BUD, A VIE and F TRI to hold as pledged. My exact orders are holds in SER and CON, with RUM pressing Russia. I will say no more on Serbia terms until the board changes.

notes.note: Fall 1919: holding BUD, TRI, VIE per pledges. Russia (GAL, WAR, UKR) and Turkey (SER, CON, RUM) say they stay off my cities; Turkey holds SER/CON. Watch for broken word. Consider strike on SER if vacated or GAL if Russia moves.

messages.body: Austria here, Fall 1920. Serbia is the one center I can take this year. Your A SER is there now. Are you holding it, or moving it toward Rumania or Bulgaria? If it leaves, I will take Serbia with A BUD. I will not move on your Bulgarian or Constantinople units. Tell me your exact Fall orders.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1920: My A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold. I will not enter Galicia or Warsaw. Are your A WAR and A MOS staying home this Fall, or heading to Galicia or Ukraine? Tell me your exact orders so we avoid any misunderstanding.

England to Germany, Fall 1920: A BEL is still on Belgium, a centre I want. Your F BAL and F DEN have stayed out of the North Sea, and I have kept my fleets home. I am holding EDI, LON and LVP. Confirm that A BEL stays put and no German unit enters the North Sea or Norway. Tell me your plans for Belgium and Holland.

England to France, Fall 1920: Germany still holds Belgium with A BEL. If you move against Germany in the west, I am willing to coordinate, with A LON and F LVP ready for Belgium and Picardy. Tell me your Fall orders and whether A PAR or A BUR will move toward Belgium or Picardy. I will not act without your written reply.

France to England, Fall 1920: I hold PAR, BUR, MAR, POR and SPA and will not enter Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. If you want Belgium, send me a written plan naming which of your units moves and when, and I will consider it. Otherwise keep A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain.

France to Italy, Fall 1920: I hold A PAR, A BUR, A MAR, A POR and A SPA and will not enter the Tyrrhenian, Tunis, Naples, Rome or Venice. Please keep F TYS away from Marseille and Spain, and tell me if your fleet plans a move toward the Western Mediterranean this fall.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1920: Your A WAR and A SWE have held all year and our pact stands. Tell me your Fall orders now. If A WAR leaves Warsaw or A SWE leaves Sweden, I will reconsider, so I want your word on both before we move.

Italy to France, Fall 1920: A TUN stays in Tunis and F TYS returns to Naples this fall, so it is a defensive move. I expect you to keep F WES and your armies out of Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice. Confirm that, and I will keep my units out of Marseille, Spain and Piedmont.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1920: I hold A VEN and A ROM, and F TYS is moving to Naples. I have no move against Trieste. Please keep F TRI and A VIE where they are, out of Venice and Tyrolia, and tell me your Fall orders so neither of us is surprised.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1920: F TYS goes to Naples and my armies hold Rome and Venice. I am not moving toward Greece, the Ionian or Albania. Please keep F AEG out of the Ionian and your armies out of Apulia and Naples, as agreed, and tell me your Fall plans.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1920: Your F SEV retreated to ARM, so SEV is now held by my A SEV. I will hold it this Fall and move nothing into RUM, BUL, CON or SER. Please keep A RUM, A ARM and A SMY out of SEV and UKR. Tell me your exact Fall orders so we avoid a bounce.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Spring 1922: Turkey leads with 7 centres and threatens both our Black Sea and Balkan positions. I propose we coordinate against Turkey. If your A SEV or A WAR pushes into Rumania, I will press Serbia with A BUD once Turkey's A SER is gone. Please confirm you will not move on Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri this spring.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1922: Are you keeping A SER in Serbia, or moving it toward Rumania or Bulgaria? I will hold A BUD, A VIE and F TRI and stay out of Bulgaria and Greece. Confirm A CON, A RUM and A SER stay away from my cities this spring, and tell me your Fall plan against Russia's Sevastopol.

England to France, Spring 1922: I have 3 centres and need growth to stay in the game. I propose a written deal: you leave Brest and Picardy alone while I take Belgium from Germany in Fall 1922, with F LVP moving to the Channel and A LON to Yorkshire. Your A PAR would then move to Picardy and Belgium. Reply in writing with your Spring orders.

England to Germany, Spring 1922: I am holding EDI, LON and LVP. Your A BEL is still a centre I want. I propose we agree on a clear split: you keep Belgium and Holland, I keep the North Sea, and neither of us moves into Denmark or Norway. If you need help against France, tell me in writing what you want before Fall 1922.

In Fall 1922 A PAR moves to Belgium and A BUR supports it, while F LVP moves to the Channel and A LON to Yorkshire, and we split Belgium with Germany afterwards. Reply in writing to confirm.

France to Germany, Spring 1922: Russia is your main threat, so I propose a written non-aggression pact. You keep A BEL and your other units off Picardy, Burgundy and Brest. I keep my armies out of Belgium, Ruhr and Munich. Confirm in writing which of your units head east this year.

Germany, Spring 1922: A MUN holds this spring. Proposal: Austria presses Russia in Galicia with A BUD and A VIE while I prepare. From Fall 1922 I may move A MUN into Bohemia, and Vienna is open to us only if you have left it. Tell me your Fall orders first.

Germany, Spring 1922: our pact stands for now, with A BER, A KIE, A BEL, A MUN and F BAL holding. Austria is the weakest neighbour to both of us, and I am considering a southern shift. Confirm A WAR and A SWE hold this spring, and that no Russian army enters Prussia or Silesia.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1922: Our pact has held for years. I will keep A VEN, A ROM and F NAP off Trieste while F TRI and A VIE hold. If you move against Turkey or Russia instead, tell me, so we can discuss how Trieste and Albania are divided later.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1922: A SEV is my centre and I hold it. I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Please keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY out of SEV and UKR this Spring. Confirm in writing and we both can turn our attention west and north.

Austria, Spring 1922: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this spring, so I will not enter Bohemia, Tyrolia or Munich. Galicia is Russian ground and I will press it when the way is clear. Share your Fall orders first, and confirm A MUN stays out of Vienna and Trieste.

My F LVP goes to the Channel and A LON to Yorkshire for Fall 1922, with F LVP and A LON supporting you into Belgium only as the plan says. Keep A BUR and A MAR out of Brest and the Channel. Spain and Portugal stay yours. Confirm your Fall orders when they come.

France to England, Spring 1922: I will not write a plan that moves A PAR into Belgium or Picardy. Germany holds Belgium and I have kept my word all along. Spain and Portugal are mine and my units stay put. Keep A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal, and we remain at peace. Any future Belgium discussion must come after your Spring orders are visible to me.

Germany to France, Spring 1922: Agreed in principle. No German unit will enter Burgundy, Picardy or Brest. A BEL holds this spring. I am watching Russia, and any eastward move will stay away from your zone. Keep A BUR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and keep your armies out of Belgium as you proposed.

Denmark stays under German interest, so I will not put a unit in your North Sea. Confirm in writing that your fleets stay out of the North Sea and Norway.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1922: I will not move on Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri this spring. My units hold. I am not planning a push into Rumania either. Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding and we stay at peace. Coordinating against Turkey is sensible once the Balkans settle.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1922: A SEV holds and stays. I will not withdraw from a Russian centre. I again pledge no entry into Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY out of SEV and UKR and we both can focus elsewhere.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1922: A WAR and A SWE hold this spring. No Russian army enters Prussia or Silesia, and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Keep BER, KIE, BEL, MUN and BAL off Sweden and St Petersburg and our pact stands. Austria's fate is your affair, but Russia will not be sidelined.

Revisit SER or GAL if Turkey vacates SER or Russia leaves GAL open with support available. Watch Germany on VIE/BOH, as their Fall plan is unclear.

Spring 1922: all hold, MOS supports SEV. Pledges to Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), Germany (no PRU/SIL/LVN, no Baltic fleets), Turkey (no RUM/BUL/CON/SER) kept. Turkey demands SEV withdrawal; refused. Watch Turkey A RUM/F ARM on SEV, Germany on SWE/STP. Consider expansion into UKR/GAL later if pacts hold.

Spring 1922: holding all units to keep 6 SCs. Pacts with Russia, France, England, Austria still holding. No unowned SCs. Plan: consider a southern shift toward Bohemia/Vienna in Fall 1922 if Austria's Galicia push proceeds and Vienna is vacated; otherwise keep pacts.

Spring 1922: holding all to keep promises. Germany agreed (no entry to BUR/PIC/BRE; BUR out of MUN/RUH/KIE/HOL). England's written Belgium plan conflicts with my word to Germany; declined, so no PAR move into PIC/BEL. Italy: no Tunis/Naples/Rome/Venice/TYS. Watch England for LVP/LON moves toward BRE. No unowned centers reachable; consider SPA convoy to NAF later.

Spring 1922: holding EDI, LON, LVP (3 centres). France proposed a Belgium plan for Fall 1922 (A PAR to Picardy now, then Belgium with A BUR support, F LVP to Channel, A LON to Yorkshire). I have agreed in writing, but no Channel or Belgium option exists this spring. Germany's A BEL is still on Belgium; Germany says it will stay put. Keep fleets out of North Sea and Norway. Check France's Fall orde

Spring 1922: attacking Russian SEV with A RUM (move), F ARM supporting RUM to SEV, after repeated Russian refusals to withdraw. Others hold to keep pacts with Italy (AEG out of Ionian) and Austria (SER/CON/RUM stay off BUD/VIE/TRI). Russia pledged no entry into RUM/BUL/CON/SER; it has not been tested. Check whether Russia moves to contest SEV or Austria and Italy break pacts; reassess Fall.

messages.body: Austria, Fall 1922: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold. I ask that A MUN stays out of Vienna, Budapest and Trieste, and that you tell me plainly whether Bohemia is your target this fall, since that would change my plans.

Austria, Fall 1922: A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this fall. Your A WAR, A MOS and A SEV are my concern. Please confirm none of them enters Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri, and tell me if Rumania is your target so we can coordinate against Turkey.

Austria, Fall 1922: I keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI at home and stay out of Bulgaria, Greece and Serbia. Confirm A SER, A CON and A RUM stay away from my cities. Are you moving against Russia's Sevastopol this fall?

England to France, Fall 1922: Confirm your Fall orders now. Our agreed plan has A PAR to Belgium with A BUR support and F LVP to the Channel, A LON to Yorkshire. Tell me if A PAR is moving to Picardy or Belgium this fall, so I can plan my own moves.

England to Germany, Fall 1922: Confirm A BEL holds this fall and no German fleet enters the North Sea or Norway. France may move into Belgium. If A BEL is attacked or leaves, I want your written word first on how we split the centre.

France to England, Fall 1922: I will keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Belgium this Fall. Your Belgium move is with Germany, not me. Please keep A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal, as agreed. What are your Fall orders?

France to Germany, Fall 1922: My armies stay out of Burgundy and Ruhr as agreed. Are you still moving east against Russia this Fall? Confirm no German unit enters Picardy, Burgundy or Brest, and tell me whether A BEL is staying put.

France to Italy, Fall 1922: No French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this Fall. Please keep F NAP, A ROM and A TUN away from Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and we both keep our centres.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1922: A MUN moves into Bohemia this fall as a step toward Vienna. I will not enter Vienna while A VIE is there. Tell me whether A VIE goes into Galicia this fall or stays put, and whether A BUD and F TRI stay out of Munich and Bohemia.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1922: Our pact stands on the Baltic, Prussia and Silesia. My southern move this fall is aimed at Austria, not at Warsaw or Sweden. Confirm A WAR and A SWE hold this fall, and that no Russian army enters Prussia or Silesia.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1922: Your fleet and armies are pressing Russia, but Turkey holds seven centres and I hold four. Once Russia is weakened, I want Greece and Albania in our later deal. Will F AEG and your southern armies stay out of Apulia and Naples this autumn? Tell me your orders.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1922: A SEV holds this Fall and I stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Serbia as pledged. Please keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY out of SEV and UKR. Confirm in writing that A RUM holds, and we can both turn west against Austria and Germany.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1922: SEV has stalled both of us long enough. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS and I keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY off your centres. Hold it and I will keep contesting. Tell me your Fall orders for SEV and MOS now.

Austria here, Fall 1922. A MUN moving into Bohemia is a breach of our agreement, and I will treat it as hostile. A VIE holds Vienna and A BUD and F TRI hold their cities; I will not move them into Munich or Bohemia. Pull A MUN back out of Bohemia now and we can keep talking about Russia. Otherwise I will defend Vienna with everything I have.

England to France, Fall 1922: Thanks for confirming. My Fall orders are holds: A EDI, A LON and F LVP stay home this fall. Belgium is out of reach for my units this turn, so no Belgium move is coming from me. I will not move toward Brest or Spain-Portugal, and I expect the same from you.

France to England, Fall 1922: My Fall orders are A PAR, A BUR and A MAR holding in place. I will not move any of them into Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Spain and Portugal stay French. Please keep A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal, as agreed. I am not writing a plan that moves A PAR into Belgium or Picardy.

Germany, Fall 1922: As I said, A MUN moves into Bohemia this fall. I will not enter Vienna while your A VIE is there. A BUD and F TRI stay out of Munich and Bohemia. A VIE should press Galicia rather than stay idle, so we can both pressure Russia.

Germany to France: Confirmed. No German unit enters Picardy, Burgundy or Brest this fall, and A BEL holds. My main effort is toward Bohemia and Russia, away from your zone. Keep A BUR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland as agreed, and we stay friends.

Germany to England: Confirmed in writing. A BEL holds this fall. My F BAL and F DEN stay out of the North Sea and Norway. Please keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark. If A BEL ever moves, you will hear it from me first.

Italy here, Fall 1922. Confirmed: my fleets and armies stay out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Tunis this fall. A NAP-area units hold their zones and I make no move toward your centres. Keep F WES and all French units out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian, as pledged, and we both keep our centres.
Russia to Austria, Fall 1922: A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this fall. None enters Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri. I have no move on Rumania planned. Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding and our peace stands.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1922: A SEV holds and stays; I will not withdraw from a Russian centre. I again pledge no entry into Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY out of SEV and UKR and we both can look west.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1922: A WAR and A SWE hold this fall. No Russian army enters Prussia or Silesia and no Russian fleet enters the Baltic. Keep your forces off Sweden and St Petersburg and our pact stands. Good luck against Austria.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1922: Confirmed, my A SER, A CON and A RUM stay away from BUD, VIE and TRI. I have no move planned against Serbia or Bulgaria this fall. Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Bulgaria, Greece and Serbia, and we both keep our centres. I am focused on Russia's Sevastopol.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1922: I will not confirm A RUM holding while your A SEV sits on my former centre. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS and I keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY off your centres. Hold it and I continue contesting SEV. Your pledges mean nothing to me until SEV is vacated.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1922: F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples, as before. I am not moving toward Greece or Albania this autumn. Keep F NAP, A ROM, A VEN and A TUN away from Greece and Albania, and we both hold our centres for now.

notes.note: Fall 1922: holding BUD, TRI, VIE to defend vs Germany's MUN->BOH breach. Russia and Turkey pledged off my cities and Turkey is focused on SEV. Watch GER BOH->VIE next spring; consider support to hold VIE. Revisit SER/GAL only if Turkey vacates SER or Russia leaves GAL open.

Fall 1922: all holds, keeping word. No unowned centers reachable without breaking promises. Germany (no Pic/Bur/Bre entry, BUR out of MUN/RUH/KIE/HOL) and England (no Bel/Pic/Bre/Channel, LON/LVP out of Bre/SPA-POR) have kept word so far. Watch England for LVP/LON moves toward BRE. Consider SPA convoy to NAF via WES/MAO later.

Fall 1922: holding all, MOS supports SEV. Pacts: Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), Germany (no PRU/SIL/LVN, no Baltic fleets), Turkey (no RUM/BUL/CON/SER; Turkey still contests SEV). Turkey's A RUM and F ARM are the threat. Watch Germany's southern move against Austria. Consider expansion once pacts are clear.

Fall 1922: holding all four centres (NAP ROM TUN VEN). No unowned centres reachable; pacts with France, Turkey, Austria still in place. Turkey and France renewed pledges. Watch Turkish Ionian/Greece moves and French fleets near Tunis; consider NAP-TYS convoy setup for later.

Fall 1922: holding EDI, LON, LVP (3 centres). No unowned centres reachable in options. Germany and France kept promises so far. France's Belgium plan not executed. Keep fleets out of North Sea and Norway. Revisit Belgium only if A BEL leaves in writing.

Fall 1922: MUN to BOH as promised to Austria (step toward VIE). Pacts: Russia held (WAR/SWE hold, no Baltic entry). France, England: BEL holds, no German move west/north. Austria threatens hostility; watch VIE. Revisit if Austria attacks MUN.

Fall 1922: RUM moves to SEV supported by ARM to retest the Russian centre; others hold to keep pacts with Italy (AEG out of Ionian) and Austria (SER/CON/RUM off BUD/VIE/TRI). Russia pledges no entry to RUM/BUL/CON/SER but keeps SEV. Reassess Spring 1923; consider convoys from BLA if SEV stays blocked.

messages.body: Austria: A BOH is in my heartland and threatens Vienna, which breaks our terms. Withdraw A BOH to Munich or Silesia now and I will keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI at home. If you attack Vienna, I will defend it and seek allies against you.

Austria: Germany's A BOH threatens my Vienna. Will you keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV off Galicia and my cities, and will you press Germany if it strikes Vienna? I will hold, and I see Turkey as the common threat to our Black Sea and Balkan flanks.

England to Germany, Spring 1923: I hold EDI, LON, LVP and keep fleets out of the North Sea and Norway as agreed. Our position is weak, so I want a real plan. Tell me in writing what you intend for Belgium and Holland this year, and whether France is a target for you.

France to England, Spring 1923: My Spring orders are holds in Paris, Marseille, Burgundy and Spain-Portugal. I will move nothing toward Belgium, Picardy, Brest or the Channel. Please keep F LVP and A LON away from Brest and Spain-Portugal, and tell me your Spring orders so we can both keep our centres.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1923: My A BOH is a real threat to Vienna and I will use it. Before Fall, withdraw A VIE from the front or accept that Bohemia is closed. Propose instead: A BUD and F TRI hold, and we discuss a Russian split in Galicia later. Reply in writing this spring.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1923: I am pressing Austria with A BOH and A MUN, not Warsaw or Sweden. Confirm A WAR and A SWE hold this spring and no Russian unit enters Prussia, Silesia or Bohemia. Our Baltic pact stands. Tell me your southern plans against Austria.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1923: Your pledge to keep F AEG out of the Ionian and armies out of Apulia and Naples has held. I will keep my units off Greece and Albania. Turkey is at seven centres and I am at four, so once Russia falls I want Albania and Greece discussed honestly. Please confirm your Spring orders.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1923: A SEV holds this spring as always. Propose we both stop bleeding: keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY off SEV and UKR, and I stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Serbia. Then we can turn our armies west against Austria and Germany. Do you accept?

Russia to Germany, Spring 1923: Our pact stands. A WAR, A SWE, A STP and A MOS hold this spring. Please keep your units off Sweden, St Petersburg and Warsaw, and no Russian army enters Prussia or Silesia. Tell me if Bohemia or Galicia is your next target, so we avoid surprises.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1923: A SEV has been a standoff for three years. I am attacking it this spring with A RUM supported by F ARM. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS now and I will keep my armies off your centres. If you hold, expect the attack to succeed.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1923: My A SER, A CON and A SMY stay off BUD, VIE and TRI this spring, as pledged. I will not move into Bulgaria or Greece against you. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI at home, and tell me if you plan anything against Serbia.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1923: A BOH entering Bohemia breaks our terms and threatens Vienna. Withdraw A BOH to Munich or Silesia now and I will keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI at home. I will not withdraw A VIE from Vienna. If A BOH stays or moves on Vienna, I will defend and seek allies against you.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1923: Confirmed, I keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI at home and will not enter Bulgaria, Greece or Serbia this spring. Keep A SER, A CON and A SMY off BUD, VIE and TRI as pledged. I have no plan against Serbia now. Let us both keep our centres and focus on Russia.

England to France, Spring 1923: My Spring orders are holds for EDI, LON and LVP, so F LVP and A LON stay away from Brest and Spain-Portugal as you ask. I expect your A PAR, A BUR and A MAR to stay out of Belgium and Picardy in return. Let's both keep our centres and watch Germany.

Austria, A BOH stays where it is this spring. Vienna is not my target this turn, but I will not withdraw from Bohemia while your A VIE is threatening Munich's approaches. Keep A BUD and F TRI out of Munich and Bohemia, and I will hold A MUN and A BER. Let us talk about a Galicia split before Fall.

England, A BEL holds this spring and will not move into the North Sea or Channel. F BAL and F DEN stay out of the North Sea and Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark. I have no plan against France this year; my focus is Austria in the south.

Russia, I confirm my forces hold the Baltic and no German unit enters Sweden, St Petersburg or Warsaw. My A BOH is aimed at Austria, not at Prussia or Silesia. Keep your A WAR and A SWE holding, and no Russian army enters Prussia, Silesia or Bohemia. Our pact stands while we both face Austria.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1923: A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this spring. None enters Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri. If Germany's A BOH strikes Vienna, I will protest to Berlin and keep my pledges to you. Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding and our peace stands.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1923: Confirmed. A WAR and A SWE hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters Prussia, Silesia or Bohemia. Our Baltic pact stands. Keep your units off Sweden, St Petersburg and Warsaw. Our southern plans stay with Russia's own borders for now.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1923: A SEV holds and I will not withdraw from a Russian centre. Any attack on SEV will be fought. I again pledge no entry into Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY out of SEV and UKR and we can both look west.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1923: Confirmed. My F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. I am not moving toward Greece or Albania this spring. Keep F NAP, A ROM, A VEN and A TUN away from Greece and Albania, and we both hold our centres. Once Russia is dealt with, we can talk about the Balkans honestly.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1923: No pact on SEV while it stays occupied. A RUM attacks SEV supported by F ARM this spring. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS now and my units stay off your centres. If you hold, the attack will likely succeed, and I will keep my armies out of your core only if you vacate.

notes.note: Spring 1923: all holds to keep promises (England: no Bel/Pic/Bre/Channel; Germany: BUR out of MUN/RUH/KIE/HOL; Italy: no Tunis/Tyrrhenian). Watch England and Germany for broken word. Consider SPA convoy to NAF later; need unowned centers or growth to avoid losing.

Spring 1923: Germany's A BOH threatens Vienna and has ignored my demand to withdraw. Holding VIE with BUD supporting it, TRI holding. Turkey and Russia pledged to stay off my cities. Watch for a German attack on VIE and for Russian moves into Galicia. Keep the defense unless Germany retreats.

Spring 1923: F LVP to IRI (unowned centre) for growth. A EDI and A LON hold. Keep fleets out of North Sea and Norway. Germany and France have kept word so far. Belgium stays German unless A BEL leaves in writing. Watch France: keep F LVP away from Brest and Spain.

Spring 1923: all 34 centres owned, no unowned targets. Holding all four to keep pacts with France, Turkey, Austria. Watch French fleets near Tunis and Turkish Ionian/Greece moves. Revisit Balkans with Turkey after Russia falls.

Spring 1923: all hold, MOS supports SEV holding against Turkey's RUM+ARM attack. Pacts: Germany (no entry to SWE/STP/WAR/Prussia/Silesia/Bohemia), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), Turkey (no RUM/BUL/CON/SER, SEV contested). Watch Germany's BOH vs Austria. Consider expansion into UKR/GAL if pacts hold.

Spring 1923: all hold to keep 6 SCs (BEL BER DEN HOL KIE MUN). Austria says BOH breaches terms and threatens VIE; I refused to withdraw. Russia pact holding (WAR/SWE hold, no Russian entry to PRU/SIL/BOH). England and France told BEL holds, no North Sea/Channel moves. Revisit: Austria may attack BOH/MUN; consider a Galicia split. Growth limited while pacts hold.

Spring 1923: RUM attacks SEV supported by ARM (Russia refused to withdraw). Others hold to keep pacts: Austria (no SER/CON/RUM into BUD/VIE/TRI, Bulgaria/Greece), Italy (AEG out of Ionian, armies out of Apulia/Naples). Russia pledges no entry to RUM/BUL/CON/SER. Reassess Fall 1923.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1923: Your A BOH is still in Bohemia and threatens Vienna. Withdraw it to Silesia or Munich now. If you do, I keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI at home and we can discuss Galicia later. If it attacks Vienna, I will defend it and seek allies against you.

Austria to Russia: Germany's A BOH is aimed at Vienna. Please keep your pledge of no Russian move into Galicia or my cities, and consider pressuring Berlin from the east. Tell me your Fall orders for A WAR, A MOS and A SEV so we avoid surprises.

England to France, Fall 1923: I hold EDI, LON and move F IRI toward the Atlantic for growth, away from Brest and Spain. Please keep A PAR and A BUR out of Belgium and Picardy as agreed. What are your Fall 1923 orders?

England to Germany, Fall 1923: Confirm A BEL holds this fall and no German fleet enters the North Sea or Norway. Are you moving against Austria in the south as you said? Tell me your Fall orders for Belgium and Holland.

France to Italy, Fall 1923: I have held my word all along. I am considering a fleet and army move toward North Africa, which could eventually touch Tunis. Would you accept a written pledge that Italy keeps its units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and that we both keep our centres? Tell me your Fall 1923 orders.

France to Germany, Fall 1923: Our non-aggression stands, and I have kept A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Ruhr, Munich, Kiel and Holland. Are you still moving east against Russia this Fall? Please confirm no German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy or Belgium this year, and tell me your Fall orders.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1923: My A BOH stays in Bohemia this fall and will not enter Vienna. Your A VIE, A BUD and F TRI should not move into Bohemia or Munich. Propose we both hold our cities this fall and split Galicia with Russia later. Please confirm in writing your intentions.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1923: Russia is your main target. Once Russia falls I want Greece and Albania discussed concretely. Confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay out of Apulia and Naples this autumn. I will keep my units off Greece and Albania.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1923: I hold A VEN, A ROM, F NAP and A TUN this autumn. Please confirm F TRI and A VIE stay put and stay out of Venice and Tyrolia. Tell me your fall orders so neither of us is surprised.

Italy to France, Fall 1923: I hold my four centres and have no move against Marseille, Spain or Piedmont. Please confirm no French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this fall, as pledged.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1923: A SEV will hold again. Your A RUM and F ARM attacks will be fought. I offer a lasting peace: you keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY off SEV and UKR, and I stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Serbia. Accept and we can both turn west.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1923: Our pact stands. A WAR, A SWE, A STP and A MOS hold this fall. Please keep your units off Sweden, St Petersburg and Warsaw, and no Russian army enters Prussia, Silesia or Bohemia. Tell me your fall orders against Austria so we avoid surprises.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1923: My A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this fall and none enters Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri. I will protest to Berlin if Germany's A BOH strikes Vienna. Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding and our peace stands. Turkey remains the threat to us both.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1923: A SEV still blocks my attack, and A RUM is attacking it supported by F ARM. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS now and I keep my armies off your centres, including WAR and MOS. If you hold, the fight continues. Tell me your orders this fall.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1923: Your A BOH is still in Bohemia and threatens Vienna. I will not accept it. Withdraw A BOH to Silesia or Munich this fall, and I will keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI at home and talk Galicia later. If it moves on Vienna, I will defend and act against you.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1923: A VIE and F TRI hold this fall, and neither moves toward Venice or Tyrolia. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, F NAP and A TUN off Trieste and Albania. Your Tunisian and Italian holdings are yours as long as our border stays quiet.

Austria to Russia: Germany's A BOH is still in Bohemia aimed at Vienna. Keep your pledge against Galicia and my cities, and press Berlin from the east if it attacks. My A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this fall. Tell me plainly if A WAR, A MOS or A SEV moves.

France to England, Fall 1923: My fall orders are holds: A PAR, A BUR, A MAR, A POR and A SPA stay put, so nothing moves toward Belgium or Picardy. Keep F IRI and A LON away from Brest and Spain-Portugal, and we both keep our centres. Your Atlantic move is fine by me as long as it stays on the sea.

France to Italy, Fall 1923: I have held my word all along and my fall orders keep all French units out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian. I am considering a move toward North Africa later. Let us sign a written pledge: Italy keeps its units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and France stays out of your home centres. Confirm and we both keep our centres.

Germany to Austria: A BOH stays in Bohemia this fall and will not enter Vienna while your units stay home. I will not withdraw from Bohemia while Vienna threatens Munich's approaches. Keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI out of Bohemia and Munich, and I will not attack Vienna. A Galicia split with Russia can be discussed in Spring 1924.

Germany to England, Fall 1923: A BEL holds this fall. F BAL and F DEN stay out of the North Sea and Norway. I confirm no German fleet enters the North Sea or Norway. Keep A LON, A EDI and F LVP out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark. My focus is Austria in the south, not the west.

Germany to France, Fall 1923: Confirmed. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest or Belgium this fall. A BEL holds. My forces are pressing Austria in the south and watching Russia. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and we stay friends.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1923: Our pact stands. My forces hold the Baltic, and no German unit enters Sweden, St Petersburg or Warsaw. A BOH is aimed at Austria, not Prussia or Silesia. Keep A WAR and A SWE holding and no Russian army enters Prussia, Silesia or Bohemia. We will discuss Galicia in Spring 1924.

Italy to France, Fall 1923: I accept a written pledge. Italy keeps units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and we both keep our centres. In return, you keep all French units out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian, and F WES stays away from Tunis. Your North African move must not touch Tunis or Sardinia. Confirm and we both hold.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1923: A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this fall. None enters Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri. Germany's A BOH is your real danger; I will press Berlin on it. Keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI holding and our peace stands.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1923: A SEV holds and I will not withdraw from a Russian centre. Your A RUM and F ARM attacks will be fought. I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY off SEV and UKR and we can both look west.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1923: Confirmed again. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. I am not moving toward Greece or Albania this autumn. Keep F NAP, A ROM, A VEN and A TUN away from Greece and Albania, and we both hold our centres. We can talk Balkans once Russia is settled.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1923: I will not accept a pact while A SEV sits on my former centre. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS and I keep A RUM, F ARM and A SMY off your centres. If you hold, my attack goes ahead and your armies will be fought in the Black Sea.

notes.note: Fall 1923: holding EDI and LON; F IRI to ENG to set up a convoy for A LON to the continent later. LVP is empty but unthreatened. Germany and France have kept word; Belgium stays German unless A BEL leaves. Watch for French moves toward Brest/Spain and keep fleets out of the North Sea and Norway.

Fall 1923: holding NAP ROM TUN VEN. No unowned centres. Pacts: France (no Tunis/Naples/Rome/Venice entry, written pledge offered), Turkey (no Ionian/Apulia/Naples, confirmed again), Austria (no Trieste move). Watch French fleets near Tunis and Turkish Ionian moves. Revisit Balkans after Russia falls.

Fall 1923: all holds to keep pledges (Germany: no BUR into MUN/RUH/KIE/HOL, no Bel/Pic/Bre; Italy: no units in Tunis/Naples/Rome/Venice/Tyrrhenian, no Marseille/Spain/Portugal entry; England: no Bel/Pic/Bre/Channel). No unowned centers reachable. All parties claim to keep word so far. Consider North Africa move via SPA/POR convoy to NAF (avoid TUN) later; watch Germany on BUR and England on Belgiu

Fall 1923: all hold, MOS supports SEV vs Turkey RUM+ARM. Pledges kept: Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), Germany (no SWE/STP/WAR/PRU/SIL/BOH), Turkey (no RUM/BUL/CON/SER). Turkey rejects pact. Watch Germany's BAL/BOH moves and Turkey's SEV attack; revisit Galicia/Ukraine if pacts hold.

Fall 1923: Germany's A BOH still threatens VIE and has ignored my withdrawal demand. Holding VIE with BUD support and TRI holding. Galicia move would open VIE to BOH. Germany, Russia and Italy have kept word so far; Turkey has kept word too. Revisit GAL or SER if Germany withdraws from BOH or Russia moves.

Fall 1923: all hold to keep 6 SCs, honoring pacts with Russia (no entry to SWE/STP/WAR/PRU/SIL), France (no BUR/PIC/BEL/RUH moves), England (no North Sea/Norway), Austria (BOH stays, not entering VIE). Growth blocked while pacts hold. Next: consider Galicia split with Russia in Spring 1924 and watch Austria's VIE. Reassess if any pact breaks.

Fall 1923: RUM attacks SEV supported by ARM, as before. Others hold to keep pacts with Italy (AEG out of Ionian, armies off Apulia/Naples) and Austria (no entry to BUD/VIE/TRI). Russia keeps refusing to leave SEV. Reassess Spring 1924; consider convoys from BLA or a move against Austria if Russia stays blocked.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1924: Your A BOH still sits next to Vienna. I need written confirmation it stays out of Vienna and Tyrolia this spring. Galicia is Russian, so a split talk only works if you honor that first. I am holding A VIE, A BUD and F TRI.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1924: Are A WAR, A MOS and A SEV still holding, with none entering Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri? Germany's A BOH remains my concern. If you move on Galicia or Rumania, tell me first so we avoid a clash.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1924: Confirming my A BUD, A VIE and F TRI stay out of Bulgaria, Greece and Serbia this spring. Please keep A SER, A CON and A RUM away from my cities. Tell me your Spring plan against Russia or Rumania.

England to France, Spring 1927: Your five armies are still on my border. I propose we both hold this spring. My A EDI, A LON and F NWG will not enter Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain-Portugal, and I ask that A PAR, A BUR and A MAR stay out of Picardy, Belgium and Brest. Confirm in writing.

England to Germany, Spring 1927: Please confirm in writing that A BEL and your northern fleets stay out of the North Sea, Norway and Channel this spring. In return my A EDI, A LON and F NWG stay out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark. Tell me your Austrian target so I can judge France's threat.

France to England, Spring 1927: My armies held all last year and stayed out of Belgium, Picardy and Brest, as agreed. I want the same from your F NTH and A LON toward Brest and Spain-Portugal. Confirm in writing, and tell me before any change to our Channel border.

France to Germany, Spring 1927: The pact has held. My A PAR, A BUR and A MAR will stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel, Holland and Belgium this spring. Please confirm no German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest or Marseille, and tell me if your plans against Austria change.

France to Italy, Spring 1927: My pledge holds. No French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this spring. Please confirm your units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. I will raise any western Mediterranean move with you first.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1927: My armies in Silesia and Berlin are not moving toward Warsaw or Sweden. I want a clear answer: will A WAR or A SWE move against Prussia or Silesia this spring? If you hold, I will hold too and we can discuss Galicia only once Austria's position is settled.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1927: Greece and Albania are open to a concrete split. Proposal: you take Greece and Bulgaria-side Balkans, I keep my units off Greece and Albania. In return F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Will you confirm this in writing before autumn?

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1927: SEV stays and I will hold it. Your A RUM, A SMY and F BLA are wasting units. Turn your armies west toward Greece-Serbia front against Austria, or take Italy's Balkan targets. I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia this year. Will you accept a standing non-aggression pact?

Russia to Germany, Spring 1927: Your A SIL and A BOH are the threat to Austria, and Austria is our shared target. I want Galicia talk now. If you take Vienna or Bohemia, I will move A WAR toward Galicia in Fall 1927. Confirm BAL and SIL stay out of Sweden, St Petersburg and Warsaw this spring.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1927: A SEV is still blocking my Black Sea centre and both of us are bleeding. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS this spring and I keep A RUM, F BLA and A SMY out of SEV, WAR and MOS. Otherwise A RUM and F BLA attack SEV again. Your answer?

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1927: F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples, as pledged. Nothing moves on Greece or Albania this spring. Keep F NAP, A ROM, A VEN and A TUN in place. Let us discuss a concrete Balkan split in Fall 1927.

England to France, Spring 1927: Confirmed in writing. My A EDI, A LON and F NWG will not enter Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain-Portugal this spring. I expect A PAR, A BUR and A MAR to hold and stay out of Picardy, Belgium and Brest. Any change must be proposed in writing before orders are executed.

France to England, Spring 1927: Confirmed in writing. A PAR, A BUR and A MAR hold this spring and will not enter Belgium, Picardy or Brest. Your A EDI, A LON and F NWG must stay out of Brest and Spain-Portugal. Any change must be proposed in writing before orders are executed.

Germany to England, Spring 1927: Confirmed in writing. A BEL holds, F BAL stays out of the North Sea and Norway, and no German unit enters the Channel. Please keep A EDI, A LON and F NWG out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark. My focus is Austria in the south, not your western centres.

Germany to France, Spring 1927: Our pact stands. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest or Marseille this spring, and A BEL holds. Please keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel, Holland and Belgium. My Bohemian pressure is aimed at Austria, not at Spain or Marseille.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1927: My A SIL holds this spring and stays out of Galicia, Warsaw and Bohemia. F BAL stays out of Sweden and St Petersburg. Galicia talk can wait until Austria's position is settled. Keep A WAR and A SWE off Prussia and Silesia, and we both avoid any bounce.

Italy to France, Spring 1927: Confirmed. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and I expect no French unit in Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this spring. Any western Mediterranean move, we discuss first as agreed.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1927: Agreed in principle. F AEG out of the Ionian, your armies out of Apulia and Naples, and I keep my units off Greece and Albania. Let us fix the concrete Balkan split in writing in Fall 1927, as proposed.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1927: A SIL and A BOH are sitting on Austria's border, and I will not let Vienna fall to you alone. Turkey to Austria, Spring 1927: A SER stays in Serbia this spring and will not move on BUD, VIE or TRI. I will not send any unit into your cities. Turkey to Italy, Spring 1927: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Nothing moves on Greece or Albania this spring. Keep F NAP, A ROM, A VEN and A TUN in place. I will discuss a concrete Balkan split in Fall 1927 as proposed.
