messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Fall 1927: Your A SER and Russia's Rumania position matter now. Are you moving A RUM-area or BUL units against Russia this fall? If you attack SEV or RUM, I'd like to coordinate, but I need written confirmation that no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI this fall.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1927: Confirm A WAR, A MOS, A SEV, A STP stay out of Galicia and Rumania, and that A SEV does not move. I hold BUD, VIE, TRI and will not enter Galicia or Rumania. Tell me your plan against Turkey in Rumania.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1927: Confirm A SIL, A BOH and A MUN stay out of Bohemia, Tyrolia and Vienna this fall. I keep A VIE, A BUD, F TRI at home. Tell me whether A SIL moves toward Warsaw against Russia, so we coordinate.

England to Germany, Fall 1927: I hold EDI, LON and F NTH and will keep my promises: no entry into Belgium, Holland or Denmark. Russia holds Norway and Sweden next to us. Would you support a joint plan to take Norway from Russia in 1928? Tell me your Spring 1928 orders in writing first.

France to England, Fall 1927: My armies hold this fall and stay out of Belgium, Picardy and Brest, as agreed. Please keep F NTH and A LON out of Brest and Spain-Portugal. Germany has six centres and is the main threat to us both. I propose we discuss a coordinated move against German Belgium and Holland in 1928. Please reply in writing.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1927: Austria is now the target. My A BOH and A SIL are moving on Vienna this fall. Proposal: you take Galicia and Budapest's eastern side, I take Vienna and Trieste. Keep A WAR out of Prussia and Silesia, and I will keep BAL out of Sweden and St Petersburg. Confirm in writing.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1927: I have broken our pact and my A BOH is pressing Vienna. Your best chance is to pull A VIE and A BUD back toward Galicia and Trieste, and to offer Russia a deal against me. A stand in Vienna will cost you both centres. Reply in writing before Fall orders lock.

Germany to France, Fall 1927: My pressure is aimed at Austria's Vienna and Bohemia, not at your Burgundy or Marseille. A BEL holds this fall. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and we both keep our centres.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1927: Let us fix the Balkan split now. I propose you take Greece and Bulgaria-side Balkans, with Greece and Albania closed to my units. Confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Reply in writing before we move.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1927: My units keep to the pact: A VEN, A ROM and A TUN stay off Trieste and Albania. Germany's pressure on Vienna is the bigger danger. If you need help against Germany, tell me what you want from me and what you will give on the Adriatic.

Italy to France, Fall 1927: Pledge still stands. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and no Italian unit enters the western Mediterranean against you. Please confirm no French fleet moves into Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1927: SEV stays and will be defended. Your A RUM, A SMY and F BLA attacks are wasting units. Turn them west against Austria or Italy's Balkan targets. I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Accept a non-aggression pact on those terms, and no Russian unit moves against you.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1927: Confirm A BAL and A SIL stay out of Sweden, St Petersburg and Warsaw this fall. In return A WAR and A SWE stay off Prussia and Silesia. Austria is our shared problem. If you take Vienna or Bohemia, I will move A WAR toward Galicia. Tell me your Fall moves now.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1927: Your A BUD, A VIE and F TRI should stay home, and no Russian unit enters Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri. Germany's A SIL and A BOH are the real threat. If you hold firm and they strike, I am willing to discuss coordinated moves against Berlin's forces.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1927: A SEV has been besieged for years and neither of us gains from it. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS this fall and I will keep A RUM, F BLA and A SMY out of SEV, WAR and MOS. Refuse and A RUM and F BLA attack SEV again.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1927: As agreed, F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Proposed split: Greece and Bulgaria-side Balkans are mine, Albania is yours. Confirm and we both keep our units to those lines.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1927: Our pact holds; A SER stays in Serbia and no unit of mine enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Are you moving against Russia in Galicia or Rumania this fall? Tell me your plans so we can coordinate.

Austria to Germany: Your A BOH is in Bohemia and your message admits you broke the pact. A BOH must withdraw from Bohemia now, and A SIL and A MUN must stay out of Vienna, Tyrolia and Bohemia. Confirm in writing, or I will defend VIE, BUD and TRI with everything I have.

Austria to Russia: Germany is pressing Vienna. Stay out of Galicia, Budapest and Trieste as agreed, and if you want a coordinated move, have A WAR and A MOS press Berlin's eastern front. Confirm in writing that no Russian unit enters Galicia or Rumania against me this fall.

Austria to Turkey: No Turkish unit has entered BUD, VIE or TRI and I expect none to. A SER must stay out of Budapest. I am being attacked by Germany and need your word that A SER and A BUL hold this fall. Joint action against Russia in Rumania is possible once Germany is contained.

Austria to Italy: Thank you for keeping A VEN, A ROM and A TUN off Trieste and Albania. Germany is attacking Vienna. Keep F TYS out of the Adriatic and hold your position. If Germany is pushed back, we can talk about a Balkan understanding with Turkey.

England to France, Fall 1927: I am holding my positions and will keep F NTH and A LON out of Brest and Spain-Portugal as agreed. I have no written plan against German Belgium or Holland at present. Any proposal for 1928 must be put in writing first, and I want your armies to remain out of Picardy, Belgium and Brest in the meantime.

France to Germany, Fall 1927: Our non-aggression holds on my side. A PAR, A BUR and A MAR stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland. I expect the same: no German unit in Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Belgium or Marseille. Austria is your target; I wish you success there while we both keep our centres.

France to Italy, Fall 1927: Confirmed. No French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn. Please keep your units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal as pledged. Any western Mediterranean move I will raise with you first, as agreed.

Germany to Austria: You are right that I broke our pact. My A BOH and A SIL are moving on Vienna this fall. Pull A VIE and A BUD back toward Galicia and Trieste now. Holding Vienna only costs you centres. I have no further word for you.

Germany to Russia: Agreed on the split. You take Galicia and Budapest's eastern side; I take Vienna and Trieste. My BAL stays out of Sweden and St Petersburg, and A SIL stays out of Warsaw. Please keep A WAR out of Prussia and Silesia. Confirmed in writing.

Germany to England: My A BEL holds this fall and no German fleet enters the North Sea, Norway or the Channel. Your EDI, LON and NTH should keep out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark. I have not decided Spring 1928 orders, so I cannot commit to a Norway plan yet. Let us talk again in Spring.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1927: Agreed on the split in writing. Greece and Albania are closed to my units, and I will keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F NAP off both. Please confirm your F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Turkey takes Greece and Bulgaria-side Balkans; Albania stays Italian-protected. We both hold our centres this autumn.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1927: My A WAR, A MOS, A SEV and A STP will not enter Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri this fall. Your BUD, VIE and TRI should hold. Germany's A BOH and A SIL are the real danger to you; I am watching them closely and may act against Berlin if they strike Vienna.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1927: Your Vienna proposal is noted but I will not sign it as written. If A BOH or A SIL moves into Vienna this fall, I will move A WAR toward Galicia, as stated. Keep BAL out of Sweden and St Petersburg, and A SIL out of Warsaw. I will keep A WAR out of Prussia and Silesia while you keep your word.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1927: SEV stays and will be defended. Withdrawal is not on offer. I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Turn your armies west against Austria or Italy's Balkan targets and accept a non-aggression pact on those terms. Attacks on SEV will be fought.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1927: Our pact holds. A SER stays in Serbia and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. I have no plan against Galicia or Rumania this fall yet. Keep your BUD, VIE and TRI units off Serbia, Bulgaria and Greece, and tell me if Germany moves on you so we can coordinate.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1927: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Proposed split accepted in principle: Greece and Bulgaria-side Balkans are mine, Albania is yours. Keep F NAP, A ROM, A VEN and A TUN off Greece and Albania. We both hold to those lines.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1927: No pact while A SEV sits on my former centre. Withdraw it to UKR or MOS this fall and I keep A RUM, F BLA and A SMY out of SEV, WAR and MOS. Refuse and I will attack SEV again with A RUM and F BLA. Your move.

notes.note: Fall 1927: Germany broke pact, A BOH/SIL threaten VIE. Holding BUD, TRI, VIE with support for defense. Russia and Turkey pledged no entry to my cities. Italy kept word. Watch for German attack on VIE; consider GAL/RUM moves if Turkey or Russia break.

Fall 1927: hold all; MOS supports SEV holding vs Turkey RUM/BLA. Pacts: Germany (no SWE/STP/WAR/PRU/SIL/BOH; Germany's Vienna split offered, not signed), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI). Fall 1927: EDI and LON hold, F NTH to NWG to set up convoy of A EDI to NOR (Russian) next turn. Promises kept with France and Germany (no Belgium, Holland, Denmark, Brest, Picardy, Spain-Portugal). Germany declined Norway plan for now; France proposes 1928 action vs German Belgium/Holland, undecided. Watch Russia and Germany for North Sea moves.

Fall 1927: all holds. Pacts: Turkey (split: Turkey takes Greece/Bulgaria side, Albania Italian; F AEG out of Ionian, no armies in Apulia/Naples) agreed in principle but not yet confirmed in writing. Fall 1927: BOH attacks VIE, likely bounce, no unit leaves an SC. Split promised to Russia: I take VIE/TRI, they take GAL/BUD east. Fall 1927: Holding all centres. Russia refuses to leave SEV; attacks on SEV bounce (MOS supports). Pacts: Austria (no units into BUD/VIE/TRI, SER stays), Italy (AEG out of Ionian, no armies in Apulia/Naples; Balkan split Greece/Bulgaria-side mine, Albania Italian). Russia: no pact while SEV held. Austria to Russia: Germany is pressing Vienna. Please confirm in writing that no Russian unit enters Galicia, Budapest or Trieste this spring. If you want to strike Berlin's eastern front with A WAR and A MOS, tell me, and I will coordinate.

Austria to Turkey: Germany has broken faith and is attacking Vienna. Confirm A SER and A BUL hold this spring. If Russia moves on Rumania, I am open to joint action. Tell me now whether you will support Budapest's defense against any German push.

England to Germany, Spring 1928: Russia is the target for both of us. I propose F NWG moves to Norway this spring, and your F BAL moves to Sweden to pressure Russia's northern centres. A EDI and A LON stay out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark. Please confirm your Spring 1928 orders in writing before we execute.

Until then, keep F NTH and A LON out of Brest and Spain-Portugal, and I keep my armies out of Picardy, Belgium and Brest. Please reply in writing.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1928: A VEN, ROM and TUN stay off Trieste and Albania this spring. F TYS stays out of the Adriatic. Tell me now if Germany moves toward Tyrolia or Venice, and whether F TRI or A VIE plan any move toward Albania.

Italy to France, Spring 1928: Pledge holds. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and I expect no French unit in Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian. Confirm your spring intentions in the western Mediterranean before any move.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1928: Our pact holds. A SER stays in Serbia and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Tell me if Germany or Russia moves on you; I am ready to coordinate against Russia in Rumania once you confirm your Galicia plans.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1928: Balkan split stands: Greece and Bulgaria-side Balkans mine, Albania yours. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples. Please confirm F NAP, A ROM, A VEN and A TUN stay off Greece and Albania this spring.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1928: Your A BOH and A SIL are the armies threatening Vienna, and your pact is broken. I will not withdraw my defense. Pull A BOH out of Bohemia now and keep A SIL and A MUN out of Tyrolia and Bohemia, or I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI against you.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1928: Germany is attacking Vienna and Bohemia, so I am defending. Confirm in writing that A SER and A BUL hold this spring. If Russia moves on Rumania or Galicia, I will coordinate with you; I will not move into Serbia or Bulgaria.

Which Russian centre falls first this year?

Russia to Austria, Spring 1928: A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this spring. No Russian unit enters Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri. Your BUD, VIE and TRI should hold, and Germany's A SIL and A BOH are the threat. Coordinate with me against Berlin if they strike Vienna.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1928: Your A BOH and A SIL are still aimed at Vienna. Withdraw A BOH from Bohemia and keep A SIL and A MUN out of Tyrolia and Bohemia this fall, and I will keep A VIE and A BUD at home. Refuse, and I will hold Vienna and Budapest, and seek help against you.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1928: Germany's A BOH and A SIL threaten Vienna, and Berlin is the common enemy in the north. Confirm in writing that no Russian unit enters Galicia, Budapest or Trieste. If you attack Berlin's eastern front with A WAR and A MOS, I will tell you when Germany moves on Vienna.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1928: Confirm A SER and A BUL hold this fall and that no Turkish unit enters Budapest, Vienna or Trieste. If Russia moves on Rumania or Galicia, I will coordinate with you. Germany is the immediate threat to me, so tell me if you will back Budapest's defense.

England to Russia, Fall 1928: Norway and Sweden are your home centres and I have kept my word. Are you moving any fleet or army toward the North Sea or Norway this fall? Please confirm in writing that A NOR and A SWE hold and no Russian unit enters Edinburgh or the North Sea.

England to France, Fall 1928: My A EDI, A LON and F NWG remain out of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal. I am still open to a joint move against German Belgium or Holland. Put any concrete plan in writing with unit orders first, and tell me what you intend for A PAR and A BUR this fall.

England to Germany, Fall 1928: Your A BEL and F BAL have held, and I keep EDI, LON and NWG out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark. Are you still undecided on Norway? If you commit F BAL and your armies to Russia, tell me in writing so we can coordinate.

France to England, Fall 1928: Still open to the joint move vs German Belgium and Holland. Proposal in writing: A PAR and A BUR attack Belgium (BEL) this autumn while F NTH and A LON stay out of Brest and Spain-Portugal. Your F NTH supports into Holland (HOL) if you agree. Reply in writing before any order is executed.

France to Germany, Fall 1928: Our pact has held. Please confirm in writing that no German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal this autumn, and that A BEL and A KIE stay out of Picardy. My armies stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland as before.

France to Italy, Fall 1928: My pledge holds. No French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn. Please confirm your units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and tell me before any western Mediterranean move.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1928: My A BOH and A SIL are poised on Vienna. Holding VIE and BUD only invites being overrun. Pull back toward Galicia or Trieste and I will consider a settlement that spares your remaining centres. Tell me your Fall 1928 orders now.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1928: Our split stands: you keep Galicia and Budapest-east, I take Vienna and Trieste. My BAL stays out of Sweden and St Petersburg, and A SIL stays out of Warsaw. Please confirm your Fall 1928 orders, especially A WAR staying out of Silesia and Prussia.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1928: Our Balkan split holds. Your fleets stay out of the Ionian and your armies out of Apulia and Naples, and I keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania. Confirm your Fall moves respect this. If you want Albania or Trieste later, tell me first.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1928: Still holding our pact. A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS stay off Trieste and Albania. Germany's pressure on Vienna is growing. Tell me if you need anything from me, and whether F TRI or A VIE plan any move toward Venice or Albania this autumn.

Italy to France, Fall 1928: Pledge holds. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and I expect no French unit in Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn. Please confirm your western Mediterranean intentions before any move.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1928: SEV stays and will be defended. My A RUM-facing units will hold. Pull A RUM and F BLA west against Austria or Italy and I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Keep attacking SEV and we both lose units for nothing. Answer now.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1928: Our split on Galicia stands only if your A SIL stays out of Warsaw and F BAL stays out of Sweden and St Petersburg. Confirm A WAR's Warsaw position is safe, and tell me whether A BOH and A SIL are committed to Vienna this fall.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1928: No Russian unit enters Galicia, Bud, Vie or Tri this fall. Hold your line against Germany's A SIL and A BOH. If you need support against Berlin's forces, tell me the exact territory and I will consider it.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1928: Your A SEV still sits on my former centre while my A RUM and F BLA press it. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS this fall and I keep A RUM, F BLA and A SMY out of SEV, WAR and MOS. Refuse and I take SEV. Give me your answer now.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1928: Our pact holds. A SER stays in Serbia and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Tell me your Fall 1928 orders against Germany and whether A VIE and F TRI can hold. If Russia moves on Rumania, I will coordinate with you.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1928: Refusal noted. A BOH must leave Bohemia and A SIL and A MUN must stay out of Tyrolia, Bohemia and Vienna. Without written confirmation I will hold VIE and BUD and seek help against Berlin. Your choice now decides whether we fight on.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1928: Thank you for the pledge. I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI. Germany's A BOH and A SIL threaten Vienna. If your A WAR and A MOS press Berlin's eastern front, I will coordinate. Please confirm in writing that no Russian unit enters Galicia or Rumania against me.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1928: Thank you. A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS stay off Trieste and Albania as agreed. F TRI and A VIE will hold this autumn and will not move toward Venice or Albania. If Germany pushes on Tyrolia, I will tell you, and we can talk Balkans later.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1928: Good. Keep A SER in Serbia and A BUL in Bulgaria, with no Turkish unit entering Budapest, Vienna or Trieste. I am holding VIE, BUD and TRI against Germany. If Russia moves on Rumania or Galicia, I will coordinate with you against them.

England to France, Fall 1928: No written plan yet. I will not commit to an attack on Belgium or Holland while you hold A PAR and A BUR. Send concrete unit orders in writing first. France to England, Fall 1928: No joint move this autumn. A PAR and A BUR hold and stay out of Belgium, Picardy and Brest. If you want a 1929 plan against German Belgium or Holland, send me written unit orders for your fleets and armies first, and I will answer in writing before anyone moves.

France to Italy, Fall 1928: Confirmed in writing. No French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn. Please keep your units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. Any western Mediterranean move I will raise with you first, in writing, before any order is executed.

Germany to Austria: I will not withdraw my Bohemia pressure in writing this fall. A BOH and A SIL remain under my control. Hold VIE and BUD if you judge it best; I make no promise to spare Vienna. Any settlement must be shown in concrete moves, not words.

Germany to England: My A BEL holds this fall and no German fleet enters the North Sea, Norway or Channel. I cannot commit F BAL to Russia or Norway yet. Keep EDI, LON and NWG out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark, and we both benefit.

Germany to France, Fall 1928: A BEL holds this fall. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal from my side. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and our pact stands.

Germany to Russia: Our split stands. A SIL stays out of Warsaw this fall and F BAL stays out of Sweden and St Petersburg. A WAR stays clear of Silesia and Prussia from my side. I will not promise every other move of mine, but I keep these terms.

Italy to France, Fall 1928: Confirmed. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and no Italian unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian against you this autumn. Russia to England, Fall 1928: Confirmed. No Russian unit enters the North Sea, Edinburgh or Norway this fall. A NOR and A SWE are holding. Keep your fleets out of Norway and Sweden and the north stays quiet. Your NTH and EDI are safe from me.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1928: Confirmed. No Russian unit enters Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Trieste this fall. A WAR, A MOS, A SEV and A STP hold. Germany's A BOH and A SIL are your danger. If Berlin strikes Vienna, I will consider pressure on Berlin's eastern front.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1928: No. SEV stays and will be defended. No withdrawal, and no pact while your RUM and BLA units attack it. Turn A RUM and F BLA west against Austria or Italy. I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople or Serbia. Attacks on SEV will be fought.

Turkey to Austria: Our pact holds. A SER stays in Serbia and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI this fall. I have no orders against you. Germany is your real threat, so keep A VIE and F TRI defensive, and I will watch Russia's Rumania and Galicia moves with you.

Turkey to Italy: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, my armies stay out of Apulia and Naples, and nothing moves on Greece or Albania this fall. Keep F TYS, A ROM, A VEN and A TUN off the Balkans as agreed, and we both keep our centres.

Turkey to Russia: No pact while A SEV sits on my former centre. Your answer is refused, so A RUM and F BLA will press SEV this fall. Withdraw A SEV to UKR or MOS and I keep my units out of SEV, WAR and MOS. Otherwise expect the attack.

France to Germany, Spring 1929: Our pact stands. Please confirm in writing that no German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal this spring, and that A BEL and A KIE stay out of Picardy. My armies stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland.

France to Italy, Spring 1929: My pledge holds. No French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this spring. Please confirm your units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and tell me before any western Mediterranean move.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1929: Vienna is my target and my A BOH and A SIL remain in place. Offer: withdraw A VIE to Galicia or Trieste and I will not enter Vienna this spring. Hold it and it falls. Reply with concrete moves.

Italy to France, Spring 1929: Pledge holds. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and I expect no French unit in Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian. Please confirm your spring intentions in the western Mediterranean before any move.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1929: I keep my fleets out of the Baltic and North Sea and my armies out of Bohemia and Silesia. Russia is my target this year, not you. If you attack Russia in the north, I will not interfere, and I ask you to keep A BOH and A SIL away from my Balkan centres.

I will not withdraw A VIE to Galicia or Trieste on your word alone. Concrete moves this spring decide whether I defend Vienna with everything I have.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1929: A VIE and F TRI are holding, and neither will move toward Venice or Albania. Germany is pushing on Tyrolia and Vienna with A BOH and A SIL. Keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. If Germany is pushed back, I will consider Adriatic help in a later Balkan understanding.

Your A PAR, A BUR and A MAR must hold and stay out of Picardy, Belgium and Brest. Any change must be proposed in writing first.

France to Germany, Spring 1929: Our pact stands. My A PAR, A BUR and A MAR hold this spring and stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland. Keep Austria as your target.

Your units must stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, as you have pledged. I will raise any western Mediterranean move with you in writing before any order is executed.

Germany to Austria: I will not withdraw A BOH or A SIL in writing. Concrete offer: move A VIE to Galicia or Trieste this spring and I will not enter Vienna this spring. Hold VIE and it falls to A BOH with A SIL support. Your choice.

Germany to Russia: Our split stands. A SIL will not enter Warsaw and F BAL stays out of Sweden and St Petersburg this spring. Galicia and Budapest-east are yours. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia and Silesia, and we both gain.

Germany to France: A BEL holds this spring. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal from my side. Our pact stands. Please keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland.

Germany to Turkey: Thank you. I keep my armies out of the Balkans and my fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean. If you move against Russia, I wish you success. Please keep F BLA and F AEG away from Germany's coasts and out of the Baltic.

Italy to France, Spring 1929: Pledge holds on my side. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and I have no move against Piedmont or your zone this spring. I expect F WES and all French units to stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian. If you ever plan a western Mediterranean move, tell me first so we can talk before any order is executed.

Russia to England, Spring 1929: Confirmed. A NOR and A SWE hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea, Edinburgh or Norway. Keep your fleets out of Norway and Sweden and the north stays quiet. A WAR and A MOS are defending my southern and central borders, not moving toward Germany or Sweden this spring.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1929: I will hold A WAR in Warsaw and keep it out of Prussia and Silesia this spring. Your A SIL must stay out of Warsaw and F BAL out of Sweden and St Petersburg, as you confirmed. If either enters, the split is void. Keep your word and we can both work on Austria.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1929: No withdrawal from SEV. Your attacks will be fought with MOS support. Pull A RUM and F BLA west against Austria or Italy and I will stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Constantinople and Serbia. Your choice, but continued attacks cost you units for nothing.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1929: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and my armies stay out of Apulia, Naples and Albania this spring. Your A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS stay off Greece and Albania as agreed. Austria is not yet settled on my side; I will tell you before any move near Trieste or Venice.

Spring 1931: all hold to keep pacts. MOS holds for Turkey SEV standoff; NOR/SWE hold for England; WAR out of Prussia/Silesia for Germany. No unowned centres in reach. Watch Germany SIL/BAL and Turkey on SEV. Consider RUM/SEV push if Turkey moves west.

Spring 1931: holding all units. Pacts: France (no TUN/NAP/ROM/VEN/Tyrrhenian entry), Turkey (Balkan split), Austria (no Trieste/Albania move). All kept so far. No unowned centres reachable. Consider breaking a pact to grow later; Austria is weakest target (TRI) if Germany pressures Vienna.

Spring 1931: all hold to keep 6 SCs. No support option exists for BOH->VIE, so no attack. Pacts: France (no western entry), England (no North Sea/Norway/Channel, BAL stays), Russia (SIL out of WAR, BAL out of SWE/STP). Austria refuses to withdraw. Reassess Fall 1931 for VIE with support, or Russia/Turkey plan.

Spring 1931: no unowned centres reachable. Holding all 8 to keep pacts with Russia, Italy, Austria. Russia's A MOS held as promised. Austria and Italy confirmed their stays. Next turn, reassess a move on BUD or SEV, or Russian targets, if pacts still hold; if pacts break, convoy options via F RUM to BLA.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1931: Both of us gain nothing from a war over Vienna while Turkey leads at 8 centers. I propose A BOH to Munich or Silesia this fall and A SIL out of Tyrolia. In return A VIE, A BUD and F TRI stay put and I will not enter Bohemia or Silesia. Tell me your answer before orders.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1931: Turkey is the leader at 8 centers and threatens both of us through Rumania and Serbia. I keep my word: no Austrian unit enters Galicia or Warsaw. Please confirm your A WAR, A MOS and A SEV will not enter Galicia or Budapest, and tell me if you plan any move against Rumania so we coordinate.

England to Germany, Fall 1931: Give me written orders for A BEL, F BAL and A KIE this autumn. If your armies go east against Russia, I will consider a joint Norway plan. I keep EDI, LON and NTH out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark unless you propose otherwise in writing.

France to England, Fall 1931: Germany's A BEL and Holland are our shared gain. Proposal for autumn: my A BUR moves to BEL with support from A PAR moving to PIC, and your F NTH moves to HOL. If you agree, send your written unit orders first and I will reply in writing with mine before we execute.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1931: Our split stands. I am still not entering Warsaw or Sweden. Your A WAR and A SWE stay out of Prussia and Silesia. I am considering a move against Austria's VIE. Tell me your Fall 1931 orders in writing so we do not collide in Galicia or Budapest.

Germany to Turkey, Fall 1931: My armies stay out of the Balkans and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. Please confirm F AEG and F RUM stay away from Germany's coasts and out of the Baltic. What are your Fall 1931 plans against Russia or Austria?

Italy to Austria, Fall 1931: Pact still holds from my side. Germany has A BOH and A SIL near you; if they strike Vienna or Tyrolia, tell me at once. I need to know whether F TRI and A VIE stay put this autumn before I decide my Adriatic moves.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1931: Confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay out of Apulia, Naples and Albania this autumn. I am holding A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania. Tell me before any move toward Tunis-side waters.

Italy to France, Fall 1931: Our pledge holds. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. Confirm your western Mediterranean units stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian this autumn, and tell me in writing before any change.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1931: My A MOS holds this fall and I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople. Your A SEV and A RUM are a standoff I would rather end. Tell me whether your A RUM and F AEG will push west against Austria or Italy this fall, so neither of us wastes units.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1931: Your A MOS has held, and I have kept my word. Before autumn orders, confirm A MOS holds again and that no Russian unit enters Rumania or Bulgaria. I will keep A SEV, A SMY and A ANK out of Moscow and Warsaw while you do the same to my Balkan centres.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1931: Our pact holds. A SER stays in Serbia and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Germany is pressing you in Bohemia, and I have no plans against you. Tell me your Galicia intentions before any move there.

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1931: My fleets stay out of the Baltic and North Sea, and F AEG and F BLA stay away from your coasts. My armies stay out of Bohemia and Silesia. Please keep A BOH and A SIL away from my Balkan centres. What are your fall plans against Austria or Russia?

Austria to Italy, Fall 1931: Pact holds from my side. A VIE and F TRI stay put this autumn and will not enter Venice or Tyrolia. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. If Germany's A BOH or A SIL strikes Vienna or Tyrolia, I will tell you at once and we can coordinate.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1931: Confirmed on my side. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold and will not enter Serbia, Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. I have no move planned into Galicia yet. If Russia moves in Galicia or Rumania, I will tell you before I act.

England to France, Fall 1931: I have read your proposal, but I will not move F NTH to Holland or send any fleet toward Belgium this autumn. Your A BUR to BEL with A PAR to PIC is a direct attack on German Belgium and invites a long war on my western border. I will keep F NTH and A LON out of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal as before. Hold your armies and I will do the same.

France to Italy, Fall 1931: Confirmed in writing. No French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn. My armies stay out of Marseille-adjacent Italian zones and Piedmont. Please keep your units out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal as pledged. Any western Mediterranean move I will raise with you in writing first.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1931: Your proposal is noted. I will not put my orders in writing, but I accept the principle: if A BOH leaves for Munich or Silesia and A SIL leaves Tyrolia, I will not attack Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this fall. Show me the moves first and we will talk about spring.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1931: Confirmed. No Russian unit enters Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Trieste this fall. A WAR, A MOS and A SEV will not move into Galicia or Budapest. Hold BUD, VIE and TRI, and keep Germany's A BOH and A SIL off your centres. Turkey is the real leader; a coordinated squeeze on Rumania is worth discussing once Turkey's units commit west.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1931: Our split holds. A WAR stays out of Prussia and Silesia, and A SWE stays home. My orders this fall keep A WAR and A MOS central, with no move toward Galicia or Budapest. Your moves on Austria's VIE are your business, and I will not interfere. Keep A SIL and F BAL out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1931: A MOS holds this fall, and I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople. A SEV and A RUM remain a standoff, but I prefer to end it. Keep A SMY, A ANK and A SEV out of Moscow and Warsaw, and turn your western units against Austria or Italy.

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1931: F AEG and F BLA stay away from your coasts and out of the Baltic and North Sea. A BOH and A SIL stay out of my Balkan centres as well. I am weighing autumn options against Russia and Austria and will tell you before any move that crosses into your sphere.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1931: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay out of Apulia, Naples and Albania. Your A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS stay off Greece and Albania. I have no move toward Tunis-side waters or Venice planned this autumn, and I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1931: I keep my word. A SEV, A SMY and A ANK stay out of Moscow and Warsaw while your A MOS holds and no Russian unit enters Rumania or Bulgaria. Confirm A MOS holds and that A SWE and A WAR stay out of my Balkan centres. Any breach ends the pact.

notes.note: Fall 1931: holding all units per pacts with Germany, England, Italy. England refused BEL/PIC joint move. No unowned centers reachable. Watch German BEL/Ruhr and England NTH; revisit only if pacts break.

Fall 1931: holding VIE, BUD, TRI as promised to Turkey, Italy, Russia. BUD supports VIE hold against German BOH/SIL. Germany proposed BOH to MUN/SIL and SIL out of TYR, but gave no written orders; watch for it. Turkey and Russia have kept pledges so far. Revisit GAL/SER only if Turkey vacates SER or Russia opens GAL.

Fall 1931: holding all units. Pacts kept: France (no TUN/NAP/ROM/VEN/TYS entry), Turkey (Balkan split), Austria (no Trieste/Albania). No unowned centres reachable. Watch Germany A BOH/A SIL vs Vienna; Austria must warn me. Consider breaking a pact later to grow.

Fall 1931: holding EDI, LON, NTH. Declined France's Belgium/Holland proposal in writing, so no move there. France, Russia and Germany have kept their word so far. Germany still refuses a written Norway plan. Revisit a Norway convoy only with a written plan from Russia or Germany.

Fall 1931: all hold to honor pacts. MOS holds for Turkey SEV standoff; NOR/SWE hold for England; WAR out of Prussia/Silesia for Germany; no Galicia/Budapest for Austria. Turkey (8 centers) is leader and keeps word so far; watch its western push. Consider RUM/SEV only if Turkey's units leave the Balkans. Watch Germany SIL/BAL.}

Fall 1931: holding all 8 centres to keep pacts with Russia (no entry to MOS/WAR, SEV standoff), Austria (SER stays, no BUD/VIE/TRI), Italy (AEG out of Ionian, no armies in Apulia/Naples/Albania), Germany (fleets out of Baltic/North Sea). No unowned centres reachable. Reassess Spring 1932 for Russian or Austrian targets; all pacts kept so far.

Fall 1931: keeping 6 SCs. F BAL to DEN, SIL to BER, BOH to SIL (vacated). VIE attack unsupported, so no attack. Austria and Russia have said they will stay put; Turkey unconfirmed. Reassess Spring 1932 for a VIE attack with real support.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Spring 1932: Turkey at 8 centres is the danger to us both. Propose we coordinate: A WAR and A MOS keep off Galicia and Budapest, and I will not enter Galicia or Rumania. Once Turkey commits west, we can squeeze Rumania together. Confirm in writing before any move.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1932: Our pact has held. Please confirm A SER, A BUL and A RUM stay out of BUD, VIE and TRI this spring. Tell me your plans against Russia in Galicia or Rumania so we avoid a clash. I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1932: Your BOH and SIL still press Vienna. Move A BOH to Munich or Silesia and A SIL out of Tyrolia, and I will keep VIE, BUD and TRI in place and not enter Bohemia or Silesia. Otherwise I hold and expect a fight.

England to Germany, Spring 1932: Still no written Norway plan from you. Are A BEL, F DEN and A KIE staying put this spring? If Germany commits in writing to hold Denmark and Holland and to keep fleets out of the North Sea, I will keep EDI, LON and NTH out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark.

France to Germany, Spring 1932: Our pact has held for years. Since you are pressing Austria and Turkey, I propose you keep A BEL and A KIE in place, and I keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Belgium, Ruhr, Munich and Kiel. Please confirm in writing, and tell me your Bohemia and Tyrolia orders before they execute.

France to Italy, Spring 1932: My pledge holds. No French unit will enter Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian. Please confirm in writing that your F TYS and A TUN stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this spring. I will raise any western Mediterranean change with you in writing first.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1932: Our past terms still stand. Pull A VIE to Galicia or Trieste this spring and I will not attack Vienna. If A VIE holds, A MUN to Tyrolia with A SIL to Bohemia will strike VIE, and I expect to take it.

Italy to Germany, Spring 1932: Austria is weak with A BUD, F TRI, A VIE under your pressure from A BOH and A SIL. I may move on Trieste this autumn if Austria's fleet leaves it. Will you keep A MUN and your armies out of Venice and Trieste, and help take Vienna if Austria collapses? Tell me your plans.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1932: Our Balkan split has held well. I am weighing a move against Austria in the Adriatic. Will you keep F AEG and your armies out of Apulia, Naples and Albania, and hold A SER and A BUL off Albania? Tell me your intentions for Greece and Serbia this year.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1932: Your A SEV and A RUM standoff has lasted too long. Turkey is the 8-centre leader and I am the obvious target of your ambitions. Tell me plainly whether A SEV leaves this spring. I will hold MOS and WAR, and will not enter Rumania or Bulgaria while you keep your word.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1932: Our split still holds: A SIL out of Warsaw, F BAL out of Sweden and St Petersburg, my A WAR out of Prussia and Silesia. Tell me your Spring 1932 orders against Austria in writing so we avoid collisions. I am holding WAR and MOS.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1932: I keep my pledge: no Russian unit enters Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Trieste. Turkey's A RUM and A SER are your real threat. Tell me your Spring 1932 moves so we coordinate against Turkey rather than each other.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1932: The SEV standoff has cost us both. I propose a clean split: your A MOS and A WAR stay north, my A SEV and A RUM stay south, and neither of us enters the other's centres. I will move A SMY and A ANK only toward Armenia and Syria, not Moscow or Warsaw. Confirm in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1932: Germany is your real threat in Bohemia, and I hold A SER and A BUL as promised. I am considering a push against Russia's southern holdings this year. Tell me your Galicia plans so we do not collide, and I will keep A SER out of BUD, VIE and TRI as before.

Austria to Russia: Confirmed on my side: no Austrian unit enters Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania this spring. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. Turkey's A RUM and A SER are the threat to us both; I will share my Rumania plans before any move there.

Austria to Germany: Your A BOH and A SIL are still parked on my border. Move A BOH to Munich or Silesia and A SIL out of Tyrolia, and I will keep VIE, BUD and TRI in place and stay out of Bohemia and Silesia. Hold them and I will defend Vienna with everything I have.

Austria to Turkey: Thank you for confirming A SER stays out of BUD, VIE and TRI. I hold VIE, BUD and F TRI this spring and will not enter Serbia, Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep A RUM and A BUL out of my cities too. I have no move into Galicia planned; I will tell you before any move.

Germany to England, Spring 1932: A BEL holds, F DEN holds, and A KIE holds this spring. No German fleet enters the North Sea, Norway or Channel. Keep EDI, LON and NTH out of Belgium, Holland and Denmark and we both keep our centres. I will confirm in writing once the spring moves are resolved.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1932: Our split stands. A SIL stays out of Warsaw and F DEN stays out of Sweden and St Petersburg. I am working against Austria, not into Galicia. Keep A WAR out of Prussia and Silesia, and A SWE out of Berlin and Denmark. Good luck with your southern plans.

Germany to France, Spring 1932: Our pact stands. A BEL holds and A KIE holds this spring. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland. My pressure stays on Austria and Turkey.

Germany to Italy, Spring 1932: I will not move A MUN into Venice or Trieste. My armies are aimed at Vienna and Turkey, not the Adriatic. Keep F TUN and A VEN off Tyrolia and Piedmont, and we can both deal with our other neighbours. Let us talk again after the autumn moves.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1932: My earlier terms stand. Move A VIE to Galicia or Trieste and I will not attack Vienna this spring. If A VIE holds, A MUN to Tyrolia with A SIL to Bohemia will strike it, and I expect to take it. Your choice.

Italy to France, Spring 1932: Confirmed in writing. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and my A TUN and F TYS hold their zones this spring. Please keep all French units out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian as pledged. Any western Mediterranean change we discuss first.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1932: Confirmed again. No Russian unit enters Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Trieste this spring. I will hold A WAR and A MOS while Turkey's units remain in the south. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI off Galicia and Warsaw too. Let us both watch Germany's A SIL and A BOH and coordinate before any move against Rumania.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1932: Your split is acceptable in principle. A MOS and A WAR stay north, and I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople. Your A SEV and A RUM must still leave Sevastopol and Rumania's border area for good, or I will treat it as a breach. Confirm A SMY and A ANK stay out of Moscow, Warsaw and Sweden in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1932: Confirmed. A SER will not enter BUD, VIE or TRI this spring, and no Turkish unit will enter Bulgaria-to-Austria routes against your cities. Germany in Bohemia is your main threat. I have no Galicia move planned yet, and I will tell you before any move toward Russia in Rumania.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1932: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay out of Apulia, Naples and Albania this spring. Your A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS should stay off Greece and Albania. I will keep A SER and A BUL off Albania, and I will tell you before any change near Greece.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1932: I accept a clean split. Your A MOS and A WAR stay north, my A SEV and A RUM stay south, and neither of us enters the other's centres. A SMY and A ANK will go only toward Armenia and Syria, not Moscow or Warsaw. Keep A SWE and A WAR out of Rumania and Bulgaria, and we both gain.

notes.note: Spring 1932: holding all units to keep pacts with Germany, England, Italy. Germany and Italy confirmed in writing. England has kept word. Watch German BEL and England NTH; revisit only if pacts break. Unowned centers still unreachable.

Spring 1932: F NTH to NWG to set up convoy of A EDI to NOR next turn (Russian, A NOR present). EDI and LON hold. Germany promised A BEL, F DEN, A KIE hold; Russia and France have kept word. Reassess Norway convoy if NOR is still weak; need centres.

Spring 1932: all hold. No unowned centres in reach. Turkey split: MOS/WAR north, no entry to RUM/BUL/SER/CON; Turkey A SEV/A RUM must leave for good or treat as breach. Austria: no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI. Germany: SIL out of WAR, no BAL/F DEN into SWE/STP, WAR out of PRU/SIL. Watch Germany SIL/BOH and Turkey SEV. Consider RUM/SEV push if Turkey moves west.

Spring 1932: holding all units. Italy has 4 centres and no unowned ones are reachable without a failed attack. Pacts with France, Turkey and Austria still hold. Germany promised no A MUN into Venice or Trieste. Next: watch for Austria's fleet leaving TRI; consider VEN to TRI with support if it empties. Turkey must keep AEG out of Ionian.

Spring 1932: holding BUD, TRI, VIE. Germany (A SIL, A MUN) threatens VIE via BOH/TYR; I have no VIE defender, so watch for attacks. Turkey (SER stays out of BUD/VIE/TRI) and Russia (no entry to GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI) have kept pledges. Germany's terms (VIE to GAL/TRI) rejected. Revisit counterattack on SER/RUM only if Turkey weakens.

Spring 1932: all hold to keep 6 SCs. No unowned SCs reachable. Pacts: France (no western entry), England (no North Sea/Norway/Channel), Russia (SIL out of WAR/PRU, no Sweden/StP). Austria demands BOH/SIL withdrawal, refused. Austria/Italy wary. Reassess Fall 1932 for VIE attack with real support or Russia plan.

Spring 1932: all 8 centres held. Holding all units to keep pacts: Austria (SER out of BUD/VIE/TRI), Italy (AEG out of Ionian, no armies Apulia/Naples/Albania), Russia (clean split; SEV/RUM stay south, no entry to MOS/WAR). Russia wants SEV gone; not yet a breach. No unowned centres. Reassess Fall 1932 for Russian or Austrian targets if pacts hold.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1932: Your A SIL and A MUN are next to my Vienna. Hold them this fall and I will keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI in place. If you move on Vienna or Tyrolia, I will defend and turn to Galicia and Serbia. Tell me your fall moves first.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1932: Our pact has held. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. I will hold all three and enter no Turkish-held centre. Tell me your Fall moves against Russia so we avoid a clash.

England to Russia, Fall 1932: I will keep EDI, LON and NWG out of Norway and Sweden this autumn. Germany is the common problem. If you move A WAR or A MOS against Silesia or Prussia, I can hold my fleets in the North Sea to keep Germany's fleets bottled up. Please confirm your autumn orders in writing.

England to Germany, Fall 1932: Your written spring promises on Belgium, Denmark and Kiel were kept, and I appreciate it. Please send written orders for A BEL, F DEN, A KIE and A BER this autumn. If Germany keeps fleets out of the North Sea, I will keep EDI, LON and NWG away from Holland, Denmark and Belgium.

France to Germany, Fall 1932: Our pact has held. Germany has 6 centres and is hemmed by Russia and Austria. I propose we both keep current positions this autumn. Please confirm in writing that A BEL, A KIE, A MUN stay out of Burgundy, Picardy, Marseille, Brest and Spain-Portugal, and tell me your Bohemia plans.

France to England, Fall 1932: Your fleet and army have stayed clear of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal, and I thank you. I will keep A PAR, A BUR, A MAR, A POR, A SPA on hold this autumn. Please confirm your F NWG, A LON, A EDI hold too, and tell me any change in writing first.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1932: Turkey leads at 8 centres and will win if we keep trading pacts. I am moving against Austria this autumn with A MUN and A SIL. I ask you to press Turkey's Sevastopol and Rumania from the north-east instead of Galicia, and keep A WAR out of Silesia and Prussia. Confirm in writing.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1932: The old terms are void. Turkey is the leader at 8 centres and is the real threat to both of us. If you want to live, move A VIE to Galicia now and offer a non-aggression pact against Turkey. If A VIE holds, Vienna falls this autumn.

Italy to Germany, Fall 1932: Austria's F TRI is the only obstacle to Trieste. If Germany takes Vienna and Austria collapses, I would take Trieste and Tyrolia stays yours. Please confirm A MUN stays out of Venice and Trieste this autumn, and tell me your Vienna orders.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1932: Our Balkan split still matters to me. Please confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay out of Apulia, Naples and Albania this autumn. I will keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1932: Your A SEV and A RUM still sit against my southern border. I hold A MOS and A WAR and will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople. Tell me plainly whether A SEV leaves Sevastopol this fall, and confirm A SMY and A ANK stay out of Moscow and Warsaw in writing.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1932: Our split holds: A WAR stays out of Prussia and Silesia, and F DEN and A SIL stay out of Sweden, St Petersburg and Warsaw. I hold MOS and WAR this fall. Tell me your Austria orders in writing so we avoid collisions in Bohemia and Galicia.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1932: The clean split stands. Your A MOS and A WAR stay north, my A SEV and A RUM stay south, and neither of us enters the other's centres. Confirm in writing that A SWE and A NOR will not move into Rumania, Bulgaria or the Black Sea. I will keep my Balkan units in place while you do the same.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1932: I still keep A SER out of BUD, VIE and TRI, and no Turkish unit will enter your cities. Germany's pressure in Bohemia is the real danger to you. Tell me now if you plan any move into Galicia or Rumania, so neither of us is caught in a clash.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1932: I will not move A VIE to Galicia, and I will not give up Vienna. Your A SIL and A MUN are the danger. Hold them this fall, keep A BOH out of Vienna, and I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI and make no move into Bohemia or Silesia. Attack Vienna and I will fight with everything I have, and Turkey will not benefit from that war either.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1932: Thank you for confirming. I have no move into Galicia or Rumania planned this fall; I am holding VIE, BUD and TRI. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of my three cities. I will tell you before any move toward Galicia or Rumania, and I ask the same from you.

England to France, Fall 1932: Confirmed in writing. My A EDI, A LON and F NWG hold this autumn and stay out of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal. Please keep A PAR, A BUR, A MAR, A POR and A SPA out of Belgium, Picardy and Brest as you state. Any change to this must be proposed in writing before any order is executed.

Germany to Austria: The terms are void. I am moving on Vienna this autumn with A MUN and A SIL. Move A VIE to Galicia and I will talk of a non-aggression pact against Turkey. Hold it and Vienna falls.

Germany to France: Our pact has held and I will keep A BEL and A KIE out of your provinces this autumn. My armies are aimed at Austria and Turkey. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR away from Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland.

Germany to Italy: I do not intend A MUN into Venice or Trieste this autumn. My target is Vienna and then Turkey. Keep F TUN and A VEN out of Tyrolia and Piedmont, and we can both gain at our other neighbours.

Germany to Russia: I am moving on Austria this autumn with A MUN and A SIL. Keep A WAR out of Silesia and Prussia, and press Turkey's Sevastopol and Rumania from the north-east rather than Galicia. Please confirm in writing.

Germany to England: Fleets stay out of the North Sea, Norway and Channel from my side. A BEL holds, F DEN holds, A KIE holds, and A BER holds this autumn. Keep EDI, LON and NWG away from Holland, Denmark and Belgium, and we both keep our centres.

Russia to England, Fall 1932: Confirmed. A NOR and A SWE hold this fall, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea, Edinburgh or the Baltic. My A WAR and A MOS are not moving toward Silesia or Prussia this autumn. Keep your fleets out of Norway and Sweden and the north stays quiet.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1932: Our split holds. A WAR stays out of Prussia and Silesia, and I will not enter Galicia or Budapest this autumn. I hold MOS and WAR. Keep A SIL and F DEN out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg, and we can both press Austria and stay quiet in the north.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1932: I hold A MOS and A WAR and will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople. Your A SEV and A RUM must leave the Russian border area in the coming seasons or I will treat it as a breach. A SMY and A ANK stay out of Moscow and Warsaw. A SWE and A NOR are holding, not moving south.

Turkey to Austria: Our pact holds. No Turkish unit will enter BUD, VIE or TRI this autumn, and A SER stays in Serbia. I have no move into Galicia planned. Germany in Bohemia is your real danger, so keep your eyes there. I will tell you before any change near Rumania.

Turkey to Italy: Confirmed again. F AEG stays out of the Ionian this autumn, and no Turkish army goes to Apulia, Naples or Albania. A SER and A BUL stay off Albania. I have no move toward Venice, Tunis or Trieste planned, and I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Russia: The clean split stands. Your A MOS and A WAR stay north, and my A SEV and A RUM stay south. I will not enter Moscow or Warsaw. Confirm A SWE and A NOR stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and the Black Sea, and neither of us will have reason to break this.

notes.note: Fall 1932: holding all units to keep pacts with Germany, England, Italy. Germany and England confirmed in writing; Italy confirmed. No unowned centers reachable. Watch German BEL and England NTH; revisit only if pacts break.

Fall 1932: NWG to NTH to set up convoy of A EDI/A LON toward Norway next turn, only if Russia still holds NOR and no written plan conflicts. EDI and LON hold. France, Germany, Russia have kept promises; keep out of Belgium, Holland, Denmark, Brest, Picardy, Spain-Portugal, Norway, Sweden unless a written plan appears.

Fall 1932: holding all 6 SCs. Pacts: France (no western entry), England (no North Sea/Channel), Russia (SIL/WAR split). Austria refuses to move VIE; no support route to VIE yet. Reassess Spring 1933 for a Vienna attack with real support, or a Turkey plan, and push for unowned SCs if any appear.

Fall 1932: all hold. Pacts: Turkey split (MOS/WAR north, SEV/RUM south; Turkey SEV/RUM still breach-watch). Germany: WAR out of PRU/SIL, no SIL/DEN into WAR/SWE/STP. messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1933: Your A SIL and A MUN threaten Vienna and Tyrolia. Pull A SIL out of Bohemia-facing positions and hold A MUN this spring, and I will keep A BUD, A GAL and F TRI in place. Attack Vienna and I will defend it and retake what I can. Tell me your Spring moves now.

England to Russia, Spring 1933: Still holding A NOR and A SWE as you promised? Your Fall 1932 pledge keeps the north quiet. Germany is the shared threat; if you move against Silesia or Prussia, I will keep my fleets in the North Sea. Please confirm your Spring 1933 orders in writing.

France to Germany, Spring 1933: Our pact has held. I want to plan beyond Austria and Turkey. Will A BEL and A KIE stay in place this year? I will keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR away from Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland. Please confirm in writing, and tell me your plans for any Low Countries move before it happens.

France to England, Spring 1933: Our border has stayed quiet and I value that. What are F NTH and F NWG planning this spring? I will keep A PAR, A BUR, A MAR, A POR and A SPA out of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal. Please confirm in writing that you will do the same, and tell me any change first.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1933: Your A VIE has left for Galicia, so Vienna is empty. I am moving A SIL to Bohemia and A MUN to Tyrolia this spring. Austria can keep Trieste and Budapest, and I will not enter Galicia or Serbia. Tell me whether A GAL stays out of Silesia and Bohemia.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1933: I am moving A SIL to Bohemia this spring and not into Warsaw, Prussia or Galicia. Keep A WAR out of Silesia and Prussia, and keep fleets out of Sweden and Berlin. Please confirm in writing that you will not move into Berlin or Kiel.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1933: Our pact has held. Are F TRI and A VIE holding again this spring? Germany's armies are near Vienna, so I want to know early if you need help. My A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS stay off Trieste and Albania while the pact holds.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1933: Please confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and your armies stay out of Apulia, Naples and Albania this spring. I will keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania. Tell me before any move toward Tunis-side waters or Venice.

Italy to Germany, Spring 1933: Will A MUN and your armies stay out of Venice and Trieste this spring? My A VEN and A ROM will stay out of Tyrolia and Piedmont. If Austria collapses, let us agree in writing who takes Trieste before either of us moves.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1933: Your A SEV and A RUM still sit on my border. Tell me plainly whether A SEV leaves Sevastopol this spring. If it does, A MOS and A WAR stay north and I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople. Confirm A SMY and A ANK stay out of Moscow and Warsaw.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1933: Our split holds: A WAR stays out of Prussia and Silesia, and F DEN and A SIL stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. Turkey is the leader at 8 centres and is the danger to us both. Tell me your Austria orders so we avoid collisions in Bohemia and Galicia.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1933: Our split has held, but I need clarity. A SEV and A RUM are my southern forces, and I have no plan to enter Moscow or Warsaw. Confirm A SWE, A NOR and A WAR stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and the Black Sea this spring, and I will keep my Balkan units in place.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1933: Our pact holds. No Turkish unit will enter BUD, VIE or TRI. A SER stays in Serbia. I have no move into Galicia planned. Germany in Bohemia remains your real danger. I will tell you before any change near Rumania.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1933: Vienna is empty only because my unit went to Galicia, and I will not let you walk in unopposed. Your A SIL to Bohemia and A MUN to Tyrolia are a clear threat to Trieste and Budapest. Keep A BOH and A TYR out of Austrian cities and I will not enter Bohemia, Silesia or Munich. Any unit entering Vienna will be attacked by A BUD and F TRI.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1933: Thank you for keeping your pact. A VIE has gone to Galicia; I hold BUD and F TRI this spring. Germany is moving toward Tyrolia and Vienna, so I will tell you if they threaten Trieste. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania as agreed, and we can talk Adriatic cooperation this year.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1933: Thank you for confirming. A VIE has moved to Galicia, so I am holding BUD and F TRI. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest and Trieste. I am not moving against Rumania or Serbia. Tell me before any Turkish move toward Galicia or Rumania, and I will do the same.

England to France, Spring 1933: My F NTH and A LON will stay out of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal this spring, and I will not move against Belgium or Holland. I hold A EDI and F NWG at home too. Your A PAR, A BUR, A MAR, A POR and A SPA must stay out of Belgium, Picardy and Brest. Any change must be proposed in writing first.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1933: Vienna is empty, so I will not take it this spring. A SIL moves to Bohemia and A MUN to Tyrolia. Keep A GAL out of Silesia and Bohemia, and keep your units out of Munich and Tyrolia. Hold your border and we can both look at Turkey.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1933: Confirmed in writing. A SIL moves to Bohemia, not Warsaw, Prussia or Galicia. I will not move into Berlin, Kiel, Sweden or St Petersburg. Keep A WAR out of Silesia and Prussia, and keep fleets out of Sweden and Berlin. Turkey is the bigger threat to us both.

Germany to Italy, Spring 1933: A MUN goes to Tyrolia this spring, not Venice or Trieste. I will not move toward Trieste while Austria still holds it. Keep A VEN and A ROM out of Tyrolia and Piedmont. If Austria collapses later, we can agree on Trieste in writing before either of us moves.

Germany to France, Spring 1933: Our pact stands. A BEL and A KIE hold this spring and no German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal. A MUN goes to Tyrolia and A SIL to Bohemia. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR away from Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland.

Russia to England, Spring 1933: Confirmed. A NOR and A SWE hold this spring. No Russian unit enters the North Sea, Edinburgh, Norway or the Baltic. Keep your fleets out of Norway and Sweden and the north stays quiet.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1933: Your A SEV and A RUM still sit on my border and the standoff has gone on too long. I will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople while you keep your word, but I need A SEV to leave Sevastopol this year. Confirm in writing that A SMY and A ANK stay out of Moscow and Warsaw.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1933: Confirmed. A WAR stays out of Prussia and Silesia, and I will not move into Berlin or Kiel. F DEN and A SIL must stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. Your Bohemia move is yours to make, and I will not interfere in Austria.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1933: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and my armies stay out of Apulia, Naples and Albania this spring. Your A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS stay off Greece and Albania. I have no move against Venice or Tunis-side waters planned, and I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1933: A SEV and A RUM stay in place this spring, and I will not move them into Moscow or Warsaw. A SMY and A ANK stay out of Moscow and Warsaw too. Keep A SWE, A NOR and A WAR out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and the Black Sea, and the split holds.

Austria to Italy: Confirmed. F TRI holds and A BUD holds this autumn, and A VIE stays out of Venice and Tyrolia. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. If German units move on Tyrolia or Trieste, I will tell you at once.

Austria to Russia: Confirmed. A BUD, A VIE and F TRI hold this fall and no Austrian unit enters Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. Germany's A BOH and A TYR are the threat to us both. Turkey's Black Sea units are the bigger question, so let us coordinate before any Rumania move.

Germany to France, Fall 1933: Our pact stands. A BEL and A KIE hold this autumn, and no German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR away from Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and we both keep our centres.

Russia to England, Spring 1934: Confirmed. A NOR and A SWE hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea, Edinburgh or the Baltic. Your plan to move F NTH toward Holland is your affair. I will not strike Prussia or Denmark without warning you first.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1934: A SEV and A RUM hold this spring and will not move toward Moscow or Warsaw. A SMY and A ANK stay out of your centres. Turkey to France, Spring 1934: Confirmed in writing. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian this spring, and no Turkish army moves toward Trieste or Vienna. My forces stay focused on Russia. Keep your fleets in the west and we both keep our centres.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1934: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian this spring, and no Turkish army goes to Apulia, Naples or Albania. Please keep your A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania. I will tell you before any change toward Greece or Tunis-side waters.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1934: Confirmed. My fleets stay out of the Baltic and North Sea, and F AEG and F RUM stay away from your coasts. Turkey to Austria, Spring 1934: Our pact holds. No Turkish unit will enter BUD, VIE or TRI this spring, and A SER stays in Serbia. A BUL and A RUM hold their positions. I agree Germany in Bohemia is the real danger. I will tell you before any move toward Galicia, Rumania or Serbia.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1934: Your A BOH is adjacent to Vienna and Tyrolia. Please confirm in writing that A BOH, A BER and A BEL will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this fall. I will keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI in place and make no move into Bohemia, Silesia or Munich.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1934: Our pact still matters to me. Please confirm A SER, A BUL and A RUM stay out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste this fall. I have no move into Serbia or Rumania planned, and I will tell you first if that changes.

England to Germany, Fall 1934: My F HOL now sits on Holland, which Germany previously held. I am not moving against Denmark, Kiel or Berlin. Please confirm in writing that A BEL, F DEN, A KIE and A BER will not attack Holland this autumn, and I will keep my fleets out of Denmark and Belgium. Tell me your intentions first.

England to France, Fall 1934: My F HOL is in Holland, and I am keeping my western units out of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal. Please confirm in writing that your A PAR, A MUN, A BRE and A MAR will stay out of Belgium and Holland this autumn. I will keep my own fleets off your coast.

England to Russia, Fall 1934: Germany is our shared problem. Please confirm in writing that A NOR, A SWE and A WAR will not enter the North Sea or Edinburgh this autumn. If you strike Prussia or Denmark, I will support you by holding F HOL and keeping my fleets away from Norway.

France to Germany, Fall 1934: Your A BOH is useful against Austria's VIE. I hold A MUN, A PAR, A MAR, A BRE and A POR this autumn and will not move into Bohemia, Silesia or Tyrolia. Please confirm in writing that A BOH and A BER stay out of Munich and Burgundy, and tell me if A BOH moves to Vienna.

France to England, Fall 1934: I hold all my units this autumn and my western fleets stay out of the Channel and North Sea. Please confirm F HOL and A LON stay out of Belgium, Picardy and Brest, and that F NTH and F NWG remain in your waters. Any change, tell me in writing first.

France to Italy, Fall 1934: My units hold this autumn and none enter Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian. Please confirm F TYS and A TUN stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and that A VEN stays clear of Piedmont and Tyrolia. Any western Mediterranean change, we discuss in writing first.

Germany to England, Fall 1934: Your F HOL is sitting on our Holland supply centre, which breaks the no-Holland understanding we had. Move F HOL out before this turn ends, or tell me in writing why it stays. I will keep A BEL, A KIE and F DEN defensive and out of the North Sea.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1934: Please confirm in writing that A WAR, A MOS and A SWE stay out of Prussia, Silesia, Berlin and Denmark this autumn. In return, no German unit enters Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Tell me your Galicia plan so we both know where Turkey and Austria stand.

Germany to Turkey, Fall 1934: Confirm A SER and A BUL stay out of Austrian centres Budapest and Trieste if you can, and keep F RUM out of the Baltic. I am keeping my armies out of the Balkans. Tell me whether A SEV moves against Russia this autumn.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1934: Please confirm in writing that F TRI and A BUD hold this autumn and A VIE stays out of Venice and Tyrolia. Our pact stands from my side. If German units move on Tyrolia or Vienna falls, tell me at once so we can agree on Trieste.

Italy to Germany, Fall 1934: Confirm that no German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont this autumn. My A VEN, A ROM and A TUN stay off Tyrolia and Piedmont. If Austria collapses, let us agree in writing on Trieste before either of us moves.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1934: Your A SEV and A RUM have sat on my border for two years. I need a written answer now. Will A SEV and A RUM leave for Bulgaria or Serbia this fall? If they stay, I will strike SEV with MOS and WAR support. Give me a clear answer.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1934: My A SEV and F RUM hold this autumn and will not move toward Moscow or Warsaw. A SMY and A ANK stay out of your centres. I need your written word that A MOS, A WAR and your northern units stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. If you keep to that, I will keep my units defensive.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1934: A BUD, F TRI and A VIE hold this autumn. None of my units moves toward Venice, Tyrolia or Albania. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. I will tell you at once if German units move on Tyrolia or Vienna.

England to Germany, Fall 1934: F HOL stays in Holland this autumn. I will not attack Denmark, Kiel or Berlin, and I expect no German move into Holland. Propose in writing: Germany keeps Belgium, Kiel and Denmark; England keeps Holland; neither side moves against the other while we both face Russia or France. Reply with your written orders for A BEL, A KIE, F DEN and A BER.

England to France, Fall 1934: Confirmed in writing. A LON holds in London, and F HOL holds in Holland. I will not move into Belgium, Picardy, Brest or Spain-Portugal. I have no F NTH or F NWG now. Please confirm your A PAR, A MUN, A BRE and A MAR stay out of Belgium and Holland this autumn. Any change must be proposed in writing first.

France to England, Fall 1934: Confirmed in writing. My A PAR, A MUN, A BRE, A MAR hold this autumn and will not enter Belgium or Holland. My fleets stay out of the Channel and North Sea. Please keep F HOL, A LON and A EDI out of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal. Any change must be proposed in writing first.

Germany to Austria: I will not order A BOH, A BER or A BEL into Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this fall. Hold your centres and we keep our pact. I will not enter Bohemia-Silesia-Munich against you while you keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI in place.

Germany to Italy: Confirmed in writing. No German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont this autumn, and A TYR will not move to Piedmont. Keep A VEN, A ROM and A TUN off Tyrolia and Piedmont, and we will discuss Trieste only after Austria's position changes.

Germany to England: Your F HOL is sitting on our Holland centre, which breaks our understanding. Move it out this turn and I will keep A BEL, A KIE and F DEN defensive and out of the North Sea. If it stays, I cannot keep my word on the North Sea.

Germany to France: Confirmed. A BOH and A BER will not enter Burgundy, Munich, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal this autumn. A BOH is aimed at Austria, not you. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR away from Munich, Ruhr, Kiel and Holland, and our pact stands.

Italy to France, Fall 1934: Confirmed. F TYS, A TUN, A ROM and A VEN all hold this autumn. A VEN does not move to Piedmont or Tyrolia, and none of my units enter Marseille, Spain or Portugal. Your fleets and armies stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian. Any change to this, we discuss in writing first.

Russia to England, Fall 1934: A NOR and A SWE hold this autumn. No Russian fleet or army enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. I cannot promise A WAR's future moves beyond that, since Turkey's SEV and RUM still threaten my south. Keep your fleets away from Norway and Sweden and we stay at peace.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1934: A NOR and A SWE hold this autumn. A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin this autumn, as before. No German unit may enter Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. My Galicia plans are not yours to see yet. Focus on Austria.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1934: You still have not answered. A SEV and F RUM remain on my border. Move them to Bulgaria or Serbia this autumn and the split stands. If SEV or RUM is still in place at Spring's end, I will act against them. Your word about A SMY and A ANK staying out of my centres is noted.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1934: A SEV and F RUM hold this autumn. I will not move toward Moscow or Warsaw, and A SMY and A ANK stay out of your centres. Your word is still needed: A MOS, A WAR and your northern units must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Break that and I will defend SEV and RUM with everything I have.

notes.note: Fall 1934: holding BUD, TRI, VIE as pledged to Germany, Italy, Turkey, Russia. Germany pledged no entry to VIE/BUD/TRI; watch A BOH. Galicia unowned but Russia asked us to stay out. Revisit GAL/SER/RUM if a pact breaks.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1935: Your word has held. I still hold VIE, BUD and TRI. Confirm in writing that A BOH and A BER stay out of Vienna, Budapest and Trieste this spring, and that you will not move on Galicia or Tyrolia against me.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1935: I hold VIE, BUD and TRI, with no Austrian unit entering Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Please confirm A WAR, A MOS and A SEV stay out of Galicia and Budapest. Let us coordinate if Germany's units move east.

England to Germany, Spring 1935: F HOL stays in Holland this spring and I will not move against Denmark, Kiel or Berlin. Please confirm in writing that A BEL, A KIE, F DEN and A BER will not enter Holland or the North Sea this spring. Germany keeps Belgium, Kiel, Denmark and Berlin; England keeps Holland.

England to Russia, Spring 1935: Germany is weakened and has disbanded BOH. If you strike Prussia or Denmark this year, I will keep F HOL in place and keep my fleets away from Norway and Sweden. Please confirm A NOR, A SWE and A WAR will not enter the North Sea or Edinburgh this spring.

I propose we both focus on Austria's Bohemia and Tyrolia, not each other. Please confirm in writing what A BEL, A BER and A KIE will do, and I will confirm my A MUN and A PAR.
