Germany to England, Spring 1935: F HOL still sits on our Holland centre. Move it out this spring and I will keep my fleets out of the North Sea and Channel. Otherwise I must treat Holland as contested and reassess our understanding. Reply in writing before orders.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1935: Please confirm in writing that A WAR, A MOS and A SWE stay out of Prussia, Silesia, Berlin and Denmark this spring. I will keep my units out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. Tell me whether your Galicia moves are aimed at Austria or Turkey.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1935: My armies will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this spring. Please tell me in writing whether A VIE, A BUD and F TRI stay put, and whether your units leave Bohemia and Silesia alone. Keep our pact and we both gain against Turkey and Russia.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1935: Our pledges hold on my side. Are you still keeping F AEG out of the Ionian and away from Apulia, Naples and Albania this spring? I have not moved against Greece and will say before any change near Tunis-side waters.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1935: Your A SEV and F RUM have sat on my border for three years and you still have not answered. Move them to Bulgaria or Serbia this spring and I will hold MOS, WAR and STP north of you. If SEV or RUM is still in place at Fall's start, I will attack SEV. Which is it?

Russia to Germany, Spring 1935: My A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin this spring. Keep your fleets out of Sweden, St Petersburg and Warsaw and we remain at peace. Tell me your Spring 1935 moves so we avoid any collision on the Baltic.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1935: Confirmed again. No Russian unit enters Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Trieste this spring. Please keep A BUD, A VIE and F TRI out of Galicia and Warsaw. I am watching Turkey's SEV and RUM; tell me your Rumania plans before you move there.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1935: I will keep A SEV and F RUM holding this spring and will not move toward Moscow or Warsaw. Our split can hold if your A MOS, A WAR and northern units stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Turn your strength against Germany and Sweden's neighbours instead. Confirm in writing.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1935: Our pact holds. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI, and A SER stays in Serbia. Germany is the common threat, so tell me if you see Bohemia moves. I will hold A BUL and A RUM this spring and warn you before any change toward Galicia.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1935: My fleets stay out of the Baltic and North Sea, and F RUM stays away from your coasts. A SEV holds this spring. Please keep A BOH-area forces away from Serbia and Bulgaria. Tell me your Austrian and Russian plans so we avoid overlap.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1935: Confirmed in writing: A BOH and A BER will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this spring, and I will not move into Bohemia, Silesia, Munich or Tyrolia. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold in place. Keep your word on Galicia too and we both gain against Turkey and Russia.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1935: Confirmed. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring and no Austrian unit enters Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. I will tell you before any Rumania plan, and I will watch Germany's movements east.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1935: Our pact holds. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. I have no move into Serbia or Rumania planned and will warn you first if that changes.

England to France, Spring 1935: Confirmed in writing. F HOL and A LON will not enter Belgium, Picardy, Brest or Spain-Portugal this spring. The new fleet at LVP is for defending my home waters and the Irish Sea. Any change must be proposed in writing before orders are executed.

England to Germany, Spring 1935: F HOL stays in Holland this spring, and I will not move against Denmark, Kiel or Berlin. I will not enter the North Sea with my fleets toward Germany. Germany keeps Belgium, Kiel, Denmark and Berlin. Please hold your own fleets out of the North Sea and Channel, and reply in writing.

Germany to Austria: In writing, my A BOH and A BER will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this spring, and I will not move on Galicia. Keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI in place as you have, and make no move into Bohemia or Silesia. Our pact holds while we both look at Turkey and Russia.

Germany to Russia: Confirmed in writing. My units will not enter Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg this spring. I cannot guarantee against every German move, but I will not order any unit into your centres. Your A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin, and A NOR and A SWE stay out of Denmark. Galicia is your business only if it is not aimed at my borders.

Germany to England: F HOL still sits on our Holland centre, and that breaks our understanding. I will not confirm the North Sea clause while it stays. If F HOL leaves Holland this spring, my A BEL, A KIE, F DEN and A BER stay out of Holland and the North Sea. Otherwise I will treat Holland as contested.

Germany to France: A BEL and A KIE hold this spring. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Brest, Marseille or Spain-Portugal. A BER stays out of Munich and Burgundy. I will not move on your centres while you keep A MUN and A PAR at home. Keep A PAR, A BUR and A MAR away from Kiel, Ruhr and Holland, and our pact stands.

Germany to Turkey: My armies stay out of the Balkans and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I am pressing Austria, not your centres. Please keep F RUM, F AEG and A SER away from Germany's coasts and out of the Baltic. Tell me whether A SEV moves north against Galicia this year.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1935: A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin this spring. I cannot give written assurance on A SWE and A NOR beyond my word that they hold. Keep your units out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg and we remain at peace.

Russia to England, Spring 1935: A NOR and A SWE hold this spring. No Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. A WAR is not included in any North Sea pledge, as Turkey still threatens my south. Keep your fleets away from Norway and Sweden and we stay at peace.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1935: Your answer is not enough. A SEV and F RUM still sit on my border. Move them to Bulgaria or Serbia this spring or I will attack SEV at Fall's start. Holding them in place breaks our split.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1935: Our pact holds. No Turkish unit will enter BUD, VIE or TRI, and A SER stays in Serbia. I will hold A BUL and A RUM this spring. Germany in Bohemia is the threat; I will warn you before any move toward Galicia, and ask you to do the same for Rumania.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1935: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian this spring, and no Turkish army goes to Apulia, Naples or Albania. I have no move against Greece or Tunis-side waters. Keep your A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania, and I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1935: A SEV and F RUM hold this spring and will not move toward Moscow or Warsaw. A SMY and A ANK stay out of your centres. Confirm in writing that A MOS, A WAR and your northern units stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople, and our split stands while we both watch Germany.

notes.note: Spring 1935: holding all units. HOL stays in Holland per the pledge to France and Germany's claim is unresolved. No unowned centres reachable. Watch England retaliation via NTH/Channel, Russia on Baltic, and France on BEL. Austria and France pacts on hold, Russia and Turkey peaceful so far.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1935: Your word has held. I hold VIE, BUD, TRI. Given the Galicia gap, what are your A BOH and A BER doing this fall? I am considering moves against Russia in Galicia, so tell me if Germany plans anything on Silesia or Galicia so we avoid collision.

England to Germany, Fall 1935: My F HOL is staying in Holland to hold that center, and I have no fleet moving into Germany this autumn. I am not attacking Denmark, Kiel or Berlin. Please confirm in writing that A BEL, A KIE, F DEN and A BER stay out of the North Sea and Channel. Holland is only in dispute because of our past misunderstanding, so let us settle it with a clear written line.

England to Russia, Fall 1935: Please confirm in writing that A NOR, A SWE and A STP will not enter the North Sea or Edinburgh this autumn. I am holding EDI, LON, LVP and NTH and have no plans against Norway or Sweden. If you need pressure on Germany, tell me your Prussia or Denmark plan before orders.

France to Germany, Fall 1935: Your A HOL now sits next to my A PAR and A MUN. Will A HOL, A BEL and A BER stay out of Picardy, Burgundy and Ruhr this autumn? I will keep A PAR, A MUN and A MAR out of Belgium and Holland. Please confirm in writing before orders are executed.

France to Italy, Fall 1935: Your A TUN and F TYS are close to my western holdings. Please confirm in writing that they stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this autumn. I keep my units out of Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice. Any western Mediterranean change, we discuss in writing first.

Germany to England, Fall 1935: Your F HOL is still in Holland, and our attack on it is underway. Withdraw F HOL and I will stay out of the North Sea and Channel. Otherwise I will keep taking Holland and treat you as an enemy. Please reply in writing before orders.

Germany to France, Fall 1935: My A BEL and A KIE are moving against England's Holland, not against you. Keep A PAR, A MUN and A MAR away from Burgundy, Ruhr and Kiel, and I will keep my units out of Picardy, Burgundy and Spain-Portugal. Confirm in writing.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1935: Our pact stands. A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS stay off Trieste and Albania. Please confirm in writing F TRI and A BUD hold this autumn, and tell me at once if German units move on Tyrolia or Vienna.

Italy to Germany, Fall 1935: Confirm in writing that no German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont this autumn, and that A TYR does not move to Piedmont. My A VEN and A ROM stay off Tyrolia and Piedmont. Trieste talk waits until Austria falls.

Italy to France, Fall 1935: Confirming my units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. Please confirm your units stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian this autumn, and that your F MAO stays out of the Western Mediterranean.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1935: Your A SEV and F RUM have held my border for three years. This is my final warning. If either still sits on SEV or RUM after this autumn's moves, I will attack SEV with support from MOS and WAR. Move them to Bulgaria or Serbia and our split can stand.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1935: Our pact holds. No Russian unit enters Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Trieste. I am still watching Turkey's SEV and RUM. If you plan any move toward Rumania or Galicia, tell me first so we avoid a collision.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1935: My A WAR and A MOS will stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Keep your units out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg and we remain at peace. Tell me if you plan any move toward Bohemia or Galicia.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1935: Your ultimatum stands unanswered. I will hold SEV and RUM this fall. Our split holds only if A MOS, A WAR and northern units stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm in writing now, and I will keep A SMY and A ANK out of your centres.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1935: No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. A SER, A BUL and A RUM hold this fall. Germany's Bohemia build-up is our shared threat. Please tell me now if you move toward Serbia or Rumania, and I will do the same.

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1935: My fleets stay out of the Baltic and North Sea, and F RUM stays out of your coasts. A SEV holds this fall. Confirm your armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria, and tell me whether you move against Austria or Russia this year.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1935: Confirmed. F TRI holds this autumn and A VIE holds. My A GAL returns to BUD to restore Budapest. Germany's units in Bohemia and Tyrolia are the threat; I will tell you at once if they move on Vienna or Trieste. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1935: Our pact holds. I am not moving toward Rumania. My A GAL is pulling back to BUD this autumn, leaving Galicia empty. I have no move against Warsaw or Sevastopol. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest, and tell me if Turkey's SEV or RUM moves north.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1935: Our pact holds. F TRI and A VIE hold, and A GAL returns to BUD this autumn. I have no move into Serbia or Rumania planned. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste, and tell me before any move toward Galicia or Rumania.

England to Germany, Fall 1935: Holland is contested only because of our past misunderstanding, and I want it settled in writing. My F HOL stays to hold the centre this autumn. I will not attack Denmark, Kiel or Berlin, and I will keep my fleets out of Germany. Confirm in writing that A BEL, A KIE, F DEN and A BER will not enter the North Sea or Channel and will not move against Holland. If you attack Holland, I will defend it and treat it as a war between us.

France to Germany, Fall 1935: Confirmed in writing. My A PAR, A MUN and A MAR will not enter Belgium, Burgundy, Ruhr, Kiel or Holland this autumn. I ask that your A HOL, A BEL and A BER stay out of Picardy, Burgundy, Marseille, Brest and Spain-Portugal. If any of your units move toward Munich or Burgundy, I will treat our pact as broken, so tell me first.

France to Italy, Fall 1935: Confirmed in writing. My units will not enter Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn, and F MAO stays out of the western Mediterranean for now. Please keep A TUN and F TYS out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. Any western Mediterranean change we discuss in writing first.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1935: My A BEL and A HOL are in the west, and A BER stays home. None of my units will enter Vienna, Budapest, Trieste, Bohemia, Silesia or Galicia this fall. Hold VIE, BUD and TRI, and our pact stands. Go after Russia as you see fit.

Germany to Italy, Fall 1935: Confirmed in writing. No German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont this autumn, and no German unit moves to Tyrolia against you. Keep A VEN, A ROM and A TUN off Tyrolia and Piedmont. Trieste talk waits until Austria falls.

Germany to England, Fall 1935: My A HOL now holds Holland, and I will not move it into the North Sea. Keep F NTH out of Holland, Belgium and Kiel, and I will keep my fleets out of the North Sea and Channel. Let us keep the peace on that line.

Germany to France, Fall 1935: A BEL and A HOL will not enter Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr or Spain-Portugal this autumn, and A BER stays out of Munich. Keep A PAR, A MUN and A MAR out of Belgium and Holland, and our pact holds. I confirm it in writing.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1935: My A BER and F DEN will not enter Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg this autumn. I have no move toward Bohemia or Galicia. Keep your A WAR, A MOS and A SWE out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin, and we remain at peace.

Germany to Turkey, Fall 1935: My armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria, and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I am focused on the west and Austria, not your centres. Keep F RUM, F AEG and A SER away from Germany's coasts and out of the Baltic.

Italy to France, Fall 1935: Confirmed in writing. My units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this autumn. No Italian unit enters Tunis-adjacent French zones or the western Mediterranean against you. A TUN and F TYS hold their positions and will not move west. Please keep your fleets out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian as pledged. Any change, we discuss first.

Russia to England, Fall 1935: Confirmed in writing. A NOR and A SWE hold this autumn, and A STP will not enter the North Sea or Edinburgh. No Russian unit moves into Norway or Sweden against you. I have no Prussia or Denmark plan to share yet. Keep your fleets out of Norway and Sweden and the north stays quiet.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1935: A MOS and A WAR will not enter Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople this autumn. Your A SEV and F RUM still sit on my border, though, and that is the problem. Move one of them to Bulgaria or Serbia this autumn and I will hold my south. Hold both and I will act against Sevastopol.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1935: My A SEV and F RUM hold this autumn and will not move toward Moscow or Warsaw. A SMY and A ANK stay out of your centres. Your northern units must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. If you attack SEV, I will defend it with everything I have. Confirm in writing that A MOS and A WAR stay put.

notes.note: Fall 1935: all hold. Pacts kept with Germany, England, Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI, no PRU/SIL/BER, no NTH/EDI, no NOR/SWE by fleets). Turkey SEV/RUM still unmoved; attack on SEV bounces without second supporter. Next: if SEV still held in Spring 1936, build double attack with MOS and WAR supports from STP/NOR north. Watch Austria GAL and Germany BOH/SIL.

Fall 1935: GAL returns to BUD as promised to Italy/Russia/Turkey; VIE and TRI hold. Germany pledged no entry to VIE/BUD/TRI and kept its word so far. Italy wants TRI and BUD held. Watch A BOH and Russia in GAL. Next: consider Galicia only if Russia or Turkey breaks pacts.

Fall 1935: holding all. A HOL stays to take Holland (HOL was vacated by England's retreat to NTH). Keep pacts with France, Austria, Russia, Italy, Turkey. England's F NTH is the main threat to DEN/HOL; watch it. Next: convoy plans via DEN, and check whether England or France breaks faith.

Fall 1935: holding all units to honor pacts with Germany, Italy, England. Italy asked F MAO stay out of western Med, so no WES move. Germany confirmed A BEL/HOL stay out of Picardy/Burgundy/Ruhr. Watch German HOL/BEL near PAR/MUN; if pact breaks, revisit. Convoy plan (MAO to WES, then SPA to NAF) deferred.

Fall 1935: holding all four units to keep pacts with Austria, France, Germany and Turkey, all reconfirmed this turn. No unowned centres reachable; attacking TRI would bounce and break the Austria pact. Watch Germany near Tyrolia and Vienna. Take TRI with VEN only if Austria collapses and agrees in writing.

Fall 1935: holding all 8 centres defensively. F RUM supports SEV hold against Russian attack from MOS/WAR. Pacts: Austria (no entry BUD/VIE/TRI), Italy (AEG out of Ionian), Germany (fleets out of Baltic/North Sea), Russia hostile on SEV/RUM. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup.

Fall 1935: Holding EDI, LON, LVP, NTH. No unowned centres reachable. Germany's A HOL now sits in Holland; it keeps its word so far (no German fleet in North Sea). Russia confirmed NOR/SWE hold and no North Sea entry. Keep fleets out of Norway, Sweden, Germany's North Sea. Consider retaking HOL with convoy only if Germany's A HOL weakens.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1936: Our pact stands. I hold VIE, BUD, TRI. Germany now has a new A KIE and Bohemia is quiet. Confirm your A BOH and A BER will not enter VIE, BUD or TRI this spring, and tell me before any move toward Silesia or Galicia.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1936: I hold VIE, BUD, TRI and have no unit moving toward Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Please confirm A WAR, A MOS and A SEV stay out of Galicia and Budapest this spring, and tell me at once if Turkey's SEV or RUM moves north.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1936: Our pact holds. I hold VIE, BUD, TRI and plan no move into Serbia or Rumania. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste, and warn me before any move toward Galicia.

England to Germany, Spring 1936: Your A HOL is in Holland, and my F HOL has been holding there. I propose we both stand down: my F HOL moves out of Holland to NTH or stays out of Germany's way, and your units stay out of the North Sea and Channel. Confirm in writing before orders.

England to Russia, Spring 1936: Please confirm in writing that A NOR, A SWE and A STP will not enter the North Sea or Edinburgh this spring. I will keep my fleets out of Norway and Sweden. Tell me now if A WAR or A STP plans anything toward Prussia or Germany.

France to Germany, Spring 1936: Your new A KIE and A HOL are close to my A PAR and A MUN. Confirm in writing that A BEL, A HOL and A KIE stay out of Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr and Munich this spring. I will keep my armies out of Belgium and Holland. Tell me first if you plan otherwise.

France to England, Spring 1936: Your F HOL is still in Holland and A LON in London. Confirm in writing that neither enters Belgium, Picardy, Brest or Spain-Portugal this spring. I will keep A PAR, A MUN, A BRE and A MAR out of Belgium and Holland. Any change, tell me first.

France to Turkey, Spring 1936: Turkey is still the largest power. Please reconfirm in writing that F AEG stays out of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian and no Turkish army moves toward Trieste or Vienna this spring. My fleets stay in the west.

Germany to England, Spring 1936: Your F NTH and F HOL remain a threat to Holland and Denmark. Holland is now mine, so withdraw F HOL and I will not move on Edinburgh or London. I propose we both keep fleets out of the North Sea and Channel this spring. Please confirm in writing.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1936: Your A SWE, A NOR and A WAR are close to my Baltic centres. Confirm in writing that A WAR and A SWE stay out of Prussia, Berlin and Denmark, and I will keep my armies out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. Tell me whether A NOR moves to Sweden or Finland.

Germany to France, Spring 1936: Your A MUN and A PAR sit near my western units. I will keep A BEL, A HOL and A KIE out of Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr and Spain-Portugal this spring. Confirm you will keep A MUN and A MAR out of Belgium, Holland and Kiel, and tell me if you intend anything against Munich.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1936: Our pact stands. A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS stay off Trieste and Albania. Please confirm in writing F TRI and A BUD hold this spring, and tell me at once if German units threaten Vienna or Tyrolia.

Italy to France, Spring 1936: Confirming my units stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. Please confirm in writing your units stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian this spring, and that F MAO stays out of the Western Mediterranean.

Italy to Germany, Spring 1936: Confirm in writing that no German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont this spring, and that A TYR does not move to Piedmont. My A VEN and A ROM stay off Tyrolia. Trieste talk waits until Austria falls.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1936: Your A SEV and F RUM are still on my border. Move one or both to Bulgaria or Serbia this spring and I will hold my south. If both stay, I will act against Sevastopol this autumn. Tell me your plan before orders.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1936: Your new army at KIE and units in Denmark and Holland are near my northern and western centres. I will keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Please confirm your units stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg this spring.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1936: Russia, you still threaten SEV and RUM, and I hold both. Propose a real split: I keep Black Sea and Rumania, you keep Galicia, Warsaw and Moscow, and neither of us moves on Sweden or Norway. Confirm in writing, and I will keep A SMY and A ANK off your centres this spring.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1936: Your Kiel army and new build worry me. Confirm in writing that your armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and your fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I will keep F RUM and A SEV away from Germany's coasts and the Baltic this spring.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1936: Confirmed. F TRI holds and A BUD holds this spring, and A VIE stays put. A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS must stay off Trieste and Albania. If German units move on Tyrolia or Vienna, I will tell you at once and we can coordinate.

England to France, Spring 1936: Confirmed in writing. My F HOL and A LON will not enter Belgium, Picardy, Brest or Spain-Portugal this spring. Your A PAR, A MUN, A BRE and A MAR must stay out of Belgium and Holland. Any change must be proposed in writing before orders are executed.

France to Germany, Spring 1936: Confirmed in writing. My A PAR, A MUN and A MAR will not enter Belgium, Holland, Ruhr or Kiel this spring. I expect your A BEL, A HOL and A KIE to stay out of Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr, Marseille, Brest and Spain-Portugal. Any move toward Munich, I will treat as a pact breach and answer at once. Let us keep our pact and focus on Austria and Turkey.

France to Italy, Spring 1936: Confirmed in writing. My units will not enter Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this spring, and F MAO stays out of the Western Mediterranean for now. Please keep A TUN and F TYS out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal. Any western Mediterranean change we discuss in writing first.

Germany to Italy, Spring 1936: Confirmed in writing. No German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont this spring, and A TYR does not move to Piedmont. Keep A VEN and A ROM off Tyrolia. Trieste waits until Austria falls.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1936: Confirmed. My units will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this spring, and none will move toward Silesia or Galicia without telling you first. Hold VIE, BUD, TRI and our pact stands.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1936: Confirmed in writing. My units will not enter Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg this spring. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin, and A SWE out of Denmark. We remain at peace.

Germany to England, Spring 1936: Holland is mine now, so withdraw F HOL out of Holland. I will not move on Edinburgh or London. I agree that neither of us moves fleets into the North Sea or Channel this spring. Confirm in writing.

Germany to France, Spring 1936: Confirmed. A BEL, A HOL and A KIE will not enter Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr or Spain-Portugal this spring. Please keep A MUN and A MAR out of Belgium, Holland and Kiel, and tell me now if you plan anything against Munich.

Germany to Turkey, Spring 1936: Confirmed. My armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I am focused on the west and Austria. Keep F RUM and A SEV away from the Baltic and German coasts.

Russia to Austria: Confirmed. A WAR, A MOS and A SEV stay out of Galicia and Budapest this spring. I am still watching Turkey's SEV and RUM. Keep your VIE, BUD and TRI as you say, and tell me before any move toward Rumania.

Russia to England: A NOR and A SWE hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. A STP stays out of those too. I cannot pledge A WAR's future moves, but keep your fleets away from Norway and Sweden and we stay at peace.

Russia to Germany: A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin this spring. A NOR and A SWE hold. Keep your units out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg and we remain at peace. Your new army at KIE worries me, so keep it away from my borders.

Russia to Turkey: Your split offer is not acceptable while A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Move one or both into Bulgaria or Serbia this spring and I will hold my south and keep A MOS and A WAR out of Rumania and Bulgaria. If both stay, I will attack Sevastopol this autumn.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1936: Our pact holds. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI, and A SER, A BUL and A RUM stay out of your cities this spring. I will warn you before any move toward Galicia or Rumania, and I ask the same of you.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1936: I propose the split I offered: Turkey keeps Black Sea and Rumania, Russia keeps Galicia, Warsaw and Moscow, and neither of us moves on Sweden or Norway. A SEV and F RUM hold this spring. Confirm in writing that A MOS, A WAR and northern units stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople.

Turkey to France, Spring 1936: Confirmed in writing again. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian this spring, and no Turkish army moves toward Trieste or Vienna. My forces remain focused on Russia and the Black Sea. Keep your fleets in the west and we both keep our centres.

notes.note: Spring 1936: holding all units to keep pledges to France (no Belgium/Brest/Spain) and Russia (no North Sea entry). Germany wants F HOL out; its A HOL is in Holland, so I am not moving NTH there. Germany and France confirmed; Russia pledged NOR/SWE hold. Recheck next turn: consider NTH to NWG/convoy plans only if peace holds.

Spring 1936: holding all units to keep pacts with Austria, France, Germany, Turkey. No unowned centres. Attacking TRI now would bounce and break pacts. Germany and France confirmed pledges. Austria confirmed F TRI and A BUD hold. Reassess taking TRI with VEN if Austria collapses and agrees in writing.
Spring 1936: holding all 5 SCs to honor pacts with France, Austria, Russia, Italy, Turkey, England. England asked F HOL to leave; watch it. Consider a convoy via DEN later; no unowned SCs nearby.

Spring 1936: holding all units to keep pacts with Germany, Italy, England, Turkey, all confirmed in writing. No unowned centers reachable without breaking pacts. Convoy via WES breaks Italy's western Med request, so deferred. Watch German BEL/HOL/KIE and Turkey; revisit if a pact breaks.

Spring 1936: all hold. No unowned centres reachable; SEV attack bounces without a second supporter. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER, no German unit into WAR/SWE/STP, they confirmed), England (NOR/SWE hold, no fleets into NOR/SWE, no Russian unit into NTH/EDI), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI). Turkey unanswered; SEV/RUM still held. Watch Germany KIE army. Reconsider SEV attack in Fall 1936

Spring 1936: holding VIE, BUD, TRI as pledged to all powers. Germany, Italy, Turkey, Russia have kept pacts so far. Galicia unowned but Russia asked us to stay out. Revisit GAL/SER/RUM only if a pact breaks or Turkey vacates SER.

Spring 1936: hold all 8 centres. RUM supports SEV holding against Russian attack. Pacts: Austria (no entry BUD/VIE/TRI), Germany (fleets out of Black Sea/Aegean), France (AEG out of Ionian). Russia hostile on SEV/RUM; no answer. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup to push toward Russia or Austria.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Fall 1936: I am boxed in with three centers and need growth. Serbia and Rumania are your home supply, so I will not move into them. I ask that you leave Galicia and Budapest alone, and that we both keep Germany's Bohemia build-up in view.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1936: Our pact has held for years. I ask whether your A BOH and A BER will stay out of Vienna, Budapest and Trieste this fall. I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI, and I would welcome your plans against Russia or Turkey so we do not collide.

England to Russia, Fall 1936: Germany has five centres and is our shared obstacle. If your A WAR and A STP strike toward Prussia and Berlin, I will move F NTH against Holland and Belgium and keep my fleets off Norway and Sweden. Confirm your Prussia plan in writing before orders.

England to Germany, Fall 1936: Your A HOL and A BEL sit on my border. Tell me your plans for the North Sea and Holland. I will keep F NTH and LVP out of Germany if your fleets stay out of the North Sea and Channel. Confirm in writing before orders.

France to Turkey, Fall 1936: You hold 8 centres and lead the board. Fall plans? I want no conflict with you. Please reconfirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian, and no Turkish army heads toward Trieste or Vienna this autumn. My fleets stay in the west.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1936: Our pact stands and I have not moved on Vienna, Budapest or Trieste. I want to grow, so I may need Bohemia or Silesia later. Tell me your plan against Russia in Galicia before you commit, and I will tell you before any move near your borders.

Germany to France, Fall 1936: My armies stay out of Belgium-Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr and Spain-Portugal as agreed. Please keep A MUN, A PAR and A MAR out of Belgium, Holland and Kiel. If you plan anything against Munich, tell me now.

Germany to England, Fall 1936: Holland is mine and I will not move on Edinburgh or London. Withdraw F NTH away from Holland, Belgium and Kiel, and keep fleets out of the North Sea and Channel as agreed. Please confirm in writing.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1936: Our pact stands and my units hold this autumn. Germany's Bohemian and Tyrolian units worry me as much as you. If you confirm in writing that A VIE and F TRI will not move toward Venice, I will consider a joint plan for Tyrolia. Please tell me your spring 1937 plans.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1936: Please confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania this autumn. My units will hold, and I expect the same from you. Tell me your intentions for Greece and whether Russia's southern moves concern you.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1936: A SEV and F RUM still hold on my border. Tell me now whether either moves to Bulgaria, Serbia or Rumania this autumn. If both stay, I will attack Sevastopol with support from A MOS and A WAR. Your answer decides my orders.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1936: Your army at KIE is close to my western centres. Confirm it will not enter Denmark, Prussia or Holland against my units, and I will keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Tell me your autumn plan before orders.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1936: Our pact still holds. I am keeping A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. If you move toward Galicia or Rumania this autumn, tell me first so we avoid a collision.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1936: Your threat to SEV is the real issue. I will not move A SEV or F RUM into Russian land this autumn if you keep A MOS, A WAR, A STP out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm in writing, and I will keep A SMY and A ANK off your centres. Let us both gain elsewhere: Austria and Germany are the easier targets.

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1936: Confirm your armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean. In return my F RUM and A SEV stay away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic. Tell me whether you move against Austria or Russia this autumn, so we avoid overlap.

Austria to Germany: Yes, our pact stands. I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI this fall. In writing: your A BOH and A BER will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this fall, and you will not move into Tyrolia or Galicia. I will keep my units out of Bohemia, Silesia and Munich. Tell me if your plans change.

England to Germany, Fall 1936: F NTH will not enter Holland, Belgium or Kiel this autumn, and I will not move on Denmark, Kiel or Berlin. My fleets stay in the North Sea and Channel. Confirm in writing that A HOL, A BEL and your fleets stay out of the North Sea, Norway and Channel. If you move against Holland or Denmark, I will reassess.

France to Germany, Fall 1936: Our pact stands on my side. A PAR, A MUN and A MAR will not enter Belgium, Holland, Ruhr, Kiel or Burgundy this autumn. Please keep your A BEL, A HOL and A KIE out of Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr, Marseille, Brest and Spain-Portugal as confirmed. I have no plans against Munich at present, and I will tell you first if that changes.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1936: Our pact stands. My A BOH and A BER will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this fall, and I will not move toward Galicia without telling you first. I may look at Silesia later, and I will warn you before any such move. Hold your centres and we both profit against Russia and Turkey.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1936: I will not order any unit into Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg this autumn, and my A KIE is not aimed at you. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin, and do not move into Denmark or Holland. As long as we both keep that line, we remain at peace.

Germany to Turkey, Fall 1936: Confirmed. My armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I am focused on the west and Austria, not your centres. Keep F RUM and A SEV away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic, and we both gain.

Germany to England, Fall 1936: Holland is mine, and I will not move on Edinburgh or London. My fleets stay out of the North Sea and Channel. Please withdraw F NTH away from Holland, Belgium and Kiel, and keep F LVP out of Germany. I will confirm that line in writing once you do.

Russia to England, Fall 1936: I will not confirm a Prussia or Berlin attack in writing yet. A NOR and A SWE hold this autumn, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. Keep your fleets away from Norway and Sweden, and we can discuss Germany again next spring once I see how Berlin and Kiel shape up.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1936: I will not sign a split while A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Move one of them into Bulgaria, Serbia or Rumania this autumn, and I will keep A MOS and A WAR out of your core. If both hold, I will attack Sevastopol. Your answer decides it.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1936: Our pact holds on my side. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI, and A SER stays in Serbia. I will not move on Galicia this autumn. Keep Germany's Bohemia build-up in view and tell me first if you move toward Rumania.

Turkey to France, Fall 1936: Confirmed again. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian, and no Turkish army heads toward Trieste or Vienna this autumn. Keep your fleets in the west and we both keep our centres.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1936: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian this autumn, and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. I have no move against Greece this year. Keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania, and tell me before any change.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1936: I will not move A SEV or F RUM into Russian land this autumn, provided A MOS, A WAR and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm that in writing now. If you attack Sevastopol, I will defend it fully.

notes.note: Fall 1936: holding BUD, TRI, VIE as pledged to Germany, Italy, Turkey, Russia. Pacts intact so far. Galicia is not a center, so no gain there. Revisit Serbia/Rumania or Galicia only if a pact breaks or Turkey vacates SER.

Fall 1936: holding all four units to keep pacts with Austria, France, Germany and Turkey, all reconfirmed. No unowned centres. Watch Germany and Austria near Tyrolia and Vienna. Take TRI with VEN only if Austria collapses and agrees in writing. Turkey confirmed no Greece move and F AEG stays out of Ionian.

Fall 1936: no unowned centers reachable without breaking pacts. Holding all to keep pacts with Germany, Italy, England, Turkey (all confirmed in writing). Convoy plan via WES deferred because Italy objects. Watch German BEL/HOL/KIE and Turkey; revisit if a pact breaks.

Fall 1936: F NTH moved to ENG to set up a convoy for A LON next turn, away from Holland, Belgium and Kiel as Germany asked. LON and LVP hold. Germany and Russia have kept their pledges so far. Keep fleets out of Norway, Sweden and Germany. Watch whether Russia moves on Prussia.

Fall 1936: holding all 5 SCs, keeping pacts with France, Austria, Russia, Turkey, England. Watch England's F NTH and France's MUN. Consider a Spring 1937 push via RUH/MUN only if France or Austria breaks faith. Need unowned or weak-neighbor SCs to grow.

Fall 1936: all hold. SEV attack has no second supporter (MOS to SEV unsupported, bounces). Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER, they keep out of WAR/SWE/STP), England (NOR/SWE hold, no Russian unit into NTH/EDI), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), Turkey (offers split, unanswered). Watch Germany KIE and Turkey SEV/RUM. Next: look for a real second supporter before attacking SEV.

Fall 1936: holding all 8 centres. RUM supports SEV hold against Russian attack from MOS/WAR. Russia wants SEV/RUM to leave; I refuse unless its armies stay out of my core. Pacts: Austria (no entry BUD/VIE/TRI, SER stays), Italy (AEG out of Ionian, no armies Apulia/Naples/Albania), France (fleets west), Germany (fleets out of Black Sea/Aegean). Next: reassess Russia; consider F RUM to BLA convoy se

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1937: I am boxed in with three centers, and Russia is the power we both need to check. I plan A BUD to Galicia this spring, with A VIE supporting, to pressure Warsaw. Will your A BER or A BOH move toward Silesia or Galicia? Let us coordinate so we both gain on Russia rather than on each other.

England to Germany, Spring 1937: I will keep F ENG and LVP out of your North Sea approaches and Denmark while your fleets stay out of the Channel. Russia is the bigger threat to both of us on the Baltic. Will your A BER and A KIE push into Prussia or Warsaw this year? Tell me your plan in writing.

England to Russia, Spring 1937: You hold five centres and are my neighbour in the north. I have kept my word on Norway and Sweden. Do you intend to keep A NOR and A SWE fixed, or to move against Germany? Please confirm your plans for A STP and A WAR in writing before orders.

France to Germany, Spring 1937: Our pact holds on my side: A PAR, A MUN and A MAR stay out of Belgium, Holland, Ruhr, Kiel and Burgundy. Please confirm your A BEL, A HOL and A KIE stay out of Picardy, Burgundy and Spain-Portugal. What are your spring plans against Russia or Denmark-Sweden?

France to Italy, Spring 1937: My units stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian as pledged. Would you accept a French fleet moving through MAO to WES and then the Tunisian coast later in the year? I will not enter Tunis or Naples without written agreement first. Please reply in writing.

Germany to France, Spring 1937: Our pact holds on my side. Turkey leads the board and Italy is your natural southern target. I propose you turn A MAR and F TYS-side pressure on Italy's TUN and ROM while I keep my armies away from Munich and Burgundy. Confirm you will keep A MUN and A PAR out of Belgium and Holland.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1937: Our border has been quiet. Turkey has eight centres and is the real threat to both of us. I propose we keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia and Berlin, and I keep my armies out of Warsaw and Sweden. Tell me your spring plan before orders.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1937: Our pact stands. Please confirm in writing that F TRI and A VIE hold this spring and will not move toward Venice. Germany's Tyrolian and Bohemian units are the shared threat; tell me immediately if they move on Vienna or Tyrolia.

Italy to France, Spring 1937: Our western pact stands. My A TUN and F TYS will not move toward Marseille, Spain or Portugal. Please confirm your F MAO and armies stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian this spring.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1937: Please confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army moves to Apulia, Naples or Albania this spring. My A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS stay off Greece. Tell me of any change toward Tunis-side waters first.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1937: Your SEV and RUM still hold on my border, and you are our strongest power at 8 centres. Move one of them into Bulgaria or Serbia now and I keep A MOS and A WAR out of your core. If both stay, I will attack Sevastopol this autumn. Answer before orders.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1937: Keep your KIE army out of Denmark, Prussia and Holland against my units, and I keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Tell me your spring plan before orders, so neither of us is caught by a collision.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1937: Turkey is the runaway leader at 8 centres, and it threatens both of us. If you can pressure Rumania or Serbia this year, I will hold Galicia and Warsaw for you and keep my units out of your centres. Tell me your plan first.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1937: Our standoff at Sevastopol costs us both. Propose now: A SEV and F RUM hold, A MOS, A WAR and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople, and neither of us attacks Sweden or Norway. Confirm in writing, or tell me your concrete move this spring.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1937: Confirmed in writing. F TRI holds and A VIE holds this spring. A VIE will not move toward Venice or Tyrolia. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. If German units move on Vienna or Tyrolia, I will tell you at once and we can coordinate.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1937: I hold VIE, BUD and TRI this spring and no Austrian unit enters Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. Turkey is the danger to us both, but I will tell you my plan before any move south or east.

France to Germany, Spring 1937: Our pact holds. A PAR, A MUN and A MAR will stay out of Belgium, Holland, Ruhr, Kiel and Burgundy this spring. Confirm in writing that A BEL, A HOL and A KIE stay out of Picardy, Burgundy and Spain-Portugal. I am not planning any move against Munich. Any Russian or Danish operations are yours to manage, but keep your fleets away from Brest and Marseille.

France to Italy, Spring 1937: Confirmed in writing. My units will not enter Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this spring, and F MAO stays out of the Western Mediterranean. I will raise any fleet move toward WES or the Tunisian coast with you first. Keep A TUN and F TYS out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1937: My A BER stays home this spring and will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste. I make no move toward Galicia. Russia is the target for your A BUD-Galicia push, so go ahead. I will tell you before any move near Silesia or Bohemia. Our pact stands.

Germany to France, Spring 1937: Confirmed. My A BEL and A HOL will not enter Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr or Spain-Portugal this spring. Please keep A PAR, A MUN and A MAR out of Belgium, Holland and Kiel. Turkey is the board leader, so I suggest we both press Italy and Austria before we look at each other.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1937: I propose we keep the peace. My A KIE stays out of Denmark, Prussia and Holland against you, and I will keep A BER out of Warsaw and Sweden. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia and Berlin. Turkey, not us, is the threat to both of us, so let us hold this line.

Germany to England, Spring 1937: My fleets stay out of the North Sea and Channel, and I will not move on Edinburgh or London. In return, withdraw F NTH away from Holland, Belgium and Kiel, and keep F LVP out of Denmark. I will confirm the line in writing once F NTH moves.

Italy to France, Spring 1937: Our pact stands and my A TUN and F TYS will not move toward Marseille, Spain or Portugal. On MAO to WES then Tunisian coast: I cannot accept a French fleet entering Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian. A fleet in WES is fine if it stays out of my centres. Any Tunisian move would end our pact, so I need that in writing before anything moves.

Russia to England, Spring 1937: A NOR and A SWE hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. A STP and A WAR are not moving toward you. I still cannot pledge A WAR's future against Germany or Turkey, but keep your fleets off Norway and Sweden and we stay at peace.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1937: Your split is still unacceptable while A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Move one of them into Bulgaria, Serbia or Rumania and I will keep A MOS and A WAR out of your core. If both stay, I will attack Sevastopol this autumn with support.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1937: Agreed on the line. A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin, and I will not move into Denmark or Holland. Keep your KIE army out of Denmark, Prussia and Holland against my units, and keep your armies out of Warsaw and Sweden.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1937: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian this spring, and no Turkish army moves to Apulia, Naples or Albania. Keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece. I will tell you before any change toward Tunis-side waters.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1937: I will hold A SEV and F RUM this spring. Confirm in writing that A MOS, A WAR and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople, and neither of us attacks Sweden or Norway. Break that and I defend SEV fully.

notes.note: Spring 1937: holding all units to keep pacts with Austria, France, Germany, Turkey, all reconfirmed. No unowned centres reachable. Watch Germany near Tyrolia/Vienna. Take TRI with VEN only if Austria collapses and agrees in writing. France asked about MAO-WES fleet; I refused Tunis/Naples/Rome/Venice entry.

Spring 1937: all hold. No unowned centres reachable; SEV attack has no second supporter (no WAR support MOS->SEV option), so it would bounce. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER, no German into WAR/SWE/STP), England (NOR/SWE hold, no Russian unit into NTH/EDI), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI). Turkey split offer unanswered; SEV/RUM still held. Next: in Fall 1937 look for real second supporter

Spring 1937: F ENG to NTH to set up convoy of A LON next turn. Holding LON and LVP. Russia kept NOR/SWE pledge. Germany keeps asking NTH out of Holland/Belgium; watch whether its fleets stay out of the Channel. Convoy only if peace holds.

Spring 1937: F MAO to WES (Italy said a WES fleet is fine if it stays out of its centres), setting up a convoy of A SPA to NAF/TUN next turn. Other units hold to keep pacts with Germany, Italy, England, Turkey. Watch German BEL/HOL/KIE and Italian TUN. Italy's reply on the WES move is still unconfirmed.

Spring 1937: BER attacks France's MUN with KIE supporting. Breaks pact with France on Munich; the 5 centres are otherwise static. Watch Russia and England for retaliation; Denmark, Holland and Belgium held home.

Spring 1937: BUD to GAL supported by VIE per promise to Germany/Russia; TRI holds for Italy; VIE stays home. Germany pledged no entry to VIE/BUD/TRI. Russia asked to keep WAR/MOS/SEV out of BUD. Turkey still at 8; revisit SER/RUM if Turkey vacates. Watch Italy and Germany on TRI/VIE.

Spring 1937: all units defensive. RUM supports SEV hold against Russian attack from MOS/WAR. Pacts: Italy (AEG out of Ionian, no armies Apulia/Naples/Albania), Austria (no entry BUD/VIE/TRI), Germany (fleets out of Black Sea/Aegean), France (fleets west). Russia still hostile on SEV/RUM, no answer. Watch Russia; consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup for future growth.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1937: Our pact has held. I need to know whether your A MUN or A BOH plans anything against Vienna, Budapest or Trieste, or Tyrolia. Russia's Galicia is my target. I will not enter Bohemia or Silesia. Please confirm your Fall moves now.

England to Germany, Fall 1937: F NTH stays in the North Sea this autumn and will not enter Holland, Belgium or Kiel. Your fleets must stay out of the North Sea and Channel. Please confirm in writing that A HOL, A BEL, A KIE and F DEN hold or stay away from Edinburgh, London and Liverpool. Tell me your Russia plan.

France to Germany, Fall 1937: Your A MUN sits on my supply centre, which breaks our pact as I understood it. Explain in writing why it is there and commit to withdrawing it this autumn, or I will treat our pact as void and act to recover Munich and my Burgundy front.

France to Italy, Fall 1937: My F WES stays out of your centres and I make no move on Tunis or Naples this autumn. Please confirm in writing that A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and that you will not shift toward Piedmont or Marseille while I deal with Germany.

Germany to France, Fall 1937: Your A MUN retreated to BUR, and our A MUN now holds Munich. I will keep it and move no army into Burgundy, Ruhr or Belgium this autumn. Please keep A BUR and A PAR out of Munich and Ruhr. Tell me your fall intentions in writing before orders.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1937: I hold Munich now and will keep A MUN in place. My armies will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this autumn. Tell me whether A GAL and A VIE are still pressuring Russia, so we do not collide over Galicia or Silesia.

Italy to France, Fall 1937: Our western pact stands; my A TUN and F TYS stay away from Marseille, Spain and Portugal. Your F WES is fine if it stays out of my centres. Please confirm in writing your units stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian this autumn.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1937: Stop stalling. Turkey has 8 centres and I am boxed in. Propose a real split: your A SEV and F RUM go to Bulgaria or Rumania-free zones, and I take no Turkish centre this autumn. Tell me your concrete Fall orders now, or I will assume war in the south.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1937: France just took MUN and has an army at BUR, so Germany is now the weak point between us. I will keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin as agreed. Are you willing to join me against France along the Rhine? Tell me your autumn orders first.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1937: Turkey is the threat to both of us. I keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia, Budapest and Vienna. Please confirm A GAL stays out of Warsaw and Rumania this autumn, and tell me your Fall orders before we move.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1937: My SEV and RUM hold this autumn and I will not enter Russian land. Your A MOS, A WAR and A STP must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm in writing. Any attack on SEV will be met with full defense.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1937: No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI, and A SER stays put. I need to know whether your A GAL or F TRI move toward Serbia or Rumania this autumn. Germany's Bohemia build-up still concerns us both.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1937: F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army goes to Apulia, Naples or Albania this autumn. Please keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece. Tell me before any change toward Tunis-side waters.

Austria to Germany: Thanks for confirming. I will keep VIE, BUD and TRI in place this autumn and will not move into Bohemia, Silesia or Munich. My A GAL is under pressure from Russia, and I will tell you before any move toward Silesia. Please keep A MUN out of Tyrolia and hold your word on Vienna, Budapest and Trieste.

Austria to Russia: My A GAL is staying put this autumn and will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. I hold VIE, BUD and TRI. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia, Budapest and Vienna as you have pledged. Turkey remains the threat to us both, and I will tell you before any move south.

Austria to Turkey: My A GAL is not moving toward Serbia or Rumania this autumn, and F TRI and A VIE hold. I will not enter your home supply. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste, and tell me before any move toward Galicia. Germany's Bohemia build-up still concerns us both.

France to Germany, Fall 1937: A MUN was dislodged by my own retreat and now sits on my supply centre. That is not acceptable. Withdraw A MUN from Munich this autumn and I will keep A BUR and A PAR out of Munich and Ruhr. Stay out of Burgundy and Belgium as well. Reply in writing before orders are executed; without a withdrawal I will act to recover Munich.

France to Italy, Fall 1937: Confirmed in writing. My units will not enter Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn, and F WES stays out of your centres. I ask that A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and that you do not shift toward Piedmont or Marseille while I deal with Germany.

Germany to Austria: Our pact stands. A MUN holds Munich this autumn and will not enter Vienna, Budapest or Trieste. A BOH is not in play this turn, and I will not move toward Galicia or Silesia without telling you first. Go ahead against Russia in Galicia and keep me informed of your moves.

Germany to England: Confirmed in writing. My A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN stay where they are this autumn and will not enter the North Sea, Channel, Edinburgh, London or Liverpool. Keep F NTH and F LVP away from Holland, Belgium, Denmark and Kiel. We both benefit from holding the line.

Germany to France: A MUN is my army and it stays in Munich this autumn. I will not move into Burgundy, Ruhr or Belgium. If you keep A BUR and A PAR out of Munich and Ruhr, we avoid a clash. Your strongest gains are against Italy in the south, not against me. Tell me your intentions in writing.

Germany to Russia: Our Baltic line holds. My armies will not enter Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg, and I keep my units out of your centres. I am not joining a war against France this autumn, but I will keep the peace along the Rhine. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia and Berlin as agreed.

Italy to France, Fall 1937: Confirmed in writing. A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this autumn. Your F WES may stay out of my centres. I make no move toward Piedmont or Marseille. Please keep your units out of Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice and the Tyrrhenian, and tell me in writing before any change in the western Mediterranean.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1937: Confirmed. My A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS stay off Greece and Albania this autumn. I expect F AEG to stay out of the Ionian and no Turkish army in Apulia, Naples or Albania. I will tell you before any change toward Greece or Tunis-side waters. Keep me informed of any move toward Serbia or Trieste.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1937: I have heard your split offer many times and it stays unsigned while A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Your word is not enough after ten years of standoff. If SEV or RUM is still held at Spring 1938's start, I will attack SEV. Move one of them into Bulgaria or Serbia now and I will keep A MOS and A WAR out of your core.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1937: Our SEV and RUM hold this autumn and we will not enter Russian land. Your A MOS, A WAR and A STP must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Any attack on SEV will be met with full defense. Confirm in writing, and the split stands.

notes.note: Fall 1937: holding LON, LVP, NTH. Germany confirmed in writing it keeps A BEL, A HOL, A KIE, F DEN out of North Sea, Channel, EDI, LON, LVP. Russia kept NOR/SWE pledge. No unowned centres reachable. Keep peace; reassess a convoy plan (A LON via NTH) only if Germany breaks its word.

Fall 1937: hold all to keep 5 SCs and take MUN by staying. France threatens MUN; Austria and Russia pacts hold. England says NTH stays out of HOL/BEL/KIE. Next: check France's BUR/PAR moves; consider a Russia alliance if France attacks MUN.

Fall 1937: holding all units. Pacts confirmed by France, Turkey, Austria. No unowned centres reachable; attacking breaks pacts. Watch Germany near Tyrolia/Vienna; take TRI with VEN only if Austria collapses and agrees in writing. Italy has 4 centres and must find growth later.

Fall 1937: all hold. No unowned centres reachable; SEV attack lacks a second supporter. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER, no German into WAR/SWE/STP, they kept it), England (NOR/SWE hold, no Russian unit into NTH/EDI), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI, they kept it), Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. Next: if SEV/RUM held in Spring 1938, reconsider attack with a real second supporte

Fall 1937: GAL returns to empty BUD to retake our center; VIE and TRI hold. Germany, Italy, Turkey and Russia have kept their word so far. Watch Germany's MUN/BOH and Russia's WAR. Next: hold VIE/BUD/TRI, then revisit GAL moves once the position is secure.

Fall 1937: BUR attacks MUN (German-held, my centre) to pressure Germany; others hold to keep Italy pact. Germany promised A MUN stays and no moves into BUR/RUH/BEL, but has not withdrawn. Italy confirmed in writing A TUN/F TYS stay out of MAR/SPA/POR; I keep WES out of Italian centres. Next: check if MUN attack bounced; revisit convoy via WES if Italy stays cooperative.

Fall 1937: holding all 8 centres; no unowned centres in reach. Hold SEV and RUM as promised, RUM supports SEV. Russia demands split, unsigned; watch A MOS/WAR. Italy and Austria kept their pacts so far. Consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup later.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Spring 1938: Our pact has held. Your new army in Berlin is fine by me. Are you moving A MUN or A BOH against Bohemia, Silesia or Tyrolia this spring? I hold VIE, BUD, TRI and will not enter Bohemia or Munich. Please confirm you will not enter VIE, BUD or TRI.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1938: Turkey is growing fast at 8 centres. I ask that A WAR, A MOS and A SEV stay out of Galicia and Budapest again. I am keeping my units home this spring. Tell me your plans for Galicia and Warsaw so we avoid collisions.

England to Germany, Spring 1938: My fleets are holding and keeping their pledges. I want to know your plans for Holland and Belgium this year. If your fleets stay out of the North Sea and Channel, I will keep F NTH out of Holland, Belgium and Kiel. Please confirm in writing.

England to Russia, Spring 1938: A NOR and A SWE have kept their hold, and I have kept my fleets off Norway and Sweden. Germany is growing strong on our shared border. Will you confirm in writing whether A WAR and A STP plan any move toward Prussia or Berlin this year?

England to France, Spring 1938: My A LON, F LVP and F NTH are holding and will not enter Belgium, Picardy, Brest or Spain-Portugal. Please confirm your A PAR, A MAR, A POR and A SPA stay out of Belgium and Holland this spring, and tell me your plans for F WES.

France to Italy, Spring 1938: Our western pact has held. I propose we keep it while I move F WES toward MAO, and I will not enter Tunis or Naples. In return, confirm in writing that A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this spring and autumn.

France to Germany, Spring 1938: Your A MUN holds Munich, which you say is yours, and A BEL/HOL sit near Burgundy. Confirm in writing that you will not move into Burgundy, Picardy or Ruhr this spring, and I will keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr and Belgium.

France to England, Spring 1938: Confirm in writing that F HOL and A LON stay out of Belgium, Picardy, Brest and Spain-Portugal this spring. My A PAR, A BRE and A MAR will stay out of Belgium and Holland. Any change must be proposed in writing first.

Germany to France, Spring 1938: Burgundy is now an unowned centre. I intend A MUN to BUR this spring. Keep A PAR out of Burgundy and Ruhr, and I will keep my armies out of Picardy, Gascony and Spain-Portugal. Tell me in writing whether you accept this split before orders.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1938: My A BER and A KIE stay out of Prussia, Warsaw and Sweden this spring, and I make no move against your centres. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin as agreed. Tell me your spring orders so we avoid any collision.

Italy to Germany, Spring 1938: Our pact stands. Please confirm in writing no German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont this spring. Also tell me whether A MUN or A BOH plans anything against Tyrolia or Vienna this year, since Austria and I both watch that border.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1938: Your SEV and RUM are still on my border. Move A SEV out to Rumania or Bulgaria, or move F RUM into the Black Sea, and A MOS and A WAR stay out of your core this year. Tell me your Spring orders before we move.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1938: Turkey holds SEV and RUM against both of us. Tell me your Spring orders. If you press Rumania or Serbia, I keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia and Budapest and will not take any Austrian centre.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1938: Russia, your armies at MOS and WAR are the threat to my SEV and RUM. I hold both this spring. Let us stop the standoff: confirm A MOS, A WAR and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople, and I keep SEV and RUM defensive. Breaking that means full war in the south.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1938: Your Berlin and Kiel build-up worries me. Confirm again your armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean. My F RUM and A SEV stay away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic while you keep to Austria and the west.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1938: Thank you. My VIE, BUD and TRI hold this spring and no Austrian unit enters Galicia, Warsaw or Rumania. I ask the same for A WAR, A MOS and A SEV regarding Galicia and Budapest. Turkey at 8 centres is the shared danger; if Turkey's SEV or RUM moves north, let us coordinate immediately and in writing before any Rumania move.

England to France, Spring 1938: Correction for the record: I have no fleet in Holland. My units are A LON, F LVP and F NTH, and all three will hold this spring. None will enter Belgium, Picardy, Brest or Spain-Portugal. Please confirm in writing that your armies and F WES stay out of Belgium, Holland and the Channel. Any change must be proposed in writing first.

France to England: Confirmed in writing. My A PAR, A BRE and A MAR hold this spring and will not enter Belgium or Holland. Your A LON, F LVP and F NTH stay out of Brest, Picardy, Belgium and Spain-Portugal as you state. F WES stays in the western Mediterranean approaches and will not enter your waters. Any change, I will propose in writing first.

Austria, our pact stands. A MUN will not enter Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest or Trieste this spring, and I have no army aimed at Bohemia. A BER and A KIE stay home. Continue against Russia in Galicia and tell me before any move near Silesia.

Italy, confirmed in writing: no German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont this spring, and A TYR does not move to Piedmont. Nothing I hold is aimed at Tyrolia or Vienna. Keep A VEN and A ROM off Tyrolia, and we will discuss Trieste only after Austria falls.

Turkey, confirmed again: my armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria, and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I am focused on the west and Austria. Keep F RUM and A SEV away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic, and we both gain.

England, I will keep A HOL, A BEL, A KIE and F DEN out of the North Sea, Channel, Edinburgh, London and Liverpool. Move F NTH away from Holland and Kiel, and I will confirm that line in writing again. My plan is Austria and the west, not your islands.

France, I propose A MUN moves to Burgundy this spring, since Burgundy is unowned. In return keep A PAR out of Burgundy and Ruhr, and keep A MAR out of Munich. I will not enter Picardy, Gascony or Spain-Portugal. Accept in writing before orders.

Italy to France, Spring 1938: I have held our western pact and will keep it. My A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this spring and autumn, as pledged. Your F WES may move toward MAO while it stays out of my centres. I will not accept any French unit entering Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian. Confirm in writing that you keep that line.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1938: I confirm A WAR and A MOS stay out of Galicia and Budapest this spring. My plan is to hold WAR and MOS and watch Turkey's SEV and RUM. Tell me your Spring orders before the autumn, and I will tell you mine first if anything changes.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1938: I will not sign a split while SEV and RUM sit on my border. Move A SEV into Rumania or Bulgaria, or move F RUM into the Black Sea, and I will keep A MOS and A WAR out of your core. Hold both and I will treat the southern border as hostile this autumn.

Russia to England, Spring 1938: A NOR and A SWE hold this spring, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. I cannot confirm A WAR's future in writing, but I have no plan against Prussia or Berlin this spring. Keep your fleets off Norway and Sweden and we stay at peace.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1938: A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin this spring, as agreed. Keep your armies out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg, and keep KIE out of Denmark, Prussia and Holland against my units. My spring orders are holds on my western and central units.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1938: I hold A SEV and F RUM this spring and will not move them toward Moscow or Warsaw. A SMY and A ANK stay out of your centres. My written offer stands: A MOS, A WAR and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm that and our standoff ends; break it and I defend SEV and RUM fully.

notes.note: Spring 1938: all hold again. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER, they keep out of WAR/SWE/STP), England (NOR/SWE hold), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. Next: Fall 1938 consider SEV attack only with real second supporter; watch Germany KIE/BER.

Spring 1938: holding VIE, BUD, TRI as pledged to Germany, Russia, Italy, Turkey. Russia confirmed WAR/MOS stay out of GAL/BUD. Germany confirmed MUN won't enter VIE/BUD/TRI. Turkey at 8 is the threat; revisit SER/RUM only if Turkey vacates or a pact breaks.

Spring 1938: holding all 8 centres defensively as promised to Russia/Austria/Italy/Germany. Russia hostile on SEV/RUM, no signed split. Germany and Italy kept pacts. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup for growth; watch A MOS/WAR.

Spring 1938: MUN to BUR (unowned SC). BEL, HOL, KIE, BER, DEN hold. Pacts: Austria, Italy, Turkey, England, Russia kept so far. France pact on BUR is disputed; watch France's PAR. Next: consolidate BUR, look for unowned SCs.
Spring 1938: holding army units to keep pacts with Germany, England, Italy. F WES to MAO to set up convoy of A SPA/POR later. Watch German BEL/HOL/MUN near PAR/BUR; Italy pact held so far.

Spring 1938: holding all units to keep pacts with Austria, France, Germany and Turkey. Germany confirmed no move to Venice/Trieste/Piedmont. No unowned centres. Take TRI with VEN only if Austria collapses and agrees in writing; watch Germany near Tyrolia and Vienna.

Spring 1938: NTH moved to ENG to set up a convoy of A LON next turn, keeping pledges to France and Germany (no Holland/Belgium/Kiel). Germany and Russia have kept pledges so far. Watch German fleets in NTH/Channel. Consider convoy to BEL/HOL only if peace breaks.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Fall 1938: You now hold 8 centres and I have three. I need a Serbia or Rumania outlet eventually. Will A SER stay in Serbia this autumn, or will it move south or east? Please say before any move. I will keep VIE, BUD and TRI in place and stay out of your home supply.

Austria to Germany, Fall 1938: Our pact has held. I am boxed in with three centres. Russia is the weakest neighbour to my north. Will your armies stay out of Bohemia and Silesia, and will you press Russia from Prussia and Warsaw? Please tell me your Fall orders so we do not collide. I hold VIE, BUD and TRI this turn.

England to Germany, Fall 1938: Your fleets have kept their word, and so have mine. I propose we both keep the status quo this autumn. If Russia moves on Prussia or Berlin, I want your written notice first. Will you confirm in writing that A BEL, A HOL and A KIE stay out of the North Sea and Channel?

England to France, Fall 1938: Your armies have held Paris, Marseilles and Brest as pledged. I propose we both hold this autumn. Please tell me in writing whether A PAR or A BRE plans to enter Belgium or Picardy in 1939, and whether F WES will stay in the western Mediterranean.

France to Germany, Fall 1938: Your A BUR stands next to my PAR and MAR. Confirm in writing that A BUR does not enter Picardy, Gascony, Paris or Marseille this autumn, and that A BEL and A HOL stay out of Belgium's French approaches. I will keep A PAR out of Burgundy and Ruhr in return.

France to England, Fall 1938: Confirm in writing that F ENG, A LON and F LVP will not enter Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain-Portugal this autumn. My A PAR, A POR and A SPA hold, and F MAO stays out of your waters. Any change, propose it to me in writing first.

France to Italy, Fall 1938: Please confirm in writing that A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this autumn. My F MAO stays out of your centres and my armies do not enter Tunis, Naples, Rome or Venice. Tell me in writing if your plans in the western Mediterranean change.

Germany to France, Fall 1938: A BUR holds Burgundy this autumn and A BEL, A HOL stay home. I will not enter Picardy, Gascony or Spain-Portugal. Munich is empty; I ask that your armies stay out of Munich, Ruhr and Belgium. Confirm in writing before orders.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1938: My A BER, A KIE and F DEN hold this autumn and will not enter Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Please keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia and Berlin as agreed. Tell me your autumn orders so we avoid any collision.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1938: Our pact stands. I hold all units this autumn. Please confirm in writing A VIE and F TRI hold, and that no Austrian unit moves toward Venice or Piedmont. Tell me at once if German units move on Tyrolia or Vienna.

Italy to France, Fall 1938: Our western pact stands and A TUN and F TYS hold this autumn. Confirm in writing your F MAO and A POR stay out of Spain-Portugal-Marseille threats toward me, and that no French unit enters Tunis, Naples, Rome or Venice.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1938: I hold all units this autumn. Confirm in writing F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. Tell me before any move toward Greece or Tunis-side waters.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1938: Your SEV and RUM still sit on my border and I cannot sign a split while they do. Move A SEV into Rumania or Bulgaria, or F RUM into the Black Sea, and my A MOS and A WAR stay out of your core this autumn. Tell me your orders first.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1938: France holds MUN and BUR, so you are the natural partner on the Rhine. Will you confirm your autumn orders now? I keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin as agreed, and I expect your armies to stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1938: I keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia, Budapest and Vienna as pledged. Please confirm A GAL stays out of Warsaw and Rumania and tell me your autumn orders before any move south. Turkey remains our shared danger.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1938: Russia, your A MOS and A WAR are poised on my border. I still offer the split: A MOS, A WAR and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople, and my SEV and RUM stay defensive. Confirm in writing and both our fronts stay quiet this autumn.

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1938: Your Berlin and Kiel build-up still concerns me. Confirm again that your armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I will keep F RUM and A SEV away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic while we both focus on Austria and the west.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1938: No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI this autumn. Are A GAL or F TRI moving toward Serbia or Rumania? Please tell me before any move, and let us both watch Germany's Bohemia build-up.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1938: Confirmed. A VIE, F TRI and A BUD hold this autumn. No Austrian unit moves toward Venice or Piedmont. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. I will warn you at once if German units move on Tyrolia or Vienna.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1938: My A GAL stays put this autumn and will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. VIE, BUD and TRI hold. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest as pledged. I will share my spring 1939 plans before any move south or east.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1938: Neither A GAL nor F TRI moves toward Serbia or Rumania this autumn. VIE, BUD and TRI hold. A SER stays in Serbia as far as I know. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste, and I will tell you before any move south.

England to France, Fall 1938: Confirmed in writing. My F ENG, A LON and F LVP will not enter Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain-Portugal this autumn, and I will not move against your western units. Please keep A PAR, A POR and A SPA, and F MAO, out of Belgium, Picardy, the Channel and my waters. Any change must be proposed in writing before any order is executed.

France to England, Fall 1938: Confirmed in writing. My A PAR, A POR and A SPA hold this autumn, and F MAO stays out of your waters. My armies will not enter Belgium, Picardy, Brest or your home waters. Any change I will propose to you in writing first.

Germany to Austria: Our pact stands. My armies will not enter Vienna, Budapest, Trieste or Tyrolia this autumn. I have no orders aimed at Bohemia or Silesia. Russia's Galicia is yours to pressure. Tell me before any move near Silesia, and I will do the same.

Germany to England: Confirmed in writing. My A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN will not enter the North Sea, Channel, Edinburgh, London or Liverpool this autumn. Keep F NTH away from Holland, Belgium and Kiel. I will give you notice before any move toward Prussia or Berlin.

Germany to France: A BUR holds Burgundy this autumn. I will not enter Picardy, Gascony, Paris or Marseille, nor Spain-Portugal. Munich is empty and I ask that your armies stay out of Munich, Ruhr and Belgium. Keep A PAR out of Burgundy and Ruhr and we avoid a clash.

Germany to Russia: My A BER, A KIE and F DEN hold this autumn and will not enter Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia and Berlin as agreed. I am not joining a war against France. Send your autumn orders so we avoid any collision.

Germany to Turkey: Confirmed again. My armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria, and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I am focused on Austria and the west. Keep F RUM and A SEV away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic, and we both gain.

Italy to France, Fall 1938: Confirmed in writing. A TUN and F TYS hold this autumn and will not move toward Marseille, Spain or Portugal. Your F MAO may stay out of my centres. No French army or fleet enters Tunis, Naples, Rome or Venice from my side as long as you keep the same line. If you move toward Tunis or Naples, I will treat our pact as void and act accordingly. Please confirm your F WES stays out of my centres too.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1938: Confirmed. A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin this autumn, and I make no move into Denmark, Holland or Kiel. Keep your A BER, A KIE and F DEN out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. If France pushes on the Rhine, I am willing to discuss coordinated action against Paris later, once I see your spring orders.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1938: I still cannot sign a split while A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Move A SEV into Rumania or Bulgaria, or F RUM into the Black Sea, and my A MOS and A WAR stay out of your core. Hold both again and I will treat the southern border as hostile in Spring 1939.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1938: No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI this autumn. A SER stays in Serbia and F RUM stays put. I have no move toward Galicia now. I will tell you before any change toward Rumania or Serbia, and I ask you to do the same.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1938: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian this autumn, and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. I have no move toward Greece or Tunis-side waters. Keep your A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania, and I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1938: My SEV and RUM hold again this autumn and will not enter Russian land. Your A MOS, A WAR and A STP must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm in writing and our southern front stays quiet. Break it and I defend SEV and RUM fully.
