notes.note: Fall 1938: holding all units to keep pacts with France, Austria, Germany, Turkey (all reconfirmed). Italy at 4 centres, no unowned centres reachable. Take TRI with VEN only if Austria collapses and agrees in writing. Watch Germany near Tyrolia/Vienna. Need growth later.

Fall 1938: all hold again. No unowned centres reachable; SEV attack lacks real second supporter. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), England (NOR/SWE hold), Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. Next: reconsider SEV attack in Spring 1939 if Turkey holds.
Fall 1938: BUR moves to MUN (our SC, empty) to secure it; others hold home. Pacts with Russia, England, France, Austria, Turkey mostly holding. Watch France on BUR/MUN and Russia on Prussia/Berlin.

Fall 1938: F MAO to WES to set up convoy of A SPA to NAF/TUN next turn; Italy said WES is fine if it stays out of its centres. Armies hold to keep pacts with Germany, England, Italy. Watch German BUR/BEL/HOL near PAR/MAR. Revisit convoy if Italy stays cooperative.

Fall 1938: holding VIE, BUD, TRI. All pacts (Germany, Italy, Turkey, Russia) have held. Galicia is not a center, so no gain there. Revisit Serbia/Rumania only if Turkey vacates or a pact breaks. Next: check spring 1939 moves and watch Turkish SER/RUM.

Fall 1938: holding all units to keep pledges. Germany, France and Russia all confirmed peace in writing, and none has broken theirs. Keep fleets out of the North Sea and Channel toward Holland, Belgium, Kiel and Brest. Plan: F ENG to NTH only if peace holds, then A LON convoy later. Watch for Russian moves on Prussia or Berlin.

Fall 1938: holding all 8 centres defensively, keeping promises to Austria, Italy, Germany and Russia. No unowned centres reachable. Russia has not signed a split and is still hostile on SEV/RUM. Next: reconsider F RUM to BLA convoy setup if Russia stays hostile; watch A MOS/WAR and Austria's A GAL.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Spring 1939: You lead at 8 centres, so I need a route to grow. Will A SER and F RUM leave Serbia and Rumania without a fight, or will you hold them? If you move south, I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI and stay out of your home supply. Please answer before your orders.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1939: Turkey is the shared threat, so I propose we stay honest with each other. A GAL stays out of Warsaw and Rumania this spring, and I ask that A WAR, A MOS and A SEV keep out of Galicia and Budapest. Tell me your Spring orders first.

England to France, Spring 1939: Germany is the only power that can threaten both of us. I propose we coordinate for autumn: if you are ready to move on Belgium, I will support with F ENG and F LVP into the Channel and North Sea. Please answer in writing before any order.

England to Russia, Spring 1939: Germany holds six centres and borders you at Berlin and Prussia. I am keeping F ENG, A LON and F LVP at home and off Norway and Sweden. If you move against Germany, please tell me in writing first so we can talk about a shared plan.

France to Germany, Spring 1939: Your A MUN, BUR and BEL units are close to my PAR and MAR. Confirm in writing that none of your armies enter Burgundy, Picardy or Ruhr this spring, and I will keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr and Belgium. Tell me your Spring orders before we commit.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1939: My A BER, A KIE, F DEN and A MUN hold this spring and will not enter Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Tell me your spring orders and whether A WAR or A MOS plans anything toward Prussia or Berlin. I remain open to coordinated action against France later.

Germany to France, Spring 1939: A MUN holds Munich and A BEL, A HOL stay home this spring. Confirm in writing that your armies stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium, and I will keep my armies out of Picardy, Gascony, Paris, Marseille and Spain-Portugal. Tell me your spring orders before we move.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1939: Our pact stands and I am holding all units this spring. Germany has moved units toward your border in my reports. If A MUN or A BOH moves on Tyrolia or Vienna, tell me at once. I will then consider moving A VEN to support your defence of Tyrolia. Please confirm in writing that F TRI and A VIE will not move toward Venice this year.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1939: Your SEV and RUM have sat on my border for two years. I am done waiting. Unless you move A SEV or F RUM out of my reach now, I will strike SEV this autumn with support. Give me your Spring 1939 orders in writing before I commit.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1939: Your A MOS, A WAR and A STP have been poised on my border for years. Sign the split now: no Russian unit enters Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia or Constantinople, and my SEV and RUM stay put. Otherwise I will defend fully and watch for Russian moves toward SEV.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1939: Your Berlin and Kiel build-up still worries me. Confirm once more that your armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean. My F RUM and A SEV stay away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic. Tell me if you plan any move east.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1939: No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. A SER and F RUM hold. If Russia attacks my southern border, I will ask you to keep your Galicia forces out of Rumania and Serbia. Please tell me before any move toward Serbia.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1939: Our pact stands. A VIE and F TRI hold this spring and will not move toward Venice. A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS must stay off Trieste and Albania. Germany's A MUN is the threat; if it moves on Tyrolia or Vienna I will warn you at once and welcome your support from A VEN.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1939: Thank you. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold, and I will not move toward Serbia or Rumania this spring. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. If Russia attacks your south, I will consider my Galicia options, and I will tell you before any move.

France to England, Spring 1939: I have read your proposal. I am not ready to commit to any autumn move on Belgium, and I will not promise anything in writing before orders this spring. My A PAR, A BRE and A MAR hold and stay out of Belgium and Holland. Keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal, and we can talk again in the autumn.

France to Germany, Spring 1939: Your A MUN is still on my Munich centre, and I cannot accept that while it stays. I will not confirm the split. My A PAR and A MAR hold this spring. If A MUN moves out of Munich and your armies stay out of Burgundy, Picardy and Ruhr, we can keep the pact. Otherwise I will act against Munich.

Germany to France, Spring 1939: A MUN holds Munich, and A BEL and A HOL stay home this spring. I will not move into Picardy, Burgundy, Ruhr, Gascony, Paris, Marseille or Spain-Portugal. Keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Belgium and Burgundy, and we both avoid a clash. Your gains lie against Italy, not me.

Germany to Turkey, Spring 1939: Confirmed again. My armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria, and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I am focused on Austria and the west, not your centres. Keep F RUM and A SEV away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic, and we both gain.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1939: A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this spring and will not enter Galicia or Budapest. I expect your A GAL to stay out of Warsaw and Rumania as you pledged. I will tell you before any autumn move that touches your border.

Russia to England, Spring 1939: A NOR and A SWE hold this spring. No Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. I have no move against Germany planned for Spring. Keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP off Norway and Sweden, and we will talk again before any change.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1939: A WAR and A MOS hold this spring and stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Please keep your armies out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg as agreed. I am open to discussing coordinated action against France once the autumn picture is clearer.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1939: I will not sign a split while A SEV and F RUM stand on my border. Hold this spring and I keep my units defensive. Move either unit into Rumania, Bulgaria or the Black Sea and we can talk. Any Turkish move north toward Moscow or Warsaw ends the standoff.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1939: Our pact holds. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI, and A SER and F RUM hold this spring. I will not move toward Serbia or Rumania without telling you first. If Russia strikes south, I expect your Galicia forces to stay out of Rumania and Serbia, and I will do the same toward Galicia.

notes.note: Spring 1939: holding all units to keep pacts with Austria, France, Germany, Turkey. No unowned centres reachable. Watch German A MUN near Tyrolia/Vienna; support VIE with VEN only if Austria confirms attack. Need growth later.

Spring 1939: holding VIE, BUD, TRI as pledged to Germany, Italy, Turkey, Russia. All pacts have held so far. Watch German A MUN/BOH toward VIE/TRI; Italy offered A VEN support if attacked. Revisit GAL/SER/RUM only if a pact breaks or Turkey vacates SER.

Spring 1939: all hold. Attack on SEV has no real second supporter, so it would bounce. Pacts kept: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), England (NOR/SWE hold). Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. Next: find a second supporter for SEV, or look for unowned centres.

Spring 1939: armies hold to keep pacts with Germany, England, Italy. F WES to MAO to set up a possible SPA convoy to NAF next turn. Germany's A MUN is still on Munich and Germany has not confirmed a withdrawal; watch BUR/PIC/BEL. England and Italy have not broken pacts yet.

Spring 1939: holding all 6 SCs. France's A MUN threat is noted; MUN held. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking pacts. Watch France (MUN, BUR) and Russia (PRU, SIL). Consider DEN->NTH convoy to BEL/HOL next turn if a target opens.

Spring 1939: F ENG to NTH to set up A LON convoy, as planned. No unowned centres. LON and LVP hold. France refused autumn Belgium pact; Russia and Germany keep pledges. Watch German fleets near NTH/Channel. Convoy only if peace breaks or a centre opens.

Spring 1939: holding all 8 centres. RUM supports SEV hold against Russian threat. Pacts: Austria (no entry BUD/VIE/TRI, SER stays), Germany (fleets out of Black Sea/Aegean), Italy (AEG out of Ionian). Russia still refuses split and hostile on SEV/RUM. Watch for Russian strike on SEV in Fall 1939. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup if no attack.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Fall 1939: Turkey leads at 8 centres and my pacts have held. I will keep VIE, BUD and TRI in place and stay out of Serbia and Rumania. Please confirm your Fall orders for A SER, F RUM and A BUL, and keep them out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1939: Thank you for keeping A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. Turkey is the shared danger at 8 centres. Please tell me your Fall orders before any move south, and I will keep A GAL out of Warsaw and Rumania as pledged.

England to Germany, Fall 1939: Your fleets have kept their word. I need to know whether A BEL, A HOL and A KIE will stay put this autumn or move toward France or Belgium. Please confirm in writing what your Western and Russian plans are, and whether F DEN stays out of the North Sea.

England to France, Fall 1939: Germany is massing on our shared border. If A PAR or A BRE moves to Belgium this autumn, I want to know in writing before orders. I will keep F ENG and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal, and I ask you to keep F MAO out of the Channel and my waters.

France to Germany, Fall 1939: My A PAR, A MAR and A SPA hold this autumn and I will not enter Burgundy, Picardy, Ruhr or Belgium. Please confirm in writing that A MUN, A BUR-area units and your Low Countries armies stay out of Burgundy, Picardy and Gascony. Any change, tell me first.

France to Italy, Fall 1939: My F MAO moves to WES this autumn, staying out of your centres, and my armies hold in Spain, Portugal and Marseille. Please confirm in writing that A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and that you will not move toward Corsica or Marseille.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1939: I propose coordinated action against France this autumn. My A MUN and A BUR can press France's Munich and Burgundy while your A WAR holds Prussia-facing positions. Confirm you will not move toward Berlin, Kiel or Denmark, and tell me your autumn orders first.

Germany to France, Fall 1939: Munich is the sore point between us. A MUN holds this autumn and will not move. Confirm your A PAR and A MAR stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium, and I will keep my armies off Picardy, Paris, Marseille and Spain-Portugal. Tell me your autumn orders.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1939: Germany's A MUN is massing near your border. I propose we coordinate: if Germany attacks Tyrolia or Vienna, I will move A VEN to support your defence. Please confirm F TRI and A VIE hold this autumn, and tell me your plans for Trieste.

Italy to Germany, Fall 1939: Please confirm in writing that no German unit enters Venice, Trieste, Piedmont or Tyrolia this autumn. Also tell me whether A MUN or A BOH plans to attack Vienna or Tyrolia. My A VEN and A ROM will stay put while our pact holds.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1939: Turkey's SEV and RUM are the threat to both of us. Propose we coordinate: your A BUD moves toward Serbia or Rumania this autumn while my A WAR and A MOS hold and watch. Confirm your Fall orders in writing before anything moves, and I will confirm mine first.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1939: Your SEV and RUM still sit on my border. Move one of them out of reach this autumn, or I will treat any Turkish move into Ukraine or Galicia as the end of the standoff. Hold both and I keep my armies in place. Answer in writing before Spring 1940.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1939: I keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin, as agreed. Please confirm your Fall 1939 orders and keep your armies out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. Once Turkey is settled, I am willing to discuss coordinated action against France.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1939: Your A MOS, A WAR and A STP have been poised on my border too long. I will hold SEV and RUM this autumn if your armies stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm in writing now, and both our southern fronts stay quiet.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1939: I have kept my word. No Turkish unit has entered BUD, VIE or TRI, and A SER and F RUM hold. Tell me now if your Galicia forces plan any move toward Rumania or Serbia. I will hold my positions.

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1939: Your Berlin and Kiel build-up still worries me. Confirm once more that your armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean. My F RUM and A SEV remain defensive.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1939: Confirmed. F TRI and A VIE hold this autumn. No Austrian unit moves toward Venice or Piedmont. A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS must stay off Trieste and Albania. If German A MUN moves on Tyrolia or Vienna, I will call on your A VEN immediately.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1939: My VIE, BUD and TRI hold this autumn, and I will not move toward Serbia or Rumania. Please keep A SER, A BUL and A RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. Confirm your Fall orders for A SER, F RUM and A BUL, and tell me before any change.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1939: My A BUD is holding this autumn, not moving toward Serbia or Rumania. A GAL stays out of Warsaw and Rumania as pledged. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. I will share any change before it happens.

France to England, Fall 1939: I have no plan to move A PAR or A BRE into Belgium this autumn, and I will not put any army in Belgium or Picardy without first writing to you. My F MAO will stay out of the Channel and your waters. Please keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal as you have confirmed. Any change, we talk first.

England, confirmed in writing: A BEL, A HOL and A KIE hold this autumn and will not enter the North Sea, Channel, Edinburgh, London or Liverpool. F DEN stays out of the North Sea. Keep F NTH away from Holland, Belgium, Kiel and Denmark. My plans stay with Western Europe and the centre, not your islands.

Italy, confirmed in writing: no German unit enters Venice, Trieste, Piedmont or Tyrolia this autumn. A MUN holds Munich and has no orders against Vienna or Tyrolia. Keep A VEN and A ROM off Tyrolia and Piedmont, and we will discuss Trieste only after Austria falls.

France, A MUN holds this autumn and will not move. I will keep my armies out of Picardy, Burgundy, Paris, Marseille, Gascony and Spain-Portugal. Confirm your A PAR, A MAR and A SPA stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium, and we both avoid a clash this year.

Turkey, confirmed again: my armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria, and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean this autumn. I am focused on Austria and the west. Keep F RUM and A SEV away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic, and we both stay safe.

Russia, my A BER, A KIE and F DEN hold this autumn and will not enter Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. I am open to coordinated action against France later, once Turkey and the autumn picture are clearer.

Italy to France, Fall 1939: Confirmed in writing. A TUN and F TYS hold their zones this autumn and will not move toward Marseille, Spain or Portugal. I will not move toward Corsica or Marseille. Your F MAO to WES is acceptable so long as it stays out of Italian centres. Any change to this line, we discuss in writing first.

Russia to Austria: Agreed in principle. Fall 1939: A WAR and A MOS hold, no move toward Galicia or Budapest. Please confirm your A BUD and A GAL orders in writing first. Note Austria's move toward Serbia or Rumania is your call; I will not object while A GAL stays out of Warsaw and Rumania is not entered by you without warning.

Russia to Germany: Confirmed. A WAR and A MOS hold this autumn and stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Our armies stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. I will not decide on any move against France until you confirm your Fall 1939 orders in writing, including A MUN and A BUR staying away from Holland and Belgium.

Russia to Turkey: I will not sign a split while A SEV and F RUM stand on my border. Move one of them out of reach this autumn and my A WAR and A MOS stay put in their cores. Hold both and the southern border remains hostile. Answer in writing before Spring 1940.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1939: Our pact holds. A SER and F RUM hold this autumn, and A BUL holds too. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Please keep your Galicia forces out of Serbia and Rumania, and tell me before any move toward them.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1939: My SEV and RUM hold this autumn. I will not enter Russian land. Your A MOS, A WAR and A STP must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm that in writing and our southern front stays quiet. Any attack on SEV meets full defense.

notes.note: Fall 1939: holding all units to keep pacts with France, Germany, Austria, Turkey (all reconfirmed in writing). No unowned centres. Still 4 centres. Consider growth via TRI only if Austria collapses and agrees in writing; watch German A MUN near Tyrolia/Vienna. Possible later plan: F TYS to ION/WES to convoy A TUN.

Fall 1939: F MAO to WES per Italy's accepted line, staying out of Italian centres. Armies hold to keep pacts with Germany, England, Italy. Germany's A MUN still sits on my-claimed Munich; watch BUR/PAR. Plan convoy of A SPA via WES later.

Fall 1939: holding all 6 SCs, keeping pacts with France, Russia, Italy, Turkey, England. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking pacts. Watch France on MUN/BUR and Russia on PRU/SIL. Next: consider convoy F DEN->NTH to reach BEL/HOL targets if a centre opens.

Fall 1939: all hold. No unowned centres; SEV attack still lacks a second supporter. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER; they keep out of WAR/SWE/STP), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI), England (NOR/SWE hold). Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. Next: watch Turkey's SEV/RUM and any German move on DEN/KIE; consider Germany coalition vs France later.

Fall 1939: No unowned centres and peace holds; Germany, France pledged, Russia quiet. Holding LON/LVP, NTH to ENG to set up A LON convoy if a centre opens or peace breaks. Watch German DEN/BEL/HOL moves.

Fall 1939: holding BUD, TRI, VIE to keep pacts with Germany, Italy, Turkey, Russia. No support available for an attack on SER, so no move. Turkey leads at 8; revisit SER/RUM if Turkey vacates or a pact breaks. Watch German MUN and Russian WAR.

Fall 1939: holding all 8 centres. RUM supports SEV holding against Russian threat. Austria and Germany have kept pacts so far. Russia still refuses split. No unowned centres reachable. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup if Russia stays quiet; watch A MOS/WAR/STP.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Spring 1940: Your SER and RUM units are blocking my southern options, and I am boxed in with three centres. I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI this spring. Will you move A SER or F RUM this spring, or hold? Please say before any move so we avoid collision.

England to Germany, Spring 1940: Turkey leads with 8 centres and no one can stop it alone. I want your written confirmation that A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN stay out of the North Sea and Channel this year. In return, I will keep F ENG and F LVP away from Belgium, Holland, Denmark and Kiel. Tell me if you plan any move against France or Russia.

England to France, Spring 1940: Are A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F WES staying put this year? I will keep F ENG and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal as before. If Germany moves on Belgium or Picardy, I want to coordinate with you in writing before any order.

France to Germany, Spring 1940: Your A MUN still sits on Munich, my centre-claim. I will hold my armies out of Burgundy and Ruhr this spring, but I want A MUN to withdraw to Burgundy-free territory, e.g. Tyrolia, or I will treat Munich as contested. Please answer in writing before orders.

France to Italy, Spring 1940: Please confirm in writing that A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain and Portugal this spring, and that no Italian unit enters Corsica or the Gulf of Lyon. My F WES stays out of your centres and my armies hold.

France to England, Spring 1940: My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA and A POR hold this spring, and F WES stays out of the Channel and your waters. Please confirm F ENG, A LON and F LVP stay out of Brest and Spain-Portugal, as before. Any change, we talk first.

Germany to France: Munich is the core of our dispute. Ask: will your A PAR and A MAR stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium this spring? If you confirm in writing, I will keep my armies out of Picardy, Paris, Marseille, Gascony and Spain-Portugal. Otherwise I must consider where my A MUN is most useful.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1940: Our pact stands. Germany's A MUN has not moved on Tyrolia or Vienna in my reports. Please confirm in writing that your units hold this spring and that you will warn me immediately if Germany moves on you.

Italy to France, Spring 1940: Our western pact stands. A TUN and F TYS hold this spring. Please confirm in writing that your F WES and armies stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice, and tell me your intentions for Spain and Portugal.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1940: I am holding all units this spring. Please confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. Tell me before any move toward Greece or Tunis-side waters.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1940: My A SEV and F RUM are not my target while your SEV and RUM sit on my border. Neither of us gains from a fight now. Move one unit out of SEV or RUM this spring and I will hold my armies in place. Answer in writing before orders.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1940: A WAR and A MOS hold this spring, staying out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Please confirm your Spring 1940 orders in writing, including that your armies stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. I am open to talking about France later.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1940: My A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this spring and stay out of Galicia and Budapest. Turkey is the shared threat. Please confirm your A BUD, A TRI, A VIE and A GAL orders before anything moves south.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1940: Let us end the standoff. I propose a written split: my A SEV and F RUM hold this spring and I make no move into Ukraine, Galicia or Warsaw. Your A MOS, A WAR and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm by reply, or tell me your intentions for the north.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1940: Our pact has held for two years. I will keep A ANK, A SMY and A CON on Turkish soil and out of Serbia and Budapest. Tell me plainly whether your Galicia forces plan any move toward Rumania or Serbia this spring, so neither of us is surprised.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1940: Confirmed. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring. No Austrian unit moves toward Venice or Piedmont. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. I will warn you immediately if Germany moves on Tyrolia or Vienna.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1940: My A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring. A GAL stays put and will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest as pledged. Turkey is the danger; I will tell you before any change.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1940: My VIE, BUD and TRI hold this spring. A GAL holds and will not move toward Rumania or Serbia without telling you first. Please keep A SER, A BUL and F RUM out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. Tell me before any move on Serbia.

England to France, Spring 1940: Confirmed in writing. F ENG, A LON and F LVP hold this spring and will not enter Brest, Picardy, Belgium or Spain-Portugal. Please keep A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F WES out of the Channel, North Sea and our waters. If Germany moves on Belgium or Picardy, I will write to you before any order.

France to Germany: I will keep A PAR, A MAR out of Burgundy, Ruhr and Belgium this spring, as I said. In return, A MUN must withdraw from Munich now, to Tyrolia or Burgundy-free territory. Munich is my centre claim. Answer in writing before orders. If A MUN stays on Munich, I will treat it as a threat and act against it.

France to Italy: Confirmed. My F WES and armies will not enter Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this spring. Please confirm in writing that A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Corsica, and that no Italian unit enters the Gulf of Lyon. Any change, we talk first.

France to England: Confirmed in writing. My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F WES hold this spring and will not enter Brest, Picardy, Belgium, Holland or the Channel. Please keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal. If Germany moves on Belgium or Picardy, we coordinate in writing before any order.

Germany to England, Spring 1940: I confirm my A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN will not enter the North Sea or Channel this year, nor move on Edinburgh, London or Liverpool. Keep F ENG and F LVP away from Belgium, Holland, Denmark and Kiel. My attention is on the centre and the east, not your islands.

Germany to France: My A MUN will hold Munich this spring and I will not move into Burgundy, Picardy, Ruhr, Paris, Marseille, Gascony or Spain-Portugal. Confirm in writing that your A PAR and A MAR stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium. I have no intention of withdrawing from my own centre.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1940: My A BER, A KIE and F DEN hold this spring and will not enter Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin as agreed. I am open to discussing France later, once Turkey's growth is addressed.

Italy to France, Spring 1940: Confirmed in writing. A TUN and F TYS hold this spring and will not move toward Marseille, Spain or Portugal. I have no Italian unit entering Corsica or the Gulf of Lyon. Please keep your F WES and armies out of Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice as pledged. Any change in the western Mediterranean, we discuss in writing first.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1940: I will not sign a written split while A SEV and F RUM hold my border. Show me movement: one unit out of SEV or RUM this spring, into Bulgaria, Serbia or Rumania-free water. If so, my A MOS and A WAR stay in their cores and I will keep the south quiet. Hold both again and I will treat Sevastopol as a target this autumn.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1940: Our pact holds. I will not move A SER or F RUM toward Budapest, Vienna or Trieste this spring, and I expect no Austrian unit to enter Serbia or Rumania. Your Galicia forces should stay out of both. I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1940: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian this spring, and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. Keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece. I will tell you before any change toward Greece or Tunis-side waters.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1940: I accept a written split. My A SEV and F RUM hold this spring, and I make no move into Ukraine, Galicia or Warsaw. Your A MOS, A WAR and A STP must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm by reply and both southern fronts stay quiet.

notes.note: Spring 1940: F ENG to NTH to set up A LON convoy next turn. Kept pledges to France and Germany (no Belgium/Brest/Spain/Holland/Kiel moves). Germany and France have kept their pledges so far. Convoy A LON only if a center opens or peace breaks. Watch German fleets near Channel/NTH.

Spring 1940: holding armies to keep pacts with Italy and England. F WES to MAO sets up a possible convoy of A POR/SPA later. Germany still has A MUN on Munich and has not withdrawn; watch BUR/PIC/BEL. Italy confirmed its western pact in writing.

Spring 1940: holding BUD, TRI, VIE. Attacking SER alone would fail and break the Turkey pact. Pacts with Turkey, Russia, Italy, Germany have held so far. Revisit SER/RUM if Turkey vacates or a pact breaks; watch German MUN.

Spring 1940: all hold. No unowned centres; SEV attack has no second supporter (no legal support into SEV). Turkey offered written split; I have not confirmed. Germany and Austria pacts kept so far. Next: watch Turkey SEV/RUM; reconsider SEV attack only with a real second supporter.

Spring 1940: fleet TYS to ION to prepare a later convoy of A TUN toward the Balkans. Pacts with France, Austria, Germany and Turkey hold; no unowned centres. Watch Turkey's AEG and any German move on Tyrolia or Vienna.

Spring 1940: holding all 6 SCs. Kept pacts with England (no North Sea/Channel moves, F DEN stays), Russia (no Prussia/Silesia/Berlin), Italy, Turkey. France demands MUN withdraw; I refused and MUN holds. Watch France on MUN/BUR. Next: seek growth via Russia (SWE/WAR) only if Russia breaks faith or France attacks.)

Spring 1940: holding all 8 centres; no unowned centres. RUM supports SEV hold vs Russia. Promised Russia split (SEV/RUM hold, no move to UKR/GAL/WAR); Austria, Italy pacts kept. Russia unsigned so far. Watch A MOS/WAR. Consider F RUM to BLA convoy later.

messages.body: Austria here. You lead at 8 centres, so I need to grow somewhere. I will hold VIE, BUD and TRI this fall. Will your A SER or F RUM stay put? If either leaves Serbia, I want first claim on it, and I will keep A BUD out of Rumania. Please tell me your fall orders before any move.

Austria here. Thank you for keeping WAR, MOS and SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. I am holding VIE, BUD and TRI this fall and will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. Please confirm your fall orders. If you move against Turkey in the south, I would welcome coordination.

Austria here. Our pact has held. I hold VIE, BUD and TRI this fall. Are you planning anything against Bohemia or Silesia this year? I will not enter Munich or Tyrolia. Please confirm your fall orders so neither of us collides with the other.

England to France, Fall 1940: Germany holds six centres and its units sit on Belgium and Holland. I propose we strike together this autumn. Your A PAR moves to BEL, and my F NTH moves to HOL, with A LON convoyed later if the chance allows. Reply in writing before any order, and tell me if A PAR can reach Belgium.

France to Germany, Fall 1940: Your A MUN is still on Munich, which I claimed. Are you withdrawing it to Tyrolia or Burgundy-free ground this autumn? Answer in writing before orders. I will keep my armies out of Burgundy, Ruhr and Belgium if you do.

France to Italy, Fall 1940: Please confirm in writing that A TUN and F TYS stay out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal and Corsica this autumn, and that no Italian unit enters the Gulf of Lyon. My F WES stays out of your centres. Any change, we talk first.

France to England, Fall 1940: My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F MAO/WES hold or stay out of your waters and Brest-free zones this autumn. Please confirm F ENG, A LON and F LVP stay out of Brest and Spain-Portugal. Any change, we talk first.

Germany to Russia: Turkey is growing fastest, and France is the closest rival to both of us. I propose we plan to move on France together in 1941. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia and Berlin, and I will keep my armies out of Warsaw and Sweden. Tell me your Fall 1940 orders first.

Germany to France: A MUN holds Munich this autumn and will not enter Burgundy, Ruhr or Picardy. Confirm A PAR and A MAR stay out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium. If you do, we avoid a clash this year and I will look for growth elsewhere.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1940: I hold all units this autumn with F ION in place. Please confirm your F AEG stays out of the Ionian and that Turkish armies stay out of Apulia, Naples and Albania. Also tell me your plans for Greece and Serbia, as I need to plan my own Balkan options.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1940: Our pact holds and I am holding all units. Germany's A MUN is still the danger to Tyrolia and Vienna. Please tell me whether your forces are secure this autumn. If Austria cannot hold Trieste, I want to discuss a written arrangement on TRI before anyone else takes it.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1940: Turkey now holds 8 centres and is the real threat to us both. Please confirm in writing your Fall 1940 orders for BUD, TRI and VIE. I will keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest while you press Serbia or Rumania against Turkey.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1940: Turkey is the leader at 8 centres, and a Russian-German understanding helps us both. Please confirm your Fall 1940 orders in writing. I will keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. In return, please keep your armies out of Warsaw and St Petersburg.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1940: Our split still stands. My A SEV and F RUM hold this autumn, and I make no move into Ukraine, Galicia or Warsaw. Confirm that your A MOS, A WAR and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. If you move on Sevastopol, I will defend it fully.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1940: My A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold again this autumn, and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Tell me now whether your Galicia forces plan any move toward Rumania or Serbia. I will not move without telling you first.

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1940: Confirm that your armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria and your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean. My F RUM and A SEV stay defensive and away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic. Tell me of any eastern plans before you make them.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1940: Our pact holds. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this autumn, and no Austrian unit moves toward Venice or Piedmont. Keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. If Germany's A MUN moves on Tyrolia or Vienna, I will call on your A VEN at once. Regarding TRI, we can discuss a written arrangement later, but Austria will not give up Trieste.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1940: Confirmed. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this autumn. I will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest as pledged. I will warn you before any change touching your border or Turkey's southern holdings.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1940: Thank you for holding A SER, F RUM and A BUL. My VIE, BUD and TRI hold this autumn and I will not move toward Serbia or Rumania. A GAL is not moving toward Rumania or Serbia this fall. Please keep your units out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste, and I will tell you before any change.

England to France, Fall 1940: Correction: A PAR cannot reach Belgium this autumn, since Paris borders only Picardy, Burgundy, Gascony and Brest. I withdraw my strike proposal for now. A LON, F NTH and F LVP hold this autumn and will not enter Holland or Belgium. Your A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F WES must stay out of Brest, the Channel and our waters. We can plan a spring 1941 move in writing first.

France to England, Fall 1940: I will not move A PAR into Belgium or join any strike on Germany this autumn. My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA and A POR hold, and my fleet stays out of your waters. Keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP out of Brest and Spain-Portugal as you have pledged. We can revisit in writing next year.

France to Germany, Fall 1940: I cannot confirm while A MUN sits on Munich, my claimed centre. Withdraw it to Tyrolia or Burgundy-free ground in writing and I will keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium. Otherwise I will treat Munich as contested and act accordingly.

Germany to France: A MUN holds Munich this autumn and will not move into Burgundy, Ruhr, Picardy or Belgium. I confirm my armies stay out of Paris and Marseille. Please keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium, and we avoid a clash this year.

Germany to Russia: Agreed in principle on France in 1941, once the picture is clearer. My A BER, A KIE and F DEN hold this autumn and will not enter Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Please keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin as you proposed.

Germany to Austria: Our pact stands. I have no orders against Bohemia or Silesia this autumn. A MUN holds Munich and will not enter Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest or Trieste. Keep pressing Russia in Galicia and tell me before any move near Silesia.

Germany to Turkey: Confirmed again. My armies stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria, and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. I am focused on the west and Austria. Keep F RUM and A SEV away from Kiel, Berlin and the Baltic, and we both stay safe.

Italy to France, Fall 1940: Confirmed in writing. A TUN and F TYS hold this autumn and will not move toward Marseille, Spain, Portugal or Corsica. No Italian unit enters the Gulf of Lyon. Please keep your F WES and armies out of Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice and out of my centres. Any change, we discuss in writing first.

Russia to Austria: Fall 1940 for me: A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold, staying out of Galicia and Budapest. I have no plan against your BUD, TRI or VIE. Holding VIE, BUD and TRI this fall is fine with me. Let us keep communicating before any spring move against Turkey or Serbia.

Russia to Germany: I am not ready to commit to a 1941 move on France. My A WAR and A MOS hold this fall and stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Please keep your armies out of Warsaw and St Petersburg, and confirm your Fall 1940 orders in writing so we can judge the next step.

Russia to Turkey: I will not sign a written split that binds my A WAR, A MOS and A STP away from Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople while your A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Keep both in place and I hold my armies. Move one out of reach and we can talk seriously.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1940: Our pact holds. A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold this autumn, and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. I will not move toward Serbia or Rumania without telling you first. Keep your Galicia forces out of Serbia and Rumania, and I will hold my line.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1940: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian this autumn, and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. I have no move against Greece now. Keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania, and I will tell you before any change.

notes.note: Fall 1940: holding BUD, TRI, VIE. Pacts with Turkey, Russia, Italy, Germany have held. Austria is at 3 centres and boxed in; attacking Serbia alone fails. Next: look for a real opening vs Turkey (SER/RUM) with Russia coordination, or accept Galicia gain if Russia leaves it. Watch German MUN.

Fall 1940: all hold. No unowned centres; SEV attack bounces without a second supporter. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER; they keep out of WAR/SWE/STP, agreed in principle on France 1941), Austria (confirmed holds; no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI). Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. Next: watch Turkey SEV/RUM; reconsider a 1941 move on France with Germany or SEV attack if a second supporter

Fall 1940: held all units as pledged to France (no Brest/Spain/Channel moves) and told France A LON, F NTH, F LVP hold this autumn. No unowned centres. Germany kept Western pledges in Spring 1940. Consider spring 1941 convoy/strike only in writing with France first.

Fall 1940: holding all units to keep pacts with France, Austria, Turkey, Germany. All confirmed holds. No unowned centres. Still 4 centres. Future: F ION to TYS, then convoy A TUN toward Balkans/Greece only if Turkey agrees. Watch German A MUN near TYR/VIE. Take TRI only if Austria collapses and agrees in writing.

Fall 1940: all holds to keep 6 SCs. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking pacts. Kept pacts with Russia, Austria, England, Turkey. France demands MUN withdraw; refused. Next: watch France on MUN/BUR and Russia on PRU/SIL; consider DEN->NTH convoy if a target opens.

Fall 1940: holding all 8 centres per promises to Russia, Austria, Italy, Germany. Russia still unsigned, hostile on SEV/RUM. Austria and Germany kept pacts. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup if Russia stays quiet; watch A MOS/WAR/STP.

Fall 1940: A PAR to BUR, A MAR supports PAR to BUR, setting up pressure on Munich after Germany kept A MUN there. F MAO to WES for the SPA convoy plan to NAF/TUN. Germany, England and Italy gave no firm withdrawal, so pacts are weakened. Watch German counterattack on PAR/BUR and whether England's F NTH and LON stay out of Brest/Spain-Portugal.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Spring 1941: You hold 8 centres and I hold 3. I need Serbia or Rumania to survive. Will A SER and F RUM leave this spring? If not, will you commit to a non-aggression pact that lets me keep BUD, VIE and TRI safe while I stay out of your southern cities?

Austria to Russia, Spring 1941: My VIE, BUD and TRI hold this spring. Turkey is the shared threat and leads at 8 centres. Will you keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV away from Galicia and Budapest again? If Turkey moves against us, I want to coordinate a joint move toward Rumania or Serbia.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1941: Our pact has held. Are A MUN and your other armies staying out of Bohemia, Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest and Trieste this spring? Please confirm, and tell me before any move near Silesia.

England to France, Spring 1941: My A LON, F NTH and F LVP hold this spring. I ask you to keep F WES and A POR out of the Channel and Irish Sea. If you want a joint move on Belgium or Holland later, write to me first and we will agree timing in writing.

England to Germany, Spring 1941: Please confirm in writing that A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN hold this spring and stay out of the North Sea, Channel, Edinburgh, London and Liverpool. My A LON, F NTH and F LVP will hold and stay out of Holland, Belgium, Denmark and Kiel.

France to Germany, Spring 1941: Your A MUN still sits on Munich, which I consider mine. Withdraw it to Tyrolia or Ruhr-free ground in writing before orders, and I keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Burgundy, Ruhr and Belgium. Otherwise I will contest Munich and Burgundy this year.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1941: Turkey has 8 centres and we both need growth. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin as agreed. Tell me your Spring orders first. If you ever move on Prussia or Berlin, I will respond. Could we agree that neither of us moves on Sweden or St Petersburg this year?

Germany to France, Spring 1941: A MUN holds Munich and will not enter Burgundy, Ruhr, Picardy or Belgium. Please keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium. If you stay on your side, we avoid a clash and I can look for growth in the east rather than against you.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1941: Our pacts have held. I am still holding all units. With Turkey at 8 centres and growing, I need a clear picture of your plans. Will you move against Greece or Serbia this year? If you do, I ask that your fleets stay out of the Ionian and that Turkish armies stay out of Apulia and Albania, as agreed.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1941: Turkey is the leader at 8 centres and is the threat to us both. I propose we coordinate against Turkey this year. Tell me your Spring 1941 orders for BUD, TRI and VIE before I move A WAR or A MOS toward Galicia or Ukraine. I will keep to our pledge until we agree.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1941: You proposed a 1941 move on France. Which units will you use, and when? I will keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin, provided your armies stay out of Warsaw and St Petersburg. Please confirm your Spring 1941 orders in writing.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1941: I am holding A SEV and F RUM this spring and will not move into Ukraine, Galicia or Warsaw. Please confirm that A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. If you strike Sevastopol, I will defend it fully and we both lose.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1941: My A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold this spring, and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Please confirm your A GAL stays out of Rumania and Serbia, and that VIE, BUD and TRI hold. I will tell you before any change.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1941: My VIE, BUD and TRI hold this spring, and A GAL holds too. I am willing to coordinate against Turkey, but a joint attack needs a concrete plan first. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia and Budapest this spring. Tell me your orders before any move toward Ukraine or Rumania, and I will confirm mine in writing.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1941: Thank you for the confirmation. My VIE, BUD and TRI hold this spring, and A GAL does not move toward Rumania or Serbia. Please keep A SER, F RUM and A BUL out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. I will tell you before any change, and I expect the same courtesy.

France to England, Spring 1941: Agreed in writing. My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F WES will not enter the Channel, Irish Sea, Brest or your waters this spring, and I ask the same of F ENG, A LON and F LVP toward Brest and Spain-Portugal. Any joint move on Belgium or Holland we will agree in writing first.

France to Germany, Spring 1941: Your A MUN still sits on Munich, which I regard as mine. I will not confirm a split while it stays. If A MUN withdraws to Tyrolia in writing now, I will keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Burgundy, Ruhr and Belgium this spring. Otherwise I will contest Munich.

Germany to France: A MUN holds Munich this spring and will not move into Burgundy, Ruhr, Picardy or Belgium. I have no army aimed at your PAR or MAR. Keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium, and we both stay quiet this year.

Germany to Austria: Confirmed. A MUN holds this spring and will not enter Bohemia, Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest or Trieste. I have no army aimed at Silesia. If that changes, I will tell you first. Keep pressing Russia in Galicia.

Germany to England: Confirmed in writing. A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN hold this spring and will not enter the North Sea, Channel, Edinburgh, London or Liverpool. Keep F NTH, A LON and F LVP away from Holland, Belgium, Denmark and Kiel.

Germany to Russia: My armies hold this spring: A BER, A KIE, F DEN, A HOL, A BEL and A MUN. None will enter Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin, and neither of us moves on Sweden or St Petersburg this year.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1941: My A WAR, A MOS and A SEV will not enter Galicia or Budapest this spring. Your VIE, BUD and TRI holding is acceptable to me. I want no conflict with you. Turkey is the real threat, and I will coordinate with you before any southern move.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1941: My A WAR and A MOS will stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin this spring, and I agree neither of us moves on Sweden or St Petersburg. Confirm your Spring orders in writing first. A 1941 move on France is possible later, once you name the units and timing.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1941: I will not sign a written split while your A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Move one out of SEV or RUM and show good faith, and I will keep my armies in their cores. Hold both and I treat Sevastopol as a target this autumn.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1941: My A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold this spring. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. I will keep my word while you do the same. Your A GAL must stay out of Rumania and Serbia. Any non-aggression arrangement must be honored by both sides, and I will tell you before any change to my orders.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1941: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian, and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. I have no plans against Greece or Serbia this year. Keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania, and I will tell you before any change near Tunis-side waters.

notes.note: Spring 1941: holding BUD, TRI, VIE to keep pacts with Germany, Russia, Turkey, Italy. All have kept word so far. Galicia is not a center; no gain there. Watch Turkish SER/RUM and German MUN. Revisit only if a pact breaks or Turkey vacates SER.

Spring 1941: holding LON, LVP, NTH as pledged to France and Germany. Germany and France confirmed peace in writing. No unowned centres. Revisit convoy of A LON (via NTH to ENG first) if a centre opens or peace breaks; coordinate any Belgium/Holland move with France in writing first.

Spring 1941: all hold. No unowned centres; SEV attack bounces without a legal second supporter. Pacts kept: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER; no one into WAR/STP/SWE), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI). Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. Germany and Austria confirmed holds. Next: watch Turkey SEV/RUM; consider Germany coalition vs France later.

Spring 1941: F ION to TYS to set up a later convoy of A TUN or A ROM. Pacts held with Austria, France, Germany and Turkey, all confirmed. Turkey says no move on Greece or Serbia. Hold VEN/ROM off Trieste and Tyrolia. Revisit growth options after Fall 1941.

Spring 1941: A BUR moves to PAR to reclaim our centre, keeping the no-clash pact with Germany. Others hold. Germany's A MUN still sits on Munich and has not withdrawn; watch it. England and Italy have kept pacts so far. No unowned centres. Consider a Mediterranean or Iberian convoy later.

Spring 1941: MUN attacks French A BUR, BEL supports MUN to BUR, BER moves to MUN to fill it. DEN, HOL, KIE hold home SCs. Pacts with Russia, Austria, England, Turkey intact; France broken by this attack. Check whether BUR is taken and whether MUN is retaken.

Spring 1941: all 8 centres owned, no unowned targets. Held all units to keep pacts with Austria (no entry BUD/VIE/TRI, SER/RUM hold), Italy (AEG out of Ionian), Russia (SEV/RUM hold). Russia still unsigned and hostile on SEV. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup if quiet; watch A MOS/WAR/STP and A GAL.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Fall 1941: You lead at 8 centres and I am at 3, so I cannot leave my position unchanged forever. Will A SER and F RUM stay put this autumn? I am holding VIE, BUD and TRI and will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Confirm your orders so neither of us is surprised.

England to Germany, Fall 1941: Peace has held, but Turkey leads with 8 centres and everyone else trails. Will you confirm in writing that A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN stay out of the North Sea and Channel this autumn? I keep F NTH, A LON and F LVP out of Holland, Belgium, Denmark and Kiel. Tell me if you plan any move on France or Russia.

England to France, Fall 1941: Our pledges have held. I ask that A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F WES stay out of Brest, the Channel and Irish Sea this autumn. I will keep F NTH, A LON and F LVP off Brest and Spain-Portugal. Any joint move on Belgium or Holland we will agree in writing first.

France to Germany, Fall 1941: Your A BUR now sits next to my A PAR and A MAR, and A MUN still holds Munich, which I regard as mine. Please withdraw A BUR to Ruhr and A MUN to Tyrolia in writing. If you do, I will keep PAR and MAR out of Burgundy, Ruhr, Munich and Belgium. Otherwise I will act to defend Paris and Marseille.

Germany to France: Our spring attack on Burgundy was a mistake I cannot undo. Pay the cost by withdrawing A PAR and A MAR from Burgundy and Munich now. I will hold my armies out of Paris and Marseille. Tell me your Fall orders so we avoid a costly war on two fronts.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1941: Austria is down to 3 centres and Germany's A MUN is massing near you. I propose a written arrangement: Austria keeps TRI and VIE and BUD, and if Germany moves on Vienna or Tyrolia, A VEN supports you. Please confirm your A VIE and F TRI holds this autumn.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1941: You are at 8 centres and I am at 4, so I need a fair path to growth. Tell me your plans for Serbia and Greece this autumn. I will keep F TYS and A TUN out of the Aegean and Balkans if you keep F AEG out of the Ionian and Apulia.

Italy to Germany, Fall 1941: Please confirm in writing that A MUN and A BUR have no orders against Tyrolia or Vienna this autumn. My A VEN and A ROM will stay off Tyrolia and Piedmont while our pact holds. Tell me your plans for France so we avoid overlapping moves.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1941: Turkey leads at 8 centres, so we both have reason to watch each other. I am holding A WAR, A MOS, A SEV and A STP this autumn. Will you move one of A ANK, A CON or F RUM off my southern border, or hold? Tell me your Fall orders first.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1941: My A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this autumn and stay out of Galicia and Budapest, as pledged. Turkey is the leader at 8 centres. Please confirm your Fall 1941 orders for BUD, TRI and VIE so we can coordinate any southern move.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1941: My A WAR and A MOS hold this autumn and stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing, and tell me whether you still plan a move on France in 1941 or 1942.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1941: I hold A SEV and F RUM again this autumn and will not enter Ukraine, Galicia or Warsaw. Let us sign now. Your A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople, and I will keep my Black Sea fleet in place. Confirm and both southern fronts stay quiet.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1941: Still no Turkish move toward Greece or Serbia. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. Please confirm your A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS stay off Greece and Albania this autumn.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1941: F TRI and A VIE hold this autumn, and A BUD holds too. No Austrian unit moves toward Venice or Piedmont. Please keep A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania. Germany's A MUN is the threat; if it moves on Vienna or Tyrolia I will call on your A VEN at once. A written arrangement on TRI can wait until the threat is clearer.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1941: A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this autumn, and A GAL holds too. I keep to my pledge not to enter Warsaw or Rumania. Please keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. Turkey is the danger to us both; before any spring move south I will tell you first, and I ask the same from you.

France to England, Fall 1941: Agreed in writing. My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F WES will not enter Brest, the Channel, Irish Sea or your waters this autumn. Please keep F NTH, A LON and F LVP off Brest and Spain-Portugal. Any joint move on Belgium or Holland we will agree in writing first.

France to Germany, Fall 1941: Your A BUR now sits beside my A PAR and A MAR, and A MUN still holds Munich. Withdraw A BUR to Ruhr and A MUN to Tyrolia in writing before orders. If you do, I keep PAR and MAR out of Burgundy, Ruhr, Munich and Belgium. Otherwise I will act to defend Paris and Marseille.

England, confirmed: A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN hold this autumn and will not enter the North Sea, Channel, Edinburgh, London or Liverpool. Keep F NTH, A LON and F LVP away from Holland, Belgium, Denmark and Kiel. My current focus is the Continent, not your islands. I will give notice before any move that affects you.

Russia, my fall orders keep A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN at home, with no move toward Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Please keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. I have not committed to any 1941 move on France. Keep Sweden and St Petersburg off limits to both of us this year.

France, my spring move into Burgundy was a mistake. I am willing to pull A BUR back to Ruhr this autumn and keep A MUN on Munich, with no moves into Paris or Marseille. In return, keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium. Confirm in writing and we stay at peace.

Italy, confirmed in writing: no German unit enters Venice, Trieste, Piedmont or Tyrolia this autumn. A MUN and A BUR have no orders against Tyrolia or Vienna. I have no plans against your France or Italy border. Keep A VEN and A ROM off Tyrolia and Piedmont, and we will discuss Trieste only after Austria falls.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1941: Confirmed on my side. A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS hold off Greece and Albania this autumn. Please confirm F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. I have no move against Serbia or Greece planned. If you change plans, tell me before you move, not after.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1941: I will not sign a written split while your A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Your offer binds my armies but leaves yours free. Move one of them into Bulgaria, Serbia or the Black Sea and I will confirm my holds in writing and keep A MOS, A WAR and A STP in their cores. Hold both again and I remain wary of Sevastopol.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1941: Yes, A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold this autumn. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. I expect your VIE, BUD and TRI to hold and A GAL to stay out of Serbia and Rumania. I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1941: I hold A SEV and F RUM again and will not enter Ukraine, Galicia or Warsaw. Confirm your A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Sign that and both southern fronts stay quiet. Attack Sevastopol and you will meet full defense.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1941: I have no move against Serbia or Greece this autumn. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania. Please keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania. I will tell you before any change.

notes.note: Fall 1941: holding BUD, TRI, VIE, keeping pledges to Turkey, Russia, Italy, Germany. Turkey and Russia confirmed their holds. Italy offered A VEN support if German MUN moves on VIE/TYR. Attacking SER/RUM alone fails and breaks Turkey pact. Revisit if a pact breaks or Turkey vacates SER/RUM.

Fall 1941: holding all units to keep pledges to France and Germany. No unowned centres. Both confirmed peace in writing. Plan: keep the peace, and reconsider a convoy of A LON via NTH to ENG if a centre opens or peace breaks.

Fall 1941: holding all units to keep pacts with France, Germany, Austria, Turkey (all confirmed in writing). Still 4 centres. Germany confirmed no move on Venice/Trieste/Piedmont/Tyrolia. Watch A MUN near TYR/VIE; support VIE with VEN only if Austria confirms attack. Growth via F TYS to ION then convoy A TUN toward Balkans only if Turkey agrees.

Fall 1941: all hold, keeping pacts. Germany: no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER, no one into WAR/STP/SWE. Austria: no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI. Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. No unowned centres. SEV attack has no legal second supporter. Next: watch Turkey SEV/RUM; look for Germany/France or Turkey opening.

Fall 1941: BUR withdraws to RUH per France deal; MUN, BEL, HOL, KIE, DEN hold 6 SCs. Watch France on MUN/BUR, Russia on PRU/SIL. Promised England/Italy no moves on their areas. Consider Turkey/Austria growth later.

Fall 1941: Holding PAR and MAR defensively vs German A BUR; no attack. Pacts: England (keep out of Brest/Channel/Iberia), Germany offered withdrawal of BUR/MUN, unconfirmed. Watch BUR/MUN. WES to MAO sets SPA/POR convoy later, staying out of Italian centres.

Fall 1941: holding all 8 centres. Pacts kept: Austria (no entry BUD/VIE/TRI, SER/RUM hold), Italy (AEG out of Ionian, no army to Apulia/Naples/Albania), Russia (SEV/RUM hold, unsigned). No unowned centres reachable. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy if quiet; watch Russia on SEV and Austria's A GAL.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Spring 1942: My A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring. Turkey still leads with 8 centres. Please tell me your Spring 1942 orders for A WAR, A MOS and A SEV before any southern move. If you move on Rumania, I will consider supporting from Galicia, but only after we agree in writing.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1942: I hold VIE, BUD and TRI this spring and will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Please confirm A SER, F RUM and A BUL stay put, and that no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. I will tell you before any change to my orders.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1942: Our pact has held. Are A MUN and your other armies staying out of Bohemia, Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest and Trieste this spring? Please confirm, and tell me before any move near Silesia.

England to Germany, Spring 1942: Your A BEL, A HOL and F DEN are now the main obstacle to my fleets. Are you still holding them and keeping the North Sea and Channel clear? I will keep F NTH and F LVP off Holland, Belgium and Denmark if you confirm in writing. Tell me your plans for France and Russia.

England to France, Spring 1942: Turkey has 8 centres and is pulling ahead. I am interested in a written plan against Germany's Belgium and Holland once autumn timing is clear. Please tell me whether A PAR and A MAR will move toward Burgundy or Belgium this year, and whether F MAO will stay in the Atlantic.

France to Germany, Spring 1942: Your A RUH and A MUN are close to my A PAR and A MAR. Confirm in writing that they stay out of Burgundy, Picardy and Belgium this spring. I will keep A PAR, A MAR and F MAO out of Munich, Ruhr, Belgium and your centres. Any change, we talk first.

Germany to France, Spring 1942: My units are at home with A RUH and A MUN holding. I will not move into Burgundy, Picardy or Belgium this spring. Please keep A PAR and A MAR out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium, and tell me your Spring orders first so we avoid any collision.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1942: Austria is down to 3 centres and Germany's A MUN still threatens you. I propose a written pact: A VEN moves to Tyrolia to support A VIE if Germany attacks Vienna. In return Austria confirms F TRI and A BUD stay put and never threaten Venice. Do you accept?

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1942: You hold 8 centres and lead the board, which concerns me. I am still at 4 and need room. Tell me now whether you plan any move on Greece or Albania this year. If not, I will keep A TUN and F TYS out of the Balkans while you keep F AEG out of the Ionian.

Italy to Germany, Spring 1942: Our pact holds and I am holding all units. Please confirm in writing that A MUN and A RUH will not move on Tyrolia or Piedmont this spring. In return, A VEN and A ROM stay off Germany's borders. Tell me your plans for France so we avoid overlapping moves.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1942: Your A SEV and F RUM still sit on my border. Move one out now, into Bulgaria or the Black Sea, and I will confirm my holds in writing. Otherwise I must treat Sevastopol as a target this year. Tell me your Spring orders first.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1942: Our pact still stands. My A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Please confirm your Spring orders in writing, and tell me whether your armies will stay out of Warsaw and St Petersburg this year.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1942: I keep to our pledge; A WAR, A MOS and A SEV stay out of Galicia and Budapest. Turkey is still the leader at 8 centres and the shared threat. Tell me your Spring 1942 orders for BUD, TRI and VIE before any southern move.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1942: I still hold A SEV and F RUM and will not enter Ukraine, Galicia or Warsaw. You hold 5 centres and I hold 8, so the board favors me in a long game. Let us sign: your A WAR, A MOS, A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia, Constantinople. Confirm and both southern fronts stay quiet.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1942: My A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold again this spring. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Please confirm your A VIE, A BUD, F TRI hold and your A GAL stays out of Rumania and Serbia. I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1942: F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania this spring. Please keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off Greece and Albania. I will tell you before any change.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1942: I accept the written pact. A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring, and no Austrian unit moves toward Venice. If Germany attacks Vienna, A VEN to Tyrolia is welcome. A VEN, A ROM, A TUN and F TYS must stay off Trieste and Albania as before.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1942: My A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring, and I will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. Keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest. Any move toward Rumania must be agreed in writing first; I will tell you my plans before any change.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1942: Confirmed, A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this spring and I will not enter Serbia or Rumania. Please keep A SER, F RUM and A BUL in place and keep all Turkish units out of Budapest, Vienna and Trieste. I will tell you before any change.

France to England, Spring 1942: A PAR and A MAR will hold this spring and will not move toward Burgundy or Belgium. F MAO stays in the Atlantic and out of the Channel and your waters. I will keep A SPA, A POR and F WES away from Brest and your waters too. Any joint move on Belgium or Holland we will agree in writing first, and timing is not yet clear.

France to Germany, Spring 1942: I will not confirm a split while A MUN sits on Munich, my claimed centre. Withdraw A MUN to Tyrolia in writing and I will keep A PAR and A MAR out of Burgundy, Ruhr and Belgium. Otherwise I will treat Munich as contested and act accordingly. Answer before orders.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1942: Confirmed. A MUN holds Munich this spring and will not enter Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest, Trieste or Bohemia. I have no army aimed at Silesia. Keep pressing Russia in Galicia, and I will tell you before any change near Silesia.

Germany to England, Spring 1942: My A BEL, A HOL and F DEN hold this spring. None will enter the North Sea, Channel, Edinburgh, London or Liverpool. Please keep F NTH and F LVP off Holland, Belgium, Denmark and Kiel. I am focused on the Continent, not your islands, and will give notice before any move that affects you.

Germany to France: My A RUH and A MUN hold this spring and will not enter Burgundy, Picardy or Belgium. Keep A PAR, A MAR and F MAO out of Munich, Ruhr, Burgundy and Belgium. Your Picardy and Burgundy moves would be a clear breach. Confirm your spring orders first so we avoid collisions.

Germany to Italy, Spring 1942: Confirmed in writing. A MUN and A RUH will not move on Tyrolia or Piedmont this spring, and no German unit enters Venice, Trieste or Piedmont. Keep A VEN and A ROM off Tyrolia and off Germany's borders. I have no plans against France that involve your units.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1942: Our pact stands. My armies hold this spring and none will enter Prussia, Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. I will tell you before any move that changes this, and I expect the same from you.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1942: I have no move against Greece or Albania planned this year, and my fleets stay put. You hold 8 centres, though, and that is a problem for me. Stay out of the Ionian and Adriatic, and I will keep A TUN and F TYS out of the Balkans. If you ever move on Greece, tell me first, because I will not sit idle while you grow past me.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1942: My A WAR, A MOS and A SEV hold this spring and stay out of Galicia and Budapest, as pledged. My Spring orders are holds across the board. Confirm your VIE, BUD and TRI holds in writing and I will keep to the pact. If Turkey moves on Rumania, we should coordinate before any autumn move.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1942: I will not sign a split while your A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. A written pact binding my armies while yours stay on my doorstep is not balanced. Move one of them into Bulgaria or the Black Sea and I will confirm my holds in writing. Hold both and I must treat Sevastopol as a target.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1942: Confirmed, my A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold this spring, and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Keep your A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia and we stay at peace. I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1942: Confirmed, F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania this spring. I have no move against Greece or Albania planned. Keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS off the Balkans and we both keep our pact.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1942: I will not move my SEV or RUM toward Ukraine or Warsaw. Your A WAR, A MOS and A STP must stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Sign that split and both southern fronts stay quiet. Attack Sevastopol and you meet full defense.

notes.note: Spring 1942: holding VIE, BUD, TRI. Pacts with Germany, Italy, Turkey, Russia all held so far. Attacking Serbia/Rumania alone fails and breaks Turkey pact. Watch German MUN and Turkish SER/RUM. Accepted Italy pact: VEN to TYR supports VIE if Germany attacks. Revisit if a pact breaks or Turkey vacates SER/RUM.

Spring 1942: all units hold to keep 6 SCs and honor pacts with France, Russia, Austria, Italy, England. No unowned SCs exist. Watch France on MUN/BUR and Russia on PRU/SIL. Consider convoy growth only if a target opens or a pact breaks.

Spring 1942: holding all units to keep written pledges to Germany (no moves into Burgundy/Belgium/Munich/Ruhr) and England (no Channel/Brest moves). Germany has kept its word so far; watch A MUN. Consider SPA convoy via MAO/WES to NAF later for unowned centres in North Africa.

Spring 1942: all hold. No unowned centres; SEV attack has no legal second supporter. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER; no one into WAR/SWE/STP), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI). Turkey split unsigned; SEV/RUM still held. Next: look for Turkey or Germany opening; consider SEV attack if a second supporter becomes legal.

Spring 1942: No unowned centres. Germany and France reaffirmed pledges in writing (no Channel/Brest moves). F NTH to ENG sets up a later convoy of A LON. Watch German A BEL/A HOL/F DEN and Russian NOR. Reassess a convoy or strike only if a centre opens or peace breaks.

Spring 1942: Italy at 4 centres, all unowned gone. Pacts held with Austria (VEN to TYR if Vienna attacked), Germany, Turkey (no Greece move; keep AEG out of Ionian). TYS to WES to set up convoy of TUN to SPA later. Watch Turkey's Greece moves and France. Need growth at France or Turkey.

Spring 1942: all 8 centres held, no unowned targets. Holding all units to keep pacts with Austria (no entry BUD/VIE/TRI), Italy (AEG out of Ionian, no army to Apulia/Naples/Albania), Russia (unsigned; SEV/RUM hold). Italy and Austria kept terms so far. Russia still hostile on SEV. Next: consider F RUM to BLA convoy setup if quiet; watch Russia on SEV and A GAL.

messages.body: Austria to Germany, Fall 1942: I am down to three centres, so I need more than holds. Let's coordinate against Russia. If you press Warsaw or Silesia, I will move on Galicia and keep A VIE out of Bohemia. Tell me your Fall orders before you move near Silesia.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1942: You lead at eight centres, so I ask for a continued peace. Please confirm A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold this autumn and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. I will keep A VIE, A BUD and F TRI in place and tell you before any change.

England to France, Fall 1942: Turkey leads with 8 and both of us trail. Propose in writing: F ENG to NTH this autumn, and in Spring 1943 we jointly strike Belgium, with your A PAR moving to BEL and my fleet supporting into HOL. Will you commit to this timing?

England to Germany, Fall 1942: You have confirmed peace for two years, and I have kept my fleets off your centres. Will you confirm in writing that A BEL, A HOL and F DEN stay put this autumn? Tell me if you plan any move on France or Russia, so I can plan my own moves.

France to Germany, Fall 1942: Germany has 6 centres and Turkey has 8, so we both gain by weakening Turkey, not each other. Tell me in writing your Fall orders for MUN, RUH and BEL. I will keep PAR, MAR and MAO out of your centres if A MUN stays on Munich or returns to Tyrolia. Any movement into Burgundy we talk about first.

France to England, Fall 1942: Turkey is the leader with 8 centres, so we should consider a joint plan. I propose that you move against Belgium or Holland with F NTH and A LON if Germany's units are drawn east, and I keep F MAO and my armies off the Channel and Brest. Tell me your Fall orders in writing first.

France to Italy, Fall 1942: Our western pact has held. Turkey is the board leader, and Italy and France both need centres. Please confirm in writing that A TUN, F TYS and A ROM will not move toward Marseille, Corsica or Spain-Portugal this autumn, and tell me your plans in the Balkans or Adriatic so we avoid overlap.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1942: Turkey holds 8 centres and is the real threat to us both. Its SEV, RUM and BUL are close to your southern front. I propose you press Turkey from the north while I deal with France in the west. Tell me your Fall orders and whether you will move on Rumania or Sevastopol. I will keep my armies out of Warsaw and St Petersburg.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1942: You hold 8 centres and I hold 4, so the board is lopsided. I will keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F WES away from Greece and Albania as agreed. Tell me now if you plan any move toward Albania, Apulia or the Ionian this autumn, and I will tell you the same about my fleet.

Italy to France, Fall 1942: Our western pact still stands. F WES and A TUN will hold this autumn and stay out of Spain, Marseille and Corsica. Please confirm in writing that your fleet and armies stay out of Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice. Tell me your plans for Spain and Portugal before any move.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1942: Your A SEV and F RUM still sit on my border. I am done with holds. Withdraw one into Bulgaria or the Black Sea this autumn and I will sign a written split with my armies held outside Rumania, Bulgaria and Constantinople. Otherwise my fleet and armies stay ready to strike Sevastopol.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1942: Our pact has held for years. I ask you to confirm your Fall 1942 orders in writing and whether your armies will stay out of Warsaw and St Petersburg. My A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. If you plan France, tell me the timing.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1942: My A WAR, A MOS and A SEV keep out of Galicia and Budapest as pledged. Turkey is the danger to us both. If you move on Rumania or Serbia, tell me first in writing so we can coordinate against Turkey rather than each other.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1942: My SEV and RUM hold again this autumn and will not enter Ukraine or Galicia. I propose a written split: A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople. Confirm and we both put our energy into other fronts.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1942: I still have no move against Greece or Albania this autumn, and F AEG stays out of the Ionian. Please keep A TUN, A ROM, A VEN and F TYS off the Balkans. Tell me your plans in the west so we avoid surprises.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1942: My A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold this autumn, and I will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. Keep A WAR, A MOS and A SEV out of Galicia and Budapest as pledged. If I ever move on Rumania or Serbia, I will tell you in writing first. Turkey is the common danger; let us watch its SEV and RUM together.

England to France, Fall 1942: I am not committing to a written strike on Belgium yet. Turkey leads, but Germany still holds six centres and our fleets are not in position. My F NTH stays in the North Sea this autumn and A LON holds. Keep F MAO and your armies off the Channel and Brest as pledged. We can revisit Belgium timing in Spring 1943 once Germany's units are clearly drawn east.

France to England, Fall 1942: I cannot commit to a Belgium strike in Spring 1943 yet. Germany still holds A BEL, A HOL and A RUH, and I need to see its units drawn east first. F NTH moving to NTH this autumn is fine by me, and I will keep F MAO and my armies out of the Channel and Brest. Let us confirm any joint timing in writing before Spring orders.

France to Italy, Fall 1942: Confirmed in writing. My units will not enter Tunis, Naples, Rome, Venice or the Tyrrhenian this autumn, and I will not move toward Marseille, Corsica or Spain-Portugal from my side. F WES and A TUN hold as you say. Please keep your units out of my Marseille and Iberian zone, and tell me in writing before any change in the western Mediterranean.

Germany to Austria: Thanks for the offer. I am not moving on Warsaw or Silesia this autumn, and A VIE, BUD and TRI are not my targets. Russia remains the natural prize for you in Galicia. Any change near Silesia, I will tell you before orders.

Italy to France: I confirm in writing that A TUN, A ROM, A VEN and F WES hold this autumn and will not move toward Marseille, Corsica or Spain-Portugal. Your side must keep F WES and your armies out of Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice. Spain and Portugal are your business, but if your fleet moves toward Tunis or the Tyrrhenian, our pact is void. Tell me before any change in the western Mediterranean.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1942: Our pact has held, but Turkey is a threat to us both only if we let it grow. I will consider pressing Turkey from the north, but I need your Fall orders in writing first. My A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Keep your armies out of Warsaw and St Petersburg, and tell me your France timing so I can judge the Sevastopol question.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1942: I will not sign a split while your A SEV and F RUM sit on my border. Withdraw one into Bulgaria or the Black Sea this autumn, show it in orders, and I will confirm my holds in writing. Hold both again and my fleet and armies remain ready to strike Sevastopol.
