Turkey to Austria, Fall 1942: Confirmed. A SER, F RUM and A BUL hold this autumn, and no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Keep your Galicia forces out of Serbia and Rumania and we stay at peace. I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1942: Confirmed. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and no Turkish army enters Apulia, Naples or Albania this autumn. Keep A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F WES off Greece and Albania, and I will tell you before any change near the Adriatic or Ionian.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1942: My SEV and RUM hold this autumn. I offer the written split again: A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay out of Rumania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Constantinople, and I keep out of Ukraine, Galicia and Warsaw. Keep pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER, no one into WAR/SWE/STP), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI/RUM). Turkey keeps threatening SEV; watch F BLA and A RUM.
F BLA attacks SEV (A RUM supports) since Russia refuses to withdraw; MOS may support hold, so may bounce. Others hold to keep pacts with Austria, Italy. Watch Russian WAR/STP vs RUM/BUL/SER/CON.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Spring 1946: Our pact has held for years. Please confirm A SER, A BUL, A RUM and your fleets hold this spring, and that no Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Tell me in writing before any move toward Serbia or Rumania, and I will do the same.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1946: Russia's sudden retreat from SEV to MOS changes the southern picture. Are A WAR, A MOS and A STP still holding out of Galicia and Budapest? Turkey is the strongest power now. Before any move toward Rumania or Serbia, let us share plans in writing.

England to Germany, Spring 1946: Russia holds Norway and Sweden next to both our fleets and has five centres. I propose a joint strike: my F NTH moves to NWY and your F DEN moves to SWE in Spring 1946, with exact timing confirmed in writing first. Each of us gains a centre and Russia is weakened. Do you agree? Please reply before orders.

France to Turkey, Spring 1946: You hold 7 centres and lead. Our fleets stay apart as agreed. I want to know your Spring plans for Rumania and Serbia, and whether any Turkish unit heads toward Trieste or Vienna. I will keep my armies in Spain and Portugal.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1946: Turkey leads with 7 centres and must be checked. Your A MOS and A WAR can reach SEV and RUM. I will keep my armies out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg while you press south. Confirm in writing that you will not enter Prussia, Silesia or Berlin this year.

Germany to France, Spring 1946: We both have 5 or 6 centres and Turkey leads. I still have no plans against your A PAR, A MAR or F BRE. Please keep your units out of Munich, Ruhr and Belgium, and confirm you will not move toward Holland or Burgundy this year.

Germany to Turkey, Spring 1946: Our understanding holds. My armies stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Rumania, and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. Please keep your units off Kiel, Berlin, Holland and Belgium. Tell me your Spring orders in writing.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1946: Your armies at SER, BUL and RUM are closest to my Greek centre. Turkey holds 7 and leads the board. I propose we both hold this spring: no Turkish army into Greece, Albania or the Ionian, and I keep F ION and A NAP out of Greece. Confirm in writing, and tell me your intentions toward Russia's SEV and MOS line.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1946: SEV is mine and A MOS stays there. Turkey's F BLA and A RUM attacking SEV would be a war we both lose to others. Propose: you keep RUM, BUL, SER, CON and stay out of UKR and SEV; I keep WAR, STP and MOS out of your Balkan centres. Confirm in writing whether you will move on SEV this spring.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1946: Sevastopol is a Turkish supply centre. Your A MOS retreated there, and I will retake it with F BLA and A RUM unless you withdraw. Confirm in writing that WAR, STP and MOS stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON, and I will keep my units out of UKR, GAL and WAR.

France to Germany, Spring 1946: Your recent note is noted. I will keep A PAR, A MAR and F BRE out of Munich, Ruhr, Belgium, Burgundy and Picardy this spring, as pledged. In return, A MUN, A RUH, A BEL and A HOL must stay out of Burgundy, Picardy, Paris and Marseille. Confirm your orders in writing before any change; I will not move toward Holland or Burgundy without first talking to you.

Germany to England, Spring 1946: I decline the joint strike. Moving F DEN to Sweden would break my word on the Baltic and leave my northern flank open, and I will not put my fleets in the North Sea. Keep F NTH and F LVP off Holland, Belgium, Denmark and Kiel as agreed, and I will keep my A BEL, A HOL, A KIE and F DEN out of your islands and the Channel.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1946: A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay out of Galicia, Budapest, Vienna and Rumania this spring, as pledged. Please confirm A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold. If you move toward Rumania or Serbia, tell me in writing first; I will do the same before any southern move.

Russia to Turkey: SEV is Russian and A MOS holds it. Any move by F BLA or A RUM into Sevastopol will be met with my full force and will hurt you more than me. I will keep WAR and STP out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON. Withdraw F BLA and A RUM from Ukraine and Sevastopol and we can both hold.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1946: A WAR and A MOS will not enter Prussia, Silesia or Berlin this year, as pledged. I will not enter Sweden or St Petersburg against you. Please confirm in writing that your armies stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. I am not committing to a push on Turkey yet.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1946: Your A MOS retreated from SEV, and SEV is a Turkish centre. My F SEV holds this spring, and I will not move into UKR, GAL or WAR. Keep WAR, STP and MOS out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON, and we can both hold. I will tell you in writing before any change.

Turkey to France, Spring 1946: My spring orders are A SER, A BUL, A RUM and A CON holding, F SEV holding, and no Turkish unit moving toward Trieste or Vienna. F AEG stays out of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian. Keep your fleets in the west and we both keep our centres.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1946: Confirmed in writing: no Turkish army enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian this spring, and F AEG stays out of the Ionian. My armies at SER, BUL and RUM hold. Keep F ION and A NAP out of Greece and off Constantinople, and I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1946: Confirmed in writing. A SER, A BUL, A RUM hold this spring, and F SEV holds in the Black Sea. No Turkish unit enters BUD, VIE or TRI. Keep your Galicia forces out of Serbia and Rumania, and I will tell you in writing before any change.

Turkey to Germany, Spring 1946: Our understanding holds. My spring orders: A SER, A BUL, A RUM, A CON, A ANK, A SMY hold, F SEV holds. No Turkish unit moves toward Kiel, Berlin, Holland or Belgium. Keep your armies out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Rumania and your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean.

notes.note: Spring 1946: holding BUD, TRI, VIE. Pacts with Turkey, Russia, Germany, Italy still hold. Attacks on SER/RUM alone fail and break the Turkey pact; Galicia is not a center. Revisit if a pact breaks, Turkey vacates SER/RUM, or an unowned center opens.

Spring 1946: holding all 6 SCs. Declined England's joint strike on Sweden/Norway; keeping pacts with England, France, Russia, Turkey, Austria. Turkey and Russia have kept their pledges so far. No unowned SCs; revisit if a target opens or a pact breaks.

Spring 1946: all hold. NOR supports SWE against Germany DEN. Turkey F SEV blocks MOS; no legal attack on SEV. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER; no one into WAR/SWE/STP), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI/RUM). Turkey keeps promising SEV/UKR/GAL/WAR holds; watch F SEV and A RUM.

Spring 1946: Germany declined joint strike on NOR/SWE. Kept peace with France and Germany. F NTH to ENG sets up A LON convoy next turn if a centre opens or a pledge breaks. Still 3 centres; reassess each turn.

Spring 1946: all units hold, keeping pledges to Germany (no Burgundy/Picardy/Munich/Ruhr/Belgium), England (no Channel/Brest/MAO) and Italy. No unowned centres. Germany pledged no moves against us. Revisit BRE to MAO convoy later if pacts hold.

Spring 1946: holding all units to keep written pacts with Turkey (no Greece/Albania/Ionian entry), France and Austria. Italy 5 centres, no unowned centres. Turkey confirmed SER/BUL/RUM hold. Next: consider F ION to TYS convoy setup or a Turkish/French break for growth; watch Turkish moves on GRE and Austria on TRI/VEN.
Spring 1946: SER attacks BUD with RUM support, breaking Austria pact to grow. Others hold. Russia unsigned on SEV. Italy/Germany pacts kept. Next: check if BUD falls, watch Russia.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey: Your A BUD is inside our old pact, and our agreement said no Turkish unit enters BUD. Explain in writing this Fall whether A BUD leaves now. If it stays, our pact is broken and I will defend Budapest and Vienna with everything I have.

Austria to Russia: My A GAL is in Galicia and Turkey now holds BUD. Are A WAR and A MOS staying out of Galicia this Fall as pledged? I will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. Tell me in writing whether you are moving on Galicia or Rumania.

England to Germany, Fall 1946: I am holding F ENG, A LON and F LVP this autumn and keeping them off your centres. Please confirm in writing whether A BEL, A HOL, F DEN, A KIE and A MUN hold, and whether A RUH plans any move toward France or Belgium. I will give notice before any change.

France to Germany, Fall 1946: Your A MUN, A RUH, A BEL and A HOL are the units I watch most. I hold A PAR, A MAR, F BRE and POR/SPA this autumn. Please confirm in writing that your Burgundy and Picardy stay empty this turn, and tell me your Fall orders.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1946: Turkey still leads with 7. I propose we both press it this autumn: your A MOS to SEV or RUM, while I hold. I keep A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN in place and stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. Confirm your Fall orders in writing.

Germany to Turkey, Fall 1946: Our understanding holds. My armies stay out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Rumania, and my fleets stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean. Please keep your units off Kiel, Berlin, Holland and Belgium, and tell me your Fall orders in writing.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1946: Your A BUD and armies at SER, BUL and RUM are close to Greece. Our written pact stands: no Turkish army into Greece, Albania or the Ionian. Confirm it again, and tell me before any move toward Trieste or Greece. I hold A NAP, A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F ION this autumn.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1946: Your A GAL, F TRI, A VIE stand, and our Venice-Tyrolia arrangement holds. Tell me whether Turkey's A BUD is now a threat to your Trieste or Vienna. I am holding all Italian units this autumn and will not move toward Trieste or Albania.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1946: Turkish F SEV holds this autumn, so I will not attack it. My A MOS holds MOS and stays out of Ukraine and Sevastopol. Confirm in writing that F BLA and A RUM will not enter UKR, SEV or GAL this autumn, and I will keep WAR and STP out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1946: A WAR and A MOS will not enter Prussia, Silesia or Berlin this autumn. A STP, A SWE and A NOR hold. Please confirm in writing that your armies stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg, and tell me before any move toward Russian centres.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1946: Our Spring attack on BUD was a break of our pact, and I regret the breach. A BUD now holds the centre and I will keep it that way. I am willing to restore peace: keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia, and I will keep my units out of Galicia and Vienna, with no further moves toward TRI.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1946: F SEV holds Sevastopol as a Turkish centre. I will not move into UKR, GAL or WAR this autumn. Confirm in writing that WAR, STP and MOS stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON, and we can both hold and avoid a costly war.

Austria to Turkey: Your A BUD is a breach, not a restoration. Withdraw A BUD from Budapest this Fall, back to Serbia or Rumania, and BUD returns to Austria. Then I will keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia and hold VIE and TRI. Keep your units out of Galicia and Vienna too. Without the withdrawal, I cannot accept your terms.

Austria to Italy: Thank you. I am holding A VIE, F TRI and A GAL this autumn, with no move toward Venice or Piedmont. Turkey's A BUD is a direct threat to our Vienna and Trieste, and I am pressing them to withdraw. Keep A VEN ready for the Tyrolia arrangement, and keep A ROM, A TUN and F ION off Trieste and Albania.

Germany to England, Fall 1946: Confirmed. A BEL, A HOL, F DEN and A KIE hold this autumn. A MUN holds. A RUH holds and makes no move toward France or Belgium. No German unit enters the North Sea, Channel or Picardy. Please keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP off my centres. Notice before any change.

Germany to France, Fall 1946: My A MUN, A RUH, A BEL and A HOL all hold this autumn. Burgundy and Picardy stay empty from my side this turn. Please keep A PAR, A MAR and F BRE out of Munich, Ruhr and Belgium. Any change, we discuss in writing first with exact timing.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1946: Confirmed in writing. My armies stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg this autumn. A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN hold. I agree Turkey must be checked. Your A MOS to SEV or RUM is your call; I will tell you before any move toward Russian centres.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1946: My A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin this autumn, and A STP, A SWE and A NOR hold. I expect your A BEL, A HOL, A MUN, A RUH, A BER and F DEN to hold and no army to enter Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. Confirm in writing and name your France timing.

Turkey to Germany, Fall 1946: Our understanding holds. My units will not move toward Kiel, Berlin, Holland or Belgium this autumn. Keep your armies out of Serbia, Bulgaria and Rumania and your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean. My Fall orders are holds across my core, and I will tell you in writing before any change.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1946: F SEV holds Sevastopol this autumn and I will not move into UKR, GAL or WAR. In writing: WAR, STP and MOS stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON, and we both avoid a costly war. Break that and I will respond in kind.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1946: Yes, the Spring attack on BUD broke our pact and I regret it. A BUD holds the centre this autumn and I will not advance further. I offer peace: you keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia, and I keep my units out of Galicia and Vienna with no move toward TRI. Confirm and we both hold.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1946: Confirmed in writing again: no Turkish army enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian this autumn, and F AEG stays out of the Ionian. I will tell you before any change toward Trieste or Greece. Keep A NAP, A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F ION off Bulgaria and Constantinople.

notes.note: Fall 1946: holding F ENG, A LON, F LVP per pledges to France and Germany; Germany confirmed holds and no moves toward Channel/North Sea. Still 3 centres. Reassess convoy of A LON via F ENG to NTH if a centre opens or a pledge breaks.

Fall 1946: holding all units on French centers, keeping pledges to Germany (no Burgundy/Picardy/Munich/Ruhr/Belgium), England and Italy. Germany confirmed holds. Turkey leads at 7; watch for Turkish or German moves. Revisit BRE to MAO convoy for POR/SPA later if pacts hold.

Fall 1946: holding all 6 SCs, keeping pacts with England, France, Russia, Turkey, Austria. All parties have kept pledges so far. Turkey leads at 7. No unowned SCs reachable without breaking pacts. Watch France on BUR/PIC and Russia on WAR/SIL. Reassess growth if a pact breaks or a target opens.

Fall 1946: all hold, keeping pacts. NOR supports SWE hold vs Germany DEN. Germany: no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER; no one into WAR/STP/SWE. Austria: no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI/RUM. Turkey: no UKR/SEV/GAL incursions; SEV Turkish, F SEV holds. Turkey and Germany have made promises but no confirmed breaks yet. Next: watch Germany DEN/SWE and Turkey SEV/RUM.

Fall 1946: holding all units to keep pacts with Turkey (no Greece/Albania/Ionian entry), Austria (VEN-TYR arrangement) and France. Italy 5 centres, no unowned. Watch Turkish A BUD threat to Austria; if Turkey moves on GRE or TRI, reassess and consider break for growth.

Fall 1946: A BUD holds to take BUD; RUM supports it. Others hold. Austria demands BUD withdrawal and Russia wants no RUM/BUL/SER/CON entry. Italy pact (no Greece/Ionian) kept. Watch Austria attacking BUD from GAL/VIE; consider moving BUL to SER or RUM later.

Fall 1946: Turkey took BUD in Spring and refused to withdraw. Attacking BUD with GAL moving in, VIE supporting GAL to BUD, TRI and VIE home-holding Trieste and Vienna. Turkey, Russia, Italy have broken the pact on BUD. Keep Vienna and Trieste defended. Retake BUD if it succeeds, and watch RUM support.

messages.body: Austria: Your A BUD remains a breach. Withdraw it from Budapest this Spring to Serbia or Rumania, and Budapest returns to Austria. Otherwise our pact is void and A VIE and F TRI will hold while I seek help against your forces. Reply in writing before orders.

Austria: Turkey holds BUD and SEV is a Turkish target you can reach. I propose we coordinate: you press Rumania and Sevastopol, while A VIE and F TRI prepare to retake Budapest and Serbia. Please confirm in writing that A WAR and A MOS will not block Galicia to us.

Austria: With Turkey's A BUD threatening Vienna and Trieste, I ask whether Germany would support action against Turkey in the Balkans, or at least keep A MUN ready toward Bohemia. Please state your intentions for Spring in writing.

England to Germany, Spring 1947: I am still holding F ENG, A LON and F LVP and have kept my pledges. Are A BEL, A HOL and A MUN staying put this spring? If Russia attacks you in the east, I'd like to talk about a joint plan before either of us moves.

England to Russia, Spring 1947: Germany is the main threat to both of us. Will you confirm in writing whether A WAR or A STP plans a move toward Prussia or Berlin this year? I will keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP off Norway and Sweden as before.

France to Germany, Spring 1947: Our pledges hold. Germany has 6 centres and Turkey leads at 8. With Turkey growing, I propose we both keep our armies out of each other's centres this spring and cooperate on checking Turkey later. Please confirm your A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL and A BER orders in writing.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1947: Turkey now leads with 8 centres and must be checked. Tell me your Spring orders in writing. My A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN hold, and my armies stay out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg. Let's agree on a timed push against Turkey's Balkan centres.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1947: Turkey holds 8 centres and is the only power that can win. Your A WAR, A MOS and the fleet line face Turkey's SEV, RUM and SMY. I propose you press Turkey from the north this year, and I will press from the Adriatic and Greece. Tell me your Spring orders against SEV.

Italy to France, Spring 1947: Turkey is the leader at 8 centres, and neither of us grows while it does. I propose we agree in writing that you press Turkey from the west and I hold GRE with F ION and A NAP. Confirm your timing and tell me which Turkish centre you target first.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1947: Your F SEV and A RUM remain a threat to my A MOS. Are you planning any move into UKR, SEV or GAL this spring? I will keep WAR and STP out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON if you confirm F SEV and A BUD hold and no unit enters UKR or GAL.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1947: Confirm in writing that A BER, A MUN, A BEL, A HOL, A RUH and F DEN hold this spring and no army enters Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. I will keep A WAR and A MOS out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin. Tell me your France timing.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1947: Confirm A VIE, A BUD and F TRI hold, and that your A GAL does not enter Warsaw or Rumania. My A WAR, A MOS and A STP will not enter Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Rumania this spring. Tell me in writing before any southern move.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1947: Our units have held their lines and F SEV holds. I want clear terms: A MOS and WAR stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON, and I keep my units out of UKR, GAL and WAR. Confirm in writing and we can both use our armies against weaker neighbours instead.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1947: A BUD stays Turkish for now, and I will not move toward VIE or TRI this spring. If you keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia, I will keep my armies off your core. Confirm in writing and we both hold.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1947: Confirmed again: no Turkish army enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian this spring, and F AEG stays out of the Ionian. Keep A NAP, A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F ION off Bulgaria and Constantinople, and I will tell you before any change.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1947: Confirmed in writing: A WAR and A MOS stay out of Galicia this spring as you pledged, and I will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. My A GAL is not moving on Warsaw or Rumania. Our Spring plan is A VIE and F TRI holding, with Budapest the target against Turkey. Please keep A WAR and A MOS out of Galicia and Budapest.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1947: You still hold Budapest, which is a breach of our pact. I will not accept A BUD staying Turkish. If you withdraw A BUD to Serbia or Rumania this Spring, I will keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia and hold VIE and TRI. Without withdrawal, our pact is void and I will defend Vienna and Trieste.

France to Italy, Spring 1947: I agree in principle to press Turkey from the west, but no timing yet. Turkish centres are far from my armies, so I need time to reposition. Keep A TUN, A NAP, A ROM and F ION off Marseille, Spain and Portugal, and I will keep my units out of Tunis, Naples, Rome and Venice. We will talk in writing before any Balkan or Adriatic move.

Germany to France: Confirmed in writing for Spring 1947. A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL and A BER all hold. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy or your centres. Please keep A PAR, A MAR, F BRE and POR/SPA out of Munich, Ruhr and Belgium. I agree Turkey must be checked, and we can talk timing once Turkey's move is clear.

Germany to Russia: Confirmed in writing. A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN hold this spring. No German army enters Warsaw, Sweden or St Petersburg. I am open to a timed push on Turkey's Balkan centres, but I need your Spring orders first and will not move until we agree a turn.

Germany to Austria: A MUN holds this spring and will not enter Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest, Trieste or Bohemia. I have no army aimed at Silesia. I will not attack Turkey in the Balkans this spring. If Turkey's A BUD threatens you, I will tell you in writing before any Fall move near Bohemia.

Germany to England: Confirmed. A BEL, A HOL and A MUN hold this spring. No German unit enters the North Sea, Channel or Picardy. Please keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP off my centres. On Russia, I will not commit to any eastern plan yet, but I will give you written notice before any move that affects you.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1947: I have noted your written word that no Turkish army enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian and F AEG stays out. I hold my units this spring, but my patience depends on your actions. Any move toward Greece, Albania or the Ionian ends our peace at once, and I will respond.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1947: A WAR and A MOS hold this spring and will not enter Prussia, Silesia or Berlin. I will not move into Warsaw-adjacent Sweden or St Petersburg against you. A timed push on Turkey is premature for me; Turkish F SEV and A RUM still threaten my A MOS. Tell me your France timing first.

Russia to Austria: A WAR and A MOS hold this spring and will not enter Galicia, Budapest, Vienna or Rumania. I cannot pledge against Turkey in writing while F SEV and A RUM threaten my A MOS. Keep your A GAL out of Warsaw, and tell me your Serbia orders before any southern move.

Russia to England, Spring 1947: A NOR and A SWE hold, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. A WAR and A STP will not move toward Prussia or Berlin this spring. Keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP off Norway and Sweden, and we stay at peace. I cannot pledge further in writing yet.

Russia to Italy, Spring 1947: Thank you. I have no plans against NAP, ROM or VEN. My northern armies are fixed against Turkey and Germany for now. Please keep your fleets out of Balkan waters and off Greece's neighbours, and we have no quarrel. I will watch Turkey's SEV and RUM.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1947: Your F SEV and A RUM remain a direct threat to my A MOS. I will not confirm terms while you keep units on my border. Withdraw A RUM from Rumania toward Bulgaria and confirm no unit enters UKR or SEV this spring, and WAR and STP will stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1947: A BUD stays Turkish this spring, but I will not move toward VIE or TRI. Keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia and my armies stay off your core. I will tell you in writing before any further change to these orders.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1947: F SEV holds and I have no move into UKR, GAL or WAR this spring. Confirm in writing that WAR, STP and MOS stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON, and we both hold. Break that and I will respond in kind.

notes.note: Spring 1947: F ENG to NTH sets up convoy of A LON next turn toward BEL/HOL/DEN/NOR if a centre opens or a pledge breaks. A LON and F LVP hold. Germany confirmed holds and no North Sea/Channel entry; France peace holds; Russia confirmed NOR/SWE holds. Still 3 centres. Revisit convoy next turn.

Spring 1947: holding all 6 SCs, pledges to England, France, Russia, Austria, Turkey kept. Russia asks for a timed Turkey push but has not committed. Revisit a Balkan/Turkey plan only after Russia commits; watch France on BUR and Russia on SIL/PRU.

Spring 1947: holding VIE and TRI. Attacking BUD alone bounces, since TRI cannot support into BUD. Turkey says BUD stays Turkish and promises no move on VIE or TRI. Russia and Germany pledged to stay out of GAL/VIE/TRI/BOH/TYR. Revisit if Turkey leaves BUD, a pact breaks, or a support into BUD becomes available.

Spring 1947: 5 centres, none unowned. Holding all units to keep pacts: Turkey (no Greece/Albania/Ionian entry), France (west vs Turkey, no timing yet), Austria (VEN-TYR). Watch Turkish SER/BUL toward GRE; if Turkey breaks, convoy A TUN/NAP via F ION to GRE/ALB. Russia has no quarrel. Reassess next turn.

Spring 1947: all hold, NOR supports SWE vs Germany DEN. Pacts: Germany (no WAR/MOS into PRU/SIL/BER; no one into WAR/STP/SWE), Austria (no GAL/BUD/VIE/TRI/RUM). Turkey: F SEV and A RUM still threaten MOS; Turkey promised no UKR/GAL/WAR. Next: watch Turkey SEV/RUM; attack SEV only with legal support.

Spring 1947: all units hold to keep pledges to Germany (no Burgundy/Picardy/Munich/Ruhr/Belgium), Italy (no Tunis/Naples/Rome/Venice) and England. No unowned centres. Germany confirmed holds. Italy proposes pressing Turkey from the west; no timing agreed yet. Revisit BRE to MAO convoy for POR/SPA later.

Spring 1947: all hold. RUM supports BUD hold against Austria. Pacts: Italy (no Greece/Albania/Ionian, AEG out), Russia unconfirmed (WAR/STP/MOS out of RUM/BUL/SER/CON), Austria demands BUD withdrawal (refused). Watch Russia threat on SEV/RUM; Austria may attack BUD.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Fall 1947: A BUD is still Turkish, which breaks our pact. Withdraw A BUD to Serbia or Rumania this Fall and Budapest returns to Austria. Then I keep my units out of Serbia and Rumania and hold VIE and TRI. Please answer in writing before orders.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1947: Are A WAR and A MOS staying out of Galicia, Vienna, Budapest and Rumania this Fall? I hold VIE and TRI and will not enter Warsaw or Rumania. Tell me in writing if Turkey's BUD or Rumania changes your plans.
Austria to Germany, Fall 1947: Please confirm A MUN and A RUH stay out of Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest, Trieste and Bohemia this Fall. Tell me in writing before any move near Bohemia or Silesia.

England to Germany, Fall 1947: Russia has five centres and two armies, A NOR and A SWE, that both our fleets border. I propose we coordinate in writing this autumn: my F NTH to NWY and your F DEN to SWE, with exact timing confirmed before orders. Each of us gains a centre. Do you agree?

England to Russia, Fall 1947: Germany is massing against you on the Baltic and Prussia. Will you confirm in writing that A NOR and A SWE hold this autumn? I will keep F NTH and A LON off Norway and Sweden as long as you do the same.

France to Germany, Fall 1947: Turkey is the leader at 8 and both of us need centres. I propose that once Turkey's move is clear, we coordinate a check on Turkey. Confirm in writing whether your A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL and A BER are holding this autumn or moving.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1947: Turkey leads at 8 and threatens us both. I propose a timed push: you move A MOS to SEV or RUM this Fall if you can, and I will prepare to move against BUL and SER in Spring 1948. Tell me your Fall orders in writing before I commit.

Italy to France, Fall 1947: Turkey still leads at 8 centres. I propose a concrete plan: you move your armies toward Turkey's western border in Spring 1948, and I hold A TUN, A NAP, A ROM, A VEN and F ION while I prepare a Greek move. Reply in writing with your exact target and timing.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1947: Your F SEV and A RUM still threaten my A MOS. I propose a clear border: you withdraw A RUM to BUL or SER, F SEV stays put, and no Turkish unit enters UKR or GAL. In return my WAR and STP stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON. Confirm in writing.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1947: Your A RUM threat claim is misplaced; my units are defensive. Russia's A MOS and WAR are the threat to my SEV and RUM. I propose: you withdraw from UKR and SEV, and I keep F SEV and A RUM out of UKR, GAL and WAR. Confirm in writing, or tell me your fall moves.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1947: I will keep A BUD and my Balkan units out of GAL and VIE this autumn, and I propose you keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia. Your hostility leaves us both exposed to Russia. Confirm in writing whether you will hold VIE and TRI and move no units toward BUD or SER.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1947: A BUD is still Turkish and our pact is broken by it. Withdraw A BUD to Serbia or Rumania this Fall and Budapest returns to Austria. Then I keep my units out of Serbia and Rumania and hold VIE and TRI. Until then, I cannot confirm any terms in writing.

France to Italy, Fall 1947: I can agree to a Turkey plan but not a fixed timing yet. My armies are deep in the west, so Turkish targets are at least two years away by road. I will move toward Burgundy and Piedmont only after we agree the exact turn in writing. Hold your Tunisian and Greek units as you propose for now.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1947: Confirmed in writing. A MUN and A RUH hold this Fall and will not enter Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest, Trieste or Bohemia. I have no army aimed at Silesia. If that changes, you will hear it in writing before orders.

Germany to England, Fall 1947: I decline the NTH-NWY and DEN-SWE plan this autumn. My F DEN stays put and my fleets do not enter the North Sea or Channel. Keep F NTH, F ENG and F LVP off my centres as agreed and we stay at peace.

Germany to France, Fall 1947: My A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL and A BER all hold this autumn. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy or your centres. Please keep A PAR, A MAR, F BRE and POR/SPA out of Munich, Ruhr and Belgium. We can discuss a Turkey check once Turkey's move is clear.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1947: A WAR and A MOS stay out of Galicia, Vienna, Budapest and Rumania this Fall as pledged. I will not enter Warsaw or Rumania with my armies either. Turkey's BUD and A RUM are the real danger to both of us; tell me your Serbia orders in writing before any southern move.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1947: I will not accept a withdrawal from SEV while your F SEV and A RUM sit on my border. Withdraw A RUM to BUL or SER and keep F SEV in place, and my WAR and STP will stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON. Until then I make no further promises.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1947: I will not move A MOS to SEV or RUM this Fall; that is a Turkish border I need to keep safe for now. A WAR and A MOS stay out of Prussia, Silesia and Berlin as pledged, and no Russian army enters Warsaw-adjacent Sweden. Keep your armies out of Warsaw, Sweden and St Petersburg, and tell me your France timing.

Russia to England, Fall 1947: A NOR and A SWE hold this autumn, as they have every turn. No Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. Keep F NTH and A LON off Norway and Sweden and we stay at peace. Germany is the threat to both of us, and I will tell you before any change.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1947: A BUD stays Turkish for now. Its taking was a breach and I will not pretend otherwise, but I will not move toward VIE or TRI this autumn, and I ask you to keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia. Russia is the real danger to both of us. Let us hold and talk again next spring.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1947: Your A MOS and WAR are the threat to my SEV and RUM, not the reverse. I will not move into UKR, GAL or WAR this autumn. I cannot withdraw F SEV or A RUM while Russian armies sit beside them. Confirm in writing that WAR, STP and MOS stay out of RUM, BUL, SER and CON, and we both hold.

notes.note: Fall 1947: holding VIE and TRI. Turkey still holds BUD, breach unresolved; Turkey and Russia promise no move on VIE/TRI. Germany confirmed MUN/RUH hold. Attacking BUD alone bounces. Revisit if Turkey leaves BUD or a support becomes available.

If you strike Russia in the east, I can move F ENG to NTH this turn and to NWY when Norway opens. Will you confirm in writing whether you would support that, and what you will do with DEN and SWE?

I will keep F ENG, A LON and F LVP out of Norway and Sweden as long as you do. If Germany attacks you, tell me first so we can discuss a shared plan.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1948: A WAR holds and A MOS moves to UKR, not SEV or RUM. No Russian army enters Prussia, Silesia or Berlin. I agree to a Fall 1948 timing against Turkey's Balkan centres. England to Russia, Fall 1948: Germany is massing on your Baltic and Prussian border. Will you confirm in writing that A NOR and A SWE hold this autumn? If Germany strikes you, tell me first so we can discuss a shared response.

Your pledge to keep A WAR, A MOS and A STP out of Galicia, Vienna and Budapest is noted. I may strike Budapest in Fall with your support against Turkey's units, so please keep UKR pressing Rumania and tell me your Fall orders before deadline.

Germany to England, Spring 1949: I will not move A BER or A HOL toward Prussia or the Baltic this autumn, so your NTH-NWY condition is not met. My fleets stay out of the North Sea and Channel. Keep F NTH, F ENG and F LVP off my centres. I will give written notice of any change.

Germany to France, Spring 1949: My A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN hold this spring. No German unit enters Burgundy, Picardy, Holland-to-France routes or your centres. Please keep A PAR, A MAR, F BRE, A POR and A SPA off Munich, Ruhr and Belgium. A timed Turkey check can be discussed once Turkey's Spring move is visible.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1949: I am not yet ready to commit to BUL or SER this spring, and my armies are too far south to strike in time. My A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN hold. No German army enters WAR, SWE or STP. Send your Spring orders for A UKR, A WAR and A STP first.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1949: Confirmed in writing: A TUN, A NAP and F TYS stay off Bulgaria and Constantinople this spring, and no Italian unit enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian from my side. Your F AEG must stay out of the Ionian. Tell me before any move on SEV or RUM. You hold 8 centres, so I will watch closely.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1949: Your talk of 'holding' while Turkey leads is not a commitment. Name your moves: A MUN or A BUD-side army to BUL or SER this spring, in writing, before I move A UKR. Without that, my A UKR goes after RUM alone and WAR, SWE, STP stay closed to your armies as pledged.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1949: I will not confirm a line while A RUM and F SEV sit on my border. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia this spring, keep F SEV in place, and my armies stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV. Otherwise my A UKR is free to act against your Rumanian army.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1949: A BUD, A BUL and A RUM hold this spring. I will not move toward VIE or TRI. Please keep A GAL out of Rumania and Serbia as we agreed. My Spring orders are holds across the Balkans, and I will confirm any change before it happens.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1949: Confirmed in writing again: no Turkish army enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian this spring, and F AEG stays out of the Ionian. My Spring orders are holds. I will tell you before any move toward SEV or RUM. Please keep A TUN, A NAP and F TYS off Bulgaria and Constantinople.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1949: I propose a clear line. Your armies stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV, and my units stay out of UKR, GAL and WAR. My Spring orders are holds on F SEV and A RUM. Confirm in writing that A UKR and A WAR will not enter any of those provinces this spring.

notes.note: Spring 1949: holding VIE and TRI. Attacking BUD alone bounces. Pacts with Turkey, Russia hold. Revisit if BUD vacates or a support into BUD becomes available; plan Fall strike on BUD with Russia support if Turkey stays.

Spring 1949: holding all 6 SCs per pacts with France, England, Russia, Austria, Turkey. No unowned SCs reachable. Russia has not committed in writing to BUL/SER. Watch Russia on WAR/SWE/STP and England on NTH/Channel. Revisit Balkan strike only if Russia commits.

Spring 1949: 3 centres, no unowned centres. Germany declined the NTH-NWY condition again, so the plan stays off. Holding F NTH, A LON, F LVP to keep pledges to Germany and Russia. Russia confirmed NOR/SWE holds in 1948. Reassess if a centre opens or a pledge breaks.

Spring 1949: F MAO to WES to set up convoy of A SPA or A POR to NAF/TUN next turn. Other armies hold to keep pledges to Germany (no Burgundy/Picardy/Munich/Ruhr/Belgium) and Italy (no Tunis/Naples/Rome/Venice). Germany confirmed holds. Italy plan untimed. Turkey leads at 8; need growth via Africa.

Spring 1949: holds on BUD, BUL, RUM, SEV, CON, ANK to keep pacts and centres. SMY to SYR (unowned centre). Pacts: Italy no Greece/Ionian, AEG out; Austria no VIE/TRI, GAL out of RUM/SER; Russia line unconfirmed, watch UKR/WAR vs RUM/SEV.

Fall 1949: UKR attacked RUM unsupported in Spring 1949, may bounce. Turkey refused to withdraw A RUM and F SEV. Germany committed nothing toward BUL/SER and promised no WAR/SWE/STP entry. Austria pledged no GAL/RUM/SER. Keep NOR/SWE/STP holds to protect the north; seek a real Balkan partner before striking again.

Spring 1949: Holding to keep written pacts (Turkey: no GRE/ALB/ION entry; France: west, no Marseille/Spain move; Austria: VEN-TYR if Germany hits VIE). Turkey and France have kept word. Still 5 centres, none unowned. Reassess Fall 1949; Austria (2 centres) is fallback target if pacts fail. Keep TYS off ION while Turkey keeps word.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Fall 1949: I will strike Budapest with A VIE only if you support it, which needs a Russian unit adjacent to BUD (GAL, RUM or SER). Will your A UKR move to Galicia or Rumania this fall and support A VIE to BUD? Confirm in writing before orders. I still ask A WAR and A MOS to stay out of Galicia, Vienna and Budapest.

England to France, Fall 1949: Germany has 6 centres and Turkey leads at 8, so we both need growth. Germany's A BEL and A HOL are the obvious targets. If you move A PAR to BUR this autumn toward BEL, I will move F NTH to HOL-area support and keep F ENG away from Brest. Will you confirm your Belgium plan in writing?

England to Russia, Fall 1949: Germany is the common threat and holds 6 centres. Proposal: you strike BER and Prussia from WAR and SWE, while I press DEN and HOL from the North Sea when openings appear. Please confirm in writing whether A WAR and A SWE will move against Germany this autumn, and I will keep F NTH away from NOR.

France to Italy, Fall 1949: I want Tunis and Naples secure, and I hold my armies. Turkey leads at 8 and we both need centres. Please confirm in writing whether A TUN or F TYS plan any move toward Spain or Africa this autumn. I will keep A SPA and A POR off North Africa.

France to Germany, Fall 1949: My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F BRE hold this autumn, with no moves into Burgundy, Picardy, Munich, Ruhr or Belgium. Please confirm your A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN hold as stated, and tell me whether any German unit moves toward Holland or Belgium.

France to England, Fall 1949: My units hold this autumn, F BRE stays out of the Channel and MAO, and I ask F NTH, F LVP and A LON to stay out of Brest and Iberia. Please confirm in writing your orders for these units.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1949: Turkey at 8 must be stopped. Let's not repeat the missed timing. Spring 1950: your A UKR and fleet strike RUM and SEV; I will move A MUN and A RUH toward Bohemia and Vienna as the Austrian pact allows. Confirm in writing before Spring orders. This autumn my armies hold and stay out of WAR, SWE and STP.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1949: Still holding. Turkey has 8 centres and must not be stopped by a deal that helps Russia. Confirm in writing that F AEG and A BUL stay out of Greece and the Ionian this autumn, and tell me before any move on SEV or RUM.

Italy to France, Fall 1949: Your A PAR and A MAR are idle while Turkey grows. Name your exact autumn orders in writing. If you move on Burgundy or Piedmont-adjacent positions, I will support the western plan against Turkey and keep A NAP, A TUN and F TYS ready.

Italy to Austria, Fall 1949: A VEN to Tyrolia stays our arrangement if Germany moves on Vienna. I am holding this autumn. Tell me whether Turkey's A BUD is still pressing Trieste, and keep F TRI and A VIE off Venice and Albania.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1949: Your A RUM and F SEV still threaten my southern border. I am ready to deal: withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia now, keep F SEV in place, and my armies stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV. Confirm in writing before the deadline.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1949: Turkey leads at 8 and we both gain if its Balkan centres fall. Name your Fall orders for A MUN or A BER toward BUL or SER in writing. My A UKR presses RUM, and WAR, SWE, STP stay closed to your armies as pledged.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1949: My armies stay out of GAL, VIE, BUD and TRI. If you strike Budapest this fall, A UKR presses Rumania and may support you against Turkey's units. Send your Fall orders in writing so we can coordinate before the deadline.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1949: Your A UKR is the closest threat to my A RUM and F SEV. I propose we both stay put: your armies stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV, and my units stay out of UKR, GAL and WAR. Confirm in writing this autumn's orders for UKR and WAR.

Turkey to Austria, Fall 1949: I will not move toward VIE or TRI this autumn, and A BUD stays put for now. Please keep A GAL out of RUM and SER, and tell me your Fall orders in writing so we both keep our centres while Russia remains the main danger.

Austria to Russia, Fall 1949: Budapest is the target only if you commit. I need A UKR to move to Galicia or Rumania this fall, supporting A VIE to BUD. Confirm in writing before orders. A WAR and A MOS must stay out of Galicia, Vienna and Budapest. Without your written commitment I hold VIE and TRI.

Austria to Italy, Fall 1949: Confirmed, A VIE and F TRI hold this autumn, with no move toward Venice or Albania. Turkey's A BUD still presses us, and I may strike it this fall with Russian support. Keep A VEN ready for Tyrolia if Germany moves on Vienna, and keep A ROM, A TUN and F ION off Trieste and Albania.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1949: BUD remains a breach until withdrawn. Withdraw A BUD to Serbia or Rumania and Budapest returns to Austria. Otherwise I may strike it this fall. I will keep A VIE and F TRI off your core while you hold to our pact. Confirm in writing that A BUD, A BUL and A RUM stay out of Vienna and Trieste.

England to France, Fall 1949: I will hold F NTH, A LON and F LVP this autumn and keep them out of Brest and Iberia as pledged. I will not move toward Belgium without exact written timing from both of us first. Please confirm your A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F BRE hold and stay out of the Channel and my waters.

France to England, Fall 1949: I will not move A PAR to Burgundy or toward Belgium this autumn, so there is no Belgium plan to confirm. My A PAR, A MAR, F BRE, A POR and A SPA hold. I ask F NTH, F LVP and A LON to stay out of Brest, the Channel toward Brest and Iberia, as pledged.

France to Italy, Fall 1949: My A PAR, A MAR, F BRE, A POR and A SPA hold this autumn, with no move toward Tunisia, Naples or Africa. Your A TUN and F TYS stay where they are as far as I know. Any Turkey plan needs exact written timing from both of us first.

Germany to France, Fall 1949: My A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN hold this autumn. No German unit moves toward Holland-to-France routes, Burgundy or Picardy. Keep your A PAR, A MAR, F BRE, A POR and A SPA off Munich, Ruhr and Belgium as agreed. We will talk a Turkey check once Turkey's moves are visible.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1949: Turkey at 8 must be stopped. I will confirm in writing before Spring orders: A MUN and A RUH move toward Bohemia and Vienna under the Austrian pact, not Balkan targets this turn. This autumn my armies hold and stay out of WAR, SWE and STP. Keep your A UKR and fleet pressure on RUM and SEV.

Italy to France, Fall 1949: A TUN and F TYS hold this autumn. Neither moves toward Spain, Portugal or Marseille, and neither enters Africa from Tunis. Please confirm your A SPA and A POR stay out of North Africa and off Italian centres, and that A PAR and A MAR stay off Piedmont and Tunisia. We talk in writing before any change.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1949: My A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay out of Galicia, Vienna and Budapest. A UKR will not move to Galicia this fall, so I cannot support A VIE to BUD from GAL. I will not enter Rumania or Serbia with armies either. Strike Budapest on your own if you choose; I will not commit further in writing before orders.

Russia to England, Fall 1949: A NOR and A SWE hold this autumn, and no Russian unit enters the North Sea or Edinburgh. I will not move A WAR or A SWE against Germany this autumn, so do not count on that. Keep F NTH and F LVP off Norway and Sweden and we stay at peace. Let us revisit spring openings then.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1949: Your pledge to hold is noted, but I need concrete moves. Name whether A MUN or A BER goes toward BUL or SER in Spring 1950, in writing. My A UKR presses RUM; WAR, SWE and STP stay closed to your armies as pledged, provided your armies stay out too. I will confirm Spring orders once you commit.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1949: I will not confirm a line while A RUM and F SEV sit on my border. Withdraw A RUM to Bulgaria or Serbia now and keep F SEV in place, and my armies stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV. Without that, my A UKR acts against your Rumanian army.

Turkey to Italy, Fall 1949: Confirmed in writing: no Turkish army enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian this autumn, and F AEG stays out of the Ionian. A BUL stays put. I will tell you before any move on SEV or RUM. Please keep A TUN, A NAP and F TYS off Bulgaria and Constantinople, as agreed.

Turkey to Russia, Fall 1949: I will not withdraw from Rumania, and I am not moving F SEV. I confirm my units will not enter UKR, GAL or WAR this autumn. Your A UKR is the threat to my RUM and SEV. If your armies stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV, we both hold. Confirm your UKR and WAR moves in writing.

notes.note: Fall 1949: Russia refused written support for VIE to BUD; attacking alone bounces. Holding VIE and TRI. Keep pacts with Italy (VEN to TYR if Germany moves) and Turkey. Revisit if Russia commits or BUD vacates.

Fall 1949: holds all. Unsupported attacks on RUM/SEV would bounce. Keep WAR, SWE, STP, NOR closed to Germany. Turkey refused to withdraw RUM/SEV. Seek a real Balkan partner for a legal support setup before striking.

Fall 1949: holds kept, pledges to Germany, Italy and England honored. F WES to MAO sets up convoy of A POR or A SPA to BRE/NAF next turn. No unowned centers; Turkey leads at 8. Watch for broken pledges; Italy and Germany have held so far.

Fall 1949: all six holds kept to protect 6 SCs and pacts with France, England, Russia, Austria, Turkey. Russia pushes Balkan strike but has not committed in writing; no German move to BUL/SER yet. Revisit if Russia commits to UKR/RUM and WAR/SWE/STP stay closed.

Fall 1949: still 3 centres. Holding LON, LVP, NTH to keep pledges to France, Germany and Russia. Germany refused the NTH-NWY and Belgium plans; Russia will not strike Germany this autumn. Revisit a convoy of A LON via NTH only if a centre opens or a pledge breaks.

Fall 1949: holding all units to keep pacts (Turkey no GRE/ALB/ION; France west; Austria VEN-TYR if Germany hits VIE). No unowned centres. Turkey and France keep word so far. Reassess Spring 1950; Austria (2 centres) is the fallback target.

Fall 1949: holding all to keep 8 centres. RUM supports BUD hold against Austria. Pacts: Italy (no Turkish army to GRE/ALB/ION, F AEG out) kept by me; Austria demands BUD withdrawal (refused); Russia wants RUM/SEV out (refused). Watch A UKR and Austrian VIE/TRI. Consider SYR/ARM expansion later.

messages.body: Austria to Turkey, Spring 1950: Budapest is still your breach, and I am weak. Withdraw A BUD to Serbia or Rumania this spring and Budapest returns to Austria, ending the dispute. If you hold BUD, I will keep VIE and TRI defensive but will press for it later. Confirm your Spring orders in writing.

Austria to Russia, Spring 1950: Turkey's Balkan army is the shared threat. Please move A UKR to Rumania and attack Sevastopol or Rumania, drawing Turkish units away from Budapest. I will hold VIE and TRI and not enter Galicia or Warsaw. Confirm in writing whether A UKR attacks RUM this spring.

Austria to Germany, Spring 1950: Please confirm A MUN and A RUH stay out of Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest, Trieste and Bohemia this spring. If you plan any move toward Bohemia or Silesia, tell me in writing before orders, as agreed.

England to Germany, Spring 1950: Turkey leads at 8 centres and England is stuck at 3. I propose F NTH to NWY is not wanted now; instead I ask whether you will hold DEN and HOL this spring, and whether you will move A BER toward Prussia so Russia's SWE and NOR are contested. Confirm your orders in writing before I move.

France to Italy, Spring 1950: My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F MAO hold this spring unless you tell me otherwise. Turkey leads at 8, and we both need centres. Please state in writing whether A TUN or A NAP plans any move toward Algeria or Tunisia-adjacent territory this spring, and whether F TYS stays in the Tyrrhenian.

France to England, Spring 1950: My units hold this spring. F MAO stays out of the Channel and Brest approaches, and A SPA and A POR stay out of Iberian waters you need. Please confirm in writing that F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of Brest and MAO this spring.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1950: Strike Turkey's Balkan centres with your A UKR and fleet on RUM and SEV, and I will not interfere. My A MUN and A RUH hold this spring and stay out of WAR, SWE and STP. I cannot send an army to BUL or SER without breaking my Austrian pact, so I will not commit to that. Confirm your Spring orders in writing and I will hold to this.

Italy to France, Spring 1950: Turkey is at 8 and will win unless stopped. Proposal: A PAR to BUR and A MAR to PIE now, I move F TYS to the western Med and A TUN to ALG-ready positions, and we coordinate Spain/Portugal later. Reply with exact Spring orders in writing before we move.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1950: You hold 8 centres and I am watching you closely. Confirm in writing that A BUL, A SER and F AEG stay out of Greece, Albania and the Ionian this spring. Tell me your exact SEV and RUM orders now.

Italy to Austria, Spring 1950: Turkey's A BUD is your real threat, not Italy. If you hold VIE and F TRI, I will keep A VEN ready for Tyrolia. Tell me your exact spring orders against BUD, and whether you will support my F TYS toward Trieste if Turkey pushes.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1950: Turkey at 8 is the common problem. Concrete proposal: your A MUN moves to BOH this spring, and in Fall toward GAL or VIE-side, not WAR, SWE or STP. My A UKR attacks RUM this spring. Confirm your Spring orders in writing before I commit my Spring orders.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1950: Your A RUM and F SEV still sit on my southern border. Withdraw A RUM to BUL or SER this spring and keep F SEV in place, and my armies stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV. Otherwise my A UKR attacks your Rumanian army. Confirm in writing before orders.

Russia to Italy, Spring 1950: Turkey leads at 8 and only a coalition can stop it. Press Turkey from the Adriatic and Greece, and I will press RUM and SEV from the north. Keep your fleets out of Balkan waters that I need, and confirm your Spring orders for GRE and the Adriatic in writing.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1950: Your A UKR threatens my RUM and SEV. I hold my line and will not enter UKR, GAL or WAR. Confirm in writing that your armies stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV this spring, and tell me your UKR and WAR orders.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1950: A BUD, BUL and RUM hold this spring and I will not move toward VIE or TRI. Keep A GAL out of RUM and SER and tell me your Spring orders in writing so we both keep our centres.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1950: No Turkish army enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian this spring, and F AEG stays out of the Ionian. My orders are holds. Keep A TUN, A NAP and F TYS off Bulgaria and Constantinople, and send your Spring orders in writing.

Austria to Italy, Spring 1950: Spring orders: A VIE holds, F TRI holds, A BUD stays put as far as I can control it. I will not move toward Venice or Albania. I cannot support your F TYS toward Trieste while my units hold, but I will not block it either. Keep A VEN ready for Tyrolia if Germany moves on Vienna, and keep A ROM, A TUN and F TYS off Trieste and Albania as agreed.

Austria to Turkey, Spring 1950: I will not confirm your holds in writing while A BUD remains Turkish. Withdraw A BUD to Serbia or Rumania this spring and Budapest returns to Austria, and I keep my units out of Serbia and Rumania. My Spring orders: A VIE and F TRI hold. Hold your units as you say, and we avoid a clash this season.

England to France, Spring 1950: Confirmed in writing. F NTH, A LON and F LVP hold this spring and will not enter Brest, MAO or Iberia. Please keep F MAO, A SPA and A POR out of the Channel, Brest approaches and Irish Sea as you pledged. Any Belgium or Holland move will require exact written timing from both of us before any order.

France to Italy, Spring 1950: I decline the proposal to move A PAR to Burgundy or A MAR to Piedmont this spring. My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F MAO hold. Please keep A TUN, A NAP and F TYS out of Marseille, Spain, Portugal, Corsica and the Gulf of Lyon. Any Turkey plan must wait until we agree exact orders and timing in writing.

Germany to Austria, Spring 1950: Confirmed. A MUN and A RUH hold this spring and will not enter Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest, Trieste or Bohemia. I have no army aimed at Silesia. If my plans toward Bohemia or Silesia change, you will hear it in writing before orders.

Germany to England, Spring 1950: I decline the NTH-NWY idea for now. A BER, A HOL, F DEN, A KIE, A BEL and A MUN all hold this spring, and A BER does not move toward Prussia. My fleets stay out of the North Sea and Channel. Keep F NTH, F ENG and F LVP off my centres and I will give written notice of any change.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1950: I will not move A MUN to Bohemia or send any army to BUL or SER this spring, as it would break my Austrian pact. A MUN and A RUH hold and no German army enters WAR, SWE or STP. Strike RUM and SEV with your own forces as you see fit. I will not interfere.

Italy to France, Spring 1950: A NAP, A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS hold this spring. None enters Algeria, Tunisia-adjacent Africa, Spain or Marseille. Your A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F MAO holding is fine by me. We will exchange written orders before any autumn move against Turkey.

Italy to Turkey, Spring 1950: My orders are holds: A NAP, A ROM, A VEN, A TUN and F TYS. No Italian unit goes near Bulgaria or Constantinople. Your written pledge on Greece, Albania and the Ionian is noted. Any change to SEV or RUM must be told to me in writing first.

Italy to Russia, Spring 1950: My Spring orders are holds in NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and TYS, so no fleet enters the Balkans or Greece this year. I agree Turkey must be pressed. Pressure from your side on RUM and SEV is welcome. I will tell you in writing before any Adriatic move.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1950: I will not withdraw my positions or make a line while A RUM and F SEV stand on my border. My A UKR may strike RUM this spring. Move A RUM out to BUL or SER and keep F SEV in place, and my armies will stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1950: My A WAR, A MOS and A STP stay out of GAL, VIE, BUD and TRI as pledged. I will not commit A UKR to RUM in writing before orders. Hold your VIE and TRI, and I will decide my Spring moves on the board. Keep your Serbia plans out of my sphere.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1950: Your A MUN to BOH this spring is acceptable to me, provided your armies stay out of WAR, SWE and STP. I am still deciding my own Spring orders, so send me your confirmed orders in writing first, and I will reply before the deadline.

Turkey to Austria, Spring 1950: BUD stays Turkish this spring. I will not move A BUD, BUL or RUM toward VIE or TRI, and I ask that A GAL stay out of RUM and SER. Russia's threat on our shared northern flank is the real danger, so let us both hold and keep our centres.

Turkey to Russia, Spring 1950: My RUM and SEV units hold and will not enter UKR, GAL or WAR. I expect your armies to stay out of RUM, BUL, SER, CON and SEV this spring. Your A UKR is the threat I am watching. Confirm your UKR and WAR orders in writing.

Turkey to Italy, Spring 1950: Confirmed in writing: no Turkish army enters Greece, Albania or the Ionian this spring, and F AEG stays out of the Ionian. A BUL and A SER hold. My orders are holds with no move on SEV or RUM. Keep A TUN, A NAP and F TYS off Bulgaria and Constantinople.

notes.note: Spring 1950: holding VIE and TRI as pledged. Turkey keeps BUD; no support available from Russia. Germany confirmed MUN/RUH hold. Italy keeps VEN ready. Revisit if BUD vacates or Russia commits UKR to RUM/GAL in writing.

Spring 1950: holds kept, pledges to Germany, Italy, England honored. F MAO to WES sets up convoy of A SPA/POR to NAF next turn (Fall 1950 or Spring 1951). Turkey leads at 8; need growth via Africa. Italy proposal to attack Burgundy/Piedmont declined.

Spring 1950: holding LON, LVP, NTH per pledges to France and Germany. Germany and France kept their holds this spring. Russia has not confirmed. Still 3 centres. Revisit a convoy via NTH if a centre opens or a pledge breaks.

Spring 1950: holding all units to keep written pacts (Turkey: no GRE/ALB/ION entry; France: west holds; Austria: VEN-TYR). Turkey and France have kept word so far. Turkey at 8 is the threat. Fall 1950: reassess, Austria (2 centres) is fallback target; agree written orders with France first.

Spring 1950: holding all 6 SCs per pacts with Austria, England, France, Russia. Russia has not committed in writing to Turkey strike; Russia's WAR/SWE/STP closure kept. No German move to BOH/BUL/SER. Revisit a Balkan or Bohemia move only if Russia confirms UKR/RUM orders in writing first.

Spring 1950: all hold. Unsupported UKR attacks on RUM/SEV would bounce; no legal support available. Turkey refuses to withdraw RUM/SEV. Keep NOR/SWE/STP closed to Germany; Austria and Germany pacts stand. Seek Germany or Italy support for a real Balkan strike in Fall.

Spring 1950: all hold, keeping pacts with Italy (no Greece/Albania/Ionian, AEG out) and Austria/Russia lines unconfirmed. Austria demands BUD withdrawal (refused). Russia threatens RUM/SEV via UKR. A SYR holds, taking unowned SYR in Fall. Watch Russian UKR and Austrian VIE/TRI. Consider ARM expansion later.

messages.body: Austria to Russia, Fall 1950: Turkey's Balkan army is the shared threat. If you move A UKR to Galicia or Rumania and support my A VIE to Budapest, we both gain. Confirm in writing before orders. Otherwise I hold VIE and TRI, and A WAR and A MOS stay out of Galicia and Vienna.

Austria to Turkey, Fall 1950: Budapest is still your breach. Withdraw A BUD to Serbia or Rumania this fall and it returns to Austria, ending the dispute. Keep A BUL and A RUM away from Vienna and Trieste. I hold VIE and TRI this fall.
Austria to Italy, Fall 1950: A VIE and F TRI hold this fall, with no Austrian move toward Venice or Albania. Keep A VEN ready for Tyrolia if Germany moves on Vienna, and keep your fleets off Trieste.

England to Germany, Fall 1950: I am at 3 centres and need growth. Germany holds BEL, HOL, DEN; I will not move F NTH into your waters this autumn. Will you confirm in writing whether you will keep A BEL, A HOL, F DEN and A RUH holding, and whether any Germany unit plans to leave for Russia or France?

England to France, Fall 1950: I have kept my pledges: F NTH, A LON and F LVP hold and stay out of Brest, MAO and Iberia. Please confirm in writing that A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR, F WES and F BRE will not move toward the Channel or Belgium this autumn.

England to Russia, Fall 1950: Germany holds 6 centres and is the shared threat. Will you confirm in writing whether A WAR, A SWE, A NOR and A STP will hold this autumn? If you plan any move against Germany, tell me first so we can coordinate.

France to Italy, Fall 1950: Turkey leads at 8 and both of us need growth. I propose we each keep our current holds this autumn, with A TUN and F TYS staying out of Algeria and Marseille, and my armies staying out of Piedmont and Tunisia. Please confirm in writing and tell me your Fall orders.

France to Germany, Fall 1950: Please confirm in writing that A MUN, A RUH, A BEL, A HOL, A BER and F DEN hold this autumn, with no move toward Burgundy or Picardy. My A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR and F WES hold as well. Tell me if any German unit heads toward Holland or Belgium.

France to England, Fall 1950: My units hold this autumn: A PAR, A MAR, A SPA, A POR, F WES. Please confirm F NTH, F LVP and A LON stay out of the Channel toward Brest, MAO and Iberia as pledged. I will keep my fleets away from your waters.

Germany to Austria, Fall 1950: Confirmed in writing. A MUN and A RUH hold this autumn and will not enter Tyrolia, Vienna, Budapest, Trieste or Bohemia. I have no army aimed at Silesia. This is the final turn, so I see no reason for either of us to change course.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1950: My A MUN and A RUH hold and no German army enters WAR, SWE or STP. If you strike Turkey's RUM and SEV with your own forces, I will not interfere. Please confirm your Fall orders in writing, since this is the last turn.

Italy to Turkey, Fall 1950: Turkey at 8 is the problem and I will not sit idle while you grow. Hold your word on Greece and Albania. I am now considering Greek or Balkan moves to limit you, so state plainly whether A SER or A BUL moves toward GRE this autumn.
